text.body:
<ṭitle page>
|| śrīḥ ||
<śrīrāmatoṣaṇa bhaṭṭācāryeṇa>
<śrījīvānandavidyāsāgarabhaṭṭācaryyeṇa prakāśitā |>
<1898 āḍ>
[4 kāmyakāṇḍa]
nityānandamayī nitāntanipuṇā bhakteṣṭasiddhyai nirākārā nūtananūtanollikhitakṛt prajñāsvarūpā kaveḥ | śabdārthobhayarūpiṇī śatasudhāṃśūddīptaśociḥ sadā dhyātā cetasi me cakāstu rucirā vāgīśvarī nirmalā ||
śrīyuktaḥ prāṇakṛṣṇo gurucaraṇasarojātasaṃlīnacetā datā khyātaḥ pramātā suvihitakṛtiko brahmasaṃsthāpakaḥ stāt | bhogāḍhyo dīrghajīvī yadanumativaśādudgateyaṃ vipaścidvṛndaṃ śrīprāṇatoṣiṇyatimṛdulalatā hlādayatvadrikāṇḍaiḥ |
ādeṣṭratyantaśīghratvahetunā doṣarāśayaḥ |
atra jātā budhaiḥ śodhyā iti bhūyo nivedanam ||
kāmyakāṇḍasya nirghaṇṭa ādau caitanyameva ca |
sarvasāmeva vidyānāṃ mantrārthastadanantaram |
kullukā ca tathā seturmahāsetustataḥ param |
nirvāṇaṃ mukhaśuddhiśca prāṇayogastataḥ param |
dīpanīsūtakonmuktijapakramanirūpaṇam |
kullukādestathā sthānaṃ puraścaryā tataḥ param |
vāramāsapuraścaryārahasyādipuraskriyā |
grahaṇakālapuraścaryā tatra saṅkalpavāraṇam |
mālāprakaraṇamiti prathamaccheda ucyate || 1 ||
sādhanasthānanirṇītimahāpīṭhanirūpaṇam |
mahāpīṭhāni pīṭhāni tathaiva pīṭhadevatāḥ |
pūjākālastadviśeṣastathā devārcanāvidhiḥ |
ekāhādikramādbādhe kartavyanirṇayastataḥ |
prāyaścittamiticchedadvitīyasya samāpanam|| 2 ||
kṛkalāsākhumārjāraśṛgālakhādisādhanam |
iṣṭasādhanabhedāśca trivāṭādeśca sādhanam |
kārtavīryaprayogastatkavacaṃ tadanantaram |
paricchedatṛtīyasya samāpanamataḥ param || 3 ||
kukkuṭasya prayogaścocchiṣṭacāṇḍālinī tataḥ |
dhūmāvatī tataḥ kṛtyā parimālātmikā tataḥ |
jayadurgādiriti vai turyacchedasamāpanam || 4 ||
durgotsavasya ṣaṣṭhyādikalpatatkālanirṇayaḥ |
pūjādhāraśca mṛṇmayyā niṣedhavidhikīrtanam |
brāhmaṇādivarṇabhede vilvayugmasya nirṇayaḥ |
pūrvādidiśyamālūrayugmasya phalakīrtanam |
bilvayugmasya mṛṇmayyāścātra doṣaścuktau tathā |
tatprāyaścittakathanamutsavādinirūpaṇam |
tatrānyakarmatyāgaśca pūjākarma tataḥ param |
deśabhede mūrtibhedo maṇḍapantu tataḥ param |
ṣaṣṭhīkṛtyañca dikpālāstantrapūjāvidhireva ca |
balidānādi ca tato bilvavṛkṣanimantraṇam |
tataśca saptamīkṛtyaṃ kārtikādeḥ prapūjanam |
patrikāpūjanaṃ stotramaṣṭamīkṛtyameva ca |
niśīthakṛtyaṃ navamīkṛtyañca daśamīkriyā |
paricchedapañcamasya samāptiriti kīrtitam || 5 ||
durgāmantrastasya ṛṣiḥ puraścaryā ca yantrakam |
dhyānaṃ stutistato durgānāmamahātmyakīrtanam |
durgāyāḥ śatanāmākhyastotraṃ gītāvalistataḥ |
homaprakaraṇaṃ tasya dravyasya parimāṇakam |
mānādhyāya idaṃ ṣaṣṭhaparicchedasamāpanam || 6 ||
māsakṛtyaṃ tataḥ khañjarīṭaduṣṭiśca tatphalam |
kojāgarākhyakṛtyañca kṛtyaṃ kārtikamāsikam |
agrahāyaṇakṛtyāni pauṣakṛtyaṃ tataḥ param |
māghakṛtyaṃ phālgunasya kṛtyāni tadanantaram |
varṣakṛtyaṃ hṛtarājyarājyāptisādhanaṃ tataḥ |
devīṣoḍaśayātrā ca māsimāsi yathāditaḥ |
vaiśākhe mañjuyātrā ca prathamā parikīrtitā |
jyaiṣṭhe mahāsnānayātrā rathayātrādikā śucau |
śrāvaṇe jalayātrā ca bhādre ca dhūnanaṃ tathā |
āśvine ca mahāpūjā kārtike dīpayātrikā |
mārge navānnayātrā ca pauṣe'ṅgarāgarūpiṇī |
māghe yātrā raṭantyākhyā phālgune dolayātrikā |
dūtīyātrā rāsayātrā vāsantīnītyayātrikā |
etāścatasraścaitre tu ṣoḍaśīyātrikā matā |
digdarśanārthaṃ saṅghepānnirghaṇṭo vihito mayā |
anyānyapi yathāsthānaṃ veditavyāni paṇḍitaiḥ ||
idaṃ granthiśākhāpraśākhāsupatraistathā tārakaiḥ suprasūnaiḥ phalaiśca |
sadāśāṃ janānāṃ budhopāsakānāṃ prapūrṇāṃ vidhātā drutaṃ kāmyakāṇḍam ||
kāli hṛdabje śaṅkari (!) nityam |
rājatu devādhīśvarapūjye (!) |
atha caitanyam |
kubjikāyantre pañcamapaṭale ||
śrīpārvatyuvāca ||
bhagavan (!) sarvadeveśa (!) lokānāṃ hitakāraka (!) |
caturvargapradaṃ deva (!) caitanyaṃ me prakāśaya ||
śaṅkara uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi (!) pravakṣyāmi caitanyaṃ paramādbhutam |
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ gopanīyaṃ tvayā punaḥ |
cicchaktyā dhvanitaṃ devi (!) pariṇāmakrameṇa tu |
varṇabhāvaṃ samātyajya nirmalaṃ vimalātmakam |
ṣaṭcakrañca tathā bhittvā śabdarūpaṃ sanātanam |
nādabindusamāyuktaṃ caitanyaṃ parikīrtitam |
atha vānyaprakāreṇa śrūyatāṃ padmalocane (!) |
vinā yena na sidhyettu japapūjādi kiñcana |
anāhatasya madhye tu grathitaṃ varṇamuttamam |
suṣumnāvartmanā devi (!) kaṇṭhadeśaṃ vinirgatam |
caitanyañca maheśāni (!) yogināṃ yogarūpakam |
sahasrāre varṇarūpaṃ pariṇāmakrameṇa tu |
karṇikāmadhyasaṃsthe tu nādabindusamanvitam |
evaṃ sañcintayeddevīṃ caitanyañca punaḥ punaḥ |
mantrākṣarāṇi cicchaktau grathitāni maheśvari (!) |
tāni sañcintayeddevi (!) sahasrāradale tathā |
caitanyamantrarūpā ca caitanyānandadāyinī |
caitanyanādaśaktiśca caitanyavarṇarūpakam |
maṇipūre sadā cintyaṃ mantrāṇāṃ prāṇarūpakam |
athavānyaprakāreṇa śrūyatāṃ varavarṇini (!) |
kāmabījaṃ ramābījaṃ śaktibījaṃ sureśvari (!) |
etāni pūrvamuccārya mātṛkāṃ tadanantaram |
puṭitaṃ mūlamantrañca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet |
koṭikoṭiguṇañcaiva labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
athavānyaprakāreṇa caitanyaṃ śṛṇu pārvati (!) |
yena vijñānamātreṇa paramaṃ paśyati dhruvam |
sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ cintayenmūlamantrakam |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ jāpyaṃ mūlavidyāsvarūpakam |
guruṃ sañcintayettatra śivarūpaṃ sanātanam |
śaktiñca cintayettatra brahmarūpāṃ sanātanīm |
evaṃ sañcintayedyastu japedvā surasundari (!) |
nāsādhyaṃ tasya loke'smin muktirdevi (!) kare sthitā |
tathā prathamapaṭale ||
mantrārthaṃ mantracaitanyaṃ yonimudrāṃ na vetti yaḥ |
na sidhyati varārohe (!) kalpakoṭiśatairapi |
śatakoṭijapenāpi tasya vidyā na sidhyatīti sarasvatī tantre pāṭhaḥ ||
kathayāmi mahāmantraṃ mantrārthañca maheśvari (!) |
yena vijñānamātreṇa sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
kevalaṃ bhāvabuddhyā ca mantrārthaṃ prāṇavallabhe (!) |
kevalaṃ jñānayogena jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam |
kālītārā mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśvarī |
bhairavī chinnamastā ca vidyā dhūmāvatī priye (!) |
bagalā caiva mātaṅgī kamalā ca prakīrtitā |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiścaturvedairnamaskṛtā |
bhogadā mokṣadā devi (!) koṭibrahmāṇḍagopitā |
asyā grahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmuktastu sādhakaḥ ||
varadātantre ṣaṣṭhapaṭale |
śiva uvāca ||
mantrārthaṃ kathayāmyadya śṛṇuṣva parameśvari (!) |
vinā yena na sidhyettu sādhanaiḥ koṭiśaḥ śive (!) |
ādau prāsādabījasya mantrārthaṃ śṛṇu pārvati (!) |
sivavācī hakārastu aukāraḥ syāt sadāśivaḥ |
śūnyaṃ duḥkhaharārthantu tasmāttena śivaṃ yajet ||
hauṃ ||
da durgāvācakaṃ devi (!) |
ukāraścāpi rakṣaṇe |
viśvamātā nādarūpaḥ kurvartho bindurūpakaḥ |
tasmāttenaiva bījena durgāmārādhayecchive (!) ||
dūṃ ||
ka kālī brahma ra proktaṃ mahāmāyārthakaśca ī |
viśvamātārthako nādo bindurduḥkhaharārthakaḥ |
tenaiva kālikādevīṃ pūjayedduḥkhaśāntaye ||
krīṃ ||
hakāraḥ śivavācī syāt rephaḥ prakṛtirucyate |
mahāmāyārtha īśabdo nādo viśvagrasūḥ smṛtaḥ |
duḥkhaharārthako bindurbhuvanāṃ tena pūjayet ||
hrīṃ ||
mahālakṣmyarthakaḥ śaḥ syāddhanārdho repha ucyate |
īstuṣṭyartho'paro nādo bindurduḥkhaharārthakaḥ |
lakṣmīdevyā bījametattena devīṃ prapūjayet ||
śrīṃ ||
sarasvatyartha aiśabdo bindurduḥkhaharārthakaḥ |
sarasvatyā bījametattena vāṇīṃ prapūjayet ||
aiṃ ||
ka kāmadeva udiṣṭo'pyathavā kṛṣṇa ucyate |
la indra ī tuṣṭivācī sukhaduḥkhapradañca aṃ |
kāmabījārthaṃ uktaste tava snehānmaheśvari (!) |
klīṃ ||
ha śivaḥ kathito devi (!) u bhairava ihocyate |
parārtho nādaśabdastu bindurduḥkhaharārthakaḥ |
varmabījatrayo hyatra kathitastava yatnataḥ ||
hūṃ ||
gaṇeśārtho ga uktaste bindurduḥkhaharārthakaḥ |
gaṃ bījārthantu kathitaṃ tava snehānmaheśvari (!) |
gaṃ ||
ga gaṇeśavyāpakārtho lakārasteja au mataḥ |
duḥkhaharārthako bindurgaṇeśaṃ tena pūjayet ||
glauṃ ||
kṣaṇṛsiṃho vrahmā raśca ūrddhadantārthakaśca au |
duḥkhaharārthako bindurnṛsiṃhaṃ tena pūjayet |
kṣrauṃ ||
nāmādivarṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ nāma uktaṃ svayambhu vā |
tenaivārthantu jānīyādarthalabhyantu cintayet |
yathāyathaṃ vibhaktyantaṃ mantrārthe cintayecchive (!) |
tattadvarṇādiyogena saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ tvayi |
durgottāraṇavācyaḥ sa tārakārthastakārakaḥ |
muktyartho repha ukto'tra mahāmāyārthakaśca ī |
viśvamātārthako nādo bindurduḥkhaharārthakaḥ ||
vadhūbījārtha ukto'tra tava snehānmaheśvari (!) ||
strīṃ ||
yatra bindudvayaṃ mantre ekaṃ duḥkhaharārthakam |
anyat sukhapradaṃ devi (!) jñātvā cārthaṃ vicintayet |
yatra bindudvayaṃ mantre anyat pūrṇārthakaṃ matam |
svāhāmātrārthakā devi (!) parārthā vāṃ prakīrtitā |
śakramātā vaṣaṭ proktā haripriyārthakā girā |
surārthā phaṭ hayagrīve vivriṃbījaṃ vinirdiśet |
yaṃ bījaṃ vāyuvācī syāt lamaindraṃ parikīrtitam |
anekākṣarabīje ca svasvabījaṃ svanāmakam |
evaṃ jñātvā maheśāni (!) mantrārthaṃ paricintayet |
ekabījadvayaṃ yatra pṛthagarthaṃ prakalpayet |
vīpsārthaṃ vā maheśāni (!) jñātvā mantraṃ japeddhiyā |
iti te kathito devi (!) mantrārthaḥ parameśvari (!) |
īṃ bījenaiva puṭitaṃ mūlamantraṃ japed yadi |
tadeva mantracaitanyaṃ bhavatyeva suniścitam ||
sarasvatītantre prathamapaṭale ||
īśvara uvāca ||
mantrārthaṃ parameśāni (!) sāvadhānāvadharaya |
mūlādhāre mūlavidyāṃ bhāvayediṣṭadevatām |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśāṃ bhāvayet parameśvarīm |
dhārayedakṣaraśreṇīmiṣṭavidyāṃ sanātanīm |
muhūrtārddhaṃ vibhāvyaitāṃ paścāddhyānaparo bhavet |
dhyānaṃ kṛtvā maheśāni (!) muhūrtārddhaṃ tataḥ param |
tato jīvo maheśāni (!) manasā kamalekṣaṇe (!) |
svādhiṣṭhānaṃ tato gatvā bhāvayediṣṭadevatām |
bandhūkāruṇasaṅkāśāṃ javāsindūrasannibhām |
vibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīṃ padmamadhyagatāṃ parām |
tato jīvaḥ prasannātmā pakṣiṇā sahasundari (!) |
maṇipūraṃ tato gatvā bhāvayediṣṭadevatām |
vibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīṃ padmamadhyagatāṃ parām |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśāṃ śiraḥpadmoparisthitām |
tato jīvo maheśāni (!) pakṣiṇā saha pārvati (!) |
hṛtpadmaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ nīrajāyatalocane (!) |
iṣṭavidyāṃ maheśāni (!) bhāvayet kamalopari (!)
vibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīṃ mahāmarakataprabhām |
tato jīvo varārohe (!) viśuddhaṃ prayayau priye (!) |
hṛtpadmagahanaṃ gatvā pakṣiṇā saha pārvati (!) |
iṣṭaṃvidyāṃ maheśāni (!) ājñāṃśe paricintayet |
pakṣiṇā saha deveśi (!) khañjanākṣi (!) sucismite (!) |
iṣṭavidyāṃ maheśāni (!) sākṣādbrahmasvarūpiṇīm |
vibhāvya akṣaraśreṇīṃ haridvarṇāṃ varānane (!) |
ājñācakre maheśāni (!) ṣaṭcakre dhyānamācaret |
ṣaṭcakre parameśāni (!) dhyānaṃ kṛtvā sucismite (!) |
dhyānena parameśāni (!) yadrūpaṃ samupasthitam |
tadeva parameśāni (!) mantrārthaṃ viddhi pārvati (!) ||
atha kullukādi |
sarasvatītantre tṛtīyapaṭale ||
tārāyāḥ kullukā devi (!) mahānīlasarasvatī |
pañcākṣarī kālikāyāḥ kullukā parikīrtitā |
kālī kūrcaṃ badhūrmāyā phaṭkārāntā maheśvari (!) |
chinnāyāstu maheśāni (!) kullukāṣṭākṣarī bhavet |
vajravairocanīye ca ante varma prapūjayet |
sampatpradāyāḥ prathamaṃ bhairavyāḥ kullukā bhavet |
śrīmattripurasundaryāḥ kullukā dvādaśākṣarī |
vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ bījaṃ kāmabījamanantaram |
lajjābījaṃ tataḥ paścāttripureti tataḥ param |
bhagavatīti tatpaścādante ṭhadvayamuddharet |
athavā kāmabījañca kullukā parikīrtitā |
prāsādabījaṃ śambhośca mañjughoṣe ṣaḍakṣaram |
ekārṇā bhuvaneśvaryā viṣṇoḥ syādaṣṭavarṇakam |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti praṇavādyañca kullukā |
mātaṅgyāḥ prathamaṃ bījaṃ māyā dhūmāvatīṃ prati |
bālāyāśca badhūbījaṃ lakṣmyāśca nijabījakam |
sarasvatyā vāgbhavañca annadāyā anaṅgakā |
apareṣāñca devānāṃ mantramātraṃ prakīrtitam |
iyaṃ te kathitā devi (!) saṅkṣepāt kullukā mayā |
ajñātvā kullukāmetāṃ yo japedadhamaḥ priye (!) |
pañcatvamāśu labhate siddhihānistu jāyate |
tathā japādikaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dhārayenmūrddhni kullukām ||
tathā |
viprāṇāṃ praṇavaḥ setuḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
vaiśyānāñcaiva phaṭkāro māyā śūdrasya kathyate |
ajaptvā hṛdi deveśa (!) yo vai mantraṃ samuccaret |
sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāmadhikāro na tasya hi |
mahāsetuśca deveśi (!) sundaryā bhuvaneśvarī |
kālikāyāḥ svabījañca tārāyāḥ kūrcabījakam |
anyāsāntu badhūbījaṃ mahāseturvarānane (!) |
ādau japtvā mahāsetuṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥ |
dhane dhaneśatulyo'sau vāṇyā vāṇīśvaropamaḥ |
yuddhe kṛtāntasadṛśo nārīṇāṃ madanopamaḥ |
japakālo bhavettasya sarvakālo na saṃśayaḥ |
atha vakṣyāmi nirvāṇaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahitānaghe (!) |
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya mātṛkādyaṃ samuddharet |
tato mūlaṃ maheśāni (!) tato vāgbhavamuddharet |
mātṛkāstu samastāstu punaḥ praṇavamuddharet |
evaṃ puṭitamūlantu prajapenmaṇipūrake |
evaṃ nirvāṇaṃ maheśāni (!) yo na jānāti pāmaraḥ |
kalpakoṭisahasreṇa tasya siddhirna jāyate ||
atha mukhaśodhanam ||
pañcamapaṭale ||
īśvara uvāca ||
aparaikaṃ pravakṣyāmi mtkhaśodhanamuttamam |
yatra kṛtvā mahādevi (!) japapūjā vṛthā bhavet |
aśuddhajihvayā devi (!) yo japet sa tu pāpakṛt |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena jihvāśodhanamācaret |
mahātripurasundaryā mukhasya śodhanaṃ śubhe (!) |
śrībījaṃ praṇavo lakṣmīstāraḥ śrīpraṇavastathā |
imaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ sundaryā daśadhā japet |
śṛṇu sundari (!) śyāmāyā mukhaśodhanamuttamam |
nijabījatrayaṃ devi (!) praṇavatritayaṃ punaḥ |
kāmatrayaṃ vahnibinduraticandrayutaṃ pṛthak |
eṣā navākṣarī vidyā mukhaśodhanakāriṇī |
tārāyāḥ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi (!) apūrvamukhaśodhanam |
jīvanaṃ madhyamaṃ lajjāṃ bhuvaneśīṃ tataḥ priye (!) |
tryakṣarīyaṃ mahāvidyā vijñeyā'mṛtavarṣiṇī |
durgāyāḥ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi (!) mukhaśodhanamuttamam |
dvādaśasvaramuddhṛtya binduyuktaṃ trayaṃ tathā |
aparaikaṃ pravakṣyāmi bagalāmukhaśodhanam |
vāgbhavaṃ bhuvaneśīñca vāgbījaṃ suravandite (!) |
mātaṅgyāḥ śodhanaṃ devi (!) aṅkuśaṃ vāgbhavaṃ tathā |
bījañcāṅkuśametaddhi vijñeyaṃ tryakṣarīyakam |
lakṣmyāśca śodhanaṃ devi (!) śrībījaṃ kamalānane (!) |
durgāyāḥ śodhanaṃ māyā vāgbījapuṭitā bhavet |
durge (!) svāhāpunarmāyā vāgbījañca punaśca vāk |
praṇavaṃ dāntamuddhṛtya vāmakarṇavibhūṣitam |
punaḥ praṇavamuddhṛtya dhanadāmukhaśodhanam |
evaṃ mantraṃ maheśāni (!) dhūmāvatyā bhavedapi ||
praṇavo bindumān devi (!) pañcāntako gaṇeśituḥ |
vedādigaganaṃ vahnimanuyugmantu candravat |
dvyakṣaraṃ parameśāni (!) viṣṇośca mukhaśodhanam |
anyāsāṃ praṇavaṃ devi (!) bālādīnāṃ prakīrtitam |
strīṇāñca śūdratulyaṃ hi mukhaśodhanamīritam |
mukhaśodhanamātreṇa jihvā'mṛtamayī bhavet |
anyathā mukhaviḍyuktā jihvā bhavati sarvadā |
bhakṣaṇairdūṣitā jihvā mithyāvākyena dūṣitā |
kalahairdūṣitā jihvā tatkathaṃ prajapenmanum |
tacchodhanamanācarya na japet pāmaraḥ kvacit |
śaivaśāktavaiṣṇavādeḥ sarvasyāvaśyameva vā |
anyathā prajapenmantraṃ mohena yadi bhāvini (!) |
sarvaṃ tasya vṛthā devi (!) mantrasiddhirna jāyate |
ante narakavāsī ca bhavet so'pi na cānyathā |
devo yadi japenmantramakṛtvā mukhaśodhanam |
patanaṃ tasya deveśi (!) kiṃ punarmartyavāsinām ||
ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
īśvara uvāca ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi (!) prāṇayogaṃ śṛṇuṣva me |
vinā prāṇaṃ yathā dehaḥ sarvakarmasu na kṣamaḥ |
vinā prāṇaṃ tathā mantraḥ puraścaryāśatairapi |
māyayā puṭito mantraḥ saptadhā japataḥ punaḥ |
saprāṇo jāyate devi (!) sarvatrāyaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
tathaivaṃ dīpanaṃ vakṣye sarvamantre ca bhāvini (!) |
andhakāre gṛhe yadvanna kiñcit pratibhāsate |
dīpanīrahito mantrastathaiva parikīrtitaḥ |
vedādipuṭitaṃ mantraṃ saptavāraṃ japet punaḥ |
dīpanīyaṃ samākhyātā sarvatra parameśvari (!) |
vedādipuṭitaṃ kṛtvā prayatnena sureśvari (!) |
daśadhā prajapenmantraṃ sūtakadvayamuktaye |
athocyate japasyātra kramaśca paramādbhutaḥ |
yaṃ kṛtvā siddhasaṅghānāmadhipo jāyate naraḥ |
natirgurvādināmādau tato mantraśikhāṃ bhajet |
tato'pi mantracaitanyaṃ mantrārthabhāvanā tataḥ |
gurudhyānaṃ śiraḥpadme hṛdīṣṭadhyānamāharan |
kullukāñca tataḥ setuṃ mahāsetumanantaram |
nirvāṇañca tato devi (!) yonimudrāvibhāvanā |
aṅganyāsaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ jihvāśodhanameva ca |
prāṇayogaṃ dīpanīñca aśaucabhaṅgamevaṃ ca |
bhrūmadhye vā nasoragre draṣṭisetuṃ japaṃ punaḥ |
setumaśaucabhaṅgañca prāṇāyāmamiti kramāḥ ||
caturthapaṭale ||
kullukāṃ mūrddhni sañjapya hṛdi setuṃ vicintayet |
mahāsetuṃ viśuddhau ca kaṇṭhadeśe samuddharet |
maṇipūre tu nirvāṇaṃ mahākuṇḍalinīmadhaḥ |
svādhiṣṭhāne kāmabījaṃ rākiṇīmūrddhnisaṃsthitam |
vicintya vidhivaddevi (!) mūlādhārāntikāṃ śive (!) |
viśuddhāntaṃ smareddevi (!) visatantutanīyasīm |
vedisthānaṃ hi jīvāntaṃ mūlamantrāvṛtaṃ muhuḥ ||
anyastu bījacintāmaṇyādāvanusandheyo'tra granthagauravabhiyā na likhitaḥ ||
puraścaraṇantu tantrasārakāreṇaiva dhṛtam |
puraścaraṇaviśeṣo likhyate |
kaṅkālamālinītantre ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate |
aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vīravandite (!) |
sūryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvat sūryodayāntaram |
tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate |
aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi |
astamārabhya sūryasya yāvat sūryāstamaṃ bhavet |
tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
athavā vijanasthaśca asthiśayyāsamaśca vā |
udayāstaṃ divā japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
tenāsane ca vā devi (!) astamārabhya bhāsvataḥ |
japitvodayaparyantaṃ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate |
sūryodayāt samārabhya ghaṭikādaśakaṃ kramāt |
ṛtavaḥ syurvasantādyā ahorātraṃ dine dine |
vasantagrīṣmavarṣākhyaśaraddhemantaśaiśirāḥ |
vasantaścāpi pūrvāhṇe grīṣmo madhyāhna ucyate |
aparāhṇaḥ prāviṣaḥ syuḥ pradoṣaḥ śaradaḥ smṛtaḥ |
arddharātre ca hemantaḥ śeṣe ca śiśiraṃ smṛtam |
sūryodayāt samārabhya vasantāntaṃ samāhitaḥ |
tāvajjapenmaheśāni (!) puraścaryā hi sidhyati |
tataḥ pūjādikaṃ kṛtvā śaktiyuktaśca sādhakaḥ |
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate |
grīṣmādiṣu maheśāni ṣaḍṛtuṣu ca sādhakaḥ |
pṛthagjaptvā varārohe (!) puraścaryā hi sidhyati |
pūrvoktavidhinā sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ vīravandite (!) |
ṛtau japtvā tu ṛtvante śaktitaḥ pūjayecchivām |
evamācarya kṛtyaṃ vai dhanānāmīśvaro bhavet ||
atha vārapuraścaraṇaṃ svatantratantre ||
ravivārādisarveṣu vārasaṃkhyasahasrakam |
japtvā mantraṃ sadā devi (!) sādhakaḥ siddhibhāgbhavet |
puraścaraṇametaddhi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
evaṃvidhaṃ samācarya daśāṃśantu tadācaret |
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā sarvakāmamavāpnuyāt ||
atha tithipuraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva ||
pratipattithimārabhya kuhuryāvadbhavet priye (!) |
tikhisaṃkhyākrameṇaiva varddhayecca sahasrakam |
evaṃ japtvā tadā mantrī sarvakāmamavāpnuyāt |
puraścaraṇametaddhi kathitañca varānane (!) |
pratipattithimārabhya rākā yāvadbhavet priye(!) |
tāvanmantraṃ prajātitithisaṃkhyākrameṇa tu |
sarvabhāvasamāyukto jāyate bhuvi sādhakaḥ |
etenaiva samṛddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
atha māsaniyatakāryam ||
adyetyādivaiśākhe kārtike māghe vā māsi amukarāśisthe bhāskare amukapakṣe'mukatithāvārabhya amukagotraḥ śrīamukadevaśarmā amukadevatāyā amukamantrasiddhikāmo'mukasaṃkrāntyāmārabhya meṣatulāmakarastharaviṃ yāvat pratyahamamukadevatāyā amukamantrasahasrasaṃkhyakajapameṣādāvanantarataddaśāṃśahoma(-) taddaśāṃśatarpaṇataddaśāṃsābhiṣekataddaśāṃśa(-) brāhmaṇabhojanarūpapuraścaraṇamahaṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpya māsaṃ vyāpya haviṣyānnabhuk niyamasthaḥ pratyahaṃ sahasrakṛtvo japet || tataḥ saurajyaiṣṭhasauramārgaśīrṣasauraphālgunaprathamadineṣu homādikaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇāṃ kuryāt yathā | adyetyādi kṛtaitat amuke māsi amukarāśisthe bhāskare amuke pakṣe amukatithau amukagotraḥ śrī(-)amukadevaśarmā amukarāśistharavikālīnāmukadevatāyā amukamantra iyatsaṃkhyakajapataddaśāṃśahomataddaśāṃśa(-) tarpaṇataddaśāṃśābhiṣekataddaśāṃśa(-)brāhmaṇabhojanarūpapuraścaraṇakarmaṇaḥ sāṅgatārthaṃ dakṣiṇāmidaṃ kāñcanaṃ vahnidaivatam amukagotrāya śrīamukadevaśarmaṇe gurave tubhyamahaṃ sampradade | tato'cchidrāvavāraṇaṃ kuryāt || atha vārādipuraścaraṇasaṅklpamāha || adyetyādi amuke māsi
amukarāśisthe bhāskare amuke pakṣe amukatithāvārabhya amukagotraḥ śrī(-) amukadevaśarmā amukadevatāyā amukamantrasiddhikāmaḥ ravivārādisarvavāreṣu amukadevatāyā amukamantrasya vārasaṃkhyakasahasrajaparūpapuraścaraṇamahaṃ kariṣye |
iti saṅkalpayet |
tataḥ śeṣadine tatparadine vā adyetyādi kṛtaitat amukadevatāyā amukamantrasya ravivārādyadhikaraṇakavārasaṃkhyakasahasrajapa(-) taddaśāṃśahomataddaśāṃśatarpaṇataddaśāṃśābhiṣekatadda(-) śāṃśabrāhmaṇabhojanakarmāṇyahaṃ kariṣye |
tato dakṣiṇā |
adyetyādi kṛtaitat ravivārādyadhikaraṇakavārasaṃkhyaka(-) sahasrajapataddaśāṃśahomataddaśāṃśatarpaṇataddaśāṃśābhi(-) ṣekataddaśāṃśabrāhmaṇabhojanarūpapuraścaraṇakarmaṇaḥ sāṅgatārthaṃ dakṣiṇāmidamityādi || tithipuraścaraṇe sarvemevaṃ sarvatra vāraśabdasthāne tithiśabdaprayogaḥ | atha ṛtupurścaraṇasaṅkalpaḥ || adyetyādi amukagotraḥ śrīamukadevaśarmā amukadevatāyā amukamantrasiddhikāmaḥ sūryodayaṃ samārabhya vasantāntaṃ yāvat amukadevatāyā amukamantrasya japarūpapuraścaraṇamahaṃ kariṣye || anyatra grīṣma(-)ṛtuvyāpakajaparūpapuraścaraṇamahaṃ kariṣye evaṃ sarvatra || japānte pūjāṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇāṃ kuryad yathā | adyetyādi amukadevatāyā amukamantrasya vasanta(-)ṛtuvyāpakajaparūpapuraścaraṇakarmaṇaḥ sāṅgatārthaṃ dakṣiṇāmidamityādi | evaṃ sarvatra || tarpaṇābhiṣekaprayogo yathā |
ācamya sāmānyārghyaṃ kṛtvā āsanaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ ṛṣyādinyāsakarāṅganyāsau ca kṛtvā dhyātvā mānasaiḥ sampūjya punardhyātvā jale devaṃ samāvāhya idamudakātmakaṃ pādyam amukadevatāyai namaḥ | idamudakātmakamarghyam | ityanena udakātmakairupacāraiḥ sampūjya sandhyoktavidhinā parivārān santarpya mūlamuccārya amukadevatāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | ityanena santarpya ātmānaṃ devatārūpaṃ dhyātvā namo'ntamūlamuccārya amukadevatāmahamabhiṣiñcāmi iti kumbhamudrayā mūrddhānamabhiṣicya saṃhāramudrayā devatāṃ visarjayet ||
atha śrīdurgāyā rahasyapuraścaraṇaṃ svatantratantre ||
śrīpārvatyuvāca ||
kathayasva mahādeva (!) siddhikāraṇamuttamam |
yena siddhiṃ samayānti sarve mantrāśca siddhidāḥ |
yeṣu yeṣu ca kāleṣu puraścaraṇaṃ bhaveddhruvam ||
śiva uvāca ||
kathayāmi samāsena śrūyatāṃ parvatātmaje (!) |
meṣe daśasahasrañca prajapenmantramuttamam |
puraścaraṇametaddhi jāyate haravallabhe (!) |
vṛṣarāśau yadā mantramayutaṃ prajapet sudhīḥ |
tena tatra susiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
mithune ca tathā mantrī ayutaṃ mantramuttamam |
prajapet prayato nityaṃ puraścaraṇamucyate |
karkaṭe ca yadā mantrī sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ japet |
tena sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt puraścaraṇakṛdbhavet |
siṃhe ca sarvamantrāṇāmayutānāṃ dvayaṃ japet |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phalabhāg bhavati dhruvam |
kanyāyāñca yadā mantrī mantraṃ mantraparāyaṇaḥ |
sahasradvādaśañcaiva japenniyatamānasaḥ |
puraścaraṇametaddhi sarvakāmārthasādhanam |
iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cānte devīpuraṃ vrajet |
tulāyāṃ pratyahaṃ mantrī sahasraṃ sādhako japet |
anena vidhinā devi (!) puraścaraṇakṛdbhavet |
vṛścike cāyutaṃ mantraṃ śayyāyāṃ prajapet sudhīḥ |
tena sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt puraścaryāphalaṃ labhet |
dhanuṣi ca yadā mantraṃ japedayutamādarāt |
ihaiva kandarpasamo dhanavān balavān sukhī |
makare ca yadā mantraṃ japet sādhakasattamaḥ |
ayutāni ca catvāri pratyahaṃ yatamānasaḥ |
dhamārthaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ puraścaraṇamucyate |
kumbhe caiva yadā mantraṃ japedayutamādarāt |
tena sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt puraścaraṇakṛdbhavet |
mīne caiva yadā devi (!) prajapedayutadvayam |
puraścaraṇamityāhuḥ sarvāgamaviśāradāḥ |
sarvatrajapanaṃ kāryaṃ rātrau vā maithune'pi vā |
śayyāyāñca viśeṣeṇa parayoṣitsamāgame |
haviṣyāśī tadā devi (!) japenniyatamānasaḥ |
evaṃvidhaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā daśāṃśañca tadācaret |
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dattvā siddhibhāgbhavati dhruvam |
yeṣu yeṣu nakṣatreṣu jāyate siddhiruttamā |
kathayāmi samāsena śrūyatāṃ parvatātmaje (!) |
aśvinyāṃ prajapenmantraṃ sādhakaśca sahasrakam |
tenāsmin siddhimāpnoti sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dvisahasraṃ yadā mantraṃ bharaṇyāñca japet sudhīḥ |
yamalokaṃ parityajya dhanena ca dhanādhipaḥ |
kṛttikāyāṃ japenmantraṃ dvisahasrañca sādhakaḥ |
rohiṇyāñca yadā mantraṃ japet sādhakasattamaḥ |
sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi sarvakāmamavāpnuyāt |
mṛgaśīrṣe yadā mantraṃ niyataṃ prajapet sudhīḥ |
sahasrapañcakañcaiva vṛhaspatisamo bhavet |
ārdrāyāṃ japyate mantraṃ sādhakaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ |
ṣaṭsahasraṃ yadā devi (!) sarvakāmārthasiddhaye |
punarvasusamāyoge sahasraṃ mantramuttamam |
japanāt sādhako nityaṃ labhate ca surottamam |
puṇyāyāñca japenmantraṃ saptānāñca sahasrakam |
tena sarvasusiddhiḥ syāt puraścaryādhiko vidhiḥ |
aśleṣāyāṃ yadā mantraṃ mantrī devi (!) samāhitaḥ |
sahasraṣaṭkakañcaiva japet sarvārthasiddhaye |
daśasahasraṃ maghāyāñca japtvā mantraṃ samāhitaḥ |
purandarasamo bhūtvā sādhako vicaredbhuvi |
ekādaśasahasrantu pūrvātraye japet sudhīḥ |
kubera iva vittāḍhyo jāyate sādhako bhuvi |
uttarātritaye devi (!) sahasradvādaśaṃ tathā |
japyate sādhakairnityaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye |
hastāyāñca japeddevi (!) trayodaśasahasrakam |
sūryasveva samo bhūtvā vicāredbhuvi sādhakaḥ |
citrāyāñca japenmantraṃ dvisahasrañca sādhakaḥ |
nānābhogasamāyukto bhavedbhuvi purandaraḥ |
svātyāṃ sarvārthasiddhiḥ syadvisahasrasya jāpanāt |
sādhako'vyāhatagatirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
viśākhāyāṃ yadā mantraṃ catuḥsāhasrakaṃ priye (!) |
japecca sādhako nityaṃ somavat priyadarśanaḥ |
anurādhāyāṃ yadā devi (!) mantrī mantraṃ sadā japet |
putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ khecaro jāyate dhruvam |
jyeṣṭhāyāñca yadā mantraṃ dvisahasraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
japanāllabhate siddhiṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
mūlāyāñca japenmantraṃ sahasrapañcakaṃ priye (!) |
nānāsiddhimavāpnoti sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ |
śravaṇāyāṃ yadā mantraṃ dvisahasraṃ japet sudhīḥ |
aṣṭasiddhirbhavettasya nātra vai saṃśayaḥ priye (!) |
dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ japenmantraṃ dvisahasraṃ samāhitaḥ |
varuṇena samo bhūtvā jāyate sādhako bhuvi |
śatabhiṣāyāṃ yadā mantraṃ dvisahasraṃ japet sudhīḥ |
sa mahāpātakānmucyet phalabhāgbhavati dhruvam |
revatyāñca mahāmantraṃ catuḥsāhasrakaṃ tathā |
japtvā stutvā sadā devi (!) somalokamāpnuyāt |
rātrau vā maithune vāpi śayyāyāñca vyavasthitaḥ |
prajapet sādhako nityaṃ sādhayedātmano hitam |
sarvadā prajapenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī divā śuciḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyādyathāvibhavavistaram |
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate |
vavādikaraṇenaiva puraścaraṇamucyate |
viṣkumbhādiṣu yogeṣu yo japedyogasaṃkhyayā |
sahasraṃ sādhako nityaṃ sarvasiddhiparāyaṇaḥ |
puraścaraṇametaddhi tantre tantre nirūpitam |
saṃkrāntiṣu ca sarvāsu viṣuvādiṣu pārvati (!) |
saṃkrānteranusāreṇa varddhayecca sahasrakam |
pūrvamukho japenmantraṃ dhanārthī sarvadā priye (!) |
śatrunāśāya satataṃ prajapet paścimāmukhaḥ |
lokānāṃ vaśyahetvarthaṃ muktyarthaṃ vā yadā priye (!) |
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ |
śatrunāśāya satataṃ dakṣiṇābhimukho japet ||
iti haragaurīsaṃvāde rahasyapuraścaraṇam ||
atha grahaṇapuraścaraṇam ||
grahaṇantu cakṣuṣā rāhordarśanam |
sa tu caṇḍālasvarūpa iti kiṃvadantī |
tasya darśanaṃ kathaṃ puṇyajanakamiti sandehe mātṛkābhedatantre ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
caṇḍikovāca ||
rāhuścāṇḍālavikhyātaḥ sarvatra parameśvara (!) |
puṇyaṃ kālaṃ kathaṃ deva (!) tasya sparśe divākare |
niśākare tathā nātha (!) ceti me saṃśayo hṛdi |
kathayasva parānanda (!) paścādanyaṃ prakāśaya ||
śrīśaṅkara uvāca ||
śṛṇu sarvāṅgasubhage (!) grahaṇa~cottamottamam |
grahaṇaṃ trividhaṃ devi (!) candrasūryāgnisaṃyutam |
sakterlalāṭe netre ca vahnistiṣṭhati sarvadā |
vāmanetre tathā candro dakṣe sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
śambhunāthena deveśi (!) ramaṇaṃ kriyate yadi |
tadaiva grahaṇaṃ devi (!) śaktiyuktaḥ sadāśivaḥ |
vāmanetre cumbite ca śaśāṅkagrahaṇaṃ tadā |
dakṣanetre cumbite ca bhāskaragrahaṇaṃ tathā |
lalāṭe cumbite cāgnigrahaṇaṃ parameśvari (!) |
śivavīryaṃ yato vahnirato dṛśyaḥ sureśvari (!) |
rāhuḥ śivaḥ samākhyātastriguṇā śaktirīritā |
śivaśaktyoḥ samāyogād grahaṇaṃ parameśvari (!) |
śivaśaktyoḥ samāyogakālo brahmamayaḥ priye (!) |
ata eva maheśāni (!) rāśyādīn na vicārayet |
tithīnakṣatrayoge tu yadyogaṃ parameśvari (!) |
tadaiva parameśāni (!) rāśyādigaṇanaṃ caret |
śivaśaktisamāyogāt sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ jagat |
māsapakṣatithīnāñca noccāryaṃ parameśvari (!) |
dṛṣṭimātreṇa japtavyaṃ tadā siddho bhaved dhruvam |
tatkālaṃ paramaṃ kālaṃ vijñeyaṃ vīravandite (!) |
tatra yad yat kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bahu kiṃ kathyate'dhunā |
etat suguptabhedaṃ hi tava snehāt prakāśitam |
na vaktavyaṃ paśoragre prāṇānte'pi sureśvari (!) ||
atrānantaphalakīrtanāt japadaśāṃśahomādikamapi na kartavyam ||
taduktaṃ gāyatrītantre prathamabrāhmaṇaparicchede ||
candrasūryoparāge ca japtvā brahmamayo bhavet |
mantrasya parameśāni (!) na ca homādikañcaret |
kṛte homādike bhadre (!) tajjapaṃ viphalaṃ bhavet |
japamātre maheśāni (!) anantatanmanuryathā |
anantasya maheśāni (!) daśāṃśaṃ kena jāyate ||
śāktānandataraṅgiṇīdvādaśollāsadhṛtabījārṇavatantrīya(-)ṣoḍaśapaṭale ||
ekadā parameśāni (!) kāmākhyāyāṃ maheśvari (!)|
dṛṣṭvoparāgaṃ yatkāryaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva varānane (!) |
kutaḥ snānaṃ kutaḥ sandhyā prāṇāyāmaḥ kutaḥ priye (!) |
bhūtaśuddhiḥ kuto bhadre (!) kutaḥ pūjā varānane (!)|
kālātītabhayāddevi (!) sarvaṃ santyajya kāmini (!) |
saṅkalpaṃ mānasaṃ kṛtvā japaṃ kṛtvā varānane (!) |
pañcāṅgaistu vihīno'pi siddho bhavati nānyathā |
mantraṃ vidyā maheśāni (!) kavacaṃ stavameva vā |
dhyānaṃ vā parameśāni (!) nyāsaṃ vā kamalekṣaṇe (!) |
ekoccāreṇa girije (!) tadbhaveddaśakoṭayaḥ |
asaṃkhyaṃ tajjapaṃ devi (!) grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
tatkathaṃ parameśāni (!) kriyate japasaṃkhyakam |
ata eva maheśāni (!) homo nāsti śucismite (!) |
abhiṣekañca deveśi (!) tathā tarpaṇameva ca |
bhojanañca maheśāni (!) nāstyatra kamalānane (!) |
candrasūryagrahe devi (!) pañcāṅgaṃ nāsti kāmini (!) |
pañcāṅgena vihīno'pi siddho bhavati nānyathā |
saṅkalpaṃ vidhivaddevi (!) mānasaṃ yadupasthitam |
tatsaṅkalpaṃ vijānīyādgrahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
tasmāttu capalāpāṅgi (!) saṅkalpaṃ naiva kārayet |
saṅkalpaṃ mānasaṃ devi caturvargaphalapradam |
tato hi mānasaṃ devi (!) mukhyaṃ saṅkalpamīritam |
vyarthaṃ hi sthūlasaṅkalpaṃ grahaṇe parikīrtitam |
saṅkalpena vinā devi (!) yatkiñcit kurute naraḥ |
vyarthameva hi tat sarvaṃ tasmāttanmānasaṃ param |
prathame prahare devi (!) candragrāsaṃ yadā bhavet ||
tadaiva divase bhuktvā satvaraṃ narakaṃ vrajet |
niśīthe tu yadā devi (!) graseccandraṃ yada tamaḥ |
tadaiva divase bhuktvā pītvānandamayo bhavet |
candragrahaṇakāletu japayajñādikañcaret |
rātrau bhuktvā ca pītvā ca japayajñādikaṃ caret |
sarveṣu viṣṇumantreṣu saure gāṇapate tathā |
śaktimantre maheśāni (!) praśastaṃ satataṃ japm |
iti bījārṇave tantre śivena parikīrtitam |
etat kalpaṃ jñānināntvajñānināmapi cocyate ||
gāndharve ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate |
grahaṇe'rkasya cendorvā śuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ |
nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātrodake sthitaḥ |
grahaṇādivimokṣāntaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā snātvā susaṅkalpo vimokṣāntaṃ japañcaret ||
japasya tu daśāṃśena homaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi |
homārthaṃ tad dviguṇaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ ||
homasya tu daśāṃśaśca tarpaṇaṃ samupācaret |
abhiṣekadaśāṃśena brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ |
tadante mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ |
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā bhaktyā viprāṃśca tarpayet ||
kālītantre ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
candrasūryagrahe caiva grāsāvadhivimuktitaḥ |
yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ manuṃ japtvā tāvaddhomādikaṃ caret |
jāmale ||
api śuddhodake snātvā śucau deśe samāhitaḥ |
grāsādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥ |
evaṃ japtvāpyasandigdho japasya phalabhāgbhavet ||
grahaṇapūrvāhe upavāsāśaktasya phaladugdhādibhojanāprāmāṇyāt varaṃ hariṣyācaraṇaṃ śāstraṃ nimittāniścaye tasyāṅgatvābhāvādupavāsaṃ vinaiva puraścaraṇamit guravaḥ |
atra śrāddhamakurvāṇaḥ paṅke gauravasīdatīti nindāśravaṇamupadiṣṭaviṣayam |
upadiṣṭasya tu japasyāvaśyakatvaṃ vaidhahiṃsāvaditi mānyāḥ |
sanatkumārīye |
śrāddhāderanurodhena yadi jāpaṃ tyajennaraḥ |
sa bhaveddevatādrohī pitṝn sapta nayatyadha ityārabdhapuraścaraṇaviṣayam |
tyajediti śravaṇāt ||
atha mālāprakaraṇam ||
nityātantre navamapaṭale ||
īśvara uvāca |
akṣamālāṃ samāśritya mātṛkāvarṇarūpiṇīm |
atha muktāphalamayī bhogamokṣapradāyinī |
rājavaśyakarī sarvasiddhidā nātra saṃśayaḥ |
yathā muktāphalamayī tathā sphaṭikanirmitā |
rudrākṣamālā girije (!) mokṣadā ca samṛddhidā |
prabālaghaṭitā mālā vaśyadā karmasādhinī |
māṇikyaracitā mālā sāmrājyaphaladāyinī |
puttrañjīvakamālā tu vidyālakṣmīpradāyinī |
padmabījākṣamālā tu mahālakṣmīpradāyinī |
raktacandanabījākṣamālā vaśyaphalapradā ||
muṇḍamālātantre dvitīyapaṭale |
sphāṭikairmokṣalābhaḥ syāt rudrākṣairbahuputradā |
jīvaputtraiśca dhandā pāṣāṇairbhogamokṣadā |
śuddhasphaṭikamālā tu mahāsampatpradā priye (!) |
śmaśānadhūsturairmālā ekā dhūmāvatīvidhau |
tathā |
maṇiratnaprabālaiśca hemarājatasambhavā |
mālā kāryā kuśagranthyā sarvabhogaphalapradā |
samayācāratantre dvitīyapaṭale ||
pūrvāmnāyādi sarveṣāṃ mālāṃ śṛṇu yathākramam |
japtvā yenāśu labhate phalaṃ devaiśca durlabham |
akṣamālā prathamato mātṛkārṇasvarūpiṇī |
atha muktāmayī mālā ratimokṣaphalapradā |
sarvasiddhikarī mālā sarvarājavaśaṅkarī |
prabālamālā vaśyārthaṃ sarvakāryaphalapradā |
māṇikyaracitā mālā sāmrājyaphaladāyinī |
putrañjīvakamālā sā lakṣmīvidyāpradāyinī |
padmākṣaracitā mālā yaśolakṣmīpradā sadā |
suvarṇaracitā mālā sphāṭikī sarvakāmadā |
raktacandranamālā ca bhogadā mokṣadā bhavet |
rudrākṣaracitā mālā sarvakāmaphalapradā |
sarvamālāṃ prapūjyātha candanena vilepitām |
samāśritya japennityaṃ yathoktaphalamāpnuyāt |
etā mālāśca subhage (!) pañcāmnāyeṣu pūjitāḥ ||
muṇḍamālātantre ||
devyuvāca ||
akṣamālā tu kathitā yatnato na prakāśitā |
akṣamāleti kiṃ nāma phalaṃ vā kiṃ vadasva me ||
īśvara uvāca
akṣamālā tu deveśi (!) kāmyabhedādanekadhā |
bhavanti śṛṇu tatprājñe (!) vistarāducyate mayā |
anulomavilomena kḷptayā varṇamālayā |
ādilāntalādi ānta krameṇa parameśvari (!) |
kṣakāraṃ merurūpañca laṅghayenna kadācana |
merulaṅghanadoṣastu tatraiva ||
meruhīnā ca yā mālā merujaṅghā ca yā bhavet |
aśuddhā pratikāśā ca sā mālā niṣphalā bhavet |
citriṇī visatantvābhā brahmanāḍīgatāntarā |
tayā saṃgrathiā mālā sarvakāmaphalapradā |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā ādiklīvaṃ samācaret |
ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ dvayaṃ yattu taddhi klīvaṃ pracakṣate |
vargāṇāmaṣṭabhirvāpi kāmyabhedāt krameṇa tu |
akacaṭatapayaśā aṣṭau vargāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
mālayā japaviśeṣeṇa phalaviśeṣastu nityātantre ||
akṣamālāṃ prapūjyātha candanena sulocane (!) |
samāśritya japedvidvān lakṣamātramananyadhīḥ |
yoṣitaḥ sakalā vaśyāḥ saptadvīpasya pārvati (!) |
tato dvitīyalakṣañca prajapedvīravandite (!) |
pātālatalanāgendrakanyā vaśyā bhavanti hi |
tato lakṣatrayaṃ bhadre (!) prajapet sādhakottamaḥ |
devāṅganā bhavantyeva vaśyāstasya maheśvari (!) |
mahāpātakakoṭiśca nāśayet kamalekṣaṇe (!) |
abhimānena saubhāgyaṃ saukhyaṃ saundaryamāpnuyāt |
caturlakṣaṃ prajapyātha mahāyogīśvaro bhavet |
pañcalakṣajapāddevi (!) kuberapadavīṃ vrajet |
ṣaḍlakṣajapamātreṇa sarvavidyāsu kovidaḥ |
saptalakṣajapāddevi (!) khecaro bhavati dhruvam |
aṣṭalakṣaṃ prajapyātha devapūjyo bhavennaraḥ |
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāṃ nāyako nātra saṃśayaḥ |
rājāno vaśagāstasya yoṣitaśca viśeṣataḥ |
navalakṣaṃ mahādevi (!) yo japet sādhakottamaḥ |
rudramūrtiḥ svayaṃ sākṣāt kartā hartā na saṃśayaḥ ||
samayācāratantre ||
uttarāmnāyeṣu yā mālā bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vadāmi te |
atha varṇamayī mālā sarvotkṛṣṭā ca sā matā |
mahāśaṅkhamayī mālā vāñchitārthaphalapradā |
uḍumbaraphalasyātha sūkṣmasyātha kṛtā matā ||
yoginītantre pūrvakhaṇḍe dvitīyapaṭale ||
īśvara uvāca ||
varṇamālā śubhā proktā sarvamantrapradīpanī |
tasyāḥ pratinidhirdevi (!) mahāśaṅkhamayī śubhā |
mahāśaṅkhaḥ kare yasya tasya siddhiradūrataḥ |
tadbhāve vīravandye (!) sphāṭikī sarvasiddhidā ||
maṇibhedena phalabhedamāha muṇḍamālātantre ||
triṃśataiśvaryaphaladā pañcaviṃśaistu mokṣadā |
caturdaśamayī mokṣadāyinī bhogavarddhinī |
daśapañcātmikā devi (!) māraṇoccāṭane sthitā |
stambhane mohane vaśye bodhane añjane tanoḥ |
pādukāsiddhisaṅghe ca śatasaṃkhyā prakīrtitā |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryādatha vā sarvakāmadam |
yoginītantre ||
maṇisaṃkhyāṃ mahādevi (!) mālāyāḥ kathayāmi te |
pañcaviṃśatibhirmokṣaṃ puṣṭyai tu saptaviṃśatiḥ |
triṃśadbhirdhanasiddhiḥ syāt pañcāśanmantrasiddhaye |
aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvasiddhireva maheśvari (!) |
etatsādhāraṇaṃ proktaṃ viśeṣaṃ kāmināṃ vada ||
śrīśiva uvāca ||
dantamālā jape kāryā gale dhāryā nṛṇāṃ śubhe (!) |
daśanairyadi kartavyā saṃkhyā dantasya te priye (!) |
sarvasiddhipradā mālā rājadantena meruṇā |
anyatrāpi maheśāni (!) merutvenaivamādiśet |
nityaṃ japaṃ kare kuryānna kāmyamavarodhanāt |
kāmyamapi kare kuryānmālābhāve priyaṃvade (!) |
atrāṅgulyā japaṃ kuryāt sāṅguṣṭhāṅgulibhirjapet |
aṅgulena vinā karma kṛtaṃ tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
utpattitantre prathamapaṭale ||
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kare kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ |
karamālā mahādevi (!) sarvadoṣavivarjitā |
chinnabhinnādidoṣo'pi kare nāsti kadācana |
akṣayastu karo devi (!) mālā bhavati tādṛśī (!)
granthiḥ sā kuṇḍalīśaktiḥ pañcāśadvarṇarūpiṇī |
ata eva maheśāni (!) karamālā mahāphalā ||
yoginītantre ||
tathā tathāto grathanaṃ mālānāṃ tatra bodhanam |
pūjāṃ vidhāya bhaktyā tu śuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ |
vijane grathayenmaunī svayaṃ mālāñca sādhakaḥ |
kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuddhaḥ śuddho'kṣeṣu ca mantravit |
yathākālaṃ yathākāmamakṣāṇyānīya yatnataḥ |
anyonyasamarūpāṇi nātisthūlakṛśāni ca |
kīṭādibhiraduṣṭāni na jīrṇāni navāni ca |
gavyaistu pañcabhistāni prakṣālya ca pṛthak pṛthak |
pṛthvī devendrapuṇyastrīnirmitaṃ granthivarjitam |
triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya paṭṭasūtramathāpi vā |
śuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ śāntivaśyavicārake |
sūtraṃ sampātayedvidvān tat prakṣālya ca pūrvavat |
mālāmekaikamādāya sūtre sampātayet sudhīḥ |
mukhe mukhantu saṃyojya pucche pucchantu yojayet |
gopucchasadṛśī kāryāthavā sarpākṛtirbhavet |
tatsajātīyamekākṣaṃ merutvenāgrato nyaset |
ekaikamālāmadhye tu brahmagranthiṃ prakalpayet ||
utpattitantre ṣaṣṭipaṭale ||
kramotkramācchatāvṛttyā pañcāśadvarṇamālayā |
yo japaḥ sa tu vijñeya uttamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
[iti śrīprāṇatoṣiṇyāṃ caturthe kāmyakāṇḍe granthikathanarūpaḥ prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ] |
athe sādhanasthānam ||
śāradāyāṃ dvitīyapaṭale ||
puṇyakṣetraṃ nadītīraṃ guhāparvatamastakam |
tīrthapradeśāḥ sindhūnāṃ saṅgamaḥ pāvanaṃ mahat |
udyānāni viviktāni vilvamūlaṃ taṭaṃ gireḥ |
devatāyatanaṃ kūlaṃ samudrasya nijaṃ gṛham |
sādhaneṣu praśasyante sthānānyetāni mantriṇām |
nadītīraṃ puṇyanadītīraṃ sāmānyanadītīrasya niṣiddhatvāt |
viviktāni vijanāni ||
rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtam |
pratyaṅmukhaḥ śivasthāne vṛṣabhādivivarjite |
aśvatthabilvatulasīvane puṣpāntarāvṛte |
gavāṃ goṣṭhe'śvatthamūle puṇyakṣetreṣu śasyate ||
goṣṭha ityanenaiva gosthāne labdhe gavāmiti yaduktaṃ tat tātkālikagosambandhajñāpanāya tena gosamīpe japādikarma praśastamataeva gavāṃ samīpa ityuktam ||
vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām |
yathā |
sūryasyāgre gurorindordīpasya ca jalasya ca |
viprāṇāñca gavāñcaiva sannidhau śasyate japaḥ |
athavā nivasettatra yatra cittaṃ prasīdati |
muṇḍamālātantre tṛtīyapaṭale ca ||
nadītīre bilvamūle śmaśāne śūnyaveśmani |
ekaliṅge parvate vā devāgāre catuṣpathe |
śavasyopari muṇḍe vā jale vā kaṇṭhapūrite |
saṃgrāmabhūmau yonau vā sthāne vā vijane vane |
yatra kutra sthale ramye yatra vā syānmanolayaḥ ||
vṛhannīlatantre dvitīyapaṭale ||
ekaliṅge śmaśāne vā śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe |
harmye vā sādhayeddevīṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinīm |
ekaliṅgalakṣaṇamāha ||
pañcakrośāntare yatra na liṅgāntaramīkṣyate |
tadekaliṅgamākhyātaṃ tatra siddhiranuttamā |
iti śyāmārahasyadhṛtenaikaliṅgaṃ jñātavyam ||
tathā |
ujjaṭe parvate vāpi nirjane vā catuṣpathe |
devāgāre devaśūnye bilvamūle nadītaṭe |
svagṛhe nirjane'raṇye tathā cāśvatthasannidhau |
ityapi śyāmārahasye nityātantre prathamapaṭale ca ||
ekaliṅge śmaśāne vā śūnyāgāre nadītaṭe |
pātālabhavane vāpi girau vā dīrghikātaṭe |
śaktikṣetre mahāpīṭhe bilvamūle śivālaye |
dhātrīvṛkṣatale'śvatthamūle caiva tarostale ||
pātālabhavane bhūmimadhye ||
samayācaratantre dvitīyapaṭale'pi ||
japasthānāni deveśi (!) siddhapīṭhāni yāni ca |
siddhapīṭhe ca śayyāyāṃ khaṭṭāśayyāviśeṣataḥ |
catuṣpathe siddhaliṅge gurudevālaye tathā |
vaṭāśvatthabilvamūle rambhāyā vipine tathā |
nadītīre śivāgare guhāparvatamastake |
japasthānāni deveśi (!) kathitāni nagātmaje (!) |
śṛṇu devi (!) viśeṣeṇa uttarāmnāyahetave |
veśyāgṛhe śmaśāne vā gatvā maithunamācaret |
tato japādikaṃ devi (!) kṛtvā ca labhate phalam |
athavā svagṛhe rātrau bhaktimān susamācaret |
sa prāpnoti phalaṃ sarvaṃ cintādibhayavarjitaḥ ||
puraścaraṇarasollāsatantre caturthapaṭale ||
goṣṭhaṃ catuṣpathañcaiva tripathañca varānane (!) |
nirjanañca tathāraṇyaṃ śūnyagehaṃ tathaiva ca |
parvatañca nadītīraṃ tathaiva dīrghikātaṭam |
aśvatthavṛkṣamūle ca vaṭavṛkṣatale tathā |
dhātrīvṛkṣatale devi (!) tathaiva vakulasya ca |
yatra padmavanaṃ bhadre (!) śuklaṃ raktaṃ varānane (!) |
droṇapuṣpasya cārvaṅgi (!) yadi bhāgyena labhyate |
aruṇādityasaṅkāśaṃ japakālaṃ parātparam |
sthānaviśeṣe annadākalpe dvitīyapaṭale ||
gośālāyāṃ puṇyabhūmau gurorgehe viśeṣataḥ |
bilvamūle nadītīre parvate śivasannidhau |
svagṛhe puṇyanilaye tathā sādhakamandire |
śrīdurgāpratimāsthāne yuvatīnāñca sannidhau |
evamādiṣu deśeṣu dīkṣākarma praśasyate ||
phalaviśeṣastu rāghavabhaṭṭenokto yathā ||
gṛhe japaḥ samaḥ prokto goṣṭhe śataguṇastu saḥ |
ārāme ca tathāraṇye sahasraguṇa ucyate |
ayutaḥ parvate puṇye nadyāṃ lakṣaguṇastu saḥ |
koṭirdevālaye prāhuranantaṃ śivasannidhau ||
atha siddhapīṭham ||
kubjikātantre saptamapaṭale ||
śiva uvāca ||
śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānena siddhapīṭhaṃ pativrate (!) |
yasmin sādhanamātreṇa sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
māyāvatī madhupurī kāśī gorakṣakāriṇī |
hiṅgulā ca mahāpīṭhaṃ tathā jālāndharaṃ punaḥ |
jvālāmukhī mahāpīṭhaṃ pīṭhaṃ nagarasambhavam |
rāmagirirmahāpīṭhaṃ tathā godāvarī priye |
nepālaṃ karṇasūtrañca mahākarṇaṃ tathā priye (!) |
ayodhyāñca kurukṣetraṃ siṃhanādaṃ manoramam |
maṇipūraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ prayāgañca tapovanam |
vadarīñca mahāpīṭhaṃ ambikā arddhanālakam |
triveṇī ca mahāpīṭhaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamam |
nārikelañca virajā uḍḍīyānaṃ maheśvari (!) |
kamalā vimalā caiva tathā māhiṣmatīpurī |
vārāhī tripurā caiva vāgmatī nīlavāhinī |
govarddhanaṃ vindhyagiriḥ kāmarūpaṃ kalau yuge |
ghaṇṭākarṇo hayagrīvo mādhavaśca sureśvari (!) |
kṣīragrāmaṃ vaidyanāthaṃ jānīyādvāmalocane (!) |
kāmarūpaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
kalau śīghraphalo devi (!) kāmarūpe japaḥ smṛtaḥ |
anyatra jape'likāmākhyāvastrayogena phalamuktaṃ tatraiva ||
kāmākhyāvastramādāya japapūjāṃ samācaret |
pūrṇakāmaṃ labheddevi (!) satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
tantracūḍāmaṇau mahāpīṭhanirūpaṇaṃ yathā |
īśvara uvāca ||
mātaḥ (!) parātpare (!) devi (!) sarvajñānamayīśvari (!) |
kathyatāṃ me sarvapīṭhaṃ śaktirbhairavadevatā ||
devyuvāca ||
śṛṇu vatsa (!) pravakṣyāmi dayālo (!) bhaktavatsala (!) |
yābhirvinā na sidhyanti japasādhanatatkriyāḥ |
ekapañcāśataṃ pīṭhaṃ śaktirbhairavadevatā |
aṅgapratyaṅgapātena viṣṇucakrakṣatena ca |
mamāsya vapuṣo devahitāya tvayi kathyate |
brahmarandhraṃ hiṅgulāyāṃ bhairavo bhīmalocanaḥ |
koṭṭarīśo mahādevastriguṇā yā digambarī || 1 ||
karavīre trinetraṃ me devī mahiṣamardinī |
krodhīśo bhairavastatra || 2 | |
sugandhāyāñca nāsikā |
devastryambakanāmā ca sunandā tatra devatā || 3 ||
kāśmīre kaṇṭhadeśaśca trisandhyeśvarabhairavaḥ |
mahāmāyā bhagavatī guṇātītā varapradā || 4 ||
jvālāmukhyāṃ mahājihvā deva unmattabhairavaḥ |
ambikā siddhidānāmnī | 5 |
stanaṃ jālāndhare mama |
bhīṣaṇo bhairavastatra devī tripuramālinī || 6 ||
hṛdyapīṭhaṃ vaidyanāthe vaidyanāthastu bhairavaḥ |
devatā jayadurgākhyā || 7 ||
nepāle jānu me śiva (!) |
kapālī bhairavaḥ śrīmān mahāmāyā ca devatā || 8 ||
mānave dakṣahastaṃ me devī dākṣāyaṇī hara (!) |
amaro bhairavastatra sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ || 9 ||
utkale nābhideśastu virajākṣetramucyate |
vimalā sā mahadevī jagannāthastu bhairavaḥ || 10 ||
gaṇḍakyāṃ gaṇḍapātaśca tatra siddhirna saṃśayaḥ |
tatra sā gaṇḍakī caṇḍī cakrapāṇistu bhairavaḥ || 11 ||
vahulāyāṃ vāmabāhurbahulākhyā ca devatā |
bhīruko bhairavastatra sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ || 12 ||
ujjayinyāṃ kūrparañca māṅgalyakapilāmbaraḥ |
bhairavaḥ siddhidaḥ sākṣāddevī maṅgalacaṇḍikā || 13 ||
caṭṭale dakṣabāhurme bhairavaścandraśekharaḥ |
vyaktarūpā bhagavatī bhavānī tatra devatā |
viśeṣataḥ kaliyuge vasāmi candraśekhare || 14 ||
tripurāyāṃ dakṣapādo devī tripurasundarī |
bhairavastripureśaśca sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ || 15 ||
trisrotāyāṃ vāmapado bhrāmaro bhairaveśvaraḥ || 16 ||
yonipīṭhaṃ kāmagirau kāmākhyā tatra devatā |
yatrāste triguṇātītā raktapāṣāṇarūpiṇī |
yatrāste mādhavaḥ sākṣādumānando'tha bhairavaḥ |
sarvadā vihareddevī tatra muktirna saṃśayaḥ |
tatra śrībhairavī devī tatra na kṣetradevatā |
pracaṇḍacaṇḍikā tatra mātaṅgī tripurātmikā |
bagalā kamalā tatra bhuvaneśī sadhūminī |
etāni nava pīṭhāni śaṃsanti varabhairavāḥ || 17 ||
aṅgulīvṛndaṃ hastasya prayāge lalitā bhava (!) || 18 ||
jayantyāṃ vāmajaṅghā ca jayantī kramadīśvaraḥ |
sarvatra viralā cāhaṃ kāmarūpe gṛhe gṛhe |
gaurīśikharamāruhya punarjanma na vidyate || 19 ||
bhūtadhātrī mahāmāyā bhairavaḥ kṣīrakaṇṭhakaḥ |
yugādyā sā mahāmāyā dakṣāṅguṣṭhaḥ pado mama |
nakulīśaḥ kālīpīṭhe dakṣapādāṅgulīṣu ca || 20 ||
karatoyāṃ samārabhya yāvaddikkaravāsinī |
śatayojanavistāraṃ trikoṇaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
devā maraṇamicchanti kiṃ punarmānavādayaḥ ||
iti kāparūpamāhātmyam ||
bhuvaneśī siddhirūpā kirīṭasthā kirīṭataḥ |
devatā vimalānāmnī saṃvarto bhairavastathā || 21 ||
vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī devatā kālabhairavaḥ |
maṇikarṇītivikhyātā kuṇḍalañca mama śruteḥ || 22 ||
kālyāśrame ca me pṛṣṭhaṃ nimiṣo bhairavastathā |
sarvāṇī devatā tatra || 23 ||
kurukṣetre ca gulphataḥ |
sthāṇunāmnī ca sāvitrī aśvanāthastu bhairavaḥ || 24 ||
maṇibandhe ca gāyatrī sarvānandastu bhairavaḥ || 25 ||
śrīśaile ca mama grīvā mahālakṣmīstu devatā |
bhairavaḥ saṃvarānando deśe deśe vyavasthitaḥ || 26 ||
kāñcīdeśe ca kaṅkālo bhairavo rurunāmakaḥ |
devatā devagarbhākhyā || 27 ||
nitambaḥ kālamādhave |
bhairavaścāsitāṅgaśca devī kālī susiddhidā || 28 ||
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā namaskṛtya mantrasiddhimavāpnuyāt |
śoṇākhye bhadrasenastu narmadākhyā nitambake || 29 ||
rāmagirau tathā nālā śivāno caṇḍabhairavaḥ || 30 ||
vṛndāvane keśajāla umānāmnī ca devatā |
bhūteśo bhairavastatra sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ || 31 ||
saṃhārākhya ūrddhadante devī nārāyaṇī śucau || 32 ||
adhodante mahārudro vārāhī pañcasāgare || 33 ||
karatoyātaṭe talpaṃ vāme vāmanabhairavaḥ |
aparṇā devatā tatra brahmarūpā karodbhavā || 34 ||
śrīparvate dakṣagulphaṃ tatra śrīsundarī parā |
sarvasiddhīśvaro sarvā sunandānandabhairavaḥ || 35 ||
kapālinī bhīmarūpā vāmagulphaṃ vibhāṣake |
bhairavaśca mahādevaḥ sarvānandaḥ śubhapradaḥ || 36 ||
udarañca prabhāse me candrabhāgā yaśasvinī |
vakratuṇḍo bhairavaśca || 37 ||
ūrddhvoṣṭhe bhairavaparvate |
avantyāñca mahādevī lambakarṇastu bhairavaḥ || 38 ||
citrake bhrāmarī devī kikubhākhyā jale sthale |
bhairavaḥ sarvasiddhiśastatra siddhiranuttamā || 39 ||
gaṇḍo godāvarītīre viśveśo viśvamātṛkā |
daṇḍapāṇirbhairavastu | 40 |
vāmagaṇḍe tu rākiṇī |
bhairavo vatsanābhastu tatra siddhirna saṃśayaḥ || 41 ||
ratrāvalyāṃ dakṣaskandhe kumārībhairavaḥ śivaḥ || 42 ||
mithilāyāṃ mahādevī vāmaskandhe mahodaraḥ | 43 |
nalāhāṭyāṃ nalāpāto yogīśo bhairavastathā |
tatra sā kālikā devī sarvasiddhipradāyikā || 44 ||
kālīghāṭe muṇḍapātaḥ krodhīśo bhairavastathā |
devatā jayadurgākhyā nānābhogapradāyinī || 45 ||
vakreśvare mana pāto vakranāthastu bhairavaḥ |
nadī pāpaharā tatra devī mahiṣamardinī || 46 ||
yaśohare pāṇipadmaṃ devī yaśohareśvarī |
caṇḍaśca bhairavastatra yatra siddhimavāpnuyāt || 47 ||
aṭṭahāse cauṣṭhapāto devī sā phullarā smṛtā |
viśveśo bhairavastatra sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ || 48 ||
hārapāto nandipure bhairavo nandikeśvaraḥ |
nandinī sā mahādevī tatra siddhirna saṃśayaḥ || 49 ||
laṅkāyāṃ nūpurañcaiva bhairavo rākṣaseśvaraḥ |
indrākṣī devatā tatra indreṇopāsitā purā || 50 ||
virāṭadeśamadhye tu pādāṅgulinipātanam |
bhairavaścāmṛtākhyaśca devī tatrāmbikā smṛtā || 51 ||
tatrāste kathitāḥ putra (!) pīṭhanāthādhidevatāḥ |
kṣetrādhīśaṃ vinā devaṃ pūjayeccānyadevatām |
bhairavairhriyate sarvaṃ japapūjādisādhanam |
ajñātvā bhairavaṃ pīṭhaṃ pīṭhaśaktiñca śaṅkara (!) |
prāṇanātha (!) na sidhyettu kalpakoṭijapādibhiḥ |
na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo nindakāya durātmane |
śaṭhāya krūrakāryāya dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt |
dadyācchāntāya śiṣyāya mantrī mantrārthasiddhaye |
mahānīlatantre pañcamapaṭale ||
pīṭhārcanaṃ mahādevi (!) yatra siddhiranuttamā |
pīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ mahāphalam |
tatra yā kriyate pūjā sakṛdvāpi maheśvari (!) |
vihāya sarvapīṭhāni tasya dehe vasāmyaham |
tasmācchataguṇaṃ proktaṃ kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍalam |
teṣāṃ phalaṃ maheśāni (!) vaktuṃ kiṃ śakyate mayā |
tatra koṭiguṇaiḥ sārddhamādyā vasati tāriṇī |
yatpīṭhaṃ brahmaṇā guptaṃ vaktuṃ sarvasukhāvaham |
yato devāśca vedāśca munayaścaiva bhāvajāḥ |
sarve'pyāvirbhavantyete tena guptaṃ sadā kuru |
dvividhañcaiva yatpīṭhaṃ goptavyaṃ tanmaheśvari (!) |
vaktrādguptaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ durāpaṃ sādhakādhamaiḥ |
vyaktaṃ sarvatra deveśi (!) labhyate kulasundari (!) |
pīṭhaprasaṅgāddeveśi (!) pīṭhāni śṛṇu bhairavi (!) |
śṛṇu tāni mahāprājñe (!) śreṣṭhasthānāni yāni ca |
siddhipradāni sādhūnāṃ mahadbhiḥ sevitāni ca |
puṣkarañca gayākṣetramakṣayākhyavaṭastathā |
varāhaparvatañcaiva tīrthañcāmarakaṇṭakam |
narmadā yamunā piṅgī gaṅgādvāraṃ tathā priye (!) |
gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgañca kuśīvartañca bilvakam |
śrīnīlaparvatañcaiva kalambakubjake tathā |
bhṛgutuṅgañca kedāraṃ sarvapriyaṃ mahābalam |
lalitā ca sugandhā ca śākambharī purapriyam |
karṇatīrthaṃ mahāgaṅgā taṇḍulikāśrama eva ca |
kumārākhyaprabhāsau ca tathā dhanyā sarasvatī |
agastyāśramamiṣṭaṃ me karṇāśramamataḥ param |
kauśikīsarayūśoṇajyotiḥsarapuraḥsaram |
kālodakaṃ priyaṃ śrīmat priyamuttamamānasam |
pataṅgavāpī saptārcirmahāviṣṇupadaṃ mahat |
vaidyanāthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ priyaḥ kālañjaro giriḥ |
rāmocchedaṃ gargocchedaṃ harocchedaṃ mahānanam |
bhadreśvaraṃ mahātīrthaṃ lakṣmaṇacchedameva ca |
jānīhi priyaśreṣṭhā ca kāverī kapilodakā |
someśvaraṃ śuklatīrthaṃ kṛṣṇavelvāprabhedakam |
pāṭhalā ca mahābodhirnagatīrthaṃ madantike (!) |
puṇyaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ devi (!) tathā meghavanaṃ hareḥ |
ailamavanakañcaiva govarddhanamajapriyam |
hariścandraṃ puraścandraṃ pṛthūdakamatipriyam |
indranīlaṃ mahānādaṃ tathaiva priyamainakam |
pañcāsaraṃ pañcavaṭī vaṭī parvaṭikā tathā |
gaṅgābilvaprasaṅgaśca priyanādavaṭaṃ tathā |
gaṅgārāmācalañcaiva tathaiva ṛṇamocanam |
gautameśvaratīrthañca vaśiṣṭhatīrthameva ca |
hārītañca tathā devi (!) brahmāvartaṃ śivapriyam |
kuśāvartamatiśreṣṭhaṃ haṃsatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca |
piṇḍārakavanaṃ khyātaṃ haridvāraṃ tathaiva ca |
tathaiva badarītīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca |
jayantīvijayantañca sarvakalyāṇadaṃ priye (!) |
vijayā śāradātīrthaṃ bhadrakāleśvaraṃ tathā |
aśvatīrthaṃ suvikhyātaṃ tathā devaśivapriyam |
oghavatī nadī caiva tīrthamaśvapradaṃ tathā |
chāgaliṅgamātṛgaṇaṃ karavīrapuraṃ tathā |
saptagodāvaraṃ tīrthaṃ liṅgākhyaṃ sarvamohanam |
kirīṭamuttare tīrthaṃ dakṣiṇe tīrthamuttamam |
viśālatīrthaṃ kālyāśca vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ tathā |
jvālāmukhī hiṅgulā ca mahātīrthaṃ gaṇeśvaram |
jānīhi sarvatīrthānāṃ hetusthānāni sundari (!) |
atra sannihitā nityaṃ sarve devā maharṣayaḥ |
pitaro yoginaścaiva ye ye siddhiparāyaṇāḥ |
āśu sidhyanti karmāṇi śraddhābhaktimatāṃ priye (!) |
puṇyakāle paṭhed yastu tatpuṇyamakṣayaṃ bhavet |
śrāddhakāle paṭhet yastu juhuyādvāpi bhaktitaḥ |
akṣayaṃ tadbhavet kavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ paramaṃ sukham |
asmin sthāne paṭhed yastu siddhirbhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||
atha vakṣye maheśāni (!) yatra yā devatā śṛṇu |
yatra te yāni nāmāni kathayiṣyāmi tat śṛṇu |
magno'haṃ paramānande tatkathāmṛtavāridhau |
puṣkare kamalākṣī ca gayāyāñca gayeśvarī |
akṣayā akṣayavaṭe'mareśo'marakaṇṭake |
varāhaparvate ca tvaṃ varāhī dharaṇīpriyā |
narmadā narmadāyāñca kālindī yamunājale |
śivāmṛtā ca gaṅgāyāṃ aśvā dehalikāśrame |
śāradā sarayūtīre śoṇe ca kanakeśvarī |
aprakāśā yadā devī jyotirmayyabdhisaṅgame |
śrīrahaṃ śrīgirau caiva kālī kālodake tathā |
mahodarī mahātīrthe nīlā cottaramānase |
mātaṅginyāṃ mataṅge ca guptārciviṣṇupāduke |
svargadā svargamārge ca godāvaryāṃ gaveśvarī |
vimuktiścaiva gomatyāṃ pipāśāyāṃ mahābalā |
śatadrvāṃ śatarūpā ca candrabhāgā ca tatra vai |
airāvatyāñca īrnāma siddhidā siddhitīrake |
dakṣapañcanade caiva dakṣiṇāhaṃ prakīrtitā |
aujase vīryadā ca tvaṃ saṅgamā tīrthasaṅgame |
bāhudāyāmanantāhaṃ kurukṣetre raṇekṣaṇā |
tapasvinī puṇyatamā bhāratī bhāratāśrame |
sukathā naimiṣāraṇye pāṇḍau ca pāṇdarānanā |
viśālāyāṃ viśālākṣī muṇḍapṛṣṭhe śivātmikā |
śraddhā kanakhale tīrthe śuddhabuddhirmunīśvarī |
suveśā sumanā gaurī mānase ca sarovare |
nandāpure mahānandā lalitā lalitāpure |
brahmāṇī brahmaśirasi mahāpātakanāśinī |
pūrṇimā cendumatyāñnca kāñcyāmatipriyā sadā |
jāhnavīsaṅgame vṛttiḥ svadhā ca pitṛtuṣṭidā |
puṇyāhaṃ bahumityāñca prapāyāṃ pāpanāśinī |
śaṅkhasaṃhāriṇī caiva ghorarūpā mahodarī |
svargocchede mahāvāriḥ prabalā ca mahāvane |
bhadrā ca bhadrakālī ca bhadreśvarī śivapriyā |
bhadreśvare ramā viṣṇupriyā viṣṇupade tathā |
dāruṇā narmadācchede kāveryāṃ kapileśvarī |
bhedinī kṛṣṇavettāyāṃ sambhede śubhavāsinī |
śraddhā ca śukratīrthe ca prabhāse ceśvarī tathā |
mahābodhau mahābuddhiḥ paṭale pāṭaleśvarī |
subalā nāgatīrthe ca nāgeśī nāgavanditā |
madantau ca madantī ca pramadā ca madantikā |
meghasvanā meghavāme vidyut saudāminīcchadā |
rāmeśvare mahābuddhirvīrā celāpure satī |
priyā ca mārgake durgā sureśā surasundarī |
kātyāyanī mahādevī govarddhane'khilātmikā |
śubheśvarī hariścandre puracandre pureśvarī |
pṛthūdake mahāvegā maināke'khilavarddhinī |
indranīle mahākāntā ratnaveśā suśobhanā |
māheśvarī mahānāde mahātejā mahābale |
patyapāsarasi sāraṅgā pañcakaṭyāṃ tapasvinī |
vaṭīśāvaṭikāyāñca sarvavarṇā suraṅgiṇī |
saṅgame vindhyagaṅgāyāṃ vindhye śrīvindhyavāsinī |
mahānandā nandataṭe gaṅgabālācale śivā |
āryāvarte mahāryā tvaṃ vimuktir(-)ṛṇamocane |
aṭṭahāse ca cāmuṇḍā tantre śrīgautameśvarī |
vedamayī brahmavidyā vaśiṣṭhe tvamarundhatī |
harite hariṇākṣī ca brahmāvarte brajeśvarī |
gāyatrī caiva sāvitrī kuśāvarte kuśapriyā |
haṃseśvarī mahātīrthe parahaṃseśvareśvarī |
piṇḍārakavane dhanyā surasā sukhadāyinī |
nārāyaṇī vaiṣṇavī ca gaṅgādvāre vimuktidā |
śrīvidyā vadarītīrthe rāmatīrthe mahādhṛtiḥ |
jayantī ca jayante tvaṃ vijayante'parājitā |
vijayā ca mahāśuddhiḥ śāradāyāñca śāradā |
subhadre bhadradā bhavyā bhadrakāleśvare tathā |
mahābhadrā mahākālī hayatīrthe gavīśvarī |
vedadā vedamātā ca videśe vedamastake |
yuvatyāñca mahāvidyā mahānadyāṃ mahodayā |
caṇḍā ca tripade caiva chāgaliṅge balipriyā |
mātardṛśe jaganmātā karavīrapure satī |
malinī raṅgiṇī rāmā paramā parameśvarī |
saptagodāvare tīrthe devarṣirakhileśvarī |
ayodhyāyāṃ bhavānī ca jayadā jayamaṅgalā |
mādhavī mathurāyāñca devakī yādaveśvarī |
vṛndā gopeśvarī rādhā rāsavṛndāvane rame |
kātyāyanī mahāmāyā bhadrakālī kalāvatī |
candramālā mahāyogā mahāyoginyadhīśvarī |
vajreśvarī yaśodeti vajraśrīgokuleśvarī |
kāñcyāṃ kanakakāñcī syādavantyāmatipāvanī |
vidyā vidyāpure caiva vimalā nīlaparvate |
rāmeśvarī setubandhe vimalā puruṣottame |
virajā yāgapuryāñca bhadre'pi bhadrakarṇikā |
tamolipte tamoghnī ca svāhā sāgarasaṅgame |
kulaśrīrvaṃśavṛddhiśca mādhavī mādhavapriyā |
maṅgalā maṅgale koṭe rāḍhe maṅgalacaṇḍikā |
jvālāmukhī śivāpīṭhe mandare bhuvaneśvarī |
kālighaṭṭe guhyakālī kirīṭe ca maheśvarī |
kirīṭeśvarī mahādevī liṅgākhye liṅgavāhinī |
sākṣī sarvatra bhaktānāmabhaktānāṃ kuto'pi na ||
athānyat sampravakṣyāmi siddhasthānāni sundari (!) |
sarvapāpavināśārthaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām |
nirmitāni śiveneha siddhasthānāni yāni ca |
śrutvā manasi bhāvyāni prakāśyānyadhikāriṣu |
amareśamahāpīṭhe kuśatuṅgārasaṃjñakaḥ |
tatra durgādvayaṃ nāma caṇḍikā ca maheśvarī |
prabhāse somanātho'sau devī ca puṣkarekṣaṇā |
devadevādhipaḥ śambhurnaimiṣe ca maheśvaraḥ |
tatra prajñā ca devī ca śivānī liṅgadhariṇī |
puṣkare ca rājagandhiḥ purahūtā maheśvarī |
śrīparvate śriyo nāma śaṅkarastripurāntakaḥ |
māyāvī śaṅkarī tatra bhaktānāmakhilārthadā |
japyeśvare mahāsthāne śaṅkarī ca triśūlinī |
triśulī śaṅkarastatra sarvapāpavimocakaḥ |
āmrātakeśvare sūkṣmā sūkṣmākhyā parameśvarī |
gaṇakṣetre maṅgalākhyā śivo yaḥ prapitāmahaḥ |
kurukṣetre śivasthāṇuḥ śivāsthāṇuḥ śriyā parā |
iṣṭalābhe svayambhūśca devī svāyambhuvā matā |
ugraḥ kanakhale proktaḥ śivogre śivavallabhā |
vimaleśvare viśvaśambhurviśvāviśvapriyā sadā |
aṭṭahāse mahānando mahānandā maheśvarī |
mahāntako mahendraśca pārvatī ca mahāntakā |
bhīmeśvaro bhīmapīṭhe śivā bhīmeśvarī tathā |
vastrapāde bhavo nāma bhavānī bhuvaneśvarī |
adrikūṭe mahāyogī rudrāṇī parameśvarī |
avimukte mahādevo viśālākṣī śivā parā |
mahāmāye haro rudro mahābhāgā śivā tathā |
mahābalaśca gokarṇe śivabhadrā ca caṇḍikā |
bhadrakarṇe mahādevo bhadrā ca karṇikā tathā |
suparṇākhye sahasrākhya utpalā parameśvarī |
sthāṇusaṃjñe śivasthā śrīsvarasthā śrīdharā śivā |
kanakālaye mahāsthāne kamalākhyo maheśvaraḥ |
kamalākṣī maheśāni (!) sakalārthapradāyinī |
chāgalā tu kapardī ca prasabhā ca maheśvarī |
ūrddharetā vareṇye ca sandhyākhyaparameśvarī |
sākoṭāsyamahākoṭā śivā ca muṇḍakeśvarī |
mātuleśvarapīḥe ca karavīrā ca śekharā |
śrīmadvyāghrapure sākṣāddharanāmā sabhāpatiḥ |
śivaḥ sabhāpatirnāma yatra nṛtyati śaṅkaraḥ |
ātmānandamahānādapūrṇānandamahārṇavam |
nṛtyantaṃ yatra deveśaṃ deveśī paripaśyati |
yatra āśu mahādevo bhaktānāṃ varado bhavet |
nṛtyantaṃ yatra sarveśaṃ vīkṣya loko vimucyate |
puṇyasthāneṣu sarveṣu sthānametanmahottamam |
yad yatkarmāṇi sarvāṇi akṣayāṇi bhavanti vai |
tasmin mahottame sthāne śivagaṅgākhyamadbhutam |
taḍāgamasti tattīre dakṣiṇe nṛtyatīśvaraḥ |
taḍāge'smin vasan snātvā sabhānāthaṃ samīkṣate |
aṣṭottarasahasrantu japecchuddho mudānvitaḥ ||
yāni te kathitānyatra sadā tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ |
pitaraḥ siddhagandharvāḥ siddhayaḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ |
atra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ snānamakṣayapuṇyadam |
yad yat prakīrtitaṃ nāma bhairavaṃ paripūjya ca |
praṇavādi hṛdante ca labhate'bhīṣṭamuttamam |
bhojayed brāhmaṇān yo'tra akṣayaṃ phalamaśnute |
iha nānāsukhaṃ bhuktvā haragaurīpuraṃ vrajet |
śokaduḥkhavināśo'yaṃ karuṇānidhirīśvaraḥ |
nirmame sarvasamprīttyai puṇyakṣetrāṇi bhūtale |
akāle puṇyaśuddhānāmanekaiḥ puṇyasādhanaiḥ |
āstikānāṃ bhavedatra nivāsaḥ sādhanaṃ prati |
tasmād yatnena kartavyamatra sādhanamuttamaiḥ |
idānīṃ śṛṇu cārvaṅgi (!) pīṭhaṃ sarvāṅgasundaram |
akṣamālāmayaṃ pīṭhaṃ brūhi me parameśvari (!) |
yatra sidhyanti kāryāṇi sthitiste śaṅkarasya ca |
viṣṇoragādhabodhasya tatpriyāyā maheśvari (!) |
anyeṣāñcaiva devānāṃ yugmaṃ padanivāsinām |
prasādo hi bhavatyāśu tatra ca prītiruttamā ||
atha pūjākālaḥ samayācāratantre prathamapaṭale ||
pūjanādiṣu yaḥ kālo devānāñca pṛthak pṛthak |
sa kālaḥ samayo nāma yajjñātvā'mṛtamaśnute ||
tathā |
prātarmadhyāhnakaḥ kālaḥ pradoṣaśca tṛtīyakaḥ |
rātriprathamayāmaśca caturthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
pañcamastvarddharātraśca pañca kālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
dinasya prathamasyādau kālaḥ prathama īritaḥ |
dinamadhye tu yaḥ kālo dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
sūryāstarajanīkādau pradoṣo yastṛtīyakaḥ |
brāhmyamuhūrtāvadhikamarddharātrādanantaram |
kālaḥ ṣaṣṭhātmako jñeyo devānāmapi durlabhaḥ |
śāntikarma tathā vaśyaṃ stambhadveṣaṇamohanam |
uccāṭanaṃ māraṇañca karmāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak |
śāntyarthaṃ prathamḥ kālo madhyāhnastadanantaram |
sāyaṃ sūryāstasamayastrikālānāmayaṃ kramaḥ ||
matsyasūkte pañcamapaṭale ||
anuktakāle sarvatra divasādau śubhe'hani |
bhāgānukte samaṃ kuryād vārānukte gurordine |
tithyanukte'ṣṭamī grāhyā nakṣatre rohiṇī matā |
yoge'nukte dhruvo yogaḥ sarvatraiva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
yoginītantre pūrvakhaṇḍe dvitīyapaṭale ||
gate tu prathame yāme tṛtīyapraharāvadhi |
kālo naktaṃ japasyoktaṃ pūjākālamiti śṛṇu |
sārddhayāmagate nakte sārddhayāmaḥ sthito yadā |
pūjākālo bhaved yāmaścaturvargapradaḥ sadā |
śliṣṭe dve ghaṭike ye tu rātrermadhyamayāmayoḥ |
sā mahārātriruddiṣṭā tatkṛtaṃ tvakṣayaṃ phalam |
yad yajjaptaṃ hutaṃ yad yat yat kṛtaṃ mokṣasādhanam |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ yāti tathānantyāya kalpyate |
guptasādhanatantre ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
niśā tu parameśāni (!) sūrye cāstamupāgate |
prahare ca gate rātrau ghaṭike dve pare ca ye |
mahāniśā samākhyātā tataścātimahāniśā |
tantrāntare ghaṭikādvayameva ceti pāṭhaḥ |
atimahāniśāntamuktvā tu |
tatra na pūjayeddevīṃ paśubhāvaḥ kadācana |
daśadaṇḍe tu yā pūjā tatsarvamakṣayaṃ bhavet |
ṣaṣṭhakrośe maheśāni (!) tat sarvamamṛtaṃ priye (!) |
saptamakrośake devi (!) sarvaṃ kṣīropamaṃ bhavet |
aṣṭamakrośaka ityādi samānam |
arddharātre gate devi (!) sarvaṃ kṣīropamaṃ smṛtam |
aṣṭamakrośake devi (!) dravyatulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
ataḥ paraṃ maheśāni (!) viṣatulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
etat sarvaṃ maheśāni (!) paśubhāve mayoditam |
divyavīramate devi (!) tattvajñāne prapūjayet |
pañcatattvaṃ samānīya yadi pūjāparo bhavet |
kālākālavicārantu devi (!) tatra vivarjayet |
arddharātre gate devi (!) kūlapūjā prakīrtitā |
tattattantrānusāreṇa sarvapūjādikañcaret |
vṛhanmuṇḍamālātantre ||
āgamaprakāśadhṛte ||
śaratkāle'thavā caitre sūryendusaṅgame'sitā |
arddharātre'rcitā devī bhogasvargāvavargadā |
sūryendusaṅgame'māvasyāyām |
asitā śyāmā kāliketi yāvat ||
āgamasāre ||
tulāmakarameṣeṣu kuhuṃ prāpya sureśvari (!) |
pūjayet kālikāṃ devīṃ caturvargaphalāptaye ||
nandikeśvaratantre ||
niśīthe kārtike kuhvāṃ yajeddīpānvitādine |
kālikāṃ kālikā tasya sarvābhīṣṭapradāyikā |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kuryāt kālikāyā mahotsavam |
kārtike tu viśeṣeṇa amāvasyāṃ niśārddhake |
tasyāṃ sampūjayeddevīṃ bhogamokṣapradāyinīm |
tulāyāṃ kujavāre'pi kuhureva yadā bhavet |
pragalbhāntu jagaddhātrīṃ pūjayedgītamaṅgalaiḥ |
muṇḍamālātantre ||
tulādityaniśārddhe tu pañcadaśyāṃ nagātmaje (!) |
pūjayet kālikāṃ tatra pracaṇḍāṃ muṇḍamālinīm ||
ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
divāpūjā vidhātavyā niśāpūjā maheśvari (!) |
sandhyāpūjā vidhātavyā tadā siddhimavāpnuyāt |
na divā na niśābhāge na sandhyāyāṃ kadācana |
pūjayenna jagaddhātrīṃ halāyāṃ paripūjayet |
divā na pūjayeddevīṃ rātrau naiva ca naiva ca |
sarvadā pūjayed devīṃ divā rātrau na pūjayet |
vacanatrayāṇāṃ iti divyavīraviṣayatvena samādhānamato na kaściddoṣaḥ |
tathā ca niruttaratantre prathamapaṭale ||
na divā pūjayedvīraḥ paśūrātrau na pūjayet |
viparītaṃ maheśāni (!) abhicārāya kalpyate ||
nanu prāguktaguptasādhanatantroktavacanena paśunāṃ ṣoḍaśadaṇḍātmakarātrimadhye pūjāśravaṇāt rātrau paśukartṛkapūjananiṣedhaḥ kathaṃ saṅgacchata iti cet satyam |
nandikeśvaramuṇḍamālātantrayorvacanairāgamaprakāśadhṛtaiḥ sahaikavākyatayā guptasādhanatantroktavacanaṃ dīpānvitādinimittakartavyaśyāmādipūjāviṣayakam |
niruttaratantrantu nityapūjāviṣayamiti sarvaṃ samañjasam |
divāvīrapūjāniṣedho'pi pañcatattvahīnapūjāviṣayatvena boddhavyaḥ |
anyathā pūrvoktakālākāletivacanamanarthakaṃ syāt |
atiniśāyāṃ pūjāniṣedhastu apraśastakālārthaḥ |
anyathā dravyasyāmṛtatvādikīrtanasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt |
sārddhayāmetyāda vastutastu kulapūjāviṣayam |
mahānirvāṇatantre caturdaśollāse ||
devyuvāca ||
yadyakasmāddevatānāṃ pūjābādho bhavedvibho (!) |
vidheyaṃ tatra kiṃ bhaktaistanme kathaya tattvataḥ |
apūjanīyāḥ kairdoṣairbhaveyurdevamūrtayaḥ |
tyājyā vā kena doṣeṇa tadupāyaśca bhaṇyatām ||
śrīsadāśiva uvāca ||
ekāhamarcanābādhāt dviguṇaṃ devapūjanam |
dinadvaye bhaveddviguṇaṃ taddvaiguṇyaṃ dinatraye |
tataḥ ṣaṇmāsaparyantaṃ yadi pūjā na sambhavet |
tadāṣṭakalasairdevaṃ snāpayitvā yajet sudhīḥ |
ṣaṇmāsāt parato devaṃ prāk saṃskāravidhānataḥ |
punaḥ susaṃskṛtaṃ kṛtvā pūjayet sādhakāgraṇīḥ |
khaṇḍitaṃ sphuṭitaṃ vyaṅgaṃ saṃspṛṣṭaṃ kuṣṭharogiṇā |
patitaṃ duṣṭabhūmyādau na devaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ |
hīnāṅgaṃ sphuṭitaṃ bhagnaṃ devaṃ toye(-)visarjayet |
sparśādidoṣaduṣṭantu saṃskṛtya punarcayet |
mahāpīṭhe'nādiliṅge sarvadoṣavivarjite |
sarvadā pūjayettatra svasvamiṣṭaṃ sukhāptaye ||
atha prāyaścittam ||
śyāmārahasyadhṛtaliṅgāgame ||
śṛṇu devi (!) pravakṣyāmi prāyaścittamanuttamam |
tadviśuddhiśca vidhivadbhairaveṇa subhāṣitam |
gurutyāgakaraḥ śiṣyaḥ prāyaścittī bhaveddhruvam |
lakṣaṃ śrīpādukāṃ japtvā tasmāt pāpādviśudhyati |
mantratyāgakaraḥ śiṣyastatsaṅgaṃ naiva kārayet |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ homatarpaṇataḥ śuciḥ ||
etattu divyavīragurutyāge boddhavyam |
kulaśiṣyeṇa paśugurutyāgaḥ kartavya eva |
iti śyāmārahasyoktaṃ tanna samīcīnam kaulikānāṃ prāyaścittābhāvāt ||
taduktaṃ kulārṇave pañcamakhaṇḍe ||
prāyaścittaṃ bhṛgoḥ pātaṃ sannyāsaṃ vratadhāraṇam |
tīrthayātrābhigamanaṃ kaulaḥ pañca vivarjayet ||
tena prāyaścittaṃ paśuśiṣyaviṣayam |
paśugurutyāgasya śāstroktatvānna tatra prāyaścittam |
tadvacanantu rudrajāmalakulārṇavayoḥ |
madhulubdho yathā bhṛṅgaḥ puṣpāt puṣpāntaraṃ vrajet |
jñānalubdhastathā śiṣyo gurorgurvantaraṃ vrajet |
mantrānmantrāntaramiti pāṭhāntaram |
tanmate ca ripumantraḥ sādhyamantro jīvahīnaḥ sandigdho vā yathā syāttathā taṃ hitvā anyamantragrahaṇaṃ kuryāt |
tathā vidyāṃ vihāya mahāvidyāgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt ||
taduktaṃ tatraiva ||
sakalo jīvahīnaśca sandigdho nidritastathā |
manavaste na sidhyanti guruḥ syād brahmaghātakaḥ |
tadā taṃ sahasā jñātvā mantradevaṃ guruṃ tyajet |
bahujño'pi gurustyājyo jñātvā sāraṃ varānane (!) |
alpajño'pi guruḥ pūjyo yo jānāti kulākulam |
ekatra guruṇā sārddhaṃ svapityupaviśecca yaḥ |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadindrāścaturdaśa |
guruvākyaṃ hataṃ kṛtvā ātmāvākyantu ropayet |
guruṃ jetuṃ mano yasya sa patennarakārṇave |
anekadhā paśorannaṃ bhuñjate ye ca kaulikāḥ |
tebhyaḥ prakupyate devī tatsaṅgaṃ naiva kārayet |
kaulikaḥ paśusaṃsargo paśuśaktiṃ ramedbalāt |
goṣṭhīmadhye ca yatnena darśaṃ tasya na kārayet |
ekapātre pibeddravyaṃ vīro māheśvaro yadi |
śuno viṣṭhā bhavet pānaṃ prāyaścitī sa kaulikaḥ |
gāyatrībhiḥ sahasreṇa tatpāpaṃ śamayedatha |
homayeddhaviṣājyena niṣpāpaḥ sa bhaveddhruvam |
lakṣatrayaṃ japellopāṃ lakṣaṃ vāpyajapāṃ japet |
samyak śodhitacittastu suvarṇaṃ gurave dadet |
cakraṃ kṛtvā tu deveśi (!) pūjayettarpaṇaṃ vinā |
catvāri tasya naśyanti āyurvidyā yaśo balam |
abhiṣeke vinābhūte ācāryatvaṃ karoti yaḥ |
yonikoṭiśataṃ yāti rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet |
mātṛrūpāṃ parityajya strīrūpāṃ śaktimācaret |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ janmakoṭiśatāni ca |
mūlaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā ajapāṃ lakṣameva ca |
kūrcabījaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ tataḥ śuddhimavāpnuyāt |
mantramātā ca putrī ca bhaginī ca kulāṅganā |
na ramet kauliko nityametāḥ samyak samarcayet |
śrīpātragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā cakramutthāpayedyadi |
paśupānaṃ bhavettasya prāyaścittaṃ prajāyate ||
atha mantramātṛgamane prāṇāntikaprāyaścittam |
taduktaṃ tantrāntare ||
balādvā svecchayā vāpi yo ramenmantramātaram |
daśalakṣaṃ manuṃ japtvā tuṣānalaṃ samācaret |
putrīkulāṅganābhaginīgamane mūlamantralakṣajapāt śuddhistaduktaṃ tatraiva ||
mantraputrī svaputrī ca bhaginī ca kulāṅganā |
ramaṇāllakṣajāpena śuddho bhavati kaulikaḥ ||
tantrāntare ||
parvaṇyapūjya deveśīṃ gurumagniñca śaktitaḥ |
adattvā ca baliṃ tatra śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ mūlamantrapānādimauṣadham |
anivedya na bhuñjīta yadāhārāya kalpyate |
anivedyantu bhuñjānaḥ prāyaścittī bhavennaraḥ |
devyāścāṣṭaśataṃ mantraṃ japtvā pūto bhavennaraḥ |
anasthiprāṇisaṅghātaṃ hatvā ca daśakaṃ japet |
hatvā ca pakṣiṇaḥ sarvān tribhirekādaśaṃ japet |
sarpamārjāranakulaṃ śvānamuṣṭraṃ kharaṃ hayam |
gajādyāṃśca mṛgān sarvān hatvā cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
japedaṣṭasahasrantu kṣatravaiśyabadhe budhaḥ |
hatvā paśuṃ striyaṃ bālaṃ mantraṃ pañcaśataṃ japet |
japedaṣṭasahasrantu sacchūdravinipātane |
trayodaśasahasrantu divyavīrabadhe japet |
vīrastrīgamanenāpi vṛthāpāne tathaiva ca |
gurusnuṣāmantraputtrigamane cāpi kaulikaḥ ||
iti tu ajñānakṛte bodhyaṃ jñānakṛte tu lakṣajapāt śuddhiḥ ||
taduktaṃ brahmajāmale ||
kṛtvā vīrabadhaṃ mantrī vṛthāpānaṃ gurusnuṣām |
vīrapatnīṃ mantraputtrīṃramitvā digayutaṃ japet ||
iti |
mahāpātakaprāyaścittajapastu latāsambandhena kāryaḥ |
taduktaṃ kālītantre ||
latāratena japtavyaṃ mahāpātakamuktaye |
rudrajāmale uttarakhaṇḍe dvitīyapaṭale ||
paśūnāṃ vratabhaṅgādau vidhiṃ prathamataḥ śṛṇu |
vratabhaṅge nityabhaṅge nityapūjādikarmaṇi |
sahasraṃ prajapenmantrī vratadoṣopaśāntaye ||
gāyatrītantre pañcamabrāhmaṇapaṭale |
śālagrāmaśilādyagre kṛtvā divyaṃ karoti yaḥ |
śālagrāmādikaṃ spṛṣṭvā yadi divyaṃ karoti ca |
tathā gaṅgājalādīṃśca tāmrañca gomayaṃ tathā |
tulasīñca mahādevi (!) suvarṇaṃ gorajastathā |
vedādīnyapi puṇyāni dravyāṇyanyāni yānyapi |
tīrthapīṭhādināmāni spṛṣṭvā divyaṃ karotyapi |
divyakartuḥ kārayiturnarakānna ca niṣkṛtiḥ ||
pūrvoktaṃ yanmaheśāni (!) tatpāpasya viśuddhaye |
yadi brahmabadhaproktaprāyaścittaṃ kariṣyati ||
tasmāt pāpāt tadā śuddho nānyathā kalpakoṭibhiḥ |
aparañca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalānane (!) |
gaṅgāsnānaṃ hi nandādau sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
gaṅgātoye kṛtaṃ divyaṃ tatpāpaṃ naganandini (!) |
mahāpātakopapāpaṃ gaṅgāsnānādvinaśyati |
gaṅgāyāṃ mauṣalaṃ snānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
prāyaścittātmakagaṅgāsnānasaṅkalpaḥ ||
adyetyādiśālagrāmasannidhidivyakaraṇaśālagrāmagaṅgājala(-) tāmragomayagorajastulasīsuvarṇarajatatīrthamahāpīṭhavedādiśāstra(-) sparśapūrvakadivyakaraṇadevādināmoccāraṇapūrvakadivyakaraṇa(-) kāraṇajñānakṛtabrahmahatyādijanitapāpakṣayakāmo nandāyāṃ gaṅgāsnānamahaṃ kariṣye |
iti tu samuccitapāpakṣayasaṅkalpaḥ |
adyetyādigaṅgājalasparśapūrvakadivyakaraṇadivyakāraṇajanitapāpa(-)kṣayakāmo gaṅgāyāṃ snānamahaṃ kariṣye |
iti gaṅgājalasparśapūrvakadivyakaraṇapāpakṣayasaṅkalpaḥ |
adyetyādijñānājñānakṛta brahmahatyādipāpakṣayakāmo gaṅgāyāṃ snānamahaṃ kariṣye ||
iti brahmahatyādipāpakṣayasaṅkalpaḥ ||
[iti śrīprāṇatoṣiṇyāṃ caturthe kāmyakāṇḍe śākhākathanaṃ nāma dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ] |
atha viśeṣasādhanāni |
kṛkalāsadīpikāyāṃ prathamapaṭale ||
śrīnīlāvāṇyuvāca ||
idānīṃ kṛkalāso'pi paśurūpadharo'vyayaḥ |
paśuvākyaprabodhāya upāyaṃ vada śaṅkara (!) ||
īśvara uvāca ||
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi (!) paśuvākyapraodhanam |
ādau tu kathayiṣyāmi paścāt sādhanamuttamam |
kārtike phālgune māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ mahāniśi |
ekākī nirbhayo gatvā citāyāṃ varavarṇini (!) |
śuddhāsanaṃ samāsādya devīṃ dhyātvā tu carcikām |
śuṣkakaṇṭhīmugrarāvāṃ śunāṃ ghoratarekṣiṇīm |
yuvatīṃ dvibhujāṃ tālajaṅghāṃ muktakacāṃ bhaje |
evaṃ dhyātvā prayatnena japenmantramananyadhīḥ |
tārāṃ māyāṃ tathā carcicarcike kṛkalāsakam |
bodhayadvitayaṃ vahnikāntāmantraḥ parātparaḥ |
evaṃ sahasraṃ prajapet tataḥ siddhiranuttamā |
kṛkalāsaravaṃ jñātvā sādhako gataśokabhāk |
tatprasādānmaheśāni (!) sāphalyaṃ tasya jāyate |
sa brūte sakalāṃ vārtāṃ sādhakāya yadā tadā |
rājānaṃ vaśayet kṣipraṃ kāminīñca na saṃśayaḥ || 1 ||
athavā goṣṭhamāsādya niśīthe sādhakottamaḥ |
ugracaṇḍāṃ prayatnena dhūpadīpairmanoramaiḥ |
bhaktitaḥ parameśāni (!) pūjayettāramāyayā |
nijamantrasahasrantu tadaiva prajapettataḥ |
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 2 ||
athavā kāminīpuṣpamakarandena sundari (!) |
tilakaṃ kārayenmūrddhni japedetaṃ manuṃ tataḥ |
tatkṣaṇāt siddhimāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 3 ||
iti kṛkalāsasiddhiḥ ||
atha vallīsiddhiḥ ||
tatraiva |
vallikāyāṃ sādhayedvidvānnadītīre mahāniśi |
ugrakeśīṃ prayatnena pūjayitvā viśeṣataḥ |
tāraṃ hṛdugrakeśīñca caturthyantāṃ dviṭhāvadhi |
japedetat sahasrantu sidhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
athavā muktakeśastu citāyāṃ parameśvari (!) |
bagalāṃ pūjayed yatnādupacārairyathocitaiḥ |
oṃ namo bagale (!) māyā svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmanuḥ |
aṣṭottarasahasrantu japedananyamānasaḥ |
tato devi (!) samānīya godhikāṃ gṛhasambhavām |
pūjayettāṃ prayatnena punarjāpaṃ samācaret |
tataḥ prabhṛti deveśi (!) vallikāśabdavidbhavet |
atītānāgatāṃ vārtāṃ līlayā vakti sarvadā || 1 ||
athavā niśi māṃsādyaiḥ pūjayet kṛṣṇapiṅgalām |
japenmāyātrayaṃ lakṣmīṃ ṅeyutaṃ nāmasaṃyutam |
japedayutamānantu tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ |
tadeva phalamāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
prātaḥkāla samāsādya japedenaṃ dināvadhi |
sandhyāyāṃ parameśāni (!) jyaiṣṭhikāśabdavidbhavet ||
atha mūṣikasādhanaṃ tatraiva ||
atha vakṣye maheśāni (!) mūṣikāśabdasādhanam |
upoṣya pūrve'hani śuddhamānasaḥ prātaḥ śuciḥ sundaraveśadhārī |
gatvā nadītīramuṣīṃ satārāṃ ṅe'ntāṃ namo'ntāṃ prajapecca yatnāt |
siddhāvadhi śrīgirirājakanyāprasādato mūṣikaśabdavidbhavet || 1 ||
kiṃvā ramāyugmamuṣīñca ṅe'ntāṃ dviṭhāvadhi proktamavītimanyat |
japet sahasrañca śataṃ niśānte tato maheśāni (!) bhavettadeva || 2 ||
vāṇīṃ ramāñca pradadāsi vidyāṃ lajjāñca tārañca punaśca lajjām |
tāraṃ punarmūṣikaśabdapūrvaṃ vicarcike vahnivadhūsametam |
śayyāmupetyāśu japecca vidyām svakāntayā vā parakāntayā vā |
tato maheśāni (!) sa rājagoṣṭhī brūte raho mūṣikaśabdavṛndam |
durbhikṣaṃ vā subhikṣaṃ vā bandhañcāpi śubhāśubham |
deśānāñca maheśāni (!) śīghraṃ brūte śubhāśubham ||
atha mārjārasādhanaṃ tatraiva ||
atha vakṣye maheśāni (!) mārjāraśabdamuttamam |
pauṣe vā śrāvaṇe vāpi haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ |
dhupadīpaiśca naivedyai raktacandanapuṣpakaiḥ |
pūjayitvā prayatnena vikaṭākṣāṃ mahotkaṭām |
bibhratīṃ kaṅkiṭīṃ dhyāyenmārjāroparisaṃsthitām |
tāraṃ māyāṃ kaṅkaṭāñca caturthyantāmudīrayet |
svāhāntā kathitā vidyā japettāmayutatrayam |
evaṃ saptadinaṃ rātrau śmaśāne sādhakottamaḥ |
kuryāt siddho'tha mārjāraśabdaṃ budhyati nānyathā |
atītānāgatāṃ vārtāṃ sa brūte parameśvari (!) ||
śṛgālasādhanamapi tatraiva ||
atha vakṣye maheśāni (!) pherūṇāṃ śabdamuttamam |
amāvāsyādine pheru ekaghātaprahāriṇaḥ |
gataprāṇo'tha saṃsthāpya bhūtale darbhasa~caye |
tamāruhya maheśāni (!) pūjayet pherukaṃ sudhīḥ |
caturbhujāṃ viśālāsyāṃ vivastrāmunnatastanīm |
taptakāñcanasaṅkāśāṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ gadāmasim |
bibhratīṃ muktakeśīñca sarvabhītiharāṃ parām |
iti dhyātvā prayatnena gandhapuṣpairmanoramaiḥ |
sāmiṣaiḥ surasaiścaiva naivedyaiśca manoramaiḥ |
pūjayitvā varārohe (!) japet praṇavasampuṭām |
kālī māyā tathā kālī vahnikāntāvadhi priye (!) |
prajapedarddharātrau ca lakṣamānaṃ śuciḥ pumān |
pheruḥ sa jīvati tato divyamutpadyate tadā |
varaṃ varaya bho vatsa (!) yatte manasi vartate |
tataḥ sa sādhakaśreṣṭho devadevaṃ manorame (!) |
vaśībhūtvā sahasrābdān tvaṃ māṃ pālaya sarvadā |
evaṃ prārthya varaṃ devi (!) pūjayettāṃ prayatnataḥ |
raktaśākānnapiṣṭena bhojanañca yathocitam |
tataḥ sa tiṣṭhati sadā yāvadāyurna saṃśayaḥ |
tachayanañca lakṣamānañca hanyāt sa vīkṣaṇena tu |
yad yat samprārthayenmantrī sarvamānīya yacchati |
sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi dhanaṃ dadyāddine dine |
icchābhojyaṃ maheśāni (!) tathaiva varasundarīm |
ānīya krośalakṣasthāṃ jape yacchati pārvati (!) |
anāgatāṃ tathā vārttāṃ brūte ṣāṇmāṣikīmapi |
atītāṃ śatavarṣīyāṃ brūte nityaṃ maheśvari (!) |
śivānāṃ sarvavārtāñca svayaṃ bodhayati dhruvam |
pratyahaṃ prajapettañca yatnena sāmiṣānnakaiḥ |
sa śrutvā pherukāṇāñca śabdaṃ praṇatimācaret ||
atha śvaśabdasādhanam tatraiva |
nimbamūlaṃ samāsādya pūjayedbhojane'satām |
dhūpadīpaiśca naivedyairbalibhiḥ paramottamaiḥ |
pūjayitvā niśābhāge japedaṣṭāyutaṃ budhaḥ |
sphiṃ sphiṃ kāli (!) vahnikāntā vidyeyaṃ paramottamā |
tataḥ siddho maheśāni (!) sarvaṃ kukkurabhāṣitam |
budhyeddevi (!) tadā sarvaṃ tadarthañca yathatatham ||
iti śvaśabdajñānam |
mekasādhanaṃ tatraiva |
nadītīraṃ samāsādya snāto nirmalavastraṣṭak |
prajāpatiṃ vahnisaṃsthamanusvārasamanvitam |
tritayaṃ tattvato bheṃ bheṃ mantrametadudīritam |
japeddevi (!) sahasrantu pratyahaṃ saptavāsarān |
tato mekavare devi (!) sarvatattvārthavidbhavet |
atītānāgatāṃ vārtāṃ brūte cāpi yathocitām ||
atha godhāsādhanam |
godhayā hatayā vāpi athavā bilvamūlake |
godhikāṃ khaḍgahastāñca daṃṣṭrāṃ śāntimukhīṃ śivām |
raktagambhīranayanāṃ raktavarṇaśiroruhām |
japellakṣapramāṇantu godhikāsiddhihetave |
siddhāyāṃ godhikāyāñca kiṃ na sidhyati pārvati (!) |
icchārūpaṃ dadātyannaṃ dadāti vipulaṃ dhanam |
atītānāgatāṃ vārtāṃ vartamānāṃ tathā priye (!) |
raktiśaktī yathā syātāṃ yadvat pṛcchati sarvadā ||
atha gośabdajñānam |
gavāṃ mūtreṇa deveśi (!) |
yāvakaṃ pācayedbudhaḥ |
tasmāddinatrayaṃ vāpi śuddhavāsodharaḥ pumān |
dharābījadvayaṃ devi (!) japellakṣapramāṇataḥ |
pūjayedenāṃ satīṃ devīṃ nīlavarṇāṃ manoramām |
dvibhujāṃ sarvabhūṣāḍhyāṃ nānālakṣaṇalakṣitām |
evaṃ dhyātvā prayatnena paśyedenāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
tasya gehe sadā devi (!) gavāṃ vṛddhirbhaveddhruvam |
gavāñca sarvavārtāñca samprabuddhyenna saṃśayaḥ |
tasya gehe sthirā lakṣmīrjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
atha mṛgaśabdajñānam tatraiva |
bilvamūlaṃ samāsādya devi (!) gandhādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
pūjayet kamalāṃ devī nīlavastrāṅgarāgiṇīm |
dvibhujāmambujadvandvadhāriṇīṃ parameśvarīm |
evaṃ dhyātvā prayatnena śuddhāsanagataḥ pumān |
kamalāṃ kamalāṃ māyāṃ māyāṃ vahnibadhūntathā |
japedaṣṭāyutaṃ devi (!) kamalāsiddhihetave |
siddhāyāṃ kamalāyāntu mṛgaśabdaṃ subudhyate |
dhanañca vipulaṃ devi (!) bhavettasya gṛhe dhruvam |
ripurna jāyate tasya jāyante sarvasampadaḥ |
kāminī vaśamāyāti yadi rambhāsamā bhavet ||
atha meṣaśabdajñānam tatraiva |
mahāgaṇḍārakaṃ devi (!) tasya carmaṇi cārdrake |
upaviśya japedvidyāṃ koṅkālāṃ kanakaprabhām |
raktavastraparīdhānāṃ nānāmaṇḍanamaṇḍitām |
dvibhujāṃ sundarīṃ devīṃ dhyātvā prayatamānasaḥ |
dharābījadvayaṃ devi (!) kāmabījadvayaṃ tathā |
svāhāntā kathitā vidyā japedaṣṭāyutaṃ budhaḥ |
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) koṅkaṇā parameśvari (!) |
śabdaṃ budhyati deveśi (!) meṣāṇāṃ tatprasādataḥ ||
atha chāgalaśabdajñānam |
kevalaṃ chāgadugdhena paramānnantu pācayet |
tadeva bhakṣayeddevi (!) japedenāmananyadhīḥ |
japecca koṅkaṇāṃ vidyāṃ saptāyutamatandritaḥ |
tatprasādānmaheśāni (!) chāgānāṃ śabdavidbhavet |
atha vanaviḍālaśabdajñānam |
haviṣyāśī niśābhāge japedenāṃ hi sādhakaḥ |
ṣaṭsahasrapramāṇena ṣaḍdinaṃ yāvadeve hi |
tataśca śaśakānāṃ vai śabdaṃ budhyati nānyathā |
anenaiva vidhānena ṛtumūlalatāṃ spṛśan |
ayutaikapramāṇena sandhyāyāṃ prajapenmanum |
tatastasyāḥ prasādena kapīnāṃ śabdavidbhavet |
anenaiva vidhānena japed yadi dināvadhi |
tato vanaviḍālānāṃ śabdaṃ budhyati nānyathā |
atha ṛkṣaśabdajñānam |
tāraṃ māyā ramāyugmaṃ viśālāṃ ṅeyutāṃ tathā |
astrānteyaṃ mahāvidyā svāhāntāmapi suvrate (!) |
viśālāṃ ghoravadanāṃ muktakeśīṃ digambarīm |
yauvanodbhinnavakṣojāṃ sarojākṣīṃ hasanmukhīm |
khaḍgakhaṭvāṅgapadmāsīn bibhratīṃ parameśvarīm |
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
niśābhāge haviṣyāśī japenmantraṃ jitendriyaḥ |
pūjayitvā prayatnena raktacandanapuṣpakaiḥ |
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādvahnau nimbakāṣṭhairvarānane (!) |
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) ṛkṣāṇāṃ śabdavidbhavet |
vivāde saṅkaṭe yuddhe jayī bhavati nānyathā |
kevalaṃ smṛtimātreṇa ṛkṣa āyāti tatpuraḥ |
yuddhe vāpi vivāde vā ripuṃ hanyācchatāyutam |
vipulañca balaṃ dadyāt satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
gajendramadasambhūtadraveṇa tilakaṃ yadi |
tadājñāvaśato hanyāt ripusainyaṃ śatāyutam |
vipulañca balaṃ dadyāt satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena śmaśāne yadi sādhakaḥ |
japellakṣapramāṇena vyāghrāṇāṃ śabdavidbhavet |
śvāpadasmṛtimātreṇa samayācāratatparaḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena japedaṣṭāyutaṃ budhaḥ |
juhuyāttaddaśāṃśena hastisiddhirbhaviṣyati |
aṣṭabhiḥ sahāyutamiti sahārthe tṛtīyā samāso'pi kvacidgamakatvāttenāṣṭādhikamayutamityāyātam |
kariśabdañca sa brūte sabhāyāṃ parameśvari (!) |
hastināntu prasādena sa jayī sarvavidbhavet |
karikṛtaśabdamabhipretya sabhāyāṃ sa brūte ityarthaḥ |
hastikarṇe tadā tena kathyate yanmaheśvari (!) |
tadeva kurute hastī drumādīnāntu bhañjanam |
anenaiva vidhānena yadi puṣpavatīgṛhe |
niśābhāge japellakṣaṃ pūjayedbalibhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
puṣpavatīgṛhe rajaḥsvalāyonimaṇḍale |
juhuyādayutaṃ padmairlohitaiḥ parameśvari (!) |
oṃ namo devadevāya pañcāsyāya mahātmane |
tvatprasādānmahādeva (!) mama siddhirbhaviṣyati |
iti stutvā maheśāni (!) mṛgendraśabdavidbhavet |
mṛgendrasya prasādena tasyāsādhyaṃ na vidyate |
yuddhe vāpi vivāde vā sa bhavedvijayī naraḥ |
mṛgendrasmṛtimātreṇa siṃho gacchati tatpuraḥ |
tadājñāvaśato nityaṃ kāryaṃ sādhayati dhruvam |
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ durlabhaṃ bhuvanatraye |
tasya gehe sthirā lakṣmīḥ puttrapautrāvadhi sthitā |
etanmantraṃ maheśāni (!) yadi parvatamastake |
haviṣyāśī japeddevi (!) sadā sarvatra siddhidaḥ ||
atha śūkaraśabdajñānam ||
paṅkabhūmiṃ samāsādya tāraṃ ghurughurudvayam |
ghūt ghūt svāhāntamantro'yaṃ japet saptāyutaṃ budhaḥ |
ghoṇirāpūrayed yatnāttataḥ sidhyati nānyathā ||
atha kaṅkālasiddhiḥ ||
nadītīraṃ samāsādya kṛtasnāno divā śuciḥ |
kaulikīṃ pūjayed yatnānnānāpuṣpairmanoramaiḥ |
madyairmāṃsairlohitaiśca nṛtyagītādibhiḥ svayam |
pītvā kularasaṃ yatnāt kulaṃ gatvā prayatnataḥ |
kālī māyābālike ca kaṅkālī vahnivallabhā |
etanmantraṃ maheśāni (!) japedviṃśasahasrakam |
tadāyāti mahādevi (!) kaṅkālī tatra sodyamā |
sādhakāya varaṃ dattvā vāhanañca varānane (!) |
yāti vā vāhanaṃ tasya vāhyaṃ vahati sarvadā |
hanti śatrusahasrāṇi pṛthvīṃ bhramati tatkṣaṇāt |
balañca vipulaṃ dadyāt satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
tāraṃ māyā ramābījaṃ paśunāmāgnivallabhā |
kālikāpūjanaṃ yastu paśunāmnā japenmanum |
sahasraṃ parameśāni (!) tasya śabdaṃ prabudhyati ||
atha kākaśabdajñānam ||
dvitīyapaṭale ||
kākapucchaṃ maheśāni (!) mūrdhni sandhārya yatnataḥ |
kālībījaṃ tathā kākā kālīmantro'yamuttamaḥ |
citāyāṃ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi homapūjāvivarjitam |
japenniśīthe deveśi (!) tataḥ siddho bhavennaraḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti deveśi (!) sārvajñaṃ tasya jāyate |
kākaśabdaprabodhena sarvaṃ vakti yathātatham |
cirajīvī bhavenmartyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 1 ||
atha khañjanasiddhiḥ ||
tāraṃ timiranāśyai ca māyābījaṃ maheśvari (!) |
pūjayet parameśāni (!) yatrāttimiranāśinīm |
tataḥ khañjanasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
khañjanānāṃ tatastasya darśanañca bhavet sadā |
mūrdhni nīte ca tatpakṣe daive'pi sa na dṛśyate |
jānīyāt khāñjanaṃ śabdaṃ sarveṣāṃ priyatāmiyāt |
atha jalacarapakṣisiddhiḥ |
etanmantraṃ maheśāni (!) śmaśāne yadi vā japet |
ṣaṭsahasrapramāṇena pūjayedambuvāsinīm |
tadā vāricarāṇāñca pakṣiṇāṃ śabdavidbhavet |
etanmantraṃ khañjanasādhanoktaṃ mantram ||
smṛtimātreṇa deveśi (!) pakṣiṇaḥ śataśaḥ kṣaṇāt |
tadājñāvaśagāḥ sarve pakṣiṇaḥ pūrvavartinaḥ || 2 ||
atha mayūrasiddhiḥ ||
vaṭamūlaṃ samāsādya niśīthe pūjayecchivām |
parāṃ caṇḍoṃ sahāsyāṃ vipulakucayugāṃ muktakeśīṃ vivastrāṃ nānālaṅkārapūrāṃ śaśadharaśakalaṃ bibhratīṃ bhīmakāntām |
japyantīmadrikārṇaṃ varajaghanabharāt kṣauṇicakraṃ samagraṃ nyakurvantīṃ samantādavaniripugaṇaṃ carvayantīṃ bhajāmi |
evaṃ dhyātvā tato devīṃ gandhapuṣpairmanoharaiḥ |
madyairmāṃsairmahābhogaiḥ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi |
kālībījaṃ samuccārya punaḥ kālī varānane (!) |
tato mayūraśabdasya mantro'yaṃ bahusiddhidaḥ |
aṣṭāyutaṃ japet paścāt humettāvat sahasrakam |
nimbakāṣṭhairharidrāktairbilvapatrairmanoharaiḥ |
samāyāti tato devī mayūragaṇamaṇḍitā |
varaṇ dattvā sādhakāya prayāti parameśvarī |
mayūraśabdavidbhūtvā sārvajñaṃ labhate dhruvam |
yathecchati tathā kṣate viṣaṃ jārayituṃ kṣamaḥ |
ripūṇāṃ jayamāpnoti satyaṃ devi (!) vadāmi te |
anenaiva vidhānena baliṃ dattvā svadehajām |
dakṣiṇāṃ śabdamātreṇa mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥ |
pūjayet kālikāṃ devīṃ madyairmāṃsairmanoharaiḥ |
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) kulasiddhiḥ sadā bhavet |
kulānāṃ śabdavidbhūtvā sārvajñaṃ labhate dhruvam || 3 ||
atha vidyādharapakṣiviśeṣasiddhiḥ |
māyāṃ tāraṃ gauṃ gauṃ caiva pātayettadanantaram |
