etanmantraṃ maheśāni (!) niśīthe tu japet sudhīḥ |
ayutañca jepeddevi (!) tataḥ siddhirbhaved dhruvam |
gandharvaśabdavidbhūtvā balavān puttravān bhavet || 4 ||
atha kaṅkaśabdajñānam |
kāmaṃ kelikeli dvandvaṃ kāmamantreṇa uttamaḥ |
japtvā saptasahasrantu kaṅkaśabdaprabodhanam |
kaṅkālaśabdavidbhūtvā sarvajño bhavati dhruvam || 5 ||
kolakāla varārohe (!) vahnikāntā tataḥ param |
bilvamūle maheśāni (!) japedayutamānataḥ |
pūjayet kālikāṃ devīṃ tataḥ siddhirbhaveddhruvam |
vakānāṃ śabdavidbhūtvā sarvajño jāyate naraḥ || 6 ||
atha caṭakaśabdajñānam ||
cāṭu cāṭu maheśāni (!) spheṃ pūrvaṃ parameśvari (!) |
saptāyutaṃ japed yatnāt kālikāmapi pūjayet |
tato budhyati deveśi (!) caṭakāśabdamuttamam || 7 ||
atha śukaśabdajñānam ||
māyābījaṃ śukadvandvaṃ bodhayadvitayaṃ tathā |
vahnikāntāvadhirmantro japedayutamānataḥ |
tataḥ śukasya śabdajño naro bhavati nānyathā |
śukasyāpi prasādena mahāsampattimān bhavet |
etanmantraṃ maheśāni (!) niśīthe tyaktabhojanaḥ |
japedaṣṭasahasrantu śārikāpadadānataḥ |
śārikāśabdavidbhūtvā sarvajño jāyate naraḥ || 8 ||
atha sārasasiddhiḥ ||
dharābījaṃ samuddhṛtya bhaiṃ bhaiṃ bījaṃ samuddharet |
etanmantraṃ maheśāni (!) saptāyutamatandritaḥ |
japet kamalamadhye tu haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ |
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
sārasāṇāṃ ravaṃ buddhvā sarvajño jāyate naraḥ || 9 ||
atha kapotasiddhiḥ ||
spheṅkāraṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya huṅkāradvayamuddharet ||
svāhāntā kathitā vidyā japedayutamānataḥ |
śālmalīmūlamāsādya pūjayet siddhikālikām |
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
kapotasya ravaṃ devi (!) sa budhyati na saṃśayaḥ || 10 ||
kauraberaśabdamuccārya kūrcabījaṃ samuddharet |
siddhikālīṃ prapūjyātha japedayutapañcakam |
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
kapotasya ravaṃ devi (!) sa budhyati na saṃśayaḥ || 11 ||
kapotaviṣṭhayā mūdhni tilake'pi kṛte budhaḥ |
bhūtaṃ bhāvi vartamānaṃ sarvaṃ vakti yathātatham || 12 ||
atha kukkuṭaśabdajñānam |
kaṃ kaṅkāraṃ samuccārya kūrcabījamathoddharet |
japedaṣṭāyutaṃ devi (!) kālikāñca prapūjayet |
madyairmāṃsairlatāgehe siddho bhavati nānyathā |
siddhe mantre tathā mantrī bhavedbhūmipurandaraḥ |
śabdaṃ budhyati teṣāṃ vai sarvajño bhavati dhruvam |
yāvattiṣṭhati tadviṣṭhā tasya mūrdhni varānane (!) |
kavitvaṃ kurute tāvat vādinaṃ jayati dhruvam || 13 ||
atha śarālusiddhiḥ ||
haṃ haṅkāraṃ samuccārya spheṃ spheṅkāraṃ samuccaret |
haṃsa haṃsa tato brūyāt japellakṣaṃ varānane (!) |
guhyakālīṃ prapūjyātha madyairmāṃsairvarānane (!) |
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) haṃsaśabdo hi suvrate (!) |
tadviṣṭhātilakaṃ kṛtvā mahāsarvajñatāmiyāt || 14 ||
atha kṣemaṅkarīsiddhiḥ ||
māyābījaṃ samuddhṛtya dharābījaṃ samuddharet |
kṣemaṅkarīpadaṃ paścāttadante vahnivallabhā |
vaṭamūlaṃ nadītīraṃ gatvā lakṣaṃ japennaraḥ |
pūjayet kālikāṃ devīṃ madyamāṃsairmanoramaiḥ |
raktapuṣpai raktamālyairnānālaṅkārasaṃyutaiḥ ||
tataḥ sidhyati deveśi (!) niśīthe sa bhavet priye (!) |
kṣemaṅkarīṇāṃ śabdajño jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
parastrīnirato devi (!) manovāñchāmavāpnuyāt || 15 ||
atha ṭiṭṭibhasiddhiḥ |
ṭiṭṭibhāyastu svaṃ bījaṃ vahnikāntā tataḥ param |
kālīṃ sampūjayedyatnāt ṭiṭṭibha śabdavidbhavet || 16 ||
atha kokasiddhiḥ |
kokayugmaṃ vahnikāntā japet saptāyutaṃ budhaḥ |
kālikāṃ pūjayedyatnāt kokānāṃ śabdavidbhavet || 17 ||
atha cakoraśabdajñānam |
kālībījaṃ cakorāya japedaṣṭāyutaṃ budhaḥ |
vaṭamūlaṃ samāsādya kālikāṃ pūjayettataḥ |
cakoraśabdavidbhūtvā sarvajño jāyate naraḥ || 18 ||
tāraṃ kālī cakorāya japedaṣṭāyuta naraḥ |
mahākālī tato devi (!) astraṃ vahnibadhūṃ tataḥ |
etanmantraṃ maheśāni (!) japellakṣaṃ maheśvari (!) |
madyairmāṃsai raktapuṣpairmahākālīṃ prapūjayet |
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhanena tatpucchaṃ mūrddhnidhārayet |
tatpakṣiṇaḥ śabdavettā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18 ||
atha koṭaśabdajñānam |
atha vakṣye maheśāni (!) kīṭasādhanamuttamam |
vaṭamūla samāsādya snātaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ |
vyāghracarmaiḥ samāsādya sadyairmāṃsairmanoharaiḥ |
dhūpadīpaiśca naivedyairbalibhiḥ paramottamaiḥ |
latābhirveṣṭito bhūtvā kīṭakañca samarpayet |
tuṅgavakṣījayugalāṃ cakoranetrāṃ hasanmukhīm |
pibantīṃ rudhiraṃ dhārāṃ muktakeśīṃ digambarām |
bibhratīṃ khaḍgamuṇḍañca tato vikaṭasannibhām |
evaṃ dhyātvā prayatnena japenmantramananyadhīḥ |
kālībījaṃ kīṭakālī nivasettatra sā'sitā |
etanmantra maheśāni (!) japedekāgramānasaḥ |
sahasraṃ padmapatrāṇāṃ juhuyāt saṃskṛte'nale |
kīṭakālī samāyāti tato nātrāsti saṃśayaḥ |
sādhakāya varaṃ dattvā prabhāte yāti kālikā |
tataḥ prabhṛti deveśi (!) kīṭaśabdasya sādhakaḥ |
līlayā sādhakaḥ sarvaṃ buddhvā sarvajñatāmiyāt |
pipīlikādikīṭānāṃ śabdaṃ boddhuṃ kṣamo bhavet |
svarge martye ca pātāle dharāyāṃ yā kathā bhavet |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vartamānaṃ sādhakendrāya sarvadā |
kīṭāḥ śaṃsanti deveśi (!) nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
kīṭakālīprasādena gṛhe lakṣmīḥ sthirā bhavet |
dhanavān putravān bhūtvā svargamokṣamavāpnuyāt || 20 ||
atha prakṛtasādhanam |
muṇḍamālātantre caturthapaṭale ||
niśāhāge caturdaśyāmamāyāṃ haravallabhe (!) |
japedayutasaṃkhyañca sa siddhaḥ sarvakarmasu |
sa yogīndraḥ sa bhāvajñaḥ sa dhīraḥ sarvakarmasu || 1 ||
tathā |
prabhāte'śvatthamūle ca gatvā paramakovidaḥ |
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā sāmiṣairlohitairapi |
bilvairbilvadalairvāpi bilvapuṣpairvarānane (!) |
japellakṣaṃ caturdaśyāmārabhya naganandini (!) |
pañcamena yajeddevīṃ bilvamūle divāniśam |
tadā vāksiddhimāpnoti sphuṭaṃ vācaspatirbhavet || 2 ||
tathā |
vāmabhāge striyaṃ sthāpya dhūpāmodasugandhibhiḥ |
tāmbūlacarvaṇādyaiśca pūjayedbhavagehinīm |
bhavānīṃ tāriṇī vidyāṃ brahmavidyāṃ manoharām |
śuddhāṃ siddhimavāpnoti tatkṣaṇādeva śaṅkari (!) |
viśvamātarjayādhāre (!) viśveśvari (!) namo'stu te |
karālavadane (!) ghore (!) candraśekharavallabhe (!) |
māṃ tāraya mahābhāge (!) dehi siddhimanuttamām |
kāmakalpalatārūpe (!) kāmeśvari (!) kalāmate (!) |
kāmarūpe (!) ca vijaye (!) nistāre (!) śavavāhini (!) || 3 ||
gṛhītvā śacāṇḍālaṃ dhṛtvā bhālaṃ mukhaṃ śiraḥ |
nāsāṃ karṇau ca hṛtpadmaṃ nābhiṃ liṅgaṃ gudaṃ tathā |
bāhupṛṣṭhañca jaṭharaṃ dhṛtvā dhṛtvā muhurmuhuḥ |
ādau māyāṃ punarmāyāṃ punarmāyāṃ niyojayet |
badhūbījaṃ tathā lajjāṃ sarvāṅge nikṣipenmanum |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā kṛtvā ca śavabandhanam |
punaḥ svamantrabījena nīladraveṇa cakṣuṣā |
sattvena rajasā devi (!) tamasā naganandini (!) |
harabījena sammārjya sa siddheśvaratāmiyāt |
vāyustambhaṃ jalastambhaṃ vahnistambhaṃ nagātmaje (!) |
tatkṣaṇādeva deveśi (!) jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4 ||
śūnyāgāre maheśāni (!) bhaveddhandadiṅmukhaḥ |
śaṅkhamālā grahītavyā sphāṭikī vātha rājatī |
cāmīkaramayī mālā prabālaghaṭitā tathā |
mūrdhni deśe kullukāñca japtvā śatamanuttamām |
tadā mantraṃ japenmantrī maheśo nātra saṃśayaḥ |
sa śāktaḥ śivabhaktaśca bhairavaśca sadāśivaḥ || 5 ||
tathā |
aśvatthe bilvamūle vā svajāyāmandire'tha vā |
devīṃ vā kāminīṃ vāpi dhyāyet paramadevatām |
ādyāṃ jyotirmayīṃ vidyāmabhayāṃ varadāṃ śivām |
praṇamet stutibhiścaṇḍīṃ sarvadoṣanikṛntanīm |
śmaśānasthaḥ śavastho'pi prapaṭhet kavacottamam |
tathā śmaśāne deveśi (!) śave vā varavarṇini (!) |
siddhirbhaviṣyati tadā pratipakṣā na bhairavāḥ |
unmattaḥ krodhanaścaiva bhairavo vaṭukātmakaḥ |
saṃhāro bhīṣaṇaścaiva tathā ca kālabhairavaḥ |
mahākālabhairavaśca bhairavā vasusaṃkhyakāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā śmaśānaṃ deveśi (!) śavasādhanameva ca |
nṛtyanti bhairavāḥ sarve garjanti raktalocanāḥ |
adya matsadṛśo vāpi adyaiva vātulo'pi vā |
śavaśmaśānayormadhye na jānāmi kathañcana |
mābhaiṣīrbhairavāḥ sarve vadiṣyanti ca rakṣaṇāt |
siṃhavyāghravarāhādyākārā garjanti sarvataḥ |
mābhaiṣīścaiva mābhaiṣīrmābhaiṣīścaiva sādhakam |
yo vadiṣyati purataḥ sa gurustattvakovidaḥ || 6 ||
pañcamapaṭale ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ vā prajapedayutaṃ niśi |
tadā siddhimavāpnoti mantradhyānapuraḥsaram || 7 ||
tathā |
mahāpīṭhāśramaṃ yāti mahāpīṭhasya darśanam |
mahāpīṭhe yajeddevīṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ |
pūjayedraktapuṣpaiśca raktagandhānulepanaiḥ |
mahiṣaiśca yajeddevīṃ meṣajaiḥ kṣatajairapi |
chāgalairlohitairdevīṃ gātrajairbrāhmaṇairapi |
tadā siddheśvaro bhūtvā gāṇapatyaṃ labhettu saḥ ||
tathā |
stutipāṭhāddṛḍhajñānāt pūjanācchivasundari (!) |
suprasannā mahāvidyā japāt siddhirbhaviṣyati || 8 ||
ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
kulavāre maheśāni (!) sahasramayutaṃ japet |
śanaiścare caturdaśyāmamāyāṃ kujavāsare |
sthitvā kuśāsane jñānī mantrasiddhiparāyaṇaḥ |
ayutaṃ bhaktibhāvena sahasraṃ ca varānane (!) |
antaryāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 9 ||
aśvatthavaṭamūle vā bilvamūle'tha vā priye (!) |
pūjayet parayā buddhyā mantrasiddhiṃ jano labhet || 10 ||
tathā (!) |
suṣumnāntaḥ sthitāṃ devīṃ padmakiñjalkavāsinīm |
dhyāyennāḍīviśuddhena mantrasiddhiranuttamā ||
tathā |
śmaśāne'śvatthamūle vā śave vā śūnyamandire |
prajapet kālikāṃ tārāṃ mahāvidyā prasīdati |
japena tapasā stotrairantaryāgairmanoharaiḥ |
pūjanaiḥ kavacairdevi (!) mahāvidyā prasīdati || 11 ||
vāme surāyāṃ deveśi (!) nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām |
kulacakre ca deveśi (!) prajapettu samaḥ śivaḥ |
niśi cakre karālāsye muktakeśo digambaraḥ |
sahasraṃ vāyutaṃ vāpi japenmadanamandire |
śvetaṃ vā lohitaṃ vāpi kusumaṃ pañcamānvitam |
evaṃvidhavidhānena mahākālyai nivedat |
divāpūjā vidhātavyā niśāpūjā maheśvari (!) |
sandhyāpūjā vidhātavyā tadā siddhimavāpnuyāt ||
tathā |
śave bilvaṃ kare dakṣe mālāṃ saṃgṛhya sādhakaḥ |
prajapet pārvatīmantraṃ sarvakāryārthasiddhaye |
praṇamya bhaktyā deveśi (!) japeccintāmaṇiṃ manum |
cintāmaṇiprasādena kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale |
cintāmaṇiṃ kalpalatāṃ gṛhitvā paramāṃ śivām |
japtvā mahāmanuṃ caṇḍi (!) devadeveśvaro bhavet |
yoginītantre pūrvakhaṇḍe pañcamapaṭale ||
devyuvāca ||
bhagavan (!) sarvadharmajña (!) lokānugrahakāraka (!) |
sādhanaṃ sarvamantrasya sarvāśāparipūrakam |
sādhanaṃ siddhamantrasya vada me karuṇāmaya (!) ||
īśvara uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi (!) pravakṣyāmi sādhanaṃ paramādbhutam |
sārddhayāmagatāyāntu niśāyāṃ sādhakottamaḥ |
bhūtvā digambaraḥ samyagācamya vidhivattatthā |
abhyukṣya mūlamantreṇa śayyāyāṃ tatra saṃviśet |
guruṃ paramaguruñca parāparaguruṃ tathā |
parameṣṭhiguruñcaiva vāme'bhyarcya gaṇeśvaram |
dakṣiṇe ca dhruvākhyantu śmaśānavāsinyai namaḥ |
tato māyā āsanāya nama ityuccarecchive (!) |
śayyā śayyātale devi (!) praṇavānte dhruvañca phaṭ |
likhitvācamya yatnena svatantroktavidhānataḥ |
praṇavaṃ maṇidharī caiva vajriṇī ca mahāpadam |
pratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhayā yutaḥ |
anena manunā deve (!) śikhāṃ baddhvā vidhānataḥ |
aṅganyāsakaranyāsau mātṛkānyāsameva ca |
bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ kṛtvā tataśca paramāṃ śivām |
dhyātvā bhaktyā samabhyarcya mānasaiḥ sādhakottamaḥ |
śayyātale maheśāni (!) mantro'pi ca varānane (!) |
praṇavañca tato devi (!) vaṭukebhyo namastathā |
iti mantreṇa manasā vaṭukaṃ pādyādibhiryajet |
tatastu vahnibījena samantājjaladhārayā |
vahniprācīramācintya saṅkalpya ca samādarāt |
japaṃ kṛtvā samarpyātha vidhinā parameśvari (!) |
punaḥ saṅkalpya deveśi (!) kuryāt sa kramataḥ śive (!) |
homañca tarpaṇañcaiva abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ param |
viprasya bhojanañcaiva abhāve dviguṇaṃ japet |
kāñcanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā'cchidrāvadhāraṇaṃ caret |
sammocya vaṭukaṃ devi (!) kṣamasveti visarjayet |
evamuktaṃ maheśāni (!) śayyāsādhanamuttamam |
mantrasiddhikaraṃ śīghramasmatsāyujyadāyakam ||
viśeṣaśayyāsādhanantu nirguṇakāṇḍe vakṣyate ||
tatraiva ||
itaḥ śṛṇu trivāṭasya caturvāṭasya sādhanam |
gatvā tu tripathaṃ vāpi catuṣpathaṃ varānane (!) |
prāgvaddevīṃ samabhyarcya maṇidharīti mantrataḥ |
baddhvā granthintu vastrānte nirbhayaṃ sādhakottamaḥ |
śmaśānavāsino ye ye devā devyaśca bhairavāḥ |
kṛpāṃ kurvantu te sarve siddhidāśca bhavantu me |
praṇamet praṇavādyena manunānena bhaktitaḥ |
tataḥ pūrvamukho vāpi uttarāśāmukho'pi vā |
upaviśya samācamya svasti vācya maheśvari (!) |
sthānaṃ sammārjya tatraiva pretabījaṃ likhet sudhīḥ |
bījopari mahādevi (!) vihitāsanamāstaret |
tatropaviśya deveśi (!) hṛdīṣṭadevatāṃ smaret |
yatheṣṭaṃ manasārādhya aṣṭāśāsu baliṃ haret |
kālyādibhyo viśeṣeṇa pūjayitvā maheśvari (!) |
kālī kapālinī kullā kurukullā virodhinī |
vipracittā tathā nīlā balākā ca ghanādviṣaḥ |
praṇavādyā ṅeyutāntā pūjyā balyā vinā smṛtā |
saṅkalpyāṣṭottarayutaṃ japtvā'cchidrāvadhāraṇam |
kṛtvā sthānaṃ pariṣkṛtya devīṃ smaran gṛhaṃ vrajet |
ataḥ paramahaṃ vakṣye bilvamūlasya sādhanam |
bilvamūlaṃ maheśāni (!) samantāt ṣoḍaśaṃ karam |
atastatsādhanaṃ devi (!) sarveṣāṃ priyakārakam |
tatra gatvā bilvamūlaṃ prāgvadgurucatuṣṭayam |
abhyarcya yatnato devi (!) kṣetrapālaṃ prapūjya ca |
kṣetrapāla (!) mahābhāga (!) śmaśānādhipa (!) suvrata (!) |
siddhiṃ dehi jagatkartā dehi sthānaṃ namo'stu te |
anena praṇavādyena manunā praṇamecca tam |
tataḥ sthānantu sampūjya likhettatra varānane (!) |
vāgbhavaṃ pretabījañca punarvāgbhavameva ca |
tadante mūlamantrañca likhet sādhakasattamaḥ |
pūjayitvā ca kālyādi pūrvavat parameśvari (!) |
saṅkalpyāṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā'cchidrāvadhārayet |
pariṣkṛtya tataḥ sthānaṃ guruṃ smaran gṛhaṃ vrajet |
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam |
gopanīyaṃ sadā bhadre (!) viśeṣāt paśusaṅkule ||
atha kārtavīryārjunaprayogaḥ ||
mantramahodadhau ||
yathā phrauṃ vrīṃ kloṃ hraṃ hrīṃ kroṃ strīṃ huṃ phaṭ kārtavīryārjanāya namaḥ ||
vahnitārayuto vādyo lakṣmīragnonduśaktiyuk |

avācyamapi vakṣyāmi tava lokahitāya vai |
kavacaṃ kārtavīryasya sāṅgāvaraṇakaṃ kramāt |
svamūrtiśaktimantraughaṃ sajapadhyānapūrvakam |
sahasrādityasaṅkāśe nānāratnasamujjvale |
bhāsvaddhvajapatākāḍhye turagāyudhabhūṣaṇe |
mahāsaṃvartakāmbhojabhīmarāvavirāviṇi |
samuddhṛtamahācchatravitānitaviyatpathe |
nirmāṇakiṅkiṇījālacalaccāmaraśobhite |
mahārathavare dīpte nānāyudhavirājite |
susthitaṃ vipulodārasahasrabhujamaṇḍitam |
vāmorukuṇḍakodaṇḍān dadhānamaparaiḥ śarān |
kirīṭahāramukuṭakeyūrabalayāṅgadaiḥ |
mudrikodaragandhāḍhyairmauñjīnūpurakādibhiḥ |
bhūṣitaṃ vividhākalpairbhāsvaraiḥ sumahādhanaiḥ |
ābaddhakavacaṃ vīraṃ suprasannānanāmbujam |
dhanurjyāsiṃhanādena kampayantaṃ jagattrayam |
sarvaśatrukṣayakaraṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam |
sarvasampatpradātāraṃ vijayaśrīniṣevitam |
sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ bhadraṃ bhaktānāṃ bhayanāśanam |
divyamālānulepāḍhyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam |
rathanāgāśvapādātivṛndamadhyagamīśvaram |
varadaṃ cakravartīnāṃ mahīlokaikapālakam |
samānoditasāhasraṃ divākarasamatviṣam |
mahāyogabalaiśvaryaṃ kīrtyākrāntajagattrayam |
śrīmaccakrahareraṃśādavatīrṇaṃ mahābalam |
samyagātmavibhedena dhyātvā rakṣāmudīrayet |
dattātreya ṛṣiḥ prokto'nuṣṭupchandaḥ prakīrtitam |
kārtavīryārjuno viṣṇuścakravartī ca devatā |
viniyogaśca rakṣāyai sarvataḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
sarvaduṣṭavināśāya sarvārthasya ca siddhaye |
asyāṅgamūrtayaḥ pañca pāntu māṃ sphaṭikojjvalāḥ |
agnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇeṣu hṛdayādikāḥ |
sarvatastūjjvalarūpavīracarmāsipāṇayaḥ |
avyāhatabalaiśvaryaśaktisāmarthyavigrahaḥ |
kṣemaṅkarīśaktiyutaścaurāṇāṃ madabhañjanaḥ |
prācīdiśaṃ rakṣatu me vāṇavāṇāśayāyudhaḥ |
śrīkarāśaktisahito mārīmadavibhañjanaḥ |
śaracāpadharaḥ śrīmān diśaṃ me pātu dakṣiṇām |
mahāvaśyakarīyuktaḥ śatrūṇāṃ madabhañjanaḥ |
kodaṇḍeṣu dharaḥ sauryāṃ diśaṃ me parirakṣatu |
prajākarīyutaścāpavāṇaduṣṭapraṇāśanaḥ |
parirakṣatu me samyak vidiśaṃ caitrabhānavīm |
vidyākarīsamāyuktaḥ sumahān duṣṭanāśanaḥ |
pātu me nai(-)ṛtīṃ cāpa vāṇavān diśamīśvaraḥ |
dhanakaryā samāyukto mahāduritanāśanaḥ |
iṣvāsaneṣudhṛk pātu vidiśaṃ mama vāyavīm |
āyuṣkaryā samāyuktaḥ śrīmān bhayavināśanaḥ |
cāpeṣudhāro śaivīṃ me vidiśaṃ parirakṣatu |
vijayaśrīyutaḥ sākṣāt sahasrāradharo vibhuḥ |
diśamūrddhvābhavatu me mahābhayavināśanaḥ |
śaṅkhabhṛt sumahāśaktisaṃyuto'pyadharāṃ diśam |
parirakṣatu me duḥkhadhvāntasambhedabhāskaraḥ |
mahāyogasamāyuktaḥ sarvadikcakramaṇḍalam |
mahāyogīśvaraḥ pātu sarvato mama padmabhṛt |
etā diṅmūrtayo raktā raktamālyāṃśukairvṛtāḥ |
pradhānadevatārūpāḥ pṛthak rathavare sthitāḥ |
śaktayaḥ padmahastāśca nīlendīvarasannibhāḥ |
suśuklamālyavasanāḥ suliptatilakojjvalāḥ |
tatpārśvadevatāḥ svasvavāhanāyudhabhūṣaṇāḥ |
svasvadikṣu sthitāḥ pāntu māmindrādyā mahābalāḥ |
etāstasya samākhyātāḥ sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ |
sarvato māṃ sadā pāntu sarvaśaktisamanvitāḥ |
hṛdaye codare nābhau jaṭhare guhyamaṇḍale |
ūruyugjānupādeṣu mūrddhni bhrūyugaleṣu ca |
karṇākṣināsikājihvākaṇṭhabāhuyugeṣu ca |
daśabījātmakā mantrāḥ samyak sampattidāyakāḥ |
tejorūpāḥ sthitāḥ pāntu vāñchāsuradrumāḥ |
daśa cānye mahāvarṇā mantrarūpā mahojjvalāḥ |
vyāpakatvena pāntvasmānāpādatalamastakam |
kārtavīryaḥ śiraḥ pātu lalāṭaṃ haihayeśvaraḥ |
sumukho me mukhaṃ pātu karṇau vyāptajagattrayaḥ |
sukamāro hanū pātu bhrūyugaṃ me dhanurdharaḥ |
nayane puṇḍarīkākṣo nāsikāṃ me guṇākaraḥ |
adharoṣṭhau sadā pātu brahmageyo dvijān kaviḥ |
sarvaśāstrakalādhāro jihvāṃ cibukamavyayaḥ |
dattātreyapriyaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ skandhau rājakuleśvaraḥ |
bhujau daśāsyadarpaghno hṛdayaṃ me mahābalaḥ |
karau sarvārthadaḥ pātu karāgrāṇi jagatpriyaḥ |
kukṣiṃ rakṣatu me vidvān vakṣaḥ parapurañjayaḥ |
revāmbulīlāsantṛpto jaṭharaṃ parirakṣatu |
vīraśūrastu me nābhiṃ pārśvau me sarvaduṣṭahā |
sahasrabhujabhṛt pṛṣṭhaṃ saptadvīpādhipaḥ kaṭim |
ūrūmāhiṣmatīnātho jānunī vallabho vibhuḥ |
jaṅghe vīrādhipaḥ pātu pātu pādau manojavaḥ |
pātu sarvāyudhadharaḥ sarvāṅgaṃ sarvamarmasu |
sarvaduṣṭāntakaḥ pātu dhātvaṣṭakakalevaram |
prāṇādidaśajīveśān sarvaśiṣṭeṣṭado'vatu |
vaśīkṛtendriyagrāmaḥ pātu sarvendriyāṇi me |
anuktamapi yat sthānaṃ śarīre'ntarvahiśca yat |
tatsarvaṃ pātu me sarvalokanātheśvareśvaraḥ |
vajrāt sāratarañcedaṃ śarīraṃ kavacāvṛtam |
bādhāśatavinirmuktamasti me bhayavarjitam |
baḍdhvedaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ na bhedyaṃ haihayeśituḥ |
vicarāmi divārātrau nirbhayeṇāntarātmanā |
rājamārge mahādurge mārge caurādisaṅkule |
viṣame vipine ghore dāvāgnau girikandare |
saṃgrāme śastrasaṅghāte siṃhavyāghraniṣevite |
gahvare sarpasaṅkīrṇe sandhyākāle nṛpālaye |
vivāde vipulāvarte samudre ca nadītaṭe |
paripanthijanākīrṇe deśe dasyugaṇairvṛte |
sarvasvaharaṇe prāpte prāpte prāṇasya saṅkaṭe |
nānārogajarāveśe viṣādaprāptabhūtale |
mārīduḥkhasvapnapīḍāsu kliṣṭe viśvāsaghātakaiḥ |
śārīre ca mahāduḥkhairmānase ca mahājvare |
ādhivyādhibhaye vighne jvālopadravake'pi ca |
na bhavettu bhayaṃ kiñcit kavacenāvṛtasya me |
āgantukāmānakhilān suradasyuvilumpakān |
vināśayettaddordaṇḍasahasreṇa mahārathaḥ |
svakaroddhṛtanirbhinnān sahasraśarakhaṇḍitān |
rājacūḍāmaṇiḥ kṣipraṃ karotvasmadvirodhakān |
khaḍgasāhasradalitān sahasramūṣalārditān |
caurādiduṣṭasattvaughān sahasrārasahasrabhṛt |
kṛtavīryasuto rājā sahasrabhujamaṇḍitaḥ |
avatāro hareḥ sākṣāt pālayet sakalaṃ mama |
kārtavīryārjuno nāma rājā bāhusahasravān |
tasya smaraṇamātreṇa kṛtaṃ naṣṭañca labhyate |
yo bhavellokarakṣārthamaṃśāccakraṃ harerbhuvi |
taṃ namāmi mahāvīryamarjunaṃ kṛtavīryakam |
sahasrabāhuṃ saśaraṃ sacāpaṃ raktāmbaram raktakirīṭakuṇḍalam |
caurādiduṣṭabhayanāśanamiṣṭadaṃ taṃ vande mahābalavijṛmbhitakārtavīryam |
kārtavīrya (!) mahāvīrya (!) sarvaduṣṭavināśana (!) |
sarvatra sarvadā tiṣṭha duṣṭānnāśaya pāhi mām |
dakṣe pañcaśataṃ vāṇā vāme pañcaśataṃ dhanuḥ |
yo bibharti sa pātvasmān viṣavyālaśatākulān |
uttiṣṭha duṣṭadamana (!) saptadvipaikapālaka (!) |
tvameva śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ sarvato rakṣa rakṣa mām |
uttiṣṭha kiṃ tvaṃ svapiṣi kiṃ tiṣṭhasi cirāya hi |
pāhi naḥ sarvadā sarvabhayebhyaḥ svasutāniva |
ya caurā vasuhartāro vidviṣo ye ca hiṃsakāḥ |
antarāyakarā duṣṭāḥ pāpakā ye durāśayāḥ |
durhṛdo duṣṭabhūpālā duṣṭā mānyāśca pāpakāḥ |
ye ca kāryaviloptāro ye khalāḥ paripanthinaḥ |
sarvasvahāriṇo ye ca ye ca māyāvino'pare |
mahākleśakarā mlecchā dasyavo vṛṣalāśca ye |
ye mahāśaradātāro vañcakāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ |
ye pāpā duṣṭakarmāṇo duḥkhadā duṣṭabuddhayaḥ |
vyājakāḥ kupathāsaktā ye ca nānābhayapradāḥ |
chidrānveṣaratā nityaṃ ye'smān bādhitumudyatāḥ |
te sarve kārtavīryasya mahāśaṅkhavarāhatāḥ |
sahasā vilayaṃ yāntu dūrādeva vimohitāḥ |
ye dānavā mahādaityā ye yakṣā ye ca rākṣasāḥ |
piśācā ye mahāsattvā ye bhūtā brahmarākṣasāḥ |
apasmāragrahā yeca ye grahāḥ piśatāśanāḥ |
mahālohitabhoktāro vetālā ye ca guhyakāḥ |
manobuddhīndriyajavāḥ sphoṭakāśca mahājvarāḥ |
mahāśanā balibhujo mahākuṇapabhojanāḥ |
gandharvāpsarasaḥ siddhā ye ca devādiyonayaḥ |
ḍākinyo ghonasāḥ pretāḥ kṣetrapālā vināyakāḥ |
mahāvyāghramahāmeṣamahāturagarūpakāḥ |
mahāpūjā mahāsiṃhā mahāmahiṣasannibhāḥ |
ṛkṣavārāhaśunakarūpā volukamūrtayaḥ |
mahoṣṭrakharamārjārasarpāṇāṃ viṣamastakāḥ |
nānārūpā mahāsattvā nānākleśasahasradāḥ |
nānārogakarāḥ kṣudrā mahāvīryā mahābalāḥ |
vātikāḥ paittikā ghorāḥ ślaiṣmikāḥ sānnipātikāḥ |
māheśvarā vaiṣṇavāśca vairivaṃśyā mahāgrahāḥ |
skāndā vaināyakāḥ krūrā ye ca pramathasambhavāḥ |
mahāśatrugrhā raudrā mahāmārīmasūrikāḥ |
aikāhikā dvyāhikā tryāhikāśca mahājvarāḥ |
cāturthikāḥ pākṣikāśca māsāḥ ṣāṇmāsikāśca ye |
sāṃvatsarā durnirvāryā jvarāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ |
svāpnikāśca mahotpātā ye ca duḥkhapnikā grahāḥ |
kuṣmāṇḍā jṛmbhakā bhaumā ghonāsā nidhivañcakāḥ |
bhrāmakāḥ prāṇahartāro ye ca bālagrahādayaḥ |
divācarā rātricarā ye ca sandhyāsu dāruṇāḥ |
pramattā apramattā vā ye'smān bādhitumudyatāḥ |
te sarve haihayeśasya dhanurmuktaśarārditāḥ |
sahasradhā praṇaśyantu bhagnasattvabalodyamāḥ |
ye sarpā ye mahānāgā mahāgiriguhāśayāḥ |
kālavyālā mahādaṃṣṭrā mahājagarasaṃjñakāḥ |
anantakulikādyāśca daṃṣṭrāviṣamahābhayāḥ |
anena śataśīrṣāśca khaṇḍapucchāśca dāruṇāḥ |
mahāviṣajalīkāśca vṛścikā raktapucchakāḥ |
āśīviṣāḥ kālakūṭā mahāhālāhalāhvayāḥ |
jalasarpā jalavyālā jalagrahāśca kacchapāḥ |
māsikā viṣapucchāśca ye cānye jalavāsinaḥ |
jalajāḥ sthalajāścaiva nānābhedaśatodbhavāḥ |
ye ca ṣaḍvindavo lūtā bhrāmarāḥ śukapucchikāḥ |
sthāvarā jaṅgamāścaiva kṛtrimāśca mahāviṣāḥ |
guptarūpā guptaviṣā mūṣikā gṛhagodhikāḥ |
apasmāraviṣā ghorā mahograviṣasaṃjñakāḥ |
ye'smān bādhitumicchanti śarīraprāṇanāśanāḥ |
te sarve kārtavīryasya khaḍgasāhasrakhaṇḍitāḥ |
dūrādeva vinaśyantu pranaṣṭendriyasāhasāḥ |
manuṣyāḥ paśavo vṛkṣā vānarā vanagocarāḥ |
siṃhavyāghravarāhāśca mahiṣā ye mahāmṛgāḥ |
gajāsturaṅgā gavayā rāsabhāḥ śarabhā vṛkāḥ |
śunakāḥ piśunāḥ śūdrā mārjārā vilayonayaḥ |
śṛgālāḥ śaśakāḥ śyenā garutmanto vihaṅgamāḥ |
bheruṇḍā vāyasā gṛdhrā haṃsādyāḥ pakṣijātayaḥ |
uḍbhijjāścāṇḍajāścaiva svedajāśca jarāyujāḥ |
nānābhedakule jātā nānābhāvapṛthagvidhāḥ |
ye'smān bādhitumicchanti sandhyāsu ca divā niśi |
te kṣipraṃ kārtavīryasya gadāsāhasracūrṇitāḥ |
dūrādeva vinaśyantu vinaṣṭagatipauruṣāḥ |
ye cākṣepapradātāro dveṣṭāro ye vidūṣakāḥ |
kārtyayantraprakartāraḥ kūṭāmāyāvino'pare |
māraṇoccāṭanonmūladveṣamohanakārakāḥ |
viśvāsaghātakā duṣṭā ye ca svāmidruho narāḥ |
ye cātatāyino duṣṭā ye pāpā goprahāriṇaḥ |
dāhopaghātagaralaśastrapātātiduḥkhadāḥ |
kṣetravittāpaharaṇabandhanādibhayapradāḥ |
ete ye vividhākārā ye cānye duṣṭajātayaḥ |
pīḍākarāśca satataḥ chidramicchanti bādhitum |
te sarve kārtavīryasya cakrasāhasradāritāḥ |
dūrādeva vināśyantu kṣayaṃ yāntu sahasradhā |
ye meghā ye mahāvarṣā ye vātā yāśca vidyutāḥ |
ye mahāśanayo dīptā nirghātādyāśca dāruṇāḥ |
ulkāpātāśca ye ghorā ye mahendrāyudhādayaḥ |
sūryendukujasaumyāśca gurukāvyaśanaiścarāḥ |
rāhuśca ketavo ghorā nakṣatrāṇi ca rāśayaḥ |
tithayaḥ saṃkramā māsā hāyanā yuganāyakāḥ |
manvantarādhipāḥ siddhā ṛṣayo yogasiddhayaḥ |
śrutaya ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvaṇādyāśca vahnayaḥ |
ṛtavo lokapālāśca pitaro devasaṃhatiḥ |
vidyāścaiva catuḥṣaṣṭibhedotthā bhuvanatraye |
ete vai kīrtitāḥ sarve ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ |
te santu naḥ sadā saumyā sarvakālaṃ sukhāvahāḥ |
ājñayā kārtavīryasya yogīndrasyāmitadyuteḥ |
kārtavīryārjuno dhanvī rājendro haihayeśvaraḥ |
dattātreyapriyatamaḥ sahasrabhujamaṇḍitaḥ |
cāpī khaḍgī rathī vāṇī tūṇī carmī mahābalaḥ |
subhagaḥ sumukhaḥ śāntaścakravartī guṇākaraḥ |
daśāsyadarpahāro vā līlātṛptaḥ sudurjayaḥ |
duṣṭahā cauradamano rājarājeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ |
sarvajñaḥ sarvadaḥ śrīmān sarvaśiṣṭeṣṭadaḥ kṛtī |
rājacūḍāmaṇiryogī saptadvīpādhināyakaḥ |
vijayī viśvato rājñāṃ mahāmatiralolupaḥ |
devaviprapriyo vidvān brahmageyaḥ sanātanaḥ |
māhiṣmataupatiryoddhā mahākīrtirmahābhujaḥ |
sukumāro mahāvīro mārīghno madirekṣaṇaḥ ||
śatrughnaḥ śāśvataḥ śūraḥ śaṅkhabhṛdgopivallabhaḥ |
mahābhāgavato dhīmān mahābhayavināśanaḥ |
asādhyavigraho divyabhāvo vyāptajagattrayaḥ |
sarvaśāstrakalādhāro virajo lokavanditaḥ |
vīro vimalasattvāḍhyo mahābalaparākramaḥ |
vijayaśrīmayo nānyo jitārirmantranāyakaḥ |
cakrabhṛt kāmadaḥ kāntaḥ kāmaghnaḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ |
bhadravādapriyo vaidyo vibudho varado vaśī |
jitendriyo jitārātiḥ mahān yo'nantavikramaḥ |
cakrabhṛt paracakraghnaḥ saṃgrāmavidhipūjitaḥ |
mahādhano nidhipatirmahāyogī gurupriyaḥ |
yogāḍhyaḥ sarvarogaghno rājitākhilabhūtalaḥ |
divyāstrabhṛdameyātmā sarvagoptā mahojjvalaḥ |
sarvāyudhadharo'bhīṣṭapradaḥ parapurañjayaḥ |
yogasiddho mahākāyo mahāvṛndaśatādhipaḥ |
sarvajñānanidhiḥ sarvasiddhadānakṛtodyamaḥ |
ityaṣṭaśatanāmotthā mūrtayo daśadikapateḥ |
samyak daśa diśo vyāpya pālayantu ca māṃ sadā |
manaḥsaukhyamasambādhamārogyamaparājayaḥ |
duḥkhahānirarighnaśca prajāvṛddhiḥ sukhodayaḥ |
vāñchāptiriti kalyāṇamavaiṣamyamanāmayam |
anālasyamabhīṣṭañca mṛtyuhānirbalonnatiḥ |
bhayahāniryaśaḥ kāntirvidyābuddhimahocchritaḥ |
anaṣṭadravyatā caiva naṣṭasya punarāgamaḥ |
dīrghāyuṣṭraṃ manolābhaḥ saukumāryamabhīpsitam |
apradhṛṣṭamanlpatvaṃ mahāsāmarthyameva ca |
santu me kārtavīryasya haihayendrasya kīrtanāt |
ya idaṃ kārtavīryasya kavacaṃ puṇyavarddhanam |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam |
sarvaśāntikaraṃ guhyaṃ samastabhayanāśanam |
vijayārthapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvasampatpradaṃ śubham |
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi pūjayedvāpi pustakam |
nityaṃ śirasi yo dhatte sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt |
mucyate sarvaduḥkhaistu sarvatra vijayī bhavet |
mārīcaurādi pīḍādyairna kadācit prabādhyate |
paṭhataḥ prātarutthāya duḥsvapnādi vinaśyati |
labhate vāñchitānarthān pūjyate tridaśairapi |
śayyātalagato rātrau ya idaṃ kavacaṃ paṭhet |
na tasya taskarārātiduḥsvapnādikṛtaṃ bhayam |
caurairyadā hṛtaṃ paśyet paśvādidhanamātmanaḥ |
saptavāraṃ tadā japtvā niśi paścimadiṅmukhaḥ |
saptarātreṇa labhate naṣṭadravyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
saptaviṃśatidhā japyāt prācīdigvadano yadi |
tadā devāsuranibhaṃ paracakraṃ nivārayet |
vivāde kalahe ghore pañcadhāḥ yaḥ paṭhedidam |
vijayo jāyate tasya na kadācit parājayaḥ |
samyak dvādaśadhā rātrau prajapedbandhamuktaye |
tridinānnigaḍagrasto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena sarvasādhanakarmaṇi |
asādhyamapi saptāhāt sādhayenmantravittamaḥ |
yātrākāle paṭhitvedaṃ mārge gacchati yaḥ pumān |
na tasya cauravyāgrādyairbhayaṃ syāt paripanthibhiḥ |
nityaṃ gṛhagato japtvā kalyāṇaiḥ paripūryate |
na bhayaṃ jāyate tasya duṣṭasattvādibhiḥ kvacit |
sarvarogaprapīḍāsu tridhā vā pañcadhā paṭhet |
sa rogamṛtyuvetālabhūtapretairna bādhyate |
jagannāsecanaṃ kuryājjalenāñjalinā tanau |
na cāsau viṣakṛtyādirogasphoṭaiḥ prabādhyate |
trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedetat ṣaṇmāsaṃ vijitendriyaḥ |
kālamṛtyumapi prāptaṃ jīyānnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ |
paṭhataḥ kavacañcedaṃ viṣaṃ nākramate tanau |
na jāḍyāndhatvamūkatvaṃ nopasargabhayaṃ kvacit |
viṃśatyā coktavidhinā dhyātvā devaṃ tadātmakam |
mantrī guruprasādāptaṃ mantrarājaṃ japet punaḥ |
kavacenāvṛto bhūyo mantradhyānaṃ samācaret |
ādau sambodhanaṃ kuryāttannāmadhyānapūrvakam |
caturaścakramantraṇāmuccaredvījapūrvakān |
kṛtvānte caiva mantrāṇāmuccaredvījapūrvakān |
śarīre nyāsamevaṃ hi yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ |
sa yathoktaṃ labhet sadyaḥ phalaṃ vajratanurbhavet |
yathātathedaṃ kavacaṃ kasyacinna prakāśayet |
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena śivasya vacanaṃ yathā |
subhaktāya suśiṣyāya dadyāt sarvasvadāyine |
sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya yaduktaṃ candramaulinā |
kārtavīryasya kavacaṃ yaduktaṃ vai mayā tava |
tena saṃvīkṣito devi (!) kālenāpi na jīryate |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kavacaṃ dhārayet sudhīḥ |
kārtavīryaḥ khaladveṣī kṛtavīryasuto balī |
sahasrabāhuḥ śatrughno raktavāsā dhanurddharaḥ |
raktagandho raktamālyo rājā smarturabhīṣṭadaḥ |
dvādaśaitāni nāmāni kārtavīryasya yaḥ paṭhet |
sampadastasya jāyante janāstasya vaśe sadā |
[iti śrī uḍḍāmareśvaratantre kārtavīryārjunakalpe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde kārtavīryārjunakavacaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītipaṭalaḥ samāptaḥ] |
[iti śrīprāṇatoṣiṇyāṃ caturthe kāmyakāṇḍe praśākhākathanaṃ nāma tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ] |
atha kukkuṭaprayogaḥ |
phetkāriṇītantre dvitīyapaṭale |
atha vakṣye saṃgrahataḥ kukkuṭamantramahaṃ manusāram |
jagatāmupakāraparaiḥ kṣapaṇakagurubhiryathā purā proktam |
nāntaṃ ṣaṣṭhasvaraparigataṃ bindumat kukkuṭākhyaṃ vīpsai tattvāṃ punarapi padaṃ vīpsitaṃ pūrvakaṃ tat |
nāntaṃ bhūtasvaraparigataṃ veti mantro'yamuktaḥ syādāyuḥ śrīvibhavasukhasaubhāgyasampatpradāyī |
proktaḥ pañcadaśārṇo'yaṃ mantraḥ kukkuṭadaivataḥ |
sa sarvadevatātejaḥśaktivṛṃhitavigrahaḥ |
kṣīrodadhimadhyagate dvīpavare kanakaratnamayabhūmau |
anavaratasikatāmuktāmaṇimṛdupavanasuśītale ramye |
tatra samutthitamamalaṃ vipulataraṃ kalitavararatnaphalajātam |
haimaṃ tālamahījaṃ bahumaṇivilasadvicitrapatravaram |
taṃ punaradhitiṣṭhantaṃ dhyāyedakhilojjvalanāṅgam |
atiśobhācūḍāśobhitavaktram kukkuṭamatitīkṣṇanakhacaraṇam |
vaktraṃ yasya ṣaḍānano girisutā yasyodaraṃ kālahā pṛṣṭhaṃ yasya ca varhikukkuramukhau pādau ca vakretarau |
pakṣau yasya suradrumau maṇimayau yā śṛṅkhalābandhanī kāmākarṣakarīkarotu sa tu naḥ sarvānāsau kukkuṭaḥ |
gaurīhastāravinde tvaniśamadhivasan ṣaṇmukhārūḍhakāmaḥ sarvālaṅkāradīptaḥ pracalitacaraṇaḥ pakṣavikṣepadakṣaḥ |
hemābho ratnacañcūmaṇimayavilasadvṛttakaṇṭhaḥ svarūpaḥ pāyānnastāmracūḍaḥ sakalajanarataḥ sarvasiddhipradātā || 1 ||
athavā |
sarvapriyaḥ sāgaramadhyaratnadvīpasya tālāganivāsikukkuṭaḥ |
vidyābhirāmo'khilabhūṣaṇāḍhyo vaśīkarotyāśu susevito naraiḥ |
amuṣya pūrvasevārthamekaliṅge śivālaye |
devasya mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā āsīdudaṅmukhaḥ |
parvatāgre nadītīre vṛṣaśūnyaśivālaye |
paścimadvārasaṃyukte kuryānmantrapuraṣkriyām |
guruṃ praṇamya śirasā āsanaṃ parikalpayet |
karaśuddhiṃ dehaśuddhiṃ tālatrayamathācaret |
digbandhanaṃ kārayet paścād vidyāmantreṇa tatparaḥ |
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ paścāt praṇavena tu kalpayet |
mātṛkāṃ vinyaset pūrvaṃ paścānnyāsaṃ samācaret |
pakṣimantrasya prathamaṃ hṛnmantraṃ taṃ vinirdiśet |
dvitīyapadamuccārya śirasaiva tu yojayet |
vāṃ śikhāyāñca vinyasya varmapakṣitṛtīyakam |
turīyapadamuccārya netre ca viniyojayet |
purābhyāñcāstrasaṃyuktamaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ vidhīyate |
namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ huñca vauṣaṭ phaṭ ca kramānnyaset |
pumādivāntavarṇāṃśca kramaśo vinyaset sudhīḥ |
lalāṭe bindumadhye ca cakṣuḥśravaṇayorapi |
nāsāvivarayoścaiva āsye kaṇṭhe tathā hṛdi |
jaṭhare nābhideśe ca liṅge guhye ca vinyaset |
namo'ntena tu mantreṇa mūrdhnādivyāpakaṃ nyaset |
evaṃ vinyastadehastu dhyāyedvahniśivātmakam |
manasā devamabhyarcya ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ |
vijñāpyāvāhya yāgena devaṃ santoṣya yatnataḥ |
dhyātvā kukkuṭadevañca japedbhānusahasrakam |
tāvacchataṃ tarpayitvā puraścaryāṭṭato bhavet |
vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣastambhanoccāṭanādikam |
karmāṇi kuryādiṣṭāni mantreṇānena mantravit |
ālikhya mantreṇa vidarbhitaṃ tatsādhyāhvayaṃ tālavarasya patre |
prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya śataṃ yathāṣṭau japtvā dhṛtañcet śaraṇaṃ prayāti |
tāmbūlaṃ yadyaṣṭottarasahasraṃ japtvā dattaṃ bhuktyai yasyāḥ |
vaśyā nityaṃ pratyupadeśāddāsyatyarthān prārthitabhogān |
mantraṃ japannatha pañcakamalaṃ yaḥ kanakāhvayamaṅgapañcayuktam |
bhakṣyabhojyavidhiṣu pratiyojyaṃ sāsya yāti vaśagā maraṇāntam |
mūlaṃ tasya ca mūlakena sahitaṃ citāhvayasya tvacaṃ puṣpaṃ bījasavīryahastikusumaṃ svarṇāsikāntarjalam |
patraṃ rohiṇamaṅgapañcakamalaṃ tadbhāṇḍayuktaṃ mitho dattaṃ vā puruṣasya taddhṛtamidaṃ vaśyāṅganā manmathaiḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā hayamāraprasūnakam |
saptarātrau kṣiped yasya mūrddhni sāsya vaśībhavet |
hayamāraṃ karavīram ||
bhūrje sādhyavidarbhitaṃ manumimaṃ saṃlikhya kaulālamṛtsnākākalpitaputtalīhṛdi kṛtaṃ prāṇān prathiṣṭhāpya ca |
japtvā saptadinaṃ trisandhyamatha tāmāloḍya bhāṇḍīrasairlimpedvaśyamavaśyameva bhavitā cānyeṣu janmasvapi |
bhāṇḍī bhārgī ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā samūlakāṇḍāṃ kṛtāñjaliṃ śirasā |
dhārayati sarvalokapriyo bhavenniyatameva mantrivaraḥ |
kṛtāñjalirlajjāvatī |
tacchatamakhavallīlakṣmīpuṣpāṇi dhārayedevaṃ samudābhadrakaviṣṇupriyāśca mūṣalī sa mantrajāpena |
madhukaṃ dūrvāṃ sahāñcaiva yathādhṛtam śirasā |
sā tathaivaikaṃ svargalokakalyāṇanayanasamarthakam |
kā kathā manuṣyalokeṣu daśa ravivasurudramanuṣu |
aṣṭavākṣiviśvadrogabhāge añjalyādi kramaśaḥ |
saṃyojyādaśakamakhilavaśyakaram |
pratyekaṃ śatamaṣṭau japtvā saṃyojya daśakamapiṣṭvā guṭikīkṛtya sahasrāṣṭakaṃ japtvā guṭikayā racitā tilakakriyā suranārīnaralokarañjanādikaṃ kapilādhṛtadīpitayā tattaccūrṇagarbhayā vartyā kajjalamuddhṛtamiva tatkarpūrayutaṃ sahasraṃ parijaptam |
dinamanudinanayanayutaṃ kuryādakhilalokamavaśyavaśyakaram ||
ete vaśyāprayogāḥ |
ātmānaṃ kukkuṭaṃ dhyātvā svakīyagaṇaśaktayā |
sādhyāṃ śṛṅkhalayā kaṇṭhe baddhvā kiṣamanuvrajet |
sahasramarddharātre tu rātritrayamatandritaḥ |
turīyakukkuṭasyānte sādhyanāma svakarma ca |
japet saṃyojyavaśyādikāryeṣu sakaleṣvapi |
yāmārabhya japedenaṃ peṣitaṃ sā madālasā |
bibhrat sadārdravasanā madanākulacetanā |
utphullaguhyajaghanā śithilāṃśukabhūṣaṇā |
calatpādaparinyāsā sphuradromāñcakañcukā |
kāmānaloṣṇaniśvāsā śobhitādharapallavā |
vikīrṇakeśapāśāsau vepitā ghūrṇitekṣaṇā |
racitāñjalirāyāti svayamasyālayaṃ niśi |
sādhyāhvānavidarbhitaṃ manumimaṃ tāmbūlapatrodare lekhanyā pratilikhya karmasahitaṃ prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya ca |
japtvāṣṭau śatamarkadugdhajanitā dīpe trirātrāntare |
guptaṃ dīpaśikhāgninā svayamamuṃ vaśyorvaśī cāśrayet |
bhūrje mantramamuṃ vilikhya sakalaṃ sādhyāhvayāsampuṭaṃ prāptaprāṇamathāṣṭakottaraśataṃ japtaṃ trirātraṃ punaḥ |
kṣaudrakṣīraghṛteṣvidaṃ pṛthagapi prakṣipya mantraṃ japannākarṣatyacirādabhīṣṭavanitāṃ nāgādilokādapi |
ālikhyaiva śarāvake manumimaṃ tannāmakarmānvitam |
rātrau rocanayā praṇītapavanaṃ japtvā ca sāṣṭau śatam |
tasyā nābhimukhāṅgajanmabhavanaṃ santāpayan khādire vahnau caitamanaṅgavegavivaśā yā vā samayāti ca |
nābhimātrajale sthitvā sādhyanāmavidarbhitam |
japet sahasraṃ tridinamiṣṭāmākarṣayed dhruvam ||
ityākarṣaṇam |
kapiromahiṅgudārvīkharacarmāṇi cūrṇayet |
taccūrṇaṃ mantrasañjaptaṃ nāmakarmavidarbhitam |
trisahasraṃ punastena snigdhayorantarātmanoḥ |
dhūpairatīva vidviṣṭau snigdhāvapi bhaviṣyati |
tālapatre likhenmantraṃ nāmakarmavidarbhitam |
kṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭhāntaṃ prajaptaṃ trisahasrakam |
viṣāliptaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā nikhanet sindhutīrayoḥ |
snigdhayorāśu vidveṣaḥ syādumeśānayorapi |
sindhutīrayoḥ nadyubhayatīre |
ulūkakākayoḥ pakṣau gṛhītvā mantravittamaḥ |
mantre ālikhya vai śarāve niśāyāñca sādhyākṣarasampuṭitaṃ mantraṃ sthāpitapavanaṃ sahasrajaptaṃ catuṣpathe nikhanet |
stambhanametadavaśyaṃ bhavitā jagatāñca nātra sandehaḥ |
sthāpitapavanaṃ kṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭham ||
kṛtvā pratikṛtimathavā śmaśānāṅgārakeśaśavavasanajāṃ sapadi samyagadhiṣṭhitapavanāṃ hṛdgatanāmnīṃ samantralalāṭāṃ vasanādhiṣṭhitapavanāṃ sahasrajaptāṃ pratiṣṭhitaprāṇām |
bandhanaṃ prati tīkṣṇataraṃ stambhanamatitīkṣṇāmbunikṣiptām |
likhitamantracitāmayakīlakaṃ sahitakarma sanāma samārutam |
kṛtajapaṃ trisahasrakasaṃkhyāyāḥ pathisvanedatha yānanivāraṇam |
vihitanimbatarau ripunāmayutaṃ manumimaṃ niśayā kṛtanāmakam |
navasahasrajapādiṣu sādhitaṃ pathi khanet parasainyanirodhanam ||
iti stambhanam ||
aṅgārakaṃ pitṛbhuvo ripunaidhanarkṣe japtvā vinirmitamidaṃ pitṛbhūgatāgnau |
dagdhvā ca tabbhasitamiśritamātraśatrorālikhya nāma manukarmayutaṃ svamūrddhni |
kṣipraṃ sa cālayati cāṣṭasahasrajaptaṃ japtvā śive kujadine sacaturdaśīke |
karmāhvayamānampuṭaṃ manum |
sahasrajaptaṃ nikhaned dviṣāṃ gṛhe dvāre taduccāṭanamāśu jāyate |
nirasya kākanilayaṃ pitṛbhūgatāgnau dagdhvā ca tadbhasitamiśritamantriśatroḥ |
ālikhya nāma manumarmayugasya mūrdhni proccāṭayeccāṣṭasahasrajaptam |
japtvā śive kujadine sacaturdaśīke karmāhvayāḍhyamanunā trisahasrajaptam |
dattaṃ vidhāya ripumūrdhni vinikṣipecca proccāṭayedripumasau drutamāśu caitat |
śmaśānaje cele vā ripunāmakarmasaṃyuktaṃ mantrapañcasahasrajaptam |
dvāri kṣipedamukāmukasya śatroruccāṭayet saptadināntarāle |
kīlaṃ citākāṣṭha mayañca mantrī karmānvitaṃ cāṣṭasahasrasaṃkhyam |
mantrṇa japtaṃ nikhanedarātigehe tamuccāṭayati kṣaṇena |
unmattarasālocitāmasīsakārūpakṣaṇavidhinā |
kāraskaraphalakāntamanuṃ likhet karmanāmasampuṭitam |
sthāpya prāṇānasmin dviṣato'ṣṭaviṣānuliptasaṃsiddham |
tatraiva sahasrajaptaṃ śmaśānadeśe catuṣpathe vāpi |
nikhanedaribhavane tadaṣṭamarkṣe ripoḥ kṣipraṃ deśāntaramathavāsau |
masyeti tenodvijitalokāntaraṃ sadā rogī ||
ityuccāṭanam ||
mantraṃ sādhyasya nāma pratipuṭitamathālikhya tālasya patre puttalyāṃ tannidhāyārpitapavanamatho japtamaṣṭau sahasram |
rātrāvunmattadīpte pitṛvanajanite tīkṣṇatailena liptaṃ chitvā chitvā niśārddhe tridinaparimite mohayenmārayed vā |
madhyārkavṛkṣakṛtarūpamadhiṣṭhite'nujaptaṃ sahasramapi kīlayati śmaśāne |
mantreṇa dārayati sādhitamantramaṅgaṃ yadyadriporapi vinaśyati tattadaṅgam |
vairiprasravamṛttikāpadarajaḥsaṃyuktacakrīmṛdā kṛtvā puttalikāñca nāma hṛdaye śīrṣe pade vā likhet |
aṅgāraiḥ pitṛbhūgatairmanumimaṃ tannāmakarmānvitam |
tasya nyasya hṛdīdamāśu pavanaṃ saṃyuktacakrīmṛdā |
kṛtvā puttalikāñca nāma hṛdaye śīrṣe pade vā likhet |
aṅgāraiḥ pitṛbhūgatairmanumimaṃ tannāmakarmānvitaṃ tasya nyasya hṛdīdamāśu pavanaṃ japyāt sahasratrayam |
sañchittvaivamakhaṇḍitena śatadhā śastreṇa tāṃ puttalīṃ yāmyāśābhimukho dināni daśabhirdīpte śmaśānānale |
tailaṃ tīkṣṇataraṇ niṣicya juhuyāt naidhanya(-)ṛkṣe'thavā mantrī pretapateḥ puraṃ drutamasau yāsyatyarātirdhruvam |
naidhanya(-)ṛkṣe śatrorbadhatārāyām |
aṅgāravāre kulikodayeriporālikhya patre pratimāṃ pratiṣṭhitām |
prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya viṣānuliptāṃ śmaśānabhūmau juhuyādvinaśyet |
ripoḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā gomayena ca taddhṛdi |
tālapatre samālikhya manumākhyāvidarbhitam |
vinyasya tatpratikṛteḥ sthāpyopari ca rājatam |
mṛṇmayaṃ vā ghaṭaṃ samyag gomayena ca pūritam |
tatrāpi nikṣipenmantraṃ likhitākhyapuṭaṃ budhaḥ |
vairiprāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya tasmin gomayavāriṇi |
trisandhyaṃ prajapettasmin chāyāyāmādbhaviṣyati |
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ gomayajale ripucchāyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
astreṇa chedayedaṅgaṃ yasya yadyadabhīpsitam |
tattadvinaśyati ripoḥ saptāhānnātra saṃśayaḥ |
hṛdayodarakaṇṭheṣu chinneṣu bhavitā mṛtiḥ |
śirorogo bhavettasya vraṇe śastreṇa mastake |
śuṇṭhī hiṅgu ca citrakaṃ marīcaṃ rohipippalī |
mandībadhūmayūrakalpaṃ proktametadviṣaṃ budhaiḥ |
kāraskaramāmalakīmauḍumbarajambūkhadirakṛṣṇā ca |
vaṃśapippalanāgau rohiṇamalināsanabhrumālikāḥ |
ariṣṭabilvavikaṅkatakadambavakulatvaksaṃjñāḥ |
vañjulapanasārkaśamīkadambanimbaprakāśamūlañca |
tataḥ sahasramanumādarāt japati yaḥ sa ramābhavanaṃ bhavejjapavidhau kapīsīkusumaiḥ |
siddhajape tu kukkuṭamanvaham aṣṭottaraṃ manumimaṃ prajapet sahasraṃ dhyāyenmaheśamanukukkuṭarūpakaṇṭham |
pañcārcito'sya bhavanañca manorathādyairāpūryate bahuvidhairapi vatsareṇa |
nityaṃ gna(?) tyuṣasi pratītamanasā pādena bhūdhāriṇā ratnānyeva samantataḥ svapurataḥ paryākṣipantaṃ muhuḥ |
dhyātvā kukkuṭamīśarūpamathavā bhūtyaiva māyā svayam |
bhaktyā yaḥ prajapedupendramitaraṃ prāpyendirā lakṣayet |
tattvena khaṇḍīkṛtatālavṛttāṃ kṣmāṃ chādayettāṃ phalaratnakhaṇḍaiḥ |
dhyātvā manuṃ svaṃ nayane japed yo vidviṣṭamākhaṇḍalavat sameti |
dodhūyamāno nijapakṣapatravat parārddharatnaṃ kiraṇakanakarāgapuṣpam |
dhyātvā sunirniyatameva manuṃ prajapya prauḍhāṃ śriyaṃ bhṛśamavāpsyati ratnapūrṇām |
bhūmau kāñcanamṛttikāpadarajorājīṃ kirantaṃ mudā kūjantaṃ caraṇena dhānyanicayānākīrya cañcādinā |
sañcintyojjvalatāmracūḍamaruṇaṃ kiñcit samākuñcitagrīvaṃ yaḥ prajapedamuṣya bhavanaṃ dhānyādibhiḥ pūryate |
daśauṣadhadagdhabhasitamanunāmunā kṛtajapaṃ niśi vasādhṛtam |
duritarogaviṣabhūtabhayāpahaṃ bhajatāṃ vaśīkaraṇamatīva ramākaram ||
sthalajendhanacarmabhasitaṃ tridhā vidhivat sahasrajaptamabhirakṣati cākhilam |
bhūrjapatramabhilikhitanāmamātrakaṃ naramāśu rakṣati dhṛtaṃ japānvitam |
manunā taṇḍulamanunā |
sahasrajaptaṃ tadvat kukkuṭaṃ yo vetti so'sau |
kukkuṭasaṅghān svakīyān yuddhe jeṣyati kṣipram |
smṛtvā sahasramapi sañcintya kukkuṭaṃ japet |
jeṣyati sapadi raṇe svabhaṭe caraṇāyudhaiḥ samāyātaḥ |
bahunā kimatra manunā likhitaṃ parivāñchitaṃ sapadi sādhyataram |
acireṇa tasya bhavane japato vasatiṃ prayāti kamalā vimalā |
iti japaniratānāṃ kukkuṭaṃ lakṣayitvā kṣapaṇakamanivāhakṣiptabhūtāripakṣaḥ |
tvaritanivahapakṣakṣepakaḥ sarvabhakṣya praṇatasujanarakṣī vīkṣitānāṃ svapakṣaḥ |
nikhilamabhimatānāmarthināṃ kalpavṛkṣaḥ suravaranaranārīrañjanākṛṣṭidakṣaḥ |
anantaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ puṅkolidvitayaṃ tataḥ |
vāṃ śaktiścātha puṅkoliyugalaṃ vilikhettataḥ |
vukāraṃ varuṇārūḍhamanantaṃ vāsabindukam |
krośantamuddharenmantraṃ kukkuṭaṃ sumanoharam ||
iti kukkuṭaprayogaḥ ||
athocchiṣṭācāṇḍālīprayogaḥ ||
tatraiva ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
śrīpārvatyuvāca ||
sūcitā me purā śambho (!) mantrā naikavidhāstvayā |
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi devīmucchiṣṭapūrvikām ||
śambhuruvāca ||
śṛṇu devi (!) varārohe (!) devīṃ tāṃ kathayāmyaham |
yayā vijñātamātreṇa abhūdvidyāmayo naraḥ ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
ko vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ cāsyā mayi vidyāsvarūpataḥ |
kathyatāṃ deva (!) yatnena rahasyenaṃ niveditam ||
śambhuruvāca ||
śṛṇu devi (!) vidhiṃ vakṣye phalañcoccāṭanādikam |
viṣañca sthāvaraṃ devi (!) vidyābhāvānnihanti ca |
athānyat sampravakṣyāmi devīṃ guhyatamāṃ priye (!) |
ucchiṣṭapūrvikāṃ devīṃ mātaṅgīṃ sarvasiddhidām |
sarvapāpaharāṃ devīṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitām |
yayā vijñātayā ekāḥ kṣayaṃgacchanti cāpadaḥ |
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamañcaiva kṛtrimaṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā |
viṣaṃ jayati deveśi (!) sthāvarāṅgasamāśritam |
iyaṃ vidyā parāvidyā sarvapāpavināśinī |
svargadā mokṣadā caiva rājyasaukhyaphalapradā |
iyaṃ devī mayā pūrvaṃ sādhitā viṣavarjitā |
sakṛduccāritā vidyā brahmahatyāviśodhanī |
sarvapāpavihantrīyaṃ sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī |
yadyucchiṣṭamukho bhūtvā smareddevīṃ kadācana |
tadācānto bhaveddevi (!) vinaivācamane kṛte |
durbhagā subhagā nūnaṃ duḥkhitā sukhitā bhavet |
bandhyāpi labhate putraṃ śatahāyanajīvitam |
nirdhano dhanamāpnoti mūrkho vidyāmavāpnuyāt |
yāṃ yāṃ prārthayate siddhiṃ haṭhāttāṃ tāmavāpnuyāt |
vidhānaṃ hyatra vakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi (!) manorame (!) |
bhojanānantaraṃ devi (!) vinaivācamane kṛte |
baliṃ dattvā prathamato mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ |
tato mantraṃ japeddhyātvā devīṃ tāmiṣṭasiddhaye |
mantraṃ śṛṇu mahādevi (!) yathāvat kathayāmi te |
nama ucchiṣṭapūrvantu tathā cāṇḍālinīti ca |
sumukhī ca tato devī kīrtayettadanantaram |
mahāpiśācinī tasmāllajjāvījamataḥ param |
nādabindusamāyuktaṃ ṭhakāradvitayaṃ punaḥ |
savisargaṃ mahādevi (!) sarvasiddhipradāyakam |
na tithirna ca nakṣatraṃ nopavāso vidhīyate |
nāṅganyāsakaranyāsau na varṇanyāsa īritaḥ |
na videśo na vā vighno nāśaucaṃ niyamo na ca |
yasya tiṣṭhati mantro'yaṃ na na sa vighnairavāpyate |
dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi yathāvajjagadīśvari (!) |
śavopari samāsīnāṃ raktāmbaraparicchadām |
raktālaṅkārasaṃyuktāṃ guñjāhāravibhūṣitām |
ṣoḍaśābdāñca yuvatīṃ pīnonnatapayodharām |
kapālakṛtakāhastāṃ paramajyotirūpiṇīm |
bāladakṣiṇayogena dhyāyenmantraviduttamaḥ |
ucchiṣṭena baliṃ dattvā japettadgatamānasaḥ |
ucchiṣṭenaiva kartavyo japo'syāḥ siddhimicchatā |
ucchiṣṭajapamānasya jāyante sarvasiddhayaḥ |
aparañca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi (!) phalapradam |
homaṃ santarpaṇañcāsyāḥ sahasā kāryasiddhaye |
sthaṇḍile maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā caturasraṃ samāhitaḥ |
pūjayenmaṇḍalaṃ devi (!) mūlamantreṇa mantravit |
tato devīṃ samādhāya vahnirūpāṃ vyavasthitām |
devīṃ dhyātvā carddhomaṃ dadhisiddhānnataṇḍulaiḥ |
sahasraikaṃ vidhānena rājā bhavati vaśyagaḥ |
mārjārasya tu māṃsena yo devyai homamācaret |
sa prāpnoti parāṃ vidyāṃ śastraśāstravahiṣkṛtām |
kuryāttu chāgamāṃsena homaṃ madhusamanvitam |
sahasraikaṃ vidhānena bhavanti dhanasiddhayaḥ |
vidyākāmaścareddhomaṃ śarkarāmadhupāyasaiḥ |
punastasya bhavantyeva siddhavidyāścaturdaśa |
rajasvalāyā vastreṇa madhunā pāyasena ca |
homaṃ kṛtvā mahādevi (!) trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet |
nāgavallyā careddhomaṃ madhunā saha sarpiṣā |
ayutaikaṃ vidhānena siddhividyā bhaved dhruvam |
sadyo mārjāramāṃsena ghṛtena madhunā saha |
cāṇḍālakeśayuktena bhavedākarṣaṇaṃ dhruvam |
śaśakasya tu māṃsena madhunāloḍitena tu |
kṛtvā homamavāpnoti vidyāṃ vittaṃ varāḥ striyaḥ |
dhustūrārkasya yogena citāvahnau tu mantravit |
kokilākākapakṣaiśca homaḥ śatrūn vināśayet |
uccāṭanāya śatrūṇāṃ homaṃ kuryācca mantravit |
pūrvoktena vidhānena citākāṣṭhahutāśane |
ulūkakākapakṣābhyāṃ kṛtvā homaṃ nirantaram |
vedhayecchatrumanyonyaṃ kalahākulamuddhṛtam |
ulūkapakṣahomena garbhapāto varastriyaḥ |
sahasraikaṃ vidhānena kuryāddhomaṃ samāhitaḥ |
bilvapatreṇa sājyena māsamekaṃ nirantaram |
api bandhyā labhet putraṃ cirajīvinamuttamam |
bandhūkakusumaṃ hutvā raktaṃ madhusitānvitam |
durbhagāyā haṭhāddevi (!) saubhāgyasukhadāyakam |
prātarutthāya yaḥ kaścit kuryāddhomaṃ dine dine |
javāpuṣpeṇa sājyena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ priye (!) |
ṣaṇmāsasya prayogeṇa bhavedākarṣaṇaṃ dhruvam |
devagandharvamartyānāṃ kanyā nāgāṅganā dvijāḥ |
haṭhādāgatya kāmārtā balādāliṅgayanti tam |
vidyāyāḥ kriyate homastilapāyasamiśritaiḥ |
sa prāpnoti mahāvidyāṃ śāstraughapadaśālinīm |
madhunā rurumāṃsena homaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ |
vidyāvān dhanavān buddhiṃ śastraśāstravaśīkṛtām |
iyaṃ devī mahādevi (!) vāmācāraphalapradā |
dakṣiṇācārayogeṇa na bhavet phaladāyinī |
sabhājanāntarañcāsyā baliṃ dattvā dine dine |
ucchiṣṭena japenmantraṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ priye (!) |
ujjaṭe vā śmaśāne vā śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe |
balipradānato devī pratyakṣā bhavati dhruvam |
eṣā devī mayā khyātā bhairavākāramicchatā |
ityeṣā kathitā devī sarvapāpāpahāriṇī |
mantrasyoccāraṇāddevi (!) sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ |
ucchiṣṭadūṣaṇaṃ tyaktvā sa pavitro bhaved dhruvam |
ityucchiṣṭacāṇḍālinī devī bhuvanaviśrutā |
nānāpravartane kāñcidvidyāṃ śṛṇu varānane (!) ||
śrīśiva uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi (!) mahāvidyāṃ samayākāradhāriṇīṃ |
na tithirna ca nakṣatraṃ na sādhyādiṃ vicārayet |
mahādevīti vikhyātā śivadīkṣāntagāminī |
yajñopavītaṃ deveśi (!) dhāryate sādhakena vai |
ucchiṣṭenārcayeddevīṃ mahādevena sādhitām |
nānyamavagatastiṣṭhet sarvagranthaṃ suvistaram |
bahunoktena kiṃ devi (!) trailokyamapi sādhayet |
sadā kālantu mantro'yaṃ smartavyastripurāriṇā |
payoguḍena bhaktena māṃsena juhuyānnaraḥ |
āyurdhanañca putrāṃśca vidyāmaṣṭādaśīṃ labhet |
goptavyeyaṃ prayatnena kathitavyā na kasyacit |
gurubhaktiḥ pradātavyā kāyena ca dhanena ca |
lokāpavādo na ca devi (!) pāpaṃ naivāparā tiṣṭhati martyaloke |
marttyaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā pare devīpuraṃ vrajet |
mokṣaikasārāṃ dhanadaikasārāṃ vidyaikasārāṃ śṛṇu devi (!) vidyām |
sarvopakārāṃ paramārthasārāṃ mahānubhāvāṃ bhuvi kāmadhenum ||
ityucchiṣṭacāṇḍālinīprayogaḥ ||
matsyasūkte aṣṭapañcāśatpaṭale (!)
grāmamedhaṃ pravakṣyāmi kṛte rogairna bādhyate |
akṛte maraṇaṃ grāme tasmāt kuryāt prayatnataḥ |
tatra sampūjayeddevīṃ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ prajāpatim |
bhadrakālīñca kṣetreśaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
atha dhūmāvatīprayogaḥ ||
phetpāriṇītantre ||
dhūmāvatīprayogo'yamadhunā kathyate mayā |
dāntau sārghīśavindvantau bīje dhūmavatīhdviṭhaḥ |
dhūmāvatīmanuḥ prokto vairinigrahakārakaḥ |
ṣaḍaṅgaṃ jātisaṃyuktaṃ kalpayettena mantravit |
pippalādo muniśchando nīvṛdeṣā ca devatā |
vivarṇā ca~calā kṛṣṇā dīrghā ca malināmbarā |
vimuktakuntalā rūkṣā vidhavā virasadvijā |
kākadhvajarathārūḍhā vilambitapayodharā |
sūrpahastātirūkṣākṣā dhṛtahastā varānvitā |
pravṛddhaghoṇā tu bhṛśaṃ kuṭilā kuṭilekṣaṇā |
kṣutpipāsārditā nityaṃ bhayadā kalahāspadā |
evaṃvidhāṃ samādhyāyettataḥ karma samārabhet |
caturthena tu varṇena ṣaṣṭhasvarayutena ca |
ṣaḍdīrghajātiyuktena kuryādaṅgāni mantravit |
japet kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ puraścaraṇasiddhaye |
upavāsarato mantrī śūnyāgāre divāniśam |
śmaśāne vipine vāpi japellakṣantu vāgyataḥ |
soṣṇīṣaḥ sārdravāsāśca puraścaraṇakarmaṇi |
sādhyopari mantramālikhya tasmin sthāpya śivaṃ vrajet |
avaṣṭabhya śivaṃ śatrunāmnātha prajapenmanum |
sahasrādūrddhvataḥ śatrurjvareṇa parigṛhyate |
pañcagavyena śāntiḥ syājjvarasya payasāpi vā |
mantrādyakṣaramālikhya śatrunāma tataḥ param |
dvitīyantu manoḥ śatrornāmaikaṃ manumālikhet |
vane'yutaṃ japet śatrorniścitaṃ maraṇaṃ bhavet |
kṛtvā mantre riporākhyāṃ māraṇe yāminīdale |
utsādo jāyate śatrormanorayutajāpataḥ |
dagdhvā kākaṃ śmaśānāgnau tadbhasmādāya mantritam |
virodhināmāṣṭāśāsu sadya uccāṭanaṃ ripoḥ |
śmaśānabhasmanā kṛtvā śivaṃ tasyopari nyaset |
virodhināmasaṃruddhaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe samuccaret |
mahiṣīkṣīradhūpañca dadyāt śatruvipatkaram |
mahiṣīrūpamāsthāya śatruṃ sā vinipātayet |
mantreṇānena nikhanettadbhasma ripumandire |
śatrumuccāṭayettūrṇaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
nyasya pāṇitale śatrorākhyānaṃ citibhasmanā |
vahnāvadho mukhaṃ kruddhaḥ sthāpayannayutaṃ japan |
dhūmāvatīmanuṃ mantrī śatrukṣayaparaṃ nayet |
prāgvat karatale nyasya tvarddhayorddhaṃ ripornyaset |
jalasthaḥ prajapet mantrī huṅkārānnāśayedarīn |
śmaśānāṅgāramādāya kṛtvā puṣpādinārcayet |
bhagaliṅgaṃ samābhāṣya manasā karma cintayan |
nimbakākacchadānekīkṛtya cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
dadyāddhūpaṃ sādhyanāmnā sadyo vidveṣayedarīn |
citākāṣṭhānale kṣīrahomācchāntiḥ prajāyate |
rajodhūpapradānena gṛdhrarūpeṇa kālikā |
mārayatyarimāgatya śāntinirmālyadhūpataḥ |
varāhabāladhūpena hanyādvārāharūpiṇī |
aśvatthapatradhūpena śāntirbhavati nānyathā |
śāntiḥ sarvābhicārasya pañcagavyena jāyate |
kṣīreṇāpi ca deveśi (!) madhuratritayena ca |
kīle kṣeḍatarorvidarbhya vilikhenmantreṇa nāmākṣaraṃ japtvā lekhyapadadvaye tu nikhaneduccāṭanaṃ vidviṣām |
tvatpādadvayadhūlikīrṇahaviṣā dattvā dvijebhyo baliṃ tajjaptvā citibhasmakīrtitamarergehe ca tadvadbhavet |
vāyavye vilikhecca parṇasahitaṃ japtaṃ sahasrādhikam |
japtvā vāyusurā śivākṣadakṛśatve vā na tadrodhakam |
cūrṇaṃ tasya ca pallave vinihitaṃ japtaṃ sahasrākṣaraṃ kāntaṃ śatrugṛheṣu tacchirasi vā teṣāṃ kuloccāṭanam |
japtvārāme śmaśāne ca nirmālye padagocare |
gardabhāvāsabhūmau ca bhūtasthāne catuṣpathe |
ūṣare mehanābhūmau puṣpitāvāsameghayoḥ |
ānīya śarkarāṃ mantrī digvāsā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
śmaśānaloṣṭre nikṣipya tatrāgnau bharjayettathā |
cūrṇaṃ tattu japellakṣaṃ prakṣipecchatruveśmani |
senāmadhye ca sarveṣāṃ pakṣāduccāṭanaṃ bhavet |
garte pipīlikānāntu pādadhūlī ṣaḍānanān |
dhṛtānnaṃ saptarātrantu juhuyānmantravinniśi |
bhramate kākavat sarvāṃ mahīmāmāraṇādripuḥ |
kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ śatrorjanma(-)ṛkṣeṇa mantravit |
kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ prāṇasya viddhvā marmasu kaṇṭakaiḥ |
āyasairmantramāvartya bhaumavārodayādiṣu |
dhustūrarasasampiṣṭacitāṅgāreṇa mantriṇā |
nityasya pṛṣṭhato baddhvakeśapāśena taṃ japet |
śmaśāne śatrumāhūya tadgṛhe nikhanenniśi |
vidveṣaṇaṃ bhavet sadyo gaurīśaṅkarayorapi |
aśvatthatvaci mantrārṇairdarbhitaṃ sādhyamālikhet |
anyadviṣatarostadvajjaptvā tatkṛtyayā nyaset |
pūrvoktakaṇṭakaividvān japet piṣṭvā śataṃ śatam |
vidviṣṭau bhavatastau tu nāmnāmapi ca tatkṣaṇāt |
varṇāṃstān vilikhedviṣākhyamabhitaḥ koṇeṣu mantrākṣaraiḥ saṃruddhān paritaḥ prabhañjanagṛhaṃ madhye ca sādhyaṃ pṛthak |
aṅgāraiḥ kanakodbhavairapi padairmantraṃ japaṃstāḍayet |
kārpāsena raṇe kujārkadivase bhūlokavidveṣaṇam |
āpādya pūrvāṃ murtiñca śatrorālikhya śodhayet |
ātape niśitāṃ japtvā vahnerupari lambayet |
evaṃ saptadinaṃ dravyairājapyālikhya śodhayet |
vyomāgnilaśulonmattahiṅgusiddhārthaśūraṇaiḥ |
piṇḍairlavaṇasambhūtairunmattadravasaṅgataiḥ |
peṣayitvā tena samyag likhenmantrī manuṃ japet |
balimadhye khanet kīlaṃ yuktarūpaṃ tathopari |
vahniṃ prajvālya taddhyuccairgavyayuktaṃ humejjapet |
nikṣipya pratimāṃ tatra japennityaṃ mahāmanum |
saptaviṃśaṃ tataḥ kuṇḍaṃ śūnyāgāre ca vā humet |
trikoṇaśūladīptāgramekhalātritayānvitam |
tatrāpi nikhanet kolaṃ vahniṃ prajvālya pūrvavat |
tataḥ pratikṛtiṃ mantrī vahnerupari lambayet |
ukta dravyeṇa saṃliptvā ūrddhvapādāmadhomukhīm |
raktadravyaiḥ samārādhya prajvālya viṣavṛkṣajaiḥ |
indhanaiḥ pratimāyāñca samitprajvalitāṃ humet |
āvaraṇādibhirāmartyo layaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti dhūmāvatīprakaraṇam ||
atha kṛtyāparimalaprayogaḥ |
trayodaśapaṭale ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantraṃ parimalātmakam |
yena vijñānamātreṇa nāsādhyaṃ bhuvanatraye |
rudrajāyā mahāyogī nato gaurīpadaṃ vadet |
bhuvanabhayaṅkarīti padaṃ varmāntamuccarenmanum |
athavā prathamādanyamathāto brahmaṇaḥ padam |
parimala ityādi brahmādyakhaṇḍaparimalaḥ |
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena mantrārddhenāstrayogiṇā |
hṛdayañca tato'rddhena varmāstreṇa śiraḥ kramāt |
śikhākavacanetrāstramevaṃ nyāsakramaḥ smṛtaḥ |
aṅgirā ca ṛṣirdevī gāyatrīcchanda īritam |
siṃhavaktrā ca bhūtānāṃ bhayaṅkariṇyataḥ param |
mahākṛtyā devatā cetyuktvā nyāsaṃ samācaret |
siṃhānanāṃ kṛṣṇamukhīṃ lambamānapayodharām |
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ trinetrāṃ sarvatojjvalām |
kṛṣṇakañcukasaṃvītāṃ vidhūmāgnisamaprabhām |
triśūlacakramuṣalakhaṭṭāṅgakarapaṅkajām |
lelihānāṃ mahajjihvāṃ vidyutprekṣasabhīṣaṇām |
dhyātvā kṛtyāṃ vidhānena pūjayenmantravittamaḥ |
dhyātvā kṛtyāmarcayati raktaiḥ puṣpaiśca vaśyake |
kṛṣṇā māraṇakṛtyeṣu māṃsaraktāsavaistathā |
kṛtyāñca madanāṃ sarvakulyāṃ svañchādinīṃ tathā |
bhīṣaṇāṃ śrīmatīṃ caiva pratiṣṭhāñca tataḥ param |
vidyāmabhyarcayedaṣṭapatreṣu kramaśaḥ sudhīḥ |
pūrve tu śāṅkarīnāma śuklavarṇāṃ varānvitām |
dvibhujāṃ saumyavadanāṃ pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ śivām |
dakṣiṇe bhīṣakānāma lambajihvāṃ sudhāmukhīm |
kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ raktamukhīṃ raktamālyānulepanām |
caturbhujāṃ siṃhanādāhlādakāñca kapālinīm |
khaḍgahastāṃ śiromālāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām |
paścime vāruṇīnāma svarṇavarṇāṃ hasanmukhīm |
surudramālikāṃ śubhradaṃṣṭrāmabhayadāṃ sadā |
uttare bhīmikānāma caturvarṇabhayaṅkarīm |
pūjayitvā japenmantraṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
avāpya viniyogastu kartavyo mantriṇā sadā |
kālaṃ viditvā pratimāṃ madhūcchiṣṭena kārayet |
dvādaśāṅgulaṃ tat śatrornakhalomasamanvitam |
hṛdaye nāmadheyañca phaṭkāraṃ sarvavarmake |
amuṣya prāṇa iha cāmuṣya jīva iha sthitaḥ |
amuṣya sarvendriyāṇi tathā cāmuṣya vāṅmanaḥ |
cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇaprāṇānihānayatvagniballabhā |
iti prāṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maricairlepayettataḥ |
mṛtabrāhmaṇacāṇḍālakeśābhyāṃ pādayoḥ pṛthak |
baddhvā kāraskaramaye toraṇe cāpyayomukhīm |
tasyādho mekhalāyuktaṃ trikoṇaṃ tatra kuṇḍakam |
tatra śāvaṃ vidhāyāgniṃ paristīrya śaraistṛṇaiḥ |
vibhītakaparidhyā ca kalpayed yasya māraṇam |
juhuyānnimbatailāktaiḥ kākolūkasya picchakaiḥ |
dārayainaṃ śodhayainaṃ mārayetyabhidhāya ca |
aṣṭottaraśatenaiva manunā vidhinā budhaḥ |
homānte vidhivat kṛtyāmārādhyāgneśca sannidhau |
yo me ekasthagṛho'tidūrastho vāntike'pi ca |
piva kṛtye'sṛk tasya humityuktvā nivedayet |
saṃrakṣāgniṃ vidhānena navarātraṃ samācaret |
humed yāvattāvadasya bhavedeva ripormṛtiḥ |
arkakṣīreṇa maricaṃ piṣṭvā siddhārthameva ca |
jale saṃloḍya mantreṇa ripuṃ dhyātvā niruddhadṛk |
kṛṣṇāmbarottarīyāgraṃ pādenākramya tadripum |
vajraṃ śūlamiti dhyātvā tasyopari vinikṣipet |
navarātrāntare śatrurmriyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dūrasiddhe citāvahnau tailāsaktairvibhītakaiḥ |
juhvato mriyate śatruḥ satyamauśanasoditam |
ripoḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā sādhyarkṣaphalake'male |
arkakṣīreṇa maricaṃ piṣṭvā tatraiva lepayet |
phaṭkāraṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā śivaṃ nirmāya dhūpakaiḥ |
kṣipet kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ japtvā mantraṃ sahasraśaḥ |
sadyo'vagāhanaṃ kṛtvā kuryād yasyātmarakṣaṇam |
mantraṃ japtvā vidhānena bhedayet saha mudrayā |
ṣaṇmāsāt mriyate śatruḥ sandhyayorubhayorapi |
vāyunā coddhṛtaṃ parṇaṃ śuṣkaṃ vaibhītakaṃ tataḥ |
gṛhītvā ca likhenmantrī kṛṣṇasarpasya śoṇitaiḥ |
nāmadheyaṃ riporante vāyubījaṃ prayojayet |
nikhanettasya gehe tu kākavaktrāmaye dhruvam |
vātoddhūtaiḥ śuṣkaparṇaiḥ kāṣṭhairaśanipātitaiḥ |
uṣṭrāsthi ca navāṅgāraiḥ śatroruccāṭanaṃ humet |
dūrvāguḍūcīṃ gandhena sarpiṣā tilataṇḍulaiḥ |
annaḥ samidbhiḥ pālāśaiḥ śāntiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ |
lakṣmīṃ bilvaphalaiḥ patrairnandyāvartaiḥ śriye tathā |
vajrapatrairapāmārgairaṅgāraiśca subhadrakaiḥ |
madhuratrayasaṃyuktairebhiḥ kuryāttu vaśyakam |
uttame panase tantre vāsavasyāpi kathyate |
śāntiṃ kṛtvā vidhānena japet parimalaṃ tvidam |
mahāvyādhipraśamanaṃ nityamaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam |
japedekāgracittastu lokavaśyakaraṃ śubham |
manasā cintayedetāṃ gajārūḍhāṃ viyatsthitām ||
tasya vaśyā bhavet kṣipramaśvārūḍhā tathā bhavet |
cauravyāghramṛgādīnāṃ salilādibhayāpahām |
sakṛt śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpavināśanam |
saptābhimantritaṃ toyaṃ pītvā nityaṃ samāhitaḥ |
medhāvī ca bhavedvāgmī tāvajjaptvābhiṣekataḥ |
saptābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā viṣamapyamṛtaṃ bhavet |
māsaṃ pakṣaṃ dvimāsañca ṣaṇmāsaṃ vatsarantu vā |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt |
atha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa mahāśāntividhikramam |
sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam |
sarvamudrāpaharaṇaṃ sarvāriṣṭavināśanam |
mahāvyādhipraśamanamapasmāravināśanam |
yoginībhūtavetālāḥ pretakuṣmāṇḍapannagāḥ |
tatra sthāne na tiṣṭhanti ḍākinyādyā viśeṣataḥ |
kṛtyāmabhyarcayedvatsa (!) yathāvidhipuraḥsaram |
ṣoḍaśāraṃ likhet padmaṃ yoniyugmaṃ sabindukam |
tanmadhye'ṣṭadalaṃ likhya yakārādīn nyaset kramāt |
tanmadhye rasakoṇantu likhenmūlamanuṃ smaran |
candrabimbaṃ likhenmadhye tasyorddhve pratimāṃ likhet |
tasya madhye nyaset kumbhaṃ vane sragdāmabhūṣitām |
tasya madhye nyaset kṛtyāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām |
pūjayecca yathānyāyaṃ pāyasantu nivedayet |
paritoṣya ghaṭe nyasya cāsitāṅgādibhairavān |
asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodhīśonmattabhairavaḥ |
kapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya tadvāhye kṣetrapālakān |
lokapālaṃ yajeddevīṃ tadagre homamācaret |
juhuyādājyāpāpāmārgāvakṣatābhiramarṣaṇaḥ |
dūrvāgrakhadirāśvatthaṃ pratyekantu śatādhikam |
kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi homakarma samācaret |
tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu lakṣmīṃ dhyāyed yathāvidhi |
kuṇḍamadhye nyasyeddevīṃ dakṣiṇe tu śriyaṃ smaret |
vāmapārśve smareddevīṃ hṛllekhāṃ parameśvarīm |
tasyaiva vāmapārśve tu pūjayeddaśa nāyakān |
ayutaṃ mūlamantrañca japenmṛtyuvināśanam |
ayutaṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ japet parimalaṃ viduḥ |
mahāvyādhipraśamanaṃ tāvajjaptvābhiṣekataḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute marttyaḥ puṇyāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt |
yena jñātaṃ parimalaṃ yasya vaktre sthitaṃ sadā |
tasyāvaśyaṃ nivedyeta vyādhibhyo'pi bhayaṃ na hi |
ityādividhinā candre jñeyaḥ parimalo vidhiḥ |
mahāśāntikaraḥ puṃsāṃ duḥkhādivighnanāśanaḥ ||
iti kṛtyāparimalaḥ ||
atha jayadurgā |
caturdaśapaṭale ||
durge durge padaṃ coktvā rakṣaṇīti padaṃ tataḥ |
tārādivahnijāyānto jayadurgāmahāmanuḥ |
jātimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā nyasenmantrapadaṃ budhaḥ |
rakṣākarīyaṃ kathitā jayadurgā varmasaṃyutā |
śyāmāṃ trilocanāṃ durgāṃ dhyātvā tvenāṃ caturbhujām |
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ śaraṃ śūlaṃ vahantīṃ raudrarūpiṇīm |
yuddhe ca vyavahārādau jayedetajjapānnaraḥ |
jayāṃ śrīṃ pūjayennityāṃ śaṅkhañca churikāṃ tathā |
jayadurgāmanuḥ proktaḥ kathyate cāparo manuḥ |
namo bhagavatītyuktvā jvālāmālinyataḥ param |
gṛdhragaṇaparivṛte dviṭhastārādirīritaḥ |
oṃ namo hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ bhagavati śirastathā |
jvālāmālinī śikhā gṛdhragaṇaparivṛte tataḥ |
kavacaṃ svāhāstramityetat jātiyuktaṃ nyasettanau |
ayutaṃ niyutañcaitajjayamantraṃ yajejjayī |
rudrāṅganāgnijāyābhyāṃ ruddhvā jvālāmukhītyapi |
mantrāntaraṃ samākhyātaṃ jvālāmukhyāmanuttamam |
dīpatailāktapādo'rddharātre gurudināditaḥ |
japedaṣṭasahasrantu trayoviṃśativāsarān |
pratyahaṃ sā raupyaṣaṭkaṃ dadātīti na saṃśayaḥ |
nārāyaṇīyaṃ kathitamagastyairnavadhā punaḥ |
durgā navaprakārākhyā navadurgā viśeṣataḥ |
susiddhimicchatā gopyo mānavena samīrayet |
puro'pi nṛpate'dyāpi dhārmikasya nyaśeṣataḥ |
navadurgāvidhānantu darśayet karmagauravāt ||
nṛpaśca samyagārādhya mantrañca vividhairdhanaiḥ |
bhaktyā sannihitaṃ kuryādrakṣārthaṃ nityamādarāt |
āpatsvayaṃ prayoktavyo māraṇādau viśeṣataḥ |
tato mantrī prayatnena prakuryānmāraṇakriyām |
parairdurddharṣito mantrī rājñe sarvaṃ nivedayet |
nivedya vidhivat paścāt mantravarṣeṇa nirdahet |
smṛtimātreṇa vai mantrī ripūn sarvān vināśayet |
pradadyādambikāṃ tasmai sahasraṃ śatameva vā |
gavāṃ suvarṇaniṣkāṇāṃ bhūmiṃ vā śasyaśālinīm |
sarvaśāntimavāpnoti sarvarakṣākṛtirbhavet ||
iti phetkāriṇītantre jayadurgāgṛdhragaṇaparivṛtājvālamukhīprayogaḥ ||
[iti śrīprāṇatoṣiṇyāṃ caturthe kāmyakāṇḍe kukkuṭocchiṣṭa(-) cāṇḍālinīdhūmāvatīkṛtyāparimalajayadurgāgṛdhragaṇa(-) parivṛtajvālāmukhīprayogarūpapallavakathanaṃ nāma caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ] ||
atha durgotsavaḥ ||
matsyasūkte mahāmantre uparibhāge ekacatvāriṃśatpaṭale ||
bhagavānuvāca ||
atha cāśvayuje śuklapakṣamāsādya nandikām |
samārādhya tato durgāṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ |
kṛtvā srotojale snātvā tasyāstīre samarcayet |
tasyā iti strīliṅganirdeśānnadyāstīre samarcayedityarthaḥ ||
pūjāprakāro'pi tatraiva ||
nandāyāṃ pūjayet kumbhe dvitīyāyāñca pustake |
tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā khaḍge caturthyāṃ keśaśodhanam |
pañcamyāṃ sūryabimbe ca ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bilvasya mūlake |
saptamyāṃ patrikāyāntu aṣṭamyāṃ pratimāsu ca |
jyeṣṭhānakṣatrayuktāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bilvābhimantraṇam |
mūlādyapāde saptamyāṃ patrikāyāḥ praveśanam |
pūrvāṣāḍhāyutāṣṭamyāṃ devī pūjyā mahotsavaiḥ |
uttareṇa navamyāntu balibhiḥ pūjayecchivām |
śravaṇānte daśamyāntu praṇipatya visarjayet |
etena devīpurāṇoktasya kanyāsaṃsthe ravau śakraśuklāmārabhya nandikāmiti vacanasya ṣaṣṭhītaḥ prabhṛti navamīparyantaṃ pūjeyamityekatvenoktamiti smārtabhaṭṭācāryavyākhyānam |
nandikāpratipaditi durgābhaktitaraṅgiṇyuktaṃ yuktamiti vācyam |
mahānavamīvihitaṣaṣṭhyatikrame mānābhāvāditi vacanādevaṃ pratipaditi durgābhaktitaraṅgiṇyuktameva bhadramutpaśyāmaḥ |
keśaśodhanamiti saptamyarthe prathamā |
keśaśodhanakaṅkatikāyāṃ pūjayedityarthaḥ ||
nakṣatrāṇāmabhāve kṛtyalopaḥ syādityāha tatraiva ||
nakṣatrāṇāmabhāve'pi ṣaṣṭhyādikramaśastathā |
sarvameva vidhiṃ kuryāttārālābhe phalodayaḥ |
phalodayaḥ viśiṣṭaphalodaya ityarthaḥ |
anyathā nakṣatrābhāve phalābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ syāt |
iti pratipadādikalpakathanam |
atha pūjādikālastatraiva ||
jyeṣṭhā vāpyathavā ṣaṣṭhī sāyaṃkāle na cedbhavet |
sāyameva tathapi syādbilvaśākhābhimantraṇam |
pūrvāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ sanakṣatrāṃ sāyaṃ prāptāmapi tyajet |
yadā tu patrikāpūjā na paredyurbhaviṣyati |
sannikṛṣṭantu yat pūrvaṃ patitaṃ divasasya ca |
taddine varaṇaṃ kṛtvā pare śākhāṃ praveśayet |
saptamyāntu yadā ṣaṣṭhī niḥsṛtā vā na niḥsṛtā |
varddhate saptamī kintu daṇḍamātraṃ pare yadi |
pare'hanīti śeṣaḥ |
muhūrtamadhikā vāpi navamyāmaṣṭamī bhavet |
varddhate daśamī caiva tadā kāryaṃ yathā śṛṇu |
na kevalaṃ navamī daśamī ceti cārthaḥ |
saptamyāṃ bilvavaraṇamaṣṭamyāntu praveśanam |
pūjāṣṭakā navamyāntu daśamyāṃ preṣayecchivām |
atra kecit sāmānyavidhiprāptatithibādhabhiyā saptamyāṃ bahukālīnasaptamīyutaṣaṣṭhyāmiti vyākhyānti |
tatra ṣaṣṭhī na niḥsṛteti vacanamanākulaṃ veti pratibhāti |
yadā ṣaṣṭhau ca saptamyāṃ aṣṭamyāñcāpi varddhayet ||
svārtha iṇapāṇinividāntu ṇic varddheta |
arthāt saptamīti śeṣaḥ |
aṣṭamī paragā caiva taddine ca dinakṣayaḥ |
tadā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pūrvadine bilvasya vandanaṃ matam |
ṣaṣṭhīsaṃyuktasaptamyāṃ patrikāyāḥ praveśanam |
atikalpe tathāṣṭamyāṃ mṛṇmayīñca praveśayet |
atikalpe atipratyūṣe ||
saptamyā saṃyutāṣṭamyāṃ mahāpūjotsavakriyā |
navamyāntu baliṃ dadyāddaśamyāṃ preṣayecchivām |
navamyāmaṣṭamī yatra navamī parato nacet |
bhaved vā daśamīviddhā navamī ca pare'hani |
tadāṣṭamīnavamyośca dvayoḥ pūjādvayaṃ kila |
ekasminneva divase kartavyaṃ balibhiḥ saha |
aṣṭakā navamīpūjā trisandhyavyāpinī parā |
tadā tadā navamyuktaṃ balidānaṃ pare'hani |
trisandhyavyāpinī cet syād yadā pūrvadine'ṣṭamī |
daśamīviddhanavamyāntu kuryāt pūjāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
aṣṭakānavamīyogo rātriyogo viśiṣyate |
arddharātrau śataguṇaṃ sandhyāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ smṛtam |
saptamyādiṣu pūrvāhṇe tārāyogo na cedbhavet |
tadāpyārabhya pūrvāhṇe nakṣatrāṃśe samāpayet |
daśamyāṃ śravaṇo vyāpī tathotthāya kṛtakriyaḥ |
prātaḥ sampūjya vidhivat nṛtyagītapuraḥsaraiḥ |
pratīkṣya śrāvaṇaṃ kālaṃ prāpte sampreṣayecchivām |
yadi nakṣatramāśritya saptamyādi trikaṃ sthitam |
tadaiva śravaṇāpekṣā daśamyāṃ kecidabruvan |
śravaṇānte gate rātrau tadante navamī dine |
svasvasthānocitaṃ karma dakṣiṇāntaṃ samāpaet |
daśamyāntu tadaprāptau dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ yathāvidhi |
preṣayedbhagavatīṃ durgāmaśeṣaiḥ śāradotsavaiḥ |
navamī daśamīyuktā śravaṇā tu gatā niśi |
tadā sampreṣayeddevīṃ navamyāṃ daśamīkṣaṇe |
aṣṭamīdinaparyantā rātrau cennavamī bhavet |
navamyāmapi kurvīta mahāpūjāṃ mahāniśi |
candrodite niśāyāntu yā bhavedaṣṭamītithiḥ |
mahāṣṭamīti sā proktā devyāḥ prītikarī parā |
tato'nu navamī yā syāt sā mahānavamītithiḥ |
pūjādhāramāha tatraiva ||
citre ca pratimāyāñca mṛṇmayyāṃ śrīphale'pi ca |
mahāyonau candrabimbe śilāyāṃ yonimaṇḍale |
pustake pāduke khaḍge mahābimbe tathaiva ca |
puṇyakṣetre ca gaṅgāyāṃ devīmāvāhya pūjayet ||
pramākaraṇavidhiniṣedhāvapi tatraiva ||
na gṛhī mṛṇmayīṃ kuryānna vai tālamayīṃ kvacit |
trihastāṃ tṛṇagarbhāñca vilvayugme samarcayet ||
na gṛhī mṛṇmayīṃ kevalamṛttikayā pratimāṃ na kuryāttathā tālamayīṃ sārddhatrihastaparimitāṃ gṛhī na kuryāt |
vidhimāha trihastāmiti |
trihastāṃ pratimāmityadhikaparimāṇavyavacchedārthamuktam |
tena tannyūnapratimākaraṇe na doṣaḥ |
mṛṇmayyāḥ pratiprasavamāha tṛṇagarbhāmiti |
tena tṛṇagarbhamṛṇmayīpūjane doṣaḥ |
cakāro bhinnakrame tṛṇagarbhāṃ samarcayet bilvayugme ceti |
brāhmaṇādibhedena bilvayugmasya viśeṣamāha |
māhendrasthañca īśasthaṃ brāhmaṇasya praśasyate ||
ūrddhasthamuttarasthañca kṣatriyasya varānane (!) |
vāyavyasthañca vaiśyasya śūdrasya ca varānane (!) |
māhendrasthaṃ tatheśasthaṃ sarveṣāmathavā priye (!) |
pūrvādisthabilvayugmaphalamāha ||
māhendrasthe jñānavṛddhirīśasthe sarvakāmadam |
vāyusthe ca dhanāvāptiraiśvaryamuttarāsthite |
yāmyasthe śatruvṛddhiḥ syāt koṇage maraṇaṃ bhavet |
vāyvīśānakoṇasthasya viśeṣaphalābhidhānādatra koṇapadamagninai(-)ṛtakoṇaparaṃ pāriśeṣyāditi |
bilvayugasya śubhalakṣaṇamagrāhyatvañcāha tatraiva ||
samaṃ vṛttaṃ samaṃ sthūlaṃ śastaṃ kīṭādidūṣitam |
na grāhyaṃ parameśāni (!) kadācidūrddhvamadhyagam |
ūrddhvagetikṣatriyabhinnasyāgrāhyatvam |
samamiti sarvasya |
yadvā kadāciduktasthānasthasyāprāptādūrddhvamadhyagamapi grāhyaṃ nindyaphalāśruteriti tātparyam |
bilvayugmādeścyutidoṣo'pi tatraiva ||
snānasthāne nīyamāne cyute yugme maheśvari (!) |
mṛṇmayyāśca cyutiryatra jāyate maraṇaṃ dhruvam |
taddoṣapraśamanārthañcāyutaṃ juhuyād ghṛtaiḥ |
dhenuñca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt śvetāśvaṃ śetachāgalam ||
iti bilvayugapratimācyutiprāyaścittam |
nandāmārabhyadaśamīparyantamutsavaṃ viduḥ |
mahāmahotsavaṃ jñeyaṃ tridinaṃ tat prakīrtitam |
tadanyadevatāyāgaṃ yaḥ karoti maheśvari (!) |
na tasya phalamāpnoti so'nte narakamāpnuyāt |
devyā bhāgaśataṃ sarvaṃ tasmānnānyaṃ samarcayet |
punaraṣṭamyāṃ pratimāsu cetyantamabhidhāya |
prahare prahare snānaṃ prahare prahare baliḥ |
prahare prahare homamannañcābhiṣasaṃyutam |
prabhūtabalidānañca navamyāñca praśasyate |
navamyā pūjitā devī dadātyanantakaṃ phalam ||
deśaviśeṣe mūrtiviśeṣo'pi tatraiva ||
oḍradeśe kaliṅge ca madhyadeśe tathaiva ca |
devī cāṣṭabhujā pūjyā ayodhyāyāṃ surāṣṭrake |
cohāre caiva śrīhaṭṭe kośale śavavallake |
aṣṭādaśabhujā kāryā mahendre ca himālaye |
kaurave mathurāyāñca kedāre rāmaṭhe'pi ca |
pūjayed dvādaśabhujāṃ makarandre virāṭake |
kaumāre caiva gauḍe ca pāripātre ca dakṣiṇe |
devī daśabhujā kāryā marahaṭṭe gajāhvaye |
pūrṇe caiva tu nepāle kacchaseśe ca kaṅkaṇe |
caturbhujā bhaveddevī dvibhujā sāgarāntike |
dīpasthānantu kūrmacakraśiraḥsthānam |
tattu tantrasārakāreṇaiva dhṛtam |
dīpasthānavivarjiteneṣṭakāracitasthānena kadācana devīmarcayedityanena dīpasthāne tṛṇakāṣṭhādimayagṛhe na doṣaḥ |
tathā dīpasthānabhinne iṣṭakāmayagṛhe'pi dīpasthānabhinnasya pratiprasavamāha ||
aiśānyāñca mahendre vā uttare bhavanasya ca |
kārayedbhavanaṃ divyaṃ dhanaiśvaryaprasādataḥ |
ekatriṃśacca dairghyeṇa pañcatriṃśadathāpi vā |
vartulaṃ navahastaṃ vā tūryahastamathāpi vā |
vibhidya pārśvayorbhāgaṃ kṛtvā madhyaṃ suśobhanam |
caturdikṣu pramāṇena devīṃ tatraiva kārayet |
atha siṃhāsanādilakṣaṇam |
hastamātraṃ samutsedhaṃ loma tatra samanvitam |
siṃhāsanaṃ mahācakraṃ sarvatobhadrameva ca |
rajasā maṇḍalaṃ kuryāt pīṭhaṃ tatra niveśayet |
kṣīraṃ śrīpatikodbhūtaṃ sahakāramathāpi vā |
muṣṭibāhupramāṇena prādeśocchrāyameva ca |
prāpte'ṣṭadhā ca kuṭilaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ samaṃ śubham |
bhadrāsanamidaṃ proktaṃ kūrmāsanamathāpi vā |
vivāhe saurayāge ca sahakāraṃ vivarjayet |
vāruṇaṃ vā maheśāni (!) padmakaṃ devadārukam |
praśastaṃ sarvavedīṣu tathā śālamayāni ca |
tato'ruṇena gandhena kuṅkumena gajena vā |
mahāyoniṃ likhitvā tu vahiḥ padmadvayānvitam |
gajena mṛgamadena ||
tatra saṃsthāpayeddevīṃ sarvakāmārthadāyinīm |
ṣaṣṭhīkartavyakarmāha |
nityaṃ nirvarttya vidhivat sāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tato gṛhī |
yāyādalaṅkṛto maunī bilvamūlaṃ samāhitaḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu pañcāṅgena praṇamya ca |
uttarāśāmukho bhūtvā pīṭhaṃ nirmāya sādhakaḥ |
pañca devānnamaskṛtya tataḥ saṅkalpayet sudhīḥ |
tryambakeṇaiva mantreṇa vṛkṣaṃ toyena sāpayet |
kṣīreṇa pañcagavyena tathā pañcāmṛtena ca |
snātvā kumbhatrayeṇāpi sūtramāṇeti vai ṛcā |
niṣiktena tu sūtreṇa triguṇena ca pañcadhā |
veṣṭayeddakṣiṇāvarte pañca vrīhīṃśca vāpayet |
adyāmuke māsyamuke pakṣe etasmin puṇyabhūpredeśe bhavantamambikāśivayoḥ priyataraṃ śāṇḍilyagotraṃ bilvavṛkṣam amukagotro'mukadevaśarmā amukakāmanayā abhinnavṛntaphalayugalayuktāṃ śākhāṃ durgāsvarūpataḥ pūjārthaṃ netuṃ naktamebhirabhyarcya vṛṇe |
hastaṃ dattvā vṛkṣamūle phalairmālyaiḥ samanvitam |
saṃvāhya taiḥ samabhyarcya sthaṇḍile pūjayettataḥ |
gaṇeśamuttaradvāri pūrve caṇḍañca dakṣiṇe |
pracaṇḍaṃ paścime caiva vetālañca tataḥ param |
madhye ādhāraśaktyādīn sāṅgopāṅgāṃstathaiva ca |
mahārajatasaṅkāśāṃ pūrṇacandranibhānanām |
nānāratnasamākīrṇāṃ kaṅkaṇaiḥ kaṭakairapi |
vibhrājamānāṃ daśabhirbāhubhiḥ sumanoharaiḥ |
śaradambhojasaṅkāśavikāśimukhapaṅkajām |
indīvarābhairviṣamairlocanaistribhiruttamaiḥ |
vidyotayantīṃ nayanairuddāmadyutidāmabhiḥ |
triśūlaṃ karabālañca cakraṃ vāṇañca śaktyapi |
cintayed vāmabhāge tu kheṭakaṃ pūrṇacāpakam |
pāśāṅkuśañca paraśuṃ jvālāmālopaśobhitam |
ūrddhvapādaṃ vāmapādaṃ mahiṣoparisaṃsthitam |
māhiṣaṃ chinnaśirasamadhastāt paricintayet |
khaḍgacarmadharaṃ tatra samudbhūtaṃ mahāsuram |
bilvavṛkṣasthitāṃ dhyāyet sarvakāmārthadāyinīm |
evaṃ dhyātvā maheśāni (!) āsanaṃ pratipūjya ca |
mūlenāvāhanaṃ kuryāt pradadyādāsanaṃ tataḥ |
pādyādikaṃ tato dattvā aṅgapūjāṃ vidhāya ca |
pūrvādipatramūleṣu jayantyādīn samarcayet |
patrāgre caiva brahmādīn bhairavān patramadhyataḥ |
tatrāgatya vṛkṣamūle vṛkṣāgre ca samarcayet |
vetālaṃ maṇibhadrañca yakṣakañca tathaiva ca |
tripurāntakaṃ samākhyātaṃ kaṇaṃ hetukameva ca |
agnijihvarasañcaiva gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
tato grahān digīśāṃśca tadastrāṇi ca tadbahiḥ ||
atra dikpālatadastrapūjāyāṃ viśeṣa uktaḥ śāradātilake caturthapaṭale mahāprāmāṇikairlakṣaṇācāryaiḥ |
yathā |
ante yajellokapālānmūlapāriṣadānvitān |
hetijātyadhipopetān dikṣu pūrvāditaḥ kramāt ||
mūlapāriṣadānvitāniti asyāyamarthaḥ |
yadā śaktyāvaraṇe indrādipūjā tadā pratyekaṃ śaktipāriṣadāyeti evaṃ gaṇapatipūjāyāṃ pratyekaṃ gaṇeśapāriṣadāyeti evaṃ sūryapūjāyāṃ pratyekaṃ sūryapāriṣadāyeti |
evaṃ viṣṇupūjāyāṃ viṣṇupāriṣadāyeti |
hetīti pratiyoge jātyadhipānā pūrvamuccaraṇaṃ paścāddhetīnāṃ mūle hetiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ |
śastrajātayaḥ svaratejaḥpretarakṣojavavātakṣetrabhūtanāgalokān savāhanān saparivārānityapi jñeyam ||
dikpālānāha tatraiva ||
indramagniṃ yamaṃ rakṣo varuṇaṃ pavanaṃ vidhum |
īśānaṃ pannagādhīśamadha ūrddhvaṃ pitāmaham |
pīto rakto'sito dhūmraḥ śuklo dhūmraḥ sitāvubhau |
gauro'ruṇaḥ kramādete varṇataḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
teṣāṃ vāhanāni rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtāni |
yathā |
airāvatājamahiṣanaramakarahariṇāśvavṛṣabharathahaṃsāḥ |
eteṣāṃ bījāni kapilapañcarātre ||
yānyulomatṛtīyantu dvitīyaṃ lavilomataḥ |
caturthakaṃ vilomena vānulomena cāṣṭamam |
tṛtīyañcānulomena na vilomāt tṛtīyakam |
caturthaṃ saptamaṃ varṇaṃ vānulomena saṃsthitam |
caturthaṃ khavilomena tṛtīyaṃ gavilomataḥ |
surānteṣu sunādābhyāṃ bheditaṃ sarvameva tat |
ānupūrvoddhṛtaṃ bījaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ vāsavādikamiti |
etāni bījāni dīrghāṇīti sampradāyavidaḥ |
anantabrahmaṇormāyā pāśavī iti kecit |
pṛthvyāgnipavanādyantā varuṇānilasendukaiḥ |
anantabindusaṃyuktairarcyāḥ pāśena māyayeti |
prayogo yathā |
oṃ lāṃ indrāya pītavarṇāya surādhipataye vajrahastāya airāvatavāhanāya saparivārāya durgāpāriṣadāya namaḥ |
evaṃ rāṃ agnaye piṅgalavarṇāya tejo'dhipataye śaktihastāya ajavāhanāya saparivārāya durgāpāriṣadāya namaḥ |
ityādi ūhyam |
taduktaṃ rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtena ||
prayajet svadikṣvamaladhīḥ svajātyadhīrahetiparivārasaṃyutāniti granthakṛdapi ||
nityātantre ||
lokapālān yajedante vāhanāyudhasaṃhatān |
ityeṣāṃ pūjānantaramāyudhān pūjayet ||
śāradāyām ||
vajraṃ śaktiṃ daṇḍamasiṃ pāśamaṅkuśakaṃ gadām |
śūlaṃ cakraṃ padmameṣāmāyudhāni kramādviduḥ ||
merutantre caturthaprakāśe'pi ||
vajraṃ śaktiṃ daṇḍakhaḍgapāśāṅkuśagadāḥ punaḥ |
pūrvatastu tathaiśyānyāṃ śūlacakrāmbujānvitamiti |
āyudhānāṃ rūpamuktam śāradāyām ||
pītaśuklāsitākāśavidyudraktasitāsitāḥ |
kurubindapāṭalābhā vajrādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
kurubindaḥ padmarāgaḥ ||
tatra prayogo yathā ||
oṃ vajrāya vajrahastāya pītavarṇāya vajralāñchitamaulaye savāhanāya saparivārāya durgāpāriṣadāya namaḥ |
ityādyūhyam |
taduktaṃ rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtena |
arcyā vahirnijamalakṣitamauliyuktā svasvāyudhābhayasamudyatapāṇipadmā iti |
matsyasūkte ||
baliṃ dadyādvidhānena homaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ |
yavaṃ kṣīrañca śālyannaṃ śāntyarthañca nivedayet |
yakṣebhyo yāvakānnañca bhāṣabhaktamathāpi vā |
kṛtāñjalistato bhūtvā jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ |
tato bodhanamantrāṃśca pāṭhayet surapūjite |
aiṃ rāvaṇasya badhārthāya rāmasyānugrahāya ca |
akāle brahmaṇā bodho devyāstvayi kṛtaḥ purā |
ahamapyāśvine māsi tatastvāṃ bodhayāmi te |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nakṣatrayuktāyāṃ sāyāhne bodhayāmi te |
etadarthaṃ ārdrānakṣatrālābhena pāṭhyaṃ tātparyārthasyāsamatvatattvāditi |
śrīśailaśikhare jātaḥ śrīphalaḥ śrīniketanaḥ |
netavyo'si mayā gaccha pūjyo durgāsvarūpataḥ |
aśeṣasukhalābhāya nārīvibhavahetave |
netavyaḥ svodite gehe sarvakāmaprado bhava |
merumandarakailāsahimavacchikhare girau |
jātaḥ śrīphalavṛkṣa (!) tvamambikāśaṅkarapriyaḥ |
namaste bilvavṛkṣāya sarvakāmapradāya ca |
dātavyaṃ svodite hastaṃ pūjanīyaṃ phaladvayam |
mahādevapriyo'si tvaṃ śrīvṛkṣa (!) sarvakāmadaḥ |
durgāyajñanimittārthaṃ śākhāmekāṃ prayaccha me |
tañca ārohayet paścāduttarāśāmukhena ca |
kiñciduṣṇena toyena kuśapuṣpaphalākṣatam |
śaṅkhe kṛtvā dadedarghyaṃ bilvavṛkṣodbhavena ca |
dantakāṣṭhaṃ tato dadyādariṣṭañcānumārjayet |
dūrvākṣatena siddhārthaṃ vastrayugmena veṣṭayet ||
iti bilvavṛkṣanimantraṇarūpaṣaṣṭhīkṛtyam |
atha saptamīkṛtyaṃ tatraiva ||
mūlayuktena saptamyāṃ bhāskare codite priye (!) |
bilvamūlaṃ tato gatvā gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
gṛhītvā caiva kaṭṭāraṃ sutīkṣṇaṃ muṣṭisaṃyutam |
dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ mānaṃ muṣṭiḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ smṛtam |
chindhi chindhi yugaṃ dadyāttārayugmaṃ tathaiva ca |
astrāya hṛdayānto'yaṃ chinnamantra udāhṛtaḥ |
yugamiti saptamyarthe prathamā yuge arthādvilvayugānvitaśākhāviśeṣe |
dadyādarpayet pūrvoktakaṭṭārakamiti śeṣaḥ |
rajakasya vastraṃ dadātītivadatra dādhātorapaṇārthakatā |
arpaṇamantramāha |
chindhi chindhīti na tu chindhi chindītyanena yugaśabdāt trayañchindhītyasya catuṣkatvāpatteḥ |
chedanamantrastu tārayugmamityādi |
chinne chedane mantraśchinnamantra ityarthaḥ |
cālanamantrastu |
cāmuṇḍe (!) calayugmantu cālayadvitayaṃ tathā |
śīghrañca mandirañcaiva praviśa pūjālayaṃ padam |
tārādyo vahnijāyānto manunānena cālayet ||
chedanakāle strīprabhṛtīnāṃ dṛṣṭirniṣiddhā yathā tatraiva |
strīṇāṃ dṛṣṭiḥ paśordṛṣṭiryathā naiva tu chedane |
tathā kuryāt prayatnena śivikāyāṃ praveśayet |
pūjādiṣu praṇayet tadāha ||
unmattaṃ patitaṃ klīvaṃ vāmanaṃ chidrasaṃyutam |
na yojayeddaridrañca mantrakuṇṭhaṃ na veśayet |
chedane nayane kāle sthāpane ca viśeṣataḥ |
bhagne tu maraṇaṃ vidyāt prāyaścittaṃ tadācaret |
pārśve dīpayugaṃ dadyādikṣudaṇḍāśrayaṃ dvayam |
gṛhapraveśakāle ca ghaṭayugmañca sthāpayet |
ghaṭaṃ sammārjanīyuktaṃ raktasūtreṇa gumphitam |
cūtapatrasamāyuktāṃ darbhacchedanabhūṣitām |
dvāri dvāri nyaset sraktāṃ sapuṣpāṃ śobhanāṃ śubhām |
samūlāṃ chinnarahitāṃ toraṇena vibhūṣitām |
janateti vat srakśabdāt samūhārthe tāpratyayaḥ |
sraktāṃ mālāsamūhaṃ dvāri nyasedityarthaḥ |
prāpte pratolikāṃ dvāri gṛhiṇī lakṣaṇānvitā |
sādhvībhirnavanārībhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalapūrvakam |
bījayedvyajanenāpi vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ |
kaṭutrayaṃ salavaṇaṃ mukhe kṛtvā maheśvari (!) |
devyāḥ pracumbanaṃ kuryāttataḥ kuryād gṛhāṅgane |
patrikāṃ snānapīṭhe ca vastrādīn madhyadeśake |
deśaviśeṣe navapatrikākramamāha |
māṇādīṃścaiva śrīśaile dhyānyādiṃ malaye girau |
kramukādiṃ sāgarānte kacvī caikāmrakādike |
rambhādiṃ gauḍe vaṅge ca kaumāre kālarūpake |
pratipīṭhe yajedvāpi lakṣmīkāmena sundari (!) |
rambhā kacvī haridrā ca jayantī bilvadāḍimau |
aśoko māṇakaścaiva dhānyādirnavapatrikā |
samūlā patrikā grāhyā haridrādhānyakaṃ vinā |
samūlā eva rambhā syādrāmarambhāṃ vivarjayet |
śvetarambhā rājyarambhā tathā caiva sugandhinī |
eṣāmekatamaṃ grāhyaṃ bījarambhāṃ vivarjayet |
śarkarāsvāduyuktāyāḥ phalaṃ vṛkṣañca santyajet |
triputrañcaikaputrañca mṛtavatsañca varjayet |
dvijātiropitaṃ grāhyamathavā girisambhavam |
brāhmaṇasya gṛhe jātaṃ tīrthebhyo'nyasamudbhavam |
antyajasyālaye jātaṃ śmaśānanilayañca vā |
śākhoṭamūrddhajaṃ śuṣkaṃ tyājyaṃ syāddūradhukṣakam |
evameva ca mṛṇmayyāmānīya śubhajairjalaiḥ |
snāpayet śaṅkhatoyena pratimāyāñca darpaṇe |
dantakāṣṭhaṃ tato dadyānmantreṇa ca viśeṣataḥ |
daśākṣareṇa deveśi (!) pañcagavyena cāntaram |
pratyekena tataḥ paścāt tathā pañcāmṛtena ca |
triśītena triraktena tathā tīrthodakena ca |
vedyāmīśānato vātha patrikāyāśca sthāpanam |
madhye bilvaṃ vijānīyādathavā ekamūlakam |
rambhāvṛkṣe nibadhnīyādviṣṇukrāntālatātribhiḥ |
veṣṭayitvā tu rambhāyāṃ hastocchrāye tu yugmakam |
pītasūtreṇa vastreṇa veṣṭayenmukuṭānvitam |
kusumbharaktaṃ kṣaumaṃ vā dukūlaṃ kīṭakāni ca |
varjayet prathamaṃ devi (!) hyalaktāktaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
mahotsave tataḥ kuryād vedaghoṣapuraḥsaram |
kumārīṇāñca sādhvīnāṃ śrāvayecca tathā dhvanim |
balikarmaṇi yātrāyāṃ praveśe navaveśmanaḥ |
mahotsave ca māṅgalye tatra strīṇāṃ dhvaniḥ śubhaḥ |
nirmañchanaṃ tathā kuryāllājajambūphalādibhiḥ |
svāgataṃ kuśalapraśnamāsanañca nivedayet |
jānubhyāmavanīṃ pretya paṭhenmantraṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ |
oṃ śāradīyāmimāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa tvamihāgatā |
svāgatante mahādevi (!) viśveśvari (!) namo'stu te |
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvitañca naḥ |
āgatāsi yato durge (!) māheśvari (!) mamāśramam |
arghyamannaṃ phalaṃ pādyaṃ mālāṃ malayavāsini (!) |
gṛhāṇa varade (!) devi (!) kalyāṇañca pradehi me |
caṇḍike (!) caṇḍarūpe (!) tvaṃ sarvakāmaprade (!) śubhe (!) |
gṛhāṇārghyamidaṃ bhadre (!) āgaccha mama mandiram |
gṛhītvā śāradīṃ pūjāṃ martyamaṇḍalamāgatā |
caṇḍike (!) tvāṃ namāmyadya puṣpamarghyaṃ pragṛhyatām |
caṇḍi (!) tvaṃ caṇḍarūpāsi suratejomahābale (!) |
praviśya tiṣṭha madgehe yāvat pūjāṃ karomyaham |
sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāyātha āsanaṃ pratigṛhya ca |
vikirān vikirettatra prāṇāyāmaṃ tataścaret |
gaṇeśagrahadikpālān kalase pūjayettataḥ |
snāpayecca svamantreṇa varayedarghyapātrakam |
dineśārghyaṃ tato dadyādbhūtaśuddhimathācaret |
daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa bhāvayedraktabudbudam |
tanmadhye rukmabrahmāṇḍaṃ punareva tu bhedayet |
tanmadhye cintayeddevīṃ sarvakāmapradāyinīm |
jaṭājūṭasamāyuktāmarddhendukṛtaśekharām |
navayauvanasaṃyuktāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām |
trinetrāṃ pūrṇavadanāṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm |
triśūlañca tathā cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ vāṇaṃ tathaiva ca |
dakhiṇe ca tathā śaktiṃ vāmataḥ kheṭakaṃ dhanuḥ |
pāśāṅkuśañca ghaṇṭāñca nāgahāragarīyasīm |
adhastānmahiṣaṃ tadvadviśiraskaṃ pradarśayet |
śiraśchedodbhavaṃ tadvaddānavaṃ khaḍgapāṇinam |
hṛdi śūlena nirbhinnaṃ niryadantravibhūṣitam |
devyāstu dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ samaṃ siṃhoparisthitam |
kiñcidūrddhvaṃ tathā vāmamaṅguṣṭhaṃ mahiṣopari |
evaṃ sañcintya manasā pratimāṃ kṛtya sannyaset |
ātmānamantarātmānaṃ paramātmānamarcayet |
mātṛkānyāsapūrveṇa kalānyāsamathācaret |
mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tāreṇārghyaṃ viśodhayet |
arghya syottarataḥ kāryaṃ pādyamācamanīyakam |
madhuparkaṃ tataḥ pārśve prokṣaṇyāñca japenmanum |
aṣṭakṛtvo japenmantrī gāyatryā rakṣayettataḥ |
oṃ durgāyai vidmahe nārāyaṇyai dhīmahi |
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāditīrayet |
tena toyena deveśi (!) yāgavastūni secayet |
gaṇeśamatha caiśānyāṃ gaṇapaṃ gurupādukām |
gurubhyaḥ paramaṃ hyevaṃ parameṣṭhiguroḥ param |
guruṃ jñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryañca yathā kramāt |
raktaṃ śyāmañca hāritaṃ nīlābhañcaiva pūjayet |
dhūmrābhaṃ kanakāvidyudrūpān dharmādikān priye (!) |
adharmādīni patrāgre agnyādau ca yathāvidhi |
adharmañca tathājñānamavairāgyaṃ tathaiva ca |
anaiśvaryaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ pītaraktaṃ vibhāvayet |
ajameṣahaṃsavarṇarūpān dharmādikānapi |
dvārapārśve mahākālaṃ kapilaṃ kṛṣṇalocanam |
nandinaṃ raktapītañca śūlakhaṭvāṅgadhāriṇam |
bhujaṅgaśvetasaṅkāśaṃ dvibhujaṃ paṅkajānanam |
caṇḍeśañca karālāsyaṃ piṅgorddhvanayanaṃ yajet |
adhaḥ kūrmaśivārūḍhāṃ śaraccandranibhānanām |
ādhāraśaktiṃ prayajet paṅkajadvayadhāriṇīm |
murddhnitasyāḥ samāsīnaṃ kūrmāsanaṃ samarcayet |
ūrddhvaṃ brahmaśilāsīnamanantaṃ kundasannibham |
adhaścakradharaṃ mūrdhni dhārayantaṃ vasundharām |
tamālaśyāmalāṅgīñca nīlendīvaralocanām |
abhyarcayedvasumatīṃ sphuratsāgaramekhalām |
tatra sañcintayet padmaṃ vikāranavakeśaram |
mantrī prakṛtipatrāṇi bhāvayeddaśakarṇikam |
bhūstattvañca bhuvastattvaṃ svastattvañca tathaiva ca |
sattvaṃ rajastama iti sūryādīnāṃ trimaṇḍalam |
punarānantaraṃ vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya ca |
mahāsiṃhāya varmāstramahāsiṃhamanurmataḥ |
dadyādāsanametena mūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet |
gṛhītvā raktakusumaṃ prakuryāt pāṇikacchapam |
kṛtvā sampūrṇapātrañca gandhapuṣpākṣatāni ca |
hṛdaye sthāpayedbhaktyā dhyātvā purvoktavartmanā |
pūjayedupacārādyairmaṇḍale sthāpayettataḥ |
āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pṛcched dadyātpādyādikaṃ trikam |
madhuparkaṃ tato dadyādaṅgapūjāṃ vidhāya ca |
darśayedaṣṭamudrāśca tata āvāhanaṃ paṭhet |
oṃ āvāhitāsi durge (!) tvaṃ mṛṇmayyāṃ śrīphale'pi ca |
sthirā tvaṃ gṛhiṇo bhūtvā gṛhe kāmapradā bhava |
ehi durge (!) mahābhāge (!) patrikā gṛhyatāmiyam |
tava sthānamidaṃ bhadraṃ śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ namāmyaham |
tvaṃ devi jagatāṃ mātaḥ (!) sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇi (!) |
patrikāsu samastāsu sānnidhyamiha kalpaya |
āyurdehi dhanaṃ dehi yaśo rājyañca dehi me |
santuṣṭā cātra madgehe mano'bhīṣṭaṃ prasādhaya |
tataḥ pūrvādipatreṣu rudracaṇḍādikān yajet |
rudracaṇḍāṃ pracaṇḍāñca caṇḍogrāṃ caṇḍanāyikām |
caṇḍāṃ caṇḍavatīṃ caṇḍarūpāñcaivāticaṇḍikām |
agnivarṇāṃ tato madhye ugracaṇḍāṃ samarcayet |
sarvā yuvatyo dīptāṅgā varābhayakarāḥ śubhāḥ |
raktāḥ pītāmbaradharā nānābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
tryakṣareṇa ca mantreṇa vāgādyena maheśvari (!) |
pūjayedaṣṭapatreṣu dalāgreṣu viśeṣataḥ |
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā |
