vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikā tathā |
daṇḍaṃ kamuṇḍaluṃ paścādakṣasūtramathābhayam |
bibhratī kanakachāyāṃ brāhmī kṛṣṇājināmbarā || 1 ||
śūlaṃ paraśvadhaṃ kṣuraṃ dundubhiṃ candraśobhitam |
vahantī himasaṅkāśā dhyeyā māheśvarī sadā || 2 ||
aṅkuśaṃ daṇḍakhaṭvāṅgaṃ pāśañca dadhatī karaiḥ |
dhyeyā bandhūkasaṅkāśā kaumārī kāmadāyinī || 3 ||
cakraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ kapālañca dadhatī karaiḥ |
tamālaśyāmalā dhyeyā vaiṣṇavī vidyutojjvalā || 4 ||
muṣalaṃ karabālañca kheṭakaṃ dadhatī halam |
karaiścaturbhirvārāhī dhyeyā kālānalacchaviḥ || 5 ||
aṅkuśaṃ tomaraṃ vidyāṃ kuliśaṃ bibhratī karaiḥ |
indranīlanibhendrāṇī dhyeyā sarvasamṛddhidā || 6 ||
śūlaṃ kapālaṃ nṛśiraḥ kvapāṇaṃ dadhatī karaiḥ |
muṇḍasraṅmaṇḍitā dhyeyā cāmuṇḍā raktavigrahā || 7 ||
akṣasrajaṃ raktasravaṃ kapālaṃ nīlanīrajam |
vahantī hemasaṅkāśā vyāghrasya carmaṇojjvalā || 8 ||
raktākṣīṃ daṇḍikāñcaiva nṛsiṃhīṃ śivadūtikām |
nārāyaṇīṃ kālikākhyāṃ māyāñcaiva tu bhrāmarīm |
aravindāṃ viśālākṣīṃ bhīmāñcaiva sarasvatīm |
aparājitāṃ somalatāṃ anantāñca kapālinīm |
bhadrakālīñca purata etāḥ ṣoḍaśa nāyikāḥ |
caturbhujā yuvatyaśca śaṅkhacakragadāṅkuśāḥ |
sarvābharaṇasandīptāḥ siṃhasthāḥ śaśiśekharāḥ |
bālādyāstryakṣareṇaiva sampūjyā raktavigrahāḥ |
kālīvilāsatantre viṃśatipaṭale ||
ādau daśabhujā pūjyā ghaṭasthāpanapūrvikā |
pañca devān prapūjyādau paścānmahiṣamardinīm |
tataśca kārtikādīnāṃ pūjāñca yatnataścaret |
tataśca patrikāpūjā devīpurāṇasammatā |
iti vacanāt patrikāpūjanāt pūrvaṃ kārtikeyādīn pūjayet ||
devyāḥ kasmin deśe kaḥ pūjya ityāha tatraiva ||
jayā vāme sthitā vidyā vijayā cāpi dakṣiṇe |
vāme ca kārtikaṃ devaṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇapatiṃ tathā |
atha kartikeyadhyānamaṣṭādaśapaṭale ||
sutaptakanakaprekṣaṃ khaḍgapaṭṭidharaṃ varam |
soṣṇīṣamastakaṃ devaṃ mayūravaravāhanam |
brahmāṇḍābhyantare vīraṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā daśadhā prajapenmanum |
śṛṇu mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi kārtikeyaṃ yathocitam |
hrīṃ guhāya kārtikeyāya senānye svāhayānvitā |
caturdaśākṣarī vidyā kārtikeyasya kīrtitā |
pratimāyāṃ hṛdi sthāne dattvāṅguṣṭhaṃ sulocane (!) |
daśadhā mantramuccārya prāṇanyāsastato bhavet |
atha jayādhyānam ||
taptakāñcanasaṅkāśāṃ dvibhujāṃ lolalocanām |
kaṭākṣaviśikhopetāṃ digambaraparicchadām |
divyābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ dhyāyet siddhipradāyinīm |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā sampūjya prajapenmanum |
mantrastu hrīṃ hrīṃ jayāyai hrīṃ hrīṃ |
saptākṣarī mahāvidyā jayāyāḥ parikīrtitā |
māyādvayajayā ṅe'ntā punarmāyādvayaṃ priye (!) |
saptākṣarī mahāvidyā kathitā surapūjitā |
jayāyā hṛdaye'ṅguṣṭhaṃ dattvā mantraṃ japeddaśa |
prāṇasiddhistadā devi (!) jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
adhunāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi vijayādhyānamuttamam |
dalitāñjanasaṅkāśāṃ dvibhujāṃ khañjanekṣaṇām |
kaṭākṣaviśikhoddīptāmañjanāñcitalocanām |
divyāmbaraparīdhānāṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām |
dhyāyettāṃ vijayāṃ nityāṃ sarvasiddhipradāyinīm |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā daśadhā prajapenmanum |
mantrastu |
vāgbhavaṃ śambhuvanitā nāma sambodhanaṃ tataḥ |
māyā ca vāgbhavañcaiva manuḥ saptākṣaraḥ priye (!) |
vijayāhṛdaye'ṅguṣṭhaṃ dattvā mantraṃ japed yadi |
prāṇasiddhistadā devi (!) jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
atha mayūradhyānam ||
nānācitravicitrāṅga (!) garuḍājjananaṃ tava |
anantaśaktisaṃyukta (!) kālāhibhakṣaṇaṃ tava |
garuḍastvaṃ mahābhāga (!) atastvāṃ praṇamāmyaham |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā ekadhā mantramuccaret |
māyā bhago nādabindū ṅe'ntanāma sulocanā |
saptākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ hṛdaye prajaped yadi |
prāṇasiddhistadā devi (!) mayūrasya bhaveddhruvam ||
atha mūṣikadhyānam ||
vṛṣākāra (!) mahābhāga (!) vṛṣarūpa (!) mahābala (!) |
karmarūpa (!) vṛṣastvaṃ hi gaṇeśasya ca vāhanam |
namaskaromyahaṃ deva (!) pūjāsiddhiṃ prayaccha me |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā kṣipet puṣpāñjalitrayam |
māyādvayaṃ samuccārya vadecca mūṣikaṃ tataḥ |
ṅe'ntañca vanitāṃ śambhormūṣikasya manuḥ priye (!) |
prāṇapratiṣṭhā pūrvavat ||
siṃhadhyānam ||
siṃhastvaṃ harirūpo'si svayaṃ viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ |
pārvatyā vāhanastvaṃ hi ataḥ pūjāmi tvāmaham ||
siṃhamantraḥ ||
māyādvayaṃ samuccārya siṃhāya mahābalāya ca |
punarmāyādvayaṃ devi (!) manureṣa prakīrtitaḥ |
dvādaśākṣarī mahāvidyā siṃhasya parikīrtitā |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā ekadhā mantramuccaret ||
ūnaviṃśatipaṭale ||
mahiṣadhyānam ||
mahiṣastvaṃ mahāvīra (!) śivarūpa sadāśiva (!) |
atastvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi kṣamasva mahiṣāsura (!) |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā ekadhā prajapenmanum |
māyādvayañca nakulaṃ nādabinduvibhūṣitam |
mahiṣañca tathā ṅe'ntaṃ kūrcaṃ māyādvayaṃ tathā |
ekādaśākṣarī vidyā bhaktyā te parikīrtitā |
atha gaṇeśadhyānam ||
lambodaraṃ mahākāyaṃ gajavaktraṃ trilocanam |
sarvadevamayaṃ devaṃ pārvatīnandanaṃ bhaje |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā ekadhā mantramuccaret |
māyāṃ kavargatṛtīyaṃ nādabindusamanvitam |
tathā gaṇapatiṃ ṅe'ntaṃ vilomena punarlayam ||
lakṣmīdhyānam |
taptakāñcanasaṅkāśāṃ dvibhujāṃ lolalocanām |
kaṭākṣaviśikhoddīptāmañjanāñcitalocanām |
śuklāmbaraparīdhānāṃ sindūratilokojjvalām |
śuklapadmāsanagatāṃ dhyāyennārāyaṇapriyām |
dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ dattvā daśadhā prajapenmanum ||
mantrastu ||
māyāṃ kāmañca deveśi (!) kamalāntaravāsinī |
ṅe'ntaṃ kāmaṃ tato māyāṃ lakṣmīdevyā daśākṣaram ||
atha sarasvatīdhyām |
śaṅkhendukundasaṅkāśāṃ dvibhujāṃ padmalocanām |
kaṭākṣaviśikhoddīptāṃ divyāmbaraparicchadām |
divyābharaṇaveśāḍhyāṃ vāgrūpāṃ paramāṃ bhaje ||
sarasvatīmantro yathā ||
māyāñca vāmakarṇañca bindunādasamanvitam |
sarasvatyai punarbījadvayañcāṣṭākṣarī matā ||
brahmadhyānam ||
taruṇādityasaṅkāśaṃ caturvaktraṃ caturbhujam |
caturvedamayaṃ vaktraṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam |
brahmamantraḥ ||
māyāṃ kavargasyādyantu nādabindusamanvitam |
brahmaṇe namaścavargādyaṃ nādabindusamanvitam ||
māyāṃ saptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ brahmaṇaḥ parikīrtitam |
sāvitrīpūjanaṃ bhadre (!) śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te ||
sāvitrīdhyānam ||
taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ dvibhujāṃ lolalocanām |
divyābharaṇaveśāḍhyāṃ divyāmbaraparicchadām |
sindūratilakoddīptāmañjanāñcitalocanām |
sāvitrīmantrastu ||
māyāṃ sāṃ sāvitryai tataḥ puraḥ sāṃ māyāṃ tataḥ param |
saptākṣaramidaṃ devi (!) sāvitryāḥ parikīrtitam ||
atha navapatrikāpūjā matsyasūkte ||
rambhāñca dvibhujāṃ pītāṃ śūlapustakadhāriṇīm |
pūjayet kāmabījena mantreṇānena śaṅkari (!) |
durge (!) devi (!) samāgaccha sānnidhyamiha kalpaya |
rambhārūpeṇa me devi (!) śāntiṃ kuru namo'stu te || 1 ||
khaḍgaśūlāṅkuśadharamabhayaṃ dadhatī karaiḥ |
mahiṣāsurayuddhe tvaṃ kacvīrūpāsi suvrate (!) |
śakrasyānugrahārthāya āgaccha mama mandiram || 2 ||
māyābījena sā pūjyā haridrāmatha cintayet |
dvibhujāṃ pītavasanāṃ trinetrāṃ khaḍgadhāriṇīm |
mahiṣasthāṃ viśālākṣīṃ ambaraṃ vāmahastake |
haridre (!) varade (!) devi (!) umārūpāsi suvrate (!) |
mama vighnavināśāya pūjāṃ gṛhṇa sureśvari (!) || 3 ||
jayantīṃ raktavasanāṃ pītāñca caṇḍamālinīm |
śūlacakradharāṃ caiva sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitām |
niśumbhamathane caiva sendrairdevagaṇairapi |
pūjitāsi jayanti (!) tvamasmākaṃ varadā bhava || 4 ||
vipaddhantrīñca dvibhujāṃ mahāvṛṣabhavāhinīm |
śvetāmabhītivaradāṃ gagane tu samarcayet |
mahādevapriyakaraḥ sarvadevarataḥ sadā |
umāprītikaro yasmāt tasmāt tvāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 5 ||
dāḍimīpatrikāṃ raktāṃ raktābharaṇabhūṣitām |
raktavastradharāṃ saumyāmarddhendukṛtaśekharām |
caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ mahiṣoparisaṃsthitām |
khaḍgacarmadharāṃ skandhe vāmenotpalapustikām |
mandareṇaiva bījena bālādyena samarcayet |
siddhamantraṃ purā jātaṃ raktabījasya sammukhe |
umāprītikaraṃ yasmāttasmāttvāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 6 ||
aśokapatrikāṃ raktāṃ sindūrāruṇavigrahām |
vāṇacāpadharāṃ saumyāṃ padmasthāṃ nāgavāhanām |
haraprītikaro vṛkṣo hyaśokaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ |
umāprītikarastvaṃ hi māmaśokaṃ sadā kuru || 7 ||
śyāmāṅgīṃ māṇapatrīñca nīlanīrajadhāriṇīm |
mahiṣasthāṃ trinetrāñca kanyābījena cārcayet |
patre vasasi kaumāri (!) māṇavṛkṣe śacīpriye (!) |
mama cānugrahārthāya pūjāṃ gṛhṇa yathāsukham || 8 ||
dhānyavṛkṣe nimagnāñca dvibhujāṃ śvetavigrahām |
śvetapadmopraviṣṭāñca varābhayakarāṃ śubhām |
śrībījena satāreṇa pūjayet kamalānanām |
jagatprāṇahitārthāya brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā |
umāprītikaraṃ dhānyaṃ śāntiṃ kuru namo'stu te || 9 ||
vahiḥ pīṭhe jayantyākhyāṃ dikpatīn sāyudhāṃstathā |
upacāraiḥ samabhyarcya hṛṣṭapuṣṭikarān punaḥ |
kumudotpalapadmāni kundaśephālikājavāḥ |
vakulaṃ tagarañcaiva puṣpāṣṭakamudāhṛtam |
mantraṃ japedaṣṭaśataṃ homaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi |
balidānāntare caiva pādaṃ saṃśrapayeccarum |
kṛtāñjalistataḥ kṛtvā jānuspṛṣṭamahītalaḥ |
paṭhet stotraṃ yathānyāyaṃ vāgvījādyantasaṃyutam ||
atha stotram |
durgāṃ śivāṃ śāntikarīṃ brahmāṇīṃ brahmaṇaḥ priyām |
sarvalokapraṇetrīñca praṇamāmi sadāmbikām |
maṅgalāṃ śobhanāṃ śuddhāṃ niṣkalāṃ paramāṃ kalām |
viśveśvarīṃ viśvamātāṃ caṇḍikāṃ praṇamāmyaham |
īśānamātaraṃ devīṃ sarvalokabhayāpahām |
brahmeśaviṣṇunamitāṃ praṇamāmi sadā umām |
viśvasthāṃ viśvanilayāṃ divyasthānanivāsinīm |
yoginīṃ yogamātāñca caṇḍikāṃ praṇamāmyaham |
īśānamātaraṃ devīmīśvarīmīśvarapriyām |
praṇato'smi sadā durgāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇīm |
ya idaṃ paṭhati stotraṃ śṛṇuyādvāpi bhaktitaḥ |
sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo modate durgayā saha |
pañcaghoṣeṇa bheryādigītavādyādinisvanaiḥ |
divāvasāne snātvā tu sāyaṃsandhyāṃ samāpya ca |
paścimāśāmukho bhūtvā gandhamālyairalaṅkṛtam |
dhyāyet pūrve devīrūpaṃ haṃsamantreṇa vāgyataḥ |
dadyādarghyaṃ namaskuryāttato devīgṛhaṃ vrajet |
pañcopacārairvidhivat pūjayet parameśvarīm |
haviṣyānnaṃ tato bhaktvā dantakāṣṭhañca bhakṣayet ||
iti saptamīkṛtyam ||
athāṣṭamīkṛtyam ||
tataḥ kalpaṃ samutthāya aṣṭamyāṃ prātareva ca |
nadītīraṃ tato gatvā snānaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ |
abhāve srotastoyena yatra sūryasya darśanam |
svasti tato vācayitvā pañca devānnamasya ca |
snānaṃ homaṃ samuddiśya balinirdeśanaṃ nutim |
yathā praharapūjā ca arddharātre viśeṣataḥ |
navamyāñca tathā pūjāṃ daśamyāñca visarjanam |
tarpaṇaṃ brāhmaṇānāñca gotroddeśaṃ svasaṃjñakam |
evaṃ saṅkalpya matimān devyāḥ snānaṃ samācaret |
tārārkavacanaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ caṇḍikāhṛdayaṃ tataḥ |
pānīyasya ca kathitaṃ kṣīrasya śṛṇu sundari (!) |
māyāṃ gāṃ gauryai hṛdayaṃ pañcagavyasya ca śṛṇu |
tārāṃ vāṇīñca netrābhyāṃ sarvato hṛdayāntakam |
māyāntanuvudāñcaiva hṛdayārṇañca śarkarām |
tārāṃ māyāñca giriśe (!) madhumantra itīritaḥ |
māyāṃ śikhāyai nama iti punaḥ pānīyakena tu |
tāraṃ cakraṃ bhadrakālī kavacāyeti dadhimantra udāhṛtaḥ |
vāgbhavādyañca tailasya māyāṃ gauryai namaḥ sthitam |
uṣṇodakasya deveśi (!) tathā guḍaghṛtasya ca |
vāṅmantreṇa maheśāni (!) tathaivekṣurasena ca |
anukte caṇḍikāśāntaṃ yaccāntena maheśvari (!) |
daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa nānāgandhodakena ca |
triraktena trigandhena triśītena maheśvari (!) |
phalodakaistīrthatoyaiḥ puṣpatoyaiḥ kuśodakaiḥ |
ghaṭasthāpanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pīṭhapūjāṃ samāpya ca |
pūrvavaddhyānaṃ dhyātvā ca mantreṇāropayettataḥ |
āgatāṃ svāgatāṃ pṛccheddayāt pādyādikaṃ tataḥ |
gāyatryā snāpayeddevīmaṅgapūjāṃ vidhāya ca |
madhuparkaṃ tato dadyāt punarācamanīyakam |
pūrvādipatre sampūjyā jayantyādyāśca mātaraḥ |
jayantī maṅgalā kālī bhadrakālī kapālinī |
durgā śivā kṣamā dhātrī svāhā svadhā tataḥ param |
tatraiva ca dalāgreṣu rudracaṇḍādikā api |
rocanābhāṃ rudracaṇḍāṃ pracaṇḍāmaruṇaprabhām |
caṇḍogrāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāñca śyāmāñca caṇḍanāyikām |
śuklābhāṃ caṇḍarūpāñca dhūmrāṃ caṇḍavatīmapi |
aticaṇḍāṃ pāṇḍurābhāṃ pītavarṇāntu caṇḍikām |
vāgādyena tu mantreṇa tārādihṛdayāntakam |
agnivarṇāmugracaṇḍāṃ madhye tu paripūjayet |
pūrvādiṣvaṣṭapīṭheṣu catuḥṣaṣṭhīḥ samarcayet |
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumāri vaiṣṇavī tathā |
pañcopacārairvidhivajjayantyādi tataḥ param |
jayantī maṅgalā kālī bhadrakālī kapālinī |
durgā śivā kṣamā dhātrī pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
dakṣiṇaprānteṣu devyāḥ svāhāñcaiva svadhāṃ tataḥ |
ambikāṃ carcikāñcaiva tathā kātyāyanīmapi |
raktadantikāñca sarvādimaṅgalāñca tataḥ param |
śākambharīṃ bhrāmarīñca śivadūtīṃ tataḥ param |
mahākālīñca gauriñca tarjanīṃ bhāvinīṃ tathā |
mahāmohāñca prayajet tathā caiva bhayaṅkarīm |
tataḥ paścimaprānteṣu bhīmāṃ padmāṃ śacīṃ tathā |
medhāñcaiva mahāmāyāṃ sāvitrīṃ vijayāṃ jayām |
devasenāṃ dhṛtiñcaiva puṣṭiṃ dhṛtiñca bhrāmarīm |
mahāmāyāṃ mahādevīṃ mahāmedhāṃ tathaiva ca |
kāmeśvarīmuttarasyāṃ kāmadāmapi cārcayet |
bhrāmarīṃ kālarātriñca mahārātriṃ tathaiva ca |
cakreśvarīṃ tataścaiva pūjayedbhagamālinīm |
dhūmrāṃ bhīmāñca śāntāñca vidārīñca mahāmbikām |
lakṣmīñcaiva suparṇāñca mahogromāṃ tathādarāt |
kuladevīṃ tryakṣareṇa mantreṇa ca samarcayet |
vaṭukān pūjayed dvāre dvau dvau kṛtvā vibhāgataḥ |
siddhākhyañcaiva sandehaṃ kālaputrākhyameva ca |
kriyākulanibhañcaiva mantrāṅgaṃ devi (!) pūttrakam |
mandareṇaiva bījena satāreṇa prapūjayet |
bhairavānasitāṅgādīn kṣetreśāṃśca yajet kramāt |
hetukaṃ tripurāṅgañca agnijihvaṃ tathaiva ca |
kālāsyañca karālāsyamekapādañca bhīmakam |
anugrahañcorddhabhāge adhaśca nāsikeśvaram |
nārasiṃhena bījena satāraṃ hṛdayāntakam |
vahiḥ pīṭhe cārcayedvai tena bījena sādhakaḥ |
jambhakaṃ maṇibhadrañca pūrṇabhadraṃ tathaiva ca |
virūpañca virūpākṣaṃ citrakuṇḍalamityapi |
citrākṣaṃ citrarūpañca kelimālinameva ca |
varendraṃ nandinaṃ siṃhaṃ grahān lokapatīn yajet |
ādityādigrahā ye ca ye grahāḥ krūrakarmaṇaḥ |
tithayo vāsarāḥ sarve teṣāṃ hi sannidhau sthitāḥ |
te pūjārthamihāyāntu pūjayiṣyāmi tānaham |
krūrakarmaṇa iti chāndasatvāt hrasvaḥ |
athāstrapūjā ||
dakṣiṇādikrameṇaiva devyastrāṇi prapūjayet |
pratimantraiḥ svabījaiśca gandhacandanapuṣpakaiḥ |
iyaṃ yena dhṛtā kṣauṇī hataśca mahiṣāsuraḥ |
tridhārāya ca śūlāya tasmai śuddhātmane namaḥ |
asirviśasanaḥ khaḍgastīkṣṇadhāro durāsadaḥ |
śrīgarbho vijayaścaiva dharmapāla (!) namo'stu te |
ityaṣṭāveva prayajettīkṣṇadhārābhirālikam |
cakreśvarītimatreṇa lauhadaṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca |
sudarśana (!) mahācakra (!) daityarājabhayaṅkara (!) |
tripurāntakaraḥ śrīmān cakravarya (!) namo'stu te |
cārvaṅgagaṇasampanna (!) cakrāya ca namo namaḥ |
satāraścakramantro'yaṃ sarvavighnavināśanaḥ |
namo'stu pañcavāṇāya nirmalāya mahātmane |
pañcatattvasvarūpāya pañcavāṇāya vai namaḥ |
śaktistvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vyāpakānāñca vyāpakam |
kālākālamavaṣṭabhya śaktivarya (!) namo'stu te |
ramābījaṃ satārañca sajayaṃ mantramīritam |
vāmādivāmataḥ pūjyāḥ paścānmantrairyathāvidhi |
dharmapradastvaṃ samare dharmāṇāmāyudho'pyasi |
rakṣaṇīyastvayā yasmāt varānagha (!) namo'stu te |
dhṛtaṃ kṛṣṇena rakṣārthaṃ saṃhārārthaṃ hareṇa ca |
trayīmūrtiñca sagaraṃ dhanurastraṃ namāmyaham |
atyantaṃ rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ dhanuṣe vahnivallabhā |
vijayādiśarāntañca dhanurmantra udāhṛtaḥ |
nāgarāja (!) mahāpāśa (!) anantavaraṇāya ca |
nirmito viṣṇunā yasmādataḥ pāhi namaḥ svadhā |
caṇḍikāyāḥ pradattāsi sarvānubālavarhiṇī |
churike (!) rakṣa māṃ nityaṃ śāntiṃ kuru namo'stu te |
churikāyai ca ṭhadvayam |
ghaṇṭāyāḥ śṛṇu mantrañca koṇāntena ca sundari (!) |
paritaḥ pūjayenmantrān devāṃścaiva ṛṣīnapi |
pīṭheśāṃścaiva jīveśānupacārairanantaram |
tatraiva ca śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ vanitārañca pūjayet |
vedoktairāgamoktaiśca tathā paurāṇikairapi |
mantrairyathā vibhāgena svatantroktaiḥ prayatnataḥ |
śubhreṇa dadhisūktena gāyatryā tadanantaram |
mantraṃ japtvā stutiṃ kuryāddhomaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśakam |
prasādanaṃ tataḥ kuryādimaṃ mantraṃ paṭhettataḥ |
yanmayopahṛtaṃ kiñcit puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ |
tat sarvamupayuñjīta prasīda varadā bhava |
puṣṭīṃ prajñāṃ dhṛtiṃ medhāmārogyaṃ bhūtimeva ca ||
atha ṣoḍaśopacāramantrāḥ ||
prasīda jagatāṃ mātaḥ (!) saṃsārārṇavatāriṇi (!) |
mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā āsanaṃ saphalaṃ kuru || 1 ||
āsanaparimāṇantu mātṛkābhedatantre pañcamapaṭale ||
caturaṅgulavistāraṃ raupyanirmāṇapīṭhakam |
alaṅkāraṃ yathāyogyaṃ puruṣastu nivedayet |
mūlaprakṛtirūpeṇa sūyate sacarācaram |
pūjāmahaṃ vidhāsyāmi svāgatante maheśvari (!) || 2 ||
durgandhi paramāmodaṃ paraṃ vāgīśvareśvarī |
pādyametanmayā dattaṃ prasīda bhuvaneśvari (!) || 3 ||
dūrvātaṇḍulasammiśraṃ karpūrāgurupūritam |
arghyaṃ dattamidaṃ gṛhṇa mattastribhuvanārcite (!) || 4 ||
āpo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādapsu sarvaṃ carācaram |
nivedayāmi te devi (!) adbhirācamanīyakam || 5 ||
vājimedhaphalāvāptyai mayā dattaṃ varānane (!) |
madhuparkaṃ pratīcchastra mātarme bhuvaneśvari (!) || 6 ||
punarācamanīyamapyācamanīyamantreṇa vā dadyāt || 7 ||
śaṅkhasthamudakaṃ puṇyaṃ sugandhi sumanoharam |
niveditaṃ mayā devi (!) snānīyaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 8 ||
tvaṃ devi (!) parameśāni (!) paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇi (!) |
gṛhṇa vastramidaṃ devi (!) yajñasūtramidaṃ śubhe (!) || 9 ||
jyotiṣāṃ jyotirekastvamanādinidhanaṃ na te |
mayā dattamalaṅkāramalaṅkuru namo'stu te || 10 ||
sugandhi durgamaṃ nānyaṃ kumudotpalamālinam |
sitapītāruṇādānaṃ gṛhṇa puṣpaṃ varānane (!) || 11 ||
dhūpaṃ guggulusaṃyuktaṃ candanāgurucarcitam |
daśāṣṭāṅgasamudbhūtaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvari (!) || 12 ||
paraṃ jyotiḥ paraṃ brahma jagadekaṃ sanātani (!) |
bhūtaye mama deveśi (!) dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 13 ||
yaddattaṃ parayā bhuktyā phalamūlādikaṃ mayā |
gṛhāṇa parameśāni (!) naivedyaṃ sumanoharam || 14 ||
mātṛkābhedatantre ||
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ ramyaṃ nānāphalasamanvitam |
śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā pāyasañca nivedayet |
matsyasūkte ||
aśeṣajagadādhārabhūte (!) trailokyavandite (!) |
pradakṣiṇamahaṃ vande vidvatsu pādapaṅkajam || 15 ||
dhānyamudgakalāyasya rajovasya tilasy ca |
prakaṭānekaphalayugracanāṃ vinivedayet || 16 ||
prāṇān rakṣa yaśo rakṣa puttradāradhanāni ca |
sarvarakṣākarī yasmāttvaṃ devi (!) bhuvanatraye |
atra balidānoktasmārtabhaṭṭācāryalikhitābhilāpavākyavad dravyaviśeṣe'pi kāmanāviśeṣeṇābhilāpa uktastatraiva ||
dravyadānocitaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu vakṣye samāsataḥ |
yādṛśaṃ kalpasampūrṇaṃ tat prayaccha varānane (!) |
tato yathābhimatavijayakāmo gandhamahaṃ dadāmīti gandhaṃ dadyāt |
kalpakoṭisvarganivāsakāmaścandanāgurukarpūrakuṅkumairanu(-)lepanamahaṃ dadāmīti miśritānulepanaṃ dadyāt |
tataḥ puṣpaṃ daśasuvarṇadānaphalaprāptikāmo nānāvidhayuktapuṣpamahaṃ dadāmīti uddiśya jātīyuktavimuktacampakabilvapatrotpalakumuda(-) mallikākāñcanśephālikākahlārakaravīrajayantībandhūkayathā(-) kālaprāptajalajāraṇyajaparvatasambhūtoktānuktapuṣpāṇi dadyāt |
adya rājasūyayajñaphalaprāptikāmo bilvapatramālādvayaṃ dadyāt |
tataḥ puṣpadānatriguṇaphalaprāptikāmaḥ karavīramālyamahaṃ dadāmīti uktvā nānākarmaviracitakṛtyaṃ vakulamālyaṃ dadyāt |
adya gosahasradānaphalaprāptikāmo mālatīmālādvayaṃ raktotpalañca dadyāt ||
tato vājapeyaphalaprāptikāmo dhūpamahaṃ dadāmīti bahuvidhadhūpaṃ dadyāt |
aśvamedhaphalaprāptikāmo ghṛtapradīpamahaṃ dadāmītyuddiśya ghṛtena dīpamālāyāṃ dīpolkāñca dadyāt |
tato gomedhaśatayajñaprāptikāmo hṛdyanānāphalānvitapatrapuṣpopetabahuvidhānnapānatāmbūlādīni medhyānyamūni dadyāt |
tataḥ puṣkarādhikaraṇakadaśasuvarṇatāradānaphalaprāptikāmaḥ stavakādiphalapañcaśasyaprarūḍhadhānyaśālūkapadmamṛṇālāni yathāsambhavamedhyamatirūpāṇi dadyāt |
etadvastratantusaṃkhyavarṣasahasrāvacchinnaśivadurgālayamodana(-)kāmo netrakṣaumādiyathāsambhavavastrāṇyahaṃ dadāmīti uktvā sūkṣmamṛdurūpāṇi vastrāṇi dadyāt |
tato gaṅgādhikaraṇakadaśagodānaphalaprāptikāmaḥ sottarīyayajñasūtraṃ dadāmītyuddiśya dadyāt |
tato gosahasradānaphalaprāptikāmaḥ suvarṇamahaṃ dadāmītyuktvā dadyāt |
tataḥ svargādhikaraṇakadīpyamānakāmaśchatramahaṃ dadāmīti chatram |
agniṣṭomayajñaphalaprāptikāmaścāmaramahaṃ dadāmīti cāmaraṃ dadyāt |
adya dīrghāyurārogyavijayāvacchinnavipulabhogaprāptikāmaḥ adya candrāṃśujanmaṇisamaḥ atisaubhāgyakāmaḥ rūpadhānyakanyāyutasahasrāvacchinnadurgālokaprāptikāmaḥ sopadhānaśayyāpādukādīni dadyāt |
dattvā baliṃ tataḥ kuryāt kṛṣṇacchāgaṃ parātparam ||
balidānasya viśeṣo'gre vakṣyate |
japtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt stutipāṭhaṃ sadācaret |
atha stutiḥ ||
nārada uvāca ||
oṃ bhagavati (!) bhayocchede (!) kātyāyani (!) ca kāmade (!) |
kauśiki (!) tvaṃ maheśāni (!) kālike (!) tvāṃ namāmyaham || 1 ||
pracaṇḍe (!) puttrade (!) devi (!) sūprīte (!) suranāyike (!) |
kuladyotikare (!) cogre (!) pārvati (!) tvaṃ prasīda me || 2 ||
durgottāriṇi (!) durge (!) tvaṃ sarvāśubhanivāriṇi (!) |
sarve (!) sarvārthade (!) devi (!) bhava tvaṃ varadā mama || 3 ||
caṇḍogre (!) varade (!) devi (!) pracaṇḍe (!) vijayaprade (!) |
dharmārthakāmade (!) devi (!) kātyāyani (!) namo'stu te || 4 ||
janmāntarasahasreṣu tiryagyonigatasya ca |
aghaṃ saṃhara me devi (!) jñānato'jñānataḥ kṛtam || 5 ||
śāntipuṣṭiprade (!) devi (!) mātastrailokyatāriṇi (!) |
namasyāmi jagaddhātri (!) tvāmahaṃ bilvabhāvini (!) || 6 ||
namaste'stu śive (!) devi (!) sarvavyāpini (!) śāṅkari (!) |
nijadharmādikaṃ kāmyaṃ kalyāṇañca pradehi me || 7 ||
sarveṣāṃ nāthabhūtāsi tvamevaikākinī yataḥ |
tasmānnamāmi deveśi (!) prasannā varadā bhava || 8 ||
iyaṃ sarveśvarīpūjā yanmayā devi (!) te kṛtā |
pūrṇā bhavatu sā sarvā tvatprasādānmaheśvari (!) || 9 ||
jātasya yajamānasya garbhasthasya ca dehinaḥ |
mā bhūttatra kule janma yatra devī na caṇḍikā || 10 ||
ityaṣṭamīkṛtyam ||
atha niśīthakṛtyam ||
arddharātrau tataḥ kuryād divase vā samāhitaḥ |
sandhyāyāṃ vā maheśāni (!) śaraṇāmbhasi pūrvakam |
aṣṭamyāñca navamyāñca śivikāyāṃ yathecchayā |
niśāyātrāṃ prakurvīta sandhyāyāṃ rajanīmukhe |
tataḥ sampūjayedbhaktyā balibhiḥ pāyasādinā |
nṛtyagītavicitraiśca vādyairuccāvacairapi |
raktapuṣpasya kusumaṣṭamyāñca nivedayet |
sahasrasaṃkhyakairdevi (!) vakulairvā manoramaiḥ |
puṇḍarīkantu yo dadyādarddharātrau viśeṣataḥ |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tathā |
atha navamīkṛtyam tatraiva ||
navamyāṃ pūrvavat pūjā kartavyā bhūrtimicchatā |
devyai navamyāṃ sandhyāyāṃ piśitānnaṃ saśarkaram |
dadyād yadi tadā madyavarjitaṃ tadarānvitam |
araṃ kāñjikam ||
śāntiṃ kṛtvā dadeddhenuṃ dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivad yathā |
dakṣiṇāṃ vastrayugmañca ācāryāya nivedayet |
paritoṣaṃ punardānaṃ vidhijñāya ca kāñcanam |
dhānyaṃ vāmastathā tāmraṃ brahmaṇe dhānyakāñcanam |
ṛtvije'pi tathā dhānyaṃ satilaṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā |
brāhmaṇāṃśca kumārīśca anyānapi ca pūjayet |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāñca bhaktitaḥ pūjanaṃ caret |
dadyāduktamarkabhojyaṃ dinabhojyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
patiranyaṃ yadā dorbhirbalidānādyaśāntaye |
śivabhaktān pūjayecca śivābhaktān viśeṣataḥ |
śivabhaktāśca ye kecid viṣṇubhaktāśca pārvati (!) |
gṛhaṃ praviśya ca punargītavādyapuraḥsaram |
gṛhaṃ sampūjayedbhaktyā bhuñjīta bāndhavaiḥ saha ||
iti navamīkṛtyam ||
tatraiva |
prātareva daśamyāntu nityaṃ nirvartya sādṛtaḥ |
jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā idaṃ saṃśrāvayettataḥ |
oṃ kāli (!) kāli (!) mahākāli (!) kālike (!) pāpanāśini (!) |
kāli (!) karālaniṣkrānte (!) kālike (!) tvāṃ namo'stu te |
siṃhavāhini (!) cāmuṇḍe (!) pinākadhanuvallabhe (!) |
upahāraṃ gṛhītvaivaṃ prasīda parameśvari (!) |
oṃ uttiṣṭha devi (!) cāmuṇḍe (!) śubhāṃ pūjāṃ pragṛhya ca |
vraja tvaṃ srotasi jale vṛddhau ca sthīyatāmiha |
nirmālyadhāriṇī pūjyā cāṇḍālī gandhacandanaiḥ |
samarpayitvā mantreṇa mantrametadudīrayet |
nimajyāmbhasi sampūjyā parikālārcite jale |
puttrāyurdhanavṛddhyarthaṃ sthāpitāsi jale mayā |
yajamānaḥ svayañcaiva caṇḍikāṃ preṣayecchivām |
na vīkṣeta maheśānīṃ na nagnāṃ preṣayejjale |
daśamyāṃ śravaṇāprāpte apsu nikṣipya dārakaḥ |
alābhe kevalāyāntu na niśāyāṃ kathañcana |
pūjopahāradravyāṇi ācāryāya nivedayet |
tadarddhañca vidhijñāya tadarddhañcaiva brahmaṇe |
taccheṣaṃ ṛtvije dadyāt paritoṣaṃ tathaiva ca |
pūjālayaṃ na vīkṣeta gṛhasthaḥ svaṃ kadācana |
apsu nikṣipya deveśīṃ brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |
devīsthitagṛheṇāpi yo gṛhaṃ kārayet sudhīḥ |
tasya lakṣmīrbalañcāyuḥ sarvaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt |
iti daśamīkṛtyam ||
[iti śrīprāṇatoṣiṇyāṃ caturthe kāmyakāṇḍe durgotsavaprakaraṇe pratipadādikṛtyarūpastavakathanaṃ nāma pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ] |
ekapañcāśatpaṭale ||
bhagavānuvāca ||
atha durgāmanuṃ vakṣye sarvatantrānusārataḥ |
śāradīyaprayoge tu tadviśeṣaṃ yathā śṛṇu |
vākśaktikamalāsyāśca tryakṣaraṃ parikīrtitam |
nitye naimittike kāmye mokṣeṣu ca niyojayet |
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaścāsya chando'nuṣṭup prakīrtitam |
śambhuśca devatā devī caturvargeṣu yojayet |
kāmalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśena tarpaṇam |
tattvanyāsaṃ baliñcaiva homaṃ daśadaśāṃśake |
ṣaṭpurañcāṣṭapatrañca kalāpatraṃ dharāpuram |
caturdvāraṃ bījayuktaṃ pīṭhayuktaṃ samarcayet |
brāhmyādīnatha patre ca jayantyādīṃśca ṣaṭpure |
śeṣaśeṣaṃ tathā madhye amṛtādyāḥ kalācchade |
dhyānam ||
jaṭājūṭasamāyuktāmarddhendukṛtaśekharām |
locanatrayasaṃyuktāṃ pūrṇendusadṛśānanām |
taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ supratiṣṭhāṃ sulocanām |
navayauvanasampannāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām |
sucārudaśanāṃ tadvat pīnonnatapayodharām |
tribhaṅgasthānasaṃsthānāṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm |
triśūlaṃ dakṣiṇe haste khaḍgaṃ cakraṃ tathaiva ca |
tīkṣṇavāṇaṃ tathā śaktiṃ dakṣiṇe'pi nibodhata |
kheṭakaṃ pūrṇacāpañca pāśamaṅkuśameva ca |
ghaṇṭāṃ vā paraśuṃ vāpi devyā vāme vicintayet |
adhastānmahiṣaṃ tadvadviśriraskaṃ pradarśayet |
śiraśchedodbhavaṃ tadvaddānavaṃ khaḍgapāṇinam |
hṛdi śūlena nirbhinnaṃ niryadantravibhūṣitam |
raktaraktīkṛtāṅgañca raktavisphuritekṣaṇam |
veṣṭitaṃ nāgapāśena bhṛkuṭībhīṣaṇānanam |
pibantañcaiva raktañca devyāḥ siṃhaṃ pradarśayet |
devyāstu dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ samaṃ siṃhoparisthitam |
kiñcidūrddhvaṃ tathā vāmamaṅguṣṭhaṃ mahiṣopari |
dhyātvānena japenmantraṃ baliṃ dattvā stutiṃ paṭhet |
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaśchando'pyanuṣṭup śambhureva ca |
devatā ca samākhyātā caṇḍikā parameśvari (!) |
oṃ paraṃbrahmasvarūpāñca vedagarbhāṃ jaganmayīm |
śaraṇye (!) tvāmahaṃ vande durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 1 ||
kāmākhyāṃ kāmadāṃ śyāmāṃ kāmarūpāṃ manoramām |
īśvarīṃ tvāmahaṃ vande durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 2 ||
trinetrāṃ hāsyasaṃyuktāṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitām |
vijayāṃ tvāmahaṃ vande durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 3 ||
brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānāṃ siddhagandharvasevitām |
bhavānīṃ tvāmahaṃ vande durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 4 ||
niśumbhaśumbhamathanīṃ mahiṣāsuraghātinīm |
divyarūpāmahaṃ vande durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 5 ||
viṃśatyarddhabhujāṃ devīṃ śuddhakāñcanasannibhām |
gaurīrūpāmahaṃ vande durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 6 ||
triśūlaṃ khaḍgacakrañca vāṇaśaktiṃ paraśvadham |
dadhānāṃ tvāmahaṃ vande durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 7 ||
jaganmayīṃ mahāvidyāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇīm |
sarvadaivamahaṃ vande durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 8 ||
idantu kavacaṃ divyaṃ mahāmantraṃ mahāphalam |
yaḥ paṭhenmānavo nityamasmadbhaktisamanvitaḥ |
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ prayacchāmi sakṛdāvartanena tu |
iti matsyasūkte durgāstotraṃ samāptam |
tatraiva |
durgantvāraktaśṛṅkhalam |
nigamādyaṃ vahnijāyāṃ daśārṇaṃ parikīrtitam |
eṣā vidyā mahāvidyā jayadurgā prakīrtitā |
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaśchando gāyatrī parikīrtitā |
devatā ca bhaveddurgā sarvārthe viniyojayet |
mantraṃ lakṣaṃ japenmantrī tattvanyāsa udāhṛtaḥ |
taddaśāṃśaṃ juhuyācca tarpaṇaṃ ṛtusaṃkhyakam |
dadyānmahiṣamantreṇa āsanaṃ parikīrtayet |
mūlena kalpayenmūrtiṃ śṛṇu dhyānaṃ varānane (!) |
tato jalanidhestīre vanarājivirājitam |
tamālatālahintālapāṭalāmalakairvṛtam |
kundamandāradāḍīmakadambakusumairyutam |
campakāśokarambhāḍhyaṃ candanāgurubhūṣitam |
sugandhikusumāmodagandhāmoditadiṅmukham |
paśupakṣigaṇākīrṇaṃ bilvanopasarovaram |
kumudotpalakahlārapuṇḍarīkopaśobhitam |
tasminnamṛtadaṃ cārupārijātacatuṣṭayam |
pādapallavamāmodi mañjarīpuñjadhāritam |
tasminmaṇimayaṃ kuṇḍaṃ maṇḍapaṃ maṇikuṭṭimam |
taḍitkoṭipratīkāśaṃ bālādityasamaprabham |
maṇḍitaṃ pāṇḍaracchatrairvimānena virājitam |
śobhitaṃ śatasāhasrairdhvajaiḥ pāṇḍaracāmaraiḥ |
tatra siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ ratnadāmavirājitam |
tato bhāvayedbhāsvaraṃ siṃhamājaṃ caturvedapādaṃ caturviṃśatattvam |
vahirlolajihvaṃ calatpiṅgalākṣaṃ tuṣāraprabhaṃ durnirīkṣaṃ samastaiḥ ||
mahattāprabhavāraktapaṅkajaṃ ṣaṭpurānvitam |
vibhrājamānaṃ vistīrṇaṃ mṛgarājoparisthitam |
dhyāyettasmin taptajāmbūnadābhāṃ divyairbhavyairbhāsayantīṃ trinetraiḥ |
candrādityau kuṇḍale dve dadhānāmūrddhvaṃ candraṃ dhārayantīṃ mudā hi |
sa chinnabalavīryaugho nirgato mahiṣāsuraḥ |
saprāsena triśūlena bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanām |
gṛhītanāgatatkeśamṛgendrākṛṣṭavāhakam |
lohitāsyairmahāghoraiḥ śārdūlairapi bhakṣitam |
niyuktaṃ raktapaṃ siṃhaṃ vīkṣayantī muhurmuhuḥ |
siddhagandharvarakṣobhiryakṣavidyādharoragaiḥ |
gītavāditranirghoṣaiḥ stūyamānā maheśvarī |
mahotsave mahārātrau utthāne śayane'pi ca |
mahāmakhe mahāyoge dhyānaṃ tatra niyojayet |
nityāṃ nīlotpalābhāṃ tāṃ trinetrāṃ śaśiśekharām |
caturbhiḥ svakarairdhatte śaṅkhacakrakṛpāṇakam |
triśikhañca jaṭājūṭaṃ siṃhasthāmapi cintayet |
pīṭhasiṃhe maheśāni (!) yajet śaktisamanvitām |
prabhā māyā jayā sūkṣmā viśuddhā nandinī tathā |
suprabhā vijayā sarvasiddhidā nava śaktayaḥ |
ṣaṭpure bhairavīñcaiva śeṣamadhye samāpayet |
pūrvādyagre ca brahmādīn yaccheṣaṃ pūrvavat priye (!) |
aṣṭādaśabhujāyāśca vakṣye mantraṃ śivapradam |
bhāvasthāne samunnīya tattvaduṣṭe udāhṛtaḥ |
dhyānaṃ devyāḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ dāvāgnisadṛśaprabhām |
jaṭājūṭasamāyuktāṃ trinetrāṃ śaśiśekharām |
aṣṭādaśābdikāṃ devīṃ raktāmbaravibhūṣitām |
nighnantīṃ mahiṣañcaiva siṃhāsanoparisthitām |
śaktiñca durddharaṃ śūlaṃ vajraṃ khaḍgaṃ tathāṅkuśam |
śaraṃ cakraṃ śalākañca vāmadakṣiṇataḥ śṛṇu |
siddhākhyavaṭukañcaiva sandehavaṭukaṃ punaḥ |
samayādyaṃ tathāṅgāni patrādyañca kriyā tathā |
putraṃ teṣāmanantantu vaṭukaṃ śaktivāmataḥ |
tāreṇa bhāvayuktena namasāntena cārcayet |
ajitāparājitā caiva jayā ca vijayā punaḥ |
kālī caiva tathā śyāmā maṅgalā siddhireva ca |
kātyāyanyāḥ pravakṣyāmi mantraṃ sarvārthasādhanam |
vāgādyā jayadurgāyāstāramūle maheśvari (!) |
tataścārkabhujāyāśca kamalādyaṃ samuddharet |
māyānyāsañca sarvatra dvibhujāyāśca vāgbhavam |
sindūrārkaprasaṅkāśāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām |
trinetrāṃ mahiṣaghnīñca candralekhāṃśubhiryutām |
karaiścaturbhiḥ khaḍgañca śūlaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ tathā |
vāme carmāṅkuśaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ muṇḍapañcakameva ca |
yavādyāḥ pūjayet patre śrīkaṇṭhādīṃśca tadvahiḥ |
atha cāṣṭabhujāyāśca dhyānaṃ vakṣye samāhitaḥ |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśāṃ trinetrāṃ śaśiśekharām |
mṛgacarmottarāsaṅgāṃ siṃhaskandhanivāsinīm |
aṣṭabhirbāhubhiḥ khaḍgaṃ cakraṃ dakṣiṇabāhubhiḥ |
vajrāśaniṃ kapālañca vāme carma dhanuḥ śaram |
ghaṇṭāñca paraśuñcaiva kramādastrāṇi vai priye (!) |
puṣṭyādimātaraḥ patre śrīkaṇṭhādīṃśca tadbahiḥ |
caturbhujāyāḥ śrīvatsadhyānaṃ vaiṣṇavacoditam |
siṃhārūḍhāṃ mahābhīmāṃ śūlaṃ cakraṃ dhanustathā |
śaṅkhaṃ padmañca mahiṣaṃ nighnantīṃ paricintayet |
iti durgāviśeṣapūjā |
atha durgānāmamāhātmyaṃ tatra svarūpaṃ darśayatri rudrajāmale |
tavargatṛtīyo varṇaḥ pañcamasvarasaṃyutaḥ |
kavargasya tṛtīyaśca rephaṃ tasyopari priye (!) |
dvitīyasvarasaṃyuktaṃ nāmedaṃ parikīrtitam |
atha nāmamāhātmyam |
muṇḍamālātantre dvitīyapaṭale |
na hi durgāsamā pūjā na hi durgāsamo japaḥ |
na hi durgāsamaṃ jñānaṃ na hi durgāsamaṃ tapaḥ |
durgāyāścaritaṃ yatra tatra kailāsamandiram |
tṛtīyapaṭale |
durgāsmaraṇajaṃ devi (!) durgāsmaraṇajaṃ phalam |
durgāyāḥ smaraṇenaiva kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale |
śaivo vā vaiṣṇavo vāpi śākto vā girinandini (!) |
bhajeddurgāṃ smareddurgāṃ yajeddurgāṃ śivapriyām |
tatkṣaṇāddevadeveśi (!) mucyate bhavabandhanāt |
tathā |
durgāyā mantramākāraṃ nānātantre śrutaṃ tvayā |
durge durgeti durgāyā durge nāmaparaṃ manum |
yo bhajet satataṃ caṇḍi (!) jīvanmuktaḥ sa mānavaḥ |
he durge (!) durge ghorasaṅkaṭe durgāyāḥ paraṃ manuṃ durge iti nāmaśataṃ yo bhajejjapet sa jīvannapi mukto bhavedityanvayaḥ |
phalāntaramāha tatraiva |
mahotpāte mahāroge mahāvipadasaṅkaṭe |
mahāduḥkhe mahāśoke mahābhaye samutthite |
yaḥ sadā saṃsmareddurgāṃ yo japet paramaṃ manum |
sa jīvaloke deveśi (!) nīlakaṇṭhatvamāpnuyāt |
mahotpātādiṣu durgāṃ yaḥ smaret smṛtiviṣayatāśālinīṃ kuryādyaśca japan mānasapratyakṣaviṣayatāvatīṃ kuryāt sa nīlakaṇṭhatvamāpnuyāt kālakūṭasyeva mahotpātādeḥ pātṛtve labhet |
uttaratra tu nīlakaṇṭhatvaṃ śivatvamit sarvaṃ samañjasamiti |
tadeva spaṣṭayati caturthapaṭale |
śraddhayā'śraddhayā vāpi yaḥ kaścinmānavaḥ smaret |
durgāṃ durgaśataṃ tīrya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim |
saptamapaṭale |
nānātantramataṃ devi (!) nānāratnaṃ prakāśitam |
brahmasvarūpaṃ vijñātuṃ kaḥ samartho mahītale |
nānāmārge pradhāvanti paśavo hatabuddhayaḥ |
śrīdurgācaraṇāmbhojaṃ hitvā yānti rasātalam |
satyaṃ vacmi hitaṃ vacmi pathyaṃ vacmi punaḥ punaḥ |
na bhuktiśca na muktiśca vinā durgāniṣevaṇāt |
aṣṭamapaṭale |
bhaktyā bhagavatīṃ durgāṃ duḥkhadāridryanāśinīm |
saṃsmaret prajapeddhyāyet sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ |
jīvanmuktaḥ sa vijñeyastantrabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
sa sādhako mahājñānī yaśca durgāpadānugaḥ |
na ca bhuktirna vā muktirna gatirnaganandini (!) |
vinā durgāṃ jagaddhātri (!) niṣphalaṃ jīvanaṃ bhavet |
śaktimārgarato bhūtvā yo'nyamārge pradhāvati |
na ca śāktāstasya vaktraṃ paripaśyanti śaṅkari (!) |
vinā durgāṃ jagaddhātri (!) vāgjālaśāstramohitāḥ |
anyadevaṃ bhajante te cānyaśāstreṣu ghūrṇitāḥ |
picchilātantre pūrvakhaṇḍe tṛtīyapaṭale |
na durgānāmasadṛśaṃ nāmāsti jagatītale |
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa palāyante mahyapadaḥ |
durgānāmasmaraṇena sarvavidyāsmaraṇamāha |
tāriṇī sundarī kālī durgā ca bhairavī tathā |
bhuvaneśī mahālakṣmīstāsāṃ durgeti nāma vai |
tāsāmiti bahuvacanādgaṇo labhyate |
prāguktanāmno mantratvamatra spaṣṭayati |
durgānāmamahāmantraḥ sarvamantrottamottamaḥ |
lakṣasaṃkhyājapenaiva puraścaryā vidhīyate |
rājādibhayamāpanne durgānāma parā gatiḥ |
mahāpadi mahātrāse mahādāridryasaṅkaṭe |
lakṣasaṃkhyājapenaiva palāyante mahāpadaḥ ||
jāmale |
śiva uvāca |
ārogyasya ca sampatterjñānasya ca mahodayaḥ |
nāmedaṃ paramo heturmuktaye bhavasaṅginām |
kalikāle viśeṣeṇa mahāpātakināmapi |
nistārabījaṃ vijñeyaṃ nāmasaṃsmaraṇaṃ priye (!) |
paradārarato'pi syāt paradravyāpahārakaḥ |
so'pi pāpāt pramucyeta yo vā syādatipātakī |
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ |
tasmādapi pramucyeta yadi nāma smaret sudhīḥ |
viṣṇunāmasahasrebhyo hyadhikaṃ parameśvari (!) |
durgānāma samākhyātaṃ caturvedavidāṃ matam |
durgānāmajapāt pāpaṃ sarvaṃ yāti hi tatkṣaṇāt |
vedeṣvāgamatantreṣu purāṇeṣu suniścitam |
harināmnaḥ paraṃ nāsti vaiṣṇavānāmidaṃ smṛtam |
tādṛśāñca mate jñeyaṃ durgānāma tato'dhikam |
na tasya durlabhaṃ kiñcit paratreha ca sundari (!) |
yaḥ smaret satataṃ durgāṃ sa eva śrīsadāśivaḥ |
śaucācāravihīno'pi saṃsmaret parameśvarīm |
sa eva paramaṃ sthānaṃ kathitaṃ vīravandite (!) |
vaiṣṇavānāñca śaivānāṃ śuddhānāṃ yādṛśī gatiḥ |
nāmasaṃsmaraṇādyasya tathā śāktajanasya ca |
karmaṇānena deveśi (!) nādhikārī yamo mama |
durgānāmajapo yasya kiṃ tasya kathayāmi te |
ahaṃ pañcānanaḥ kānte (!) varṣakoṭiśatairapi |
yāvadbhūrvāyurākāśaṃ jalaṃ vahniḥ śaśī grahāḥ |
tāvattiṣṭhanti te svarge durgānāmaparāyaṇāḥ |
dhanī putrī sukhī so'pi cirajīvī bhavedbhuvi |
pratyahaṃ yo japed bhaktyā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ śuciḥ |
aṣṭottarasahasrantu yo japedbhaktimān naraḥ |
pratyahaṃ parameśāni (!) tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti jñānārtho jñānameva ca |
rogārto mucyate rogāt baddho mucyeta bandhanāt |
bhīto bhayāt pramucyeta pāpānmucyeta pātakī |
putrārthī putramāpnoti devi (!) satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
ayutaṃ yo japedbhaktyā pratyahaṃ parameśvari (!) |
nigrahānugrahe śaktaḥ sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥ |
tasya krodhādbhavenmṛtyuḥ prasāde paripūrṇatā |
evañca taṃ vijānīyāt samarthaṃ sarvakarmaṇi |
māsi māsi ca yo lakṣaṃ japaṃ kuryādvarānane (!) |
na tasya grahapīḍā syānnāpi bandhuviyojanam |
na caiśvaryaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti na ca sarpakṣataṃ kvacit |
nāgnicaurabhayaṃ vāpi na cāraṇye jale bhayam |
parvatārohaṇe devi (!) siṃhavyāghrabhayādike |
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ bhayaṃ vā kutracidbhavet |
na ca vairibhayaṃ kānte (!) na ca dasyubhayaṃ pathi |
jvarādīnāñca rogāṇāṃ na śarīre sthitiḥ kvacit |
paraloke bhavet svargī kathitaṃ vīravandite (!) |
candrasūryasamo bhūtvā vaset kalpāyutaṃ divi |
vājapeyasahasrasya yat phalaṃ syādvarānane (!) |
pratyahaṃ tat phalaṃ durgānāmajāpādvarānane (!) |
pūjākāle japedyastu gaṅgātīre ca mānavaḥ |
śatāśvamedhayajñānāṃ phalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ |
prājāpatyavrate yādṛk tathā cāndrāyaṇe'pi vā |
ekādasyupavāsena koṭisaṃkhyena yādṛśam |
candrasūryagrahe gatvā gaṅgāyāñca sureśvari (!) |
kurukṣetre ca sarvasvadāne yat phalamīritam |
prayāgādiṣu tīrtheṣu māghasnāne ca yat phalam |
śivarātricaturdaśyāṃ śambhoścaiva prapūjanāt |
rathasthaṃ vāmanaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣetre śrīpuruṣottame |
kāmarūpe mahāmāyāṃ kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍale |
pūjayitvā phalaṃ yādṛk durgānāma tato'dhikam |
aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāñca mahāniśi |
śmaśāne ca japaṃ kuryāccāṇḍālahṛdayopari |
digambaro nirātaṅko muktakeśo bhavedyadi |
sa siddhiṃ samavāpnoti devānāmapi durlabhām |
śanibhaumadine devi (!) bhavedindukṣayo yadi |
tatrāyutaṃ japedyastu nirātaṅko mahāniśi |
saṃvandyo devatānāñca munīndrāṇāñca sundari (!) |
bhaumavāre mahādevi (!) yadi syādaṣṭamītithiḥ |
bilvapatrasahasraistu tatra sampūjya pārvatīm |
baliṃ dadyādvidhānena japtvā nāmasahasrakam |
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke tattadāpnoti niścitam |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīsamāyuktaniśāyāṃ sa gaṇo bhavet |
tatra gatvā śmaśāne vai śanivāre varānane (!) |
paśūnāṃ ghātanaṃ kṛtvā yonimudrāṃ vidhāya ca |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sādhakaḥ sādhayecchivām |
aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāñcaiva pārvati (!) |
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yastu durgānāmajapaṃ caret |
sa labhedvāñchitaṃ sarvamiha loke paratra ca |
gaṅgāgodāvarīrevāyamunājalasannidhau |
yo japet sādhako bhaktyā sahasrañca tithikṣaye |
parastrīharaṇāt pāpaṃ paradravyāpahāraṇāt |
sarvaṃ tat kṣayamāpnoti mahārauravakāraṇam |
kāmarūpe mahātīrthe kāmākhyāyonisannidhau |
lakṣamekaṃ japedyastu niśāyāṃ vīravandite (!) |
sa ca vāgīśvaro bhūtvā paratra śivatāṃ vrajet |
bhavānīsannidhau yastu vārāṇasyāṃ japaṃ caret |
daridro'pi dhanī bhūtvā śivaloke mahīyate |
iti durgānāmaphalam |
atha durgāśatanāmastotram |
muṇḍamālātantre dvitīyapaṭale |
durgāyāḥ śatanāmāni śṛṇu tvaṃ bhavagehini (!) |
durgā bhavāni deveśī viśvanāthapriyā śivā |
ghoradaṃṣṭrā karālāsyā muṇḍamālāvibhūṣaṇā |
rudrāṇī tāriṇī tārā māheśī bhavavallabhā |
nārāyaṇī jagaddhātrī mahādevapriyā jayā |
vijayā ca jayārādhyā śarvāṇī haravallabhā |
asitā cāṇimā devī laghimā garimā tathā |
maheśaśaktirviśveśī gaurī parvatanandinī |
nityā ca niṣkalaṅkā ca nirīhā nityanūtanā |
raktā raktamukhī vāṇī vasuyuktā vasupradā |
rāmapriyā rāmaratā raghunāthavarapradā |
rājyeśvarī rājyaratā kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇavarapradā |
yaśodā rādhikā caṇḍī draupadī rukmiṇī tathā |
guhapriyā guharatā guhavaṃśavilāsinī |
gaṇeśajananī mātā viśvarūpā ca jāhnavī |
gaṅgā kālī ca kāśī ca bhairavī bhuvaneśvarī |
nirmalā ca sugandhā ca daivakī devapūjitā |
dakṣajā dakṣiṇā dakṣā dakṣayajñavināśinī |
suśīlā sundarī saumyā mātaṅgī kamalā kalā |
niśumbhanāśinī śumbhanāśinī caṇḍanāśinī |
dhūmralocanasaṃhartrī mahiṣāsuramardinī |
umā gaurī karālā ca kāminī viśvamohinī |
ityevaṃ śatanāmāni kathitāni varānane (!) |
nāmasmaraṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ |
yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya smṛtvā durgāpadadvayam |
mucyate janmabandhebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
sandhyākāle divābhāge niśāyāṃ vā niśāmukhe |
paṭhitvā śatanāmāni mantrasiddhiṃ labheddhruvaṃ |
ajñātvā stavarājañca daśa vidyā bhajed yadi |
tathāpi naiva siddhiḥ syāt satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvari (!) |
iti muṇḍamālātantre durgāśatanāmastotraṃ samāptam |
atha durgāgītā |
tathā saptamapṭale |
nānātantramataṃ devi (!) nānāratnaṃ prakāśitam |
brahmasvarūpaṃ vijñātuṃ kaḥ samartho mahītale |
nānāmārge pradhāvanti paśavo hatabuddhayaḥ |
śrīdurgācaraṇāmbhojaṃ hitvā yānti rasātalam |
satyaṃ vacmi hitaṃ vacmi pathyaṃ vacmi punaḥ punaḥ |
na bhuktiśca na muktiśca vinā durgāniṣevaṇāt |
pārvatyuvāca |
golake caiva rādhāhaṃ vaikuṇṭhe kamalātmikā |
brahmaloke ca sāvitrī bhāratī vāksvarūpiṇī |
kailāse pārvatī devī mithilāyāñca jānakī |
dvārakāyāṃ rukmiṇī ca draupadī nāgasāhvaye |
gāyatrī vedajananī sandhyāhañca dvijanmanām |
yogamadhye pūṣāhañca puṣpe kṛṣṇā'parājitā |
patre mālūrapatrañca pīṭhe yonisvarūpiṇī |
hariharātmikā vidyā brahmaviṣṇuśivārcitā |
viśeṣānugraheṇaiva vijñeyā śaṅkara (!) prabho (!) |
yatra kutra sthale nātha (!) śaktistiṣṭhati śaṅkara (!) |
tatraivāhaṃ mahādeva (!) niścitaṃ matamuttamam |
śaktimārgaṃ parityajya yo'nyamārge hi dhāvati |
karasthaṃ sa maṇiṃ tyaktvā bhūtibhāraṃ pradhāvati |
bhūtibhāraṃ bhasmabhāraṃ ||
iti durgāgītā samāptā ||
atha baliḥ ||
samayācāratante ||
sarvāsāṃ devatānāñca balidānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me |
yena kṛtvāśu labhate yathoktaphalamuttamam |
nityantu bhojane kāle mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ |
kārayedbalidānañca bhojanāt prathamaṃ priye (!) |
tataścānantaraṃ kuryādbhojanaṃ sthiramānasaḥ |
bhojanānantaraṃ devi (!) śucisthaḥ kṛtavān bhavet |
baliṃ samuddhared yatrādekānte sthāpayettadā |
sthāpayitvā baliṃ tatra viharecca yathāsukham |
uttarāmnāyeṣu deveśi (!) mātaṅgī yā prakīrtitā |
tasyā baliṃ bhojanānte vinaivācamane kṛte |
mūlamantreṇa subhage (!) baliṃ dadyāddine dine|
tataḥ kiñcijjapaṃ kṛtvā tataścācamanādikam |
punaśca rātrau sarveṣāṃ baliṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ |
yathoktavidhinā kuryād yathoktaphalamāpnuyāt |
baliśca dvividho devi (!) sāttviko rājasastathā |
sāttviko balirākhyāto māṃsaraktādivarjitaḥ |
rājaso māṃsaraktādiyuktaḥ sa procyate priye (!) |
gāyatrītantre pañcamabrāhmaṇapaṭale |
trividhā balayaḥ proktā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ |
uttamaścottamaṃ dadyānmadhyamo madhyamaṃ tathā |
adhamaḥ kathyate devi (!) adhame'pyadhamā gatiḥ |
daśasaṃkhyabaliryatra madhyamastena kathyate |
sāttvikī uttamā pūjā yadi dadyānmahābalim |
aṣṭamīnavamīsandhau dadyādyatrānmahābalim |
śataṃ sahasraṃ lakṣaṃ vā ayutaṃ koṭikoṭiśaḥ |
śasyate nṛpatiśreṣṭhaḥ sāttvikopūjane baliḥ |
ekena balidānena caturvargamavāpnuyāt |
bahubhirbalidānaistu paraṃbrahmamayo bhavet |
bahubhirbalidānaistu japayajñaistu bhūpateḥ |
kriyate sāttvikī pūjā sāttvikī tena kathyate |
daśabhiḥ paśubhiḥ pūjā japayajñaistathaiva ca |
yā kṛtā śāradī pūjā rājasī tena kīrtitā |
balibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ pūjā tāmasī tena kīrtitā |
matsyasūkte ||
sādhakāstrividhāḥ proktāḥ sāttvikā rājasāstathā |
tāmasāśca tathā devi (!) teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam |
sāttvikaḥ sāttvikairyukto lakṣaṇaiścaiva sundari (!) |
sāttvikaṃ balidānādi nityaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ |
rājaso rājasaguṇairyuktaḥ satyaṃ varānane (!) |
rājasaṃ balidānādi sureśe (!) rājasairyutaḥ |
tāmasastāmasaguṇai rājasādyairyutaḥ priye (!) |
na śraddhā balidāneṣu pūjanādiṣu sundari (!) |
na stotrapāṭhahomeṣu nāmamātreṇa sādhakaḥ |
yoginītantre uttarakhaṇḍe saptamapaṭale ||
viprāṇāṃ kṣīrabalayaḥ śālyannaṃ vātha pāyasam |
ghṛtaplutaṃ caruphalaṃ puṣpaṃ tasya ghṛtānvitam |
pradadyācca gavāṃ kṣīraṃ dugdhāmrāmlān nivedayet |
śālyannaṃ vātha samadhuṃ sasaraṃ khaṇḍamodakam |
rājñāṃ hi paśavaḥ śastā vaiśyānāṃ vrīhayastathā |
kṣaudraṃ vṛṣalajātīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ paśavo'thavā |
nivedayet śoṇagaṇḍaṃ mānuṣaṃ vā lulāpakam |
varāhaṃ vātha chagalaṃ cāmaraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā |
meṣañcātha varāhañca godhikāñca nivedayet ||
matsyasūkte ||
lulāpañca tathā khaḍgaṃ cāmarañca varāhakam |
kacchapaṃ śallakīṃ godhāṃ mānuṣaṃ tadanantaram |
na dadyādbrāhmaṇo madyaṃ mānuṣañca tathā rurum |
traipakṣikānna vivarṇān mānuṣānna kṛśānapi |
saṃvatsarāt paraṃ chāgaṃ yāvat syāttu trihāyaṇam |
varāhadantasadṛśaviṣāṇābhyāṃ suśobhanam |
madagandhasamāyuktaṃ romarājivirājitam |
kṛṣṇaṃ tāraṇakañcaivaṃ tṛptau dvādaśavārṣikam ||
jātibhede varṇaviśeṣamāha tatraiva ||
śvetañca chāgalañcaiva brāhmaṇasya viśiṣyate |
raktaṃ śvetaṃ kṣatriyasya vaiśyasya gaurameva ca |
nānāvarṇaṃ hi śūdrasya sarveṣāmañjanaprabham |
yoginītantre ||
paśūnāñcaiva ṣaṇmāsāt parataśca balirbhavet |
chāgalaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śveto vā dvivarṣātparato yadi |
tathā cāśvaṃ mṛgañcaiva chāgañca parvatīyakam |
mūṣikañca karālañca kṣudramārjārameva ca ||
varjyamapi tatraiva ||
kākolaṃ kalaviṅgañca rājahaṃsañca śārikam |
śukaṃ gṛdhrañca kākolaṃ mayaraṃ citrakaṃ tathā |
aśvañca veṇupṛṣṭhañca kṛṣṇapārāvatañca yat |
vṛhatkapotakañcaiva khañjarīṭaṃ tathaiva ca |
vakañcaiva balākañca prayatnena vivarjayet ||
balyantaramāha tatraiva ||
rambhā jātī bījapūraṃ sugandhiparimiśritam |
miśrīkṛtya baliṃ dadyādaṣṭamyāñca viśeṣataḥ |
prayoge balimantro'yaṃ prayogān dhārayed yadi |
arddharātre baliṃ dadyānnityaṃ devi (!) catuṣpathe |
parasainyagrahāviṣṭarogakṛtyānivāraṇam |
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya ugratāre tataḥ param |
vikaṭadaṃṣṭraṃ parapakṣaṃ mohayadvayamuccaret |
khādayadvandvamuccārya pakṣadvandvaṃ vadet punaḥ |
ye māṃ hiṃsitumudyatā yoginīcakre tān dāraya huṃ phaṭ svāhā |
sarvavidyāmākarṣayākarṣaya chedaya chedaya hana hana kapāle gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāheti ||
anenaiva ca deveśi (!) baliṃ dadyānmaheśvari (!) |
vṛhannīlatantre ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
tataḥ śatrubaliṃ rājā dadyāt kṣīreṇa nirmitam |
dvayaṃ chindyāt krodhadṛṣṭyā prahārajanakena ca |
kopena ca sakṛddevi (!) satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvari (!) |
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā vai śatrunāmnā maheśvari (!) |
śatrukṣayo maheśāni (!) bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
śatrumadhikṛtya viśeṣastu matsyasūkte ||
mantreṇānena deveśi (!) prakuryāt pūrvanirmitam |
kātyāyanyambike (!) tāraṃ hanayugmaṃ dahadvayam |
pacadvandvaṃ mathadvandvaṃ prathamadvandvameva ca |
māyā dvayaṃ vaśañcaiva caṇḍi (!) caṇḍi (!) ca tārakam |
nārasiṃhadvayaṃ paścāt mandarañca satārakam |
cāmuṇḍe (!) praṇavañcaiva bhakṣayeti dahadvayam |
mathadvayaṃ pacadvandvaṃ chindhiyugmaṃ tato nyaset |
oṃ jayadvitayañcaiva sphoṭayadvitayaṃ tathā |
kartayadvitayasyānte tato daha samīrayet |
mama śatruṃ samuttārya tato bījaṃ samuccaret |
dāhayadāhaya dvandvaṃ tataśchedaya mohaya |
chedayadvitayasyānte viśleṣaya tataḥ param |
mama śatrupadasyānte mantra muccārayettataḥ |
tāraṃ hanayugasyānte bhakṣayadvitayaṃ tathā |
trāsayanāśayadvandvamāveśaya tataḥ param |
ārohayasphoṭayānte uccāṭayayugaṃ tataḥ |
unmattayayugasyānte imaṃ mantramudīrayet |
kṛṣṇapuṣpaṃ samādāya kuryānnirmañchanaṃ svayam |
kalatrāṇāñca deveśi (!) mantreṇānena dāpayet |
vilayaṃ yāntu te sarve ye māṃ hiṃsanti jantavaḥ |
mṛtyurogabhayakleśāḥ patantu śatrumastake |
vimukhaṃ krodhadṛṣṭiñca pātayecchatrumastake |
kavacadvandvamuccārya svāhādvandvamudīrayet |
chāgādīnāmuttarottaraṃ prāśastyamuktaṃ matsyasūkte mahātantre ||
cāmarāṇāñca daśakaiśchāgalaikaṃ viśiṣyate |
daśabhiśchāgalairdeva (!) kūrma ekaḥ praśasyate |
kūrmasya ca śatenāpi śaśakaiko viśiṣyate |
śaśakasya śatenāpi svagātrarudhiraṃ śrutam |
yāvat padmadalaṃ pūrṇaṃ tāvanmātraṃ maheśvari (!) |
tataḥ śatapuṭānāñca śalalaiko viśiṣyate |
śalalasya sahasreṇa varāhastu viśiṣyate |
dve sahasre varāhasya mahiṣaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate |
dve sahasre lulāpasya khaḍga eko viśiṣyate |
khaḍgānāntu sahasreṇa mānuṣe cātulaṃ phalam |
dve sahasre manuṣyasya śoṇatuṇḍaḥ praśasyate |
dve śate śoṇatuṇḍasya śvetagrīvaḥ praśasyate |
śvetagrīvaśatenāpi godhikā tūttamā matā |
godhikānāṃ śatenāpi narasya ca kumārakaḥ |
daśaiṇasya samā godhā godhāyā daśapārṣatam |
pārṣatasya daśānāntu meṣa eko viśiṣyate |
meṣasya daśamadhye tu chāgalaśca viśiṣyate |
daśānāṃ chāgalānāñca kṛṣṇavarṇo viśiṣyate |
tilākṣatena puṣpeṇa cāṣṭāṣṭau ca viśiṣyate |
chāgasya kṛṣṇavarṇasya śveta eko viśiṣyate |
śvetavarṇasya daśakaṃ mukuṭaṃ yadi mastake |
praśastaṃ taṃ vijānīyādakṣatañca vicārayet |
śataṃ tasmāllulāpaikaṃ tacchataṃ khaḍgameva ca |
śatānāmatha khaḍgānāṃ mānuṣaśca viśiṣyate |
daśakañca narāṇāñca varāhaiko viśiṣyate |
varāhasya phalaṃ devi (!) sairibhaistoṣayecchivām |
sairibhasya śatānāñca godhāhvayo viśiṣyate |
godhikānāṃ śatānāñca svagātrarudhiraṃ tathā |
tatsamaṃ śoṇatuṇḍañca śvetagrīvaṃ tathaiva ca |
arddharātrau tu kuṣmāṇḍaṃ parvatīyaṃ vinā priye (!) |
lulāpadāne yat proktaṃ chitvā dattvā ca yat phalam |
khaḍgañca daśavarṣīyaṃ lulāpaṃ vatsarātparam |
praśastaṃ śvetavarṇantu khaḍgaṃ śvetaṃ vivarjayet |
sairibhañca śvetakṛṣṇaṃ manuṣyaṃ śyāmasundaram |
dvādaśābdāt parañcaiva yāvadyāvat sa puṣkalam |
tāvadeva maheśāni (!) kiñcinnādyānmahāmuniḥ |
pakṣiṇaḥ kacchapā grāhāḥ sthalajā jalajā api |
kāmanā tu ||
adya dīrghāyurārogyavijayāvacchinnavipulabhogaprāptipūrvaka(-) dhvajamālākulavimānavarārohaṇāvacchinnabrahmalokaprāptikāmo bhagavatyai chāgaladaśakaṃ dadyāt ||
khaḍgābhimantraṇaṃ kuryāttena khaḍgena chedayet |
pūjayedraktapuṣpeṇa gandhena candanena ca |
tāraṃ māyāyugaṃ kāliyugmaṃ syādvikaṭaṃ nyaset |
daṃṣṭrākarāli niṣpeṣaphetkāriṇi ca khādaya |
sṛ ajaṃ piba piba tūrṇaṃ rudhiraṃ nārasiṃhake |
dvitīyaṃ kirikiridvandvaṃ kāliyugmaṃ tataḥ param |
vrajeśvaripadaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ vasakhaḍgadhanuḥ smṛtam |
rudhire śarkarāṃ dadyāt pānīyañca sasaindhavam |
gandhaṃ sukusumaṃ dadyāddarbhayugmantu nikṣipet ||
tripadaṃ triśūlam ||
oṃ kāli (!) kāli (!) mahākāli (!) kālike (!) pāpanāśini (!) |
śoṇitañca baliṃ gṛhṇa varade (!) vāmalocane (!) |
tāraṃ tāraṃ tato māyāṃ hrāṃ hraiṃ hrauñca ṭhadvayam |
tāraṃ sthāṇuyugaṃ dadyāt śeṣāṅgañca samuddharet |
khaṭvāṅgaṃ nṛmuṇḍañceti triśūladhāriṇītyapi |
vikaṭadaṃṣṭre karālāsye kapālamālini tatparaṃ hāṃ hāṃ gṛhṇa sāṭṭahāsinipadasyānte mantrañca vikaṭadvayam |
śivaṃ kāntaṃ tato vāntaṃ kaṃ kaṃ kālyai namaḥ sthitiḥ |
eṣa mātsyabaliḥ svāhā anenāmantrya dāpayet |
tāraṃ māyāsphuradvandvaṃ hanayugañca ṭhadvayam |
indhanamagurudvandvaṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa ca ṭhadvayam |
dharābhimantraṇaṃ kṛtvā trivargaṃ parikalpayet |
pūtanāṃ kauśikīñcaiva kālikāñca yathākramāt ||
yoginītantre khaḍgapūjādau viśeṣo yathā ||
māyābījaṃ samuccārya kālikālīti sundari (!) |
vrajeśvaripadaṃ paścāt lauhadaṇḍāya te naraḥ |
iti sampūjya deveśi (!) śaktiṃ sampūjayettataḥ |
huṃ huṃ vāgīśvarībrahmabhyāṃ namaḥ |
huṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhyāñca padaṃ brūyāddevi (!) caṇḍe (!) maheśvari (!) |
nama umāmaheśvarābhyāṃ nama ityādinārcayet |
praṇavañca tataḥ paścāt kārtikeśvarābhyāṃ namaḥ |
ityanenaiva mantreṇa śaktiṃ prayojayennaraḥ |
iti khaḍgaṃ prapūjyaiva viśeṣeṇa prapūjayet |
khaḍgāya kharanāśāya śaktikāryārthatatpara (!) |
paśuśchedyastvayā śīghraṃ khaḍganātha (!) namo'stu te |
anenaiva ca mantreṇa praṇamet khaḍgamuttamam |
gṛhītvā tāmrapātrañca jalapūrṇamudaṅmukhaḥ |
harṣakāmo mahādevyai paśośca prokṣaṇañcaret |
prokṣaṇañca paśoḥ kṛtvā cotsṛjeddevatādhiyā |
yathoktena vidhānena tubhyamastu samarpitam ||
matsyasūkte ||
candrahāsena khaḍgena chedayeduttamaṃ balim |
candrahāsaścatustālaḥ karavīradalākṛtiḥ ||
madhyamam ||
pañcaviṃśāṅgulaṃ mānaṃ prastāraṃ sārddhatryaṅgulam |
ekadhāreṇa khaḍgena yaḥ prāṇī badhyate kila |
na tat phalamavāpnoti chettā ca narakaṃ vrajet ||
ekadhārapratiprasavastu tatraiva ||
padmapatradalākāramekadhāraṃ praśasyate |
daṇḍakhaḍgastrivakrastu praśasto balikarmaṇi |
sakṛt prahāramātreṇa baliḥ syāduttarāmukhaḥ |
svayaṃ pūrvamukho bhūtvā chedayedapramādataḥ |
baliṃ pūrvamukhaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ syāduttarāmukhaḥ |
chedayet tīkṣṇakhaḍgena prahāreṇa sakṛdbudhaḥ ||
yoginītantre ||
chinne ca patite tasmin vāmabhāge ca ninditam |
dainyaṃ madhye ca patitaṃ devīcchedaṃ smaredbudhaḥ |
tatprāyaścittamapi tatraiva ||
tataḥ kuṇḍāntike gatvā āhutirdaśapañcabhiḥ |
tenaivamutsṛjeddoṣaṃ baliṃ lakṣet salakṣaṇam ||
matsyasūkte ||
śiraśchitvā baliṃ dadyādajasya raktameva ca |
mantreṇānena deveśi (!) prakuryāt pūrvanirmitam ||
atha rudhirapātram ||
matsyasūkte ||
rājataṃ mṛṇmayaṃ kāṃsyaṃ raityaṃ kāṣṭhamayaṃ tathā |
praśastaṃ rudhirāloke dārulauhamayaṃ tyajet |
śaṅkhañcāśmayañcaiva apavitraṃ vivarjayet |
svastikāyāḥ supraśastaṃ tathā padmadalasya ca |
arghyatoyapradānena naradānaphalaṃ labhet |
kaṇṭharaktaṃ na dadyāt chāgalasya viśiṣyate |
padmapuṣpadalasyānte tathā madhyagatasya ca |
tāvaddalapramāṇaṃ syānmātṛvadanupūrvakam ||
atha rudhiragrahaṇaprakārastatraiva ||
kiyanmāṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ tathā khaḍgagatasya ca |
rudhiraṃ mastakañcaiva paśoścāpi viśeṣataḥ |
viparītaṃ paśormaste pakṣimaste ca dāpayet |
kacchape cāmare bhāse yaḥ pradīpantu jvālayet |
sa durgatimavāpnoti na cireṇa maheśvari (!) |
darbheṇāpi dvidhā kṛtvā pañcadhā rudhirasya |
pūrvabhāgādito dadyānmadhye ca tadanantaram |
vāmahastatale kṛtvā mantreṇānena mantrayet |
kāli (!) kāli (!) mahākāli (!) kālike (!) pāpanāśini (!) |
śoṇitaṃ taptakaṃ devadevi (!) gṛhṇa namo'stu te |
kāli kālīti mantreṇa caṇḍikāyai nivedayet |
carakīñca vidārīñca pūtanāṃ pāparākṣasīm |
kauśikīṃ purataḥ kṛtvā devyai raktaṃ pradāpayet |
kauśikyādyāmanuṃ vakṣye dharmakāmārthasiddhidam |
tāraṃ vā kamalā māyā kamalā kamalāmiti |
kāmakalā spheṃ spheṃ khirañcaiva dviṭhāntaṃ samudāhṛtam |
teṣāmādyakṣareṇaiva binduyuktena vā punaḥ |
etat sarvaprayatnena mantraṃ vakṣyāmi śaṅkari (!) |
tāraṃ vyoma tato māyāṃ yaśca padmamidaṃ paṭhet |
oṃ trinetre (!) vikarālāsye (!) astramālāvibhūṣite (!) |
sarvāsurakṛtānte (!) tvaṃ khaḍgakhaṭvāṅgaśūladhṛk |
tvaṃ khaḍgakhaṭvāṅgaśūladhṛk |
vakṣye mahāmanuṃ devi (!) tāraṃ krauṃ kraumudīrayet |
kauśikāya gṛhṇa gṛhṇa eṣānte ca balidvayam |
aparaṃ tāramāyā ca prasphuradvitayaṃ daha |
caladvayaṃ kuhuñcaiva kuhuścaiva guludvayam |
punaśca māraya dvandvaṃ budhairyat parikīrtitam |
viśākhādyamanuṃ vakṣya yena utpadyate śubham |
tāraṃ tato vikaṭadaṃṣṭre ṅe'ntaṃ hana hana dvayam |
vai viśikhāya svāheti balimantra udāhṛtaḥ ||
yoginītantre ||
tato rudhiramādāya vaṭukādīn samarcayet |
nai(-)ṛtyāñca maheśāni (!) krūraṃ vaṭukabhairavam |
vāyavyāṃ huṃ yāṃ yoginībhyo nama ityādinārcayet |
aiśānyāñca maheśāni (!) huṃ kṣauṃ kṣetrapālāya nama ityādinā devi (!) gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
āgneyyāṃ huṃ goṃ gaṇeśāya nama ityādinārcayet |
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya balidānaṃ samarpayet ||
matsyasūkte ||
bhūgataṃ rudhiraṃ yattu bhuñjanti paricārikāḥ |
yāvacca tāvaddeveśi (!) lepanaṃ parivarjayet ||
iti balidānavidhiḥ ||
atha homaḥ ||
śāradātilake pañcamapaṭale ||
vīkṣaṇaṃ mūlamantreṇa śareṇa prokṣaṇaṃ matam |
tenaiva tāḍanaṃ darbhairvarmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ smṛtam |
astreṇa khananoddhārau hṛnmantreṇa prapūraṇam |
samīkaraṇamantreṇa secanaṃ varmaṇā matam |
kuṭṭanaṃ hetimantreṇa marmamantreṇa mārjanam |
vilepanaṃ kalārūpakalpanaṃ tadanantaram |
trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ paścāt hṛdayenārcanaṃ matam |
astreṇa vajrīkaraṇaṃ hṛnmantreṇa kuśaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
catuṣpathaṃ tanmantreṇa tanuyādakṣapāṭanam |
yāge kuṇḍāni saṃskuryāt saṃskārairebhirīritaiḥ |
śareṇa phaḍiti mantreṇa uttānena tu hastena prokṣayediti sūtradarśanāddhastāgreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ tenaiva phaḍitimantreṇaiva |
varmaṇā humitimantreṇa muṣṭibaddhena hastena secanābhyukṣaṇamiti |
hetimantreṇāstramantreṇa varmamantreṇeti caturṣu sambadhyate |
taduktaṃ somaśambhunā |
sammarjanaṃ samālepaṃ kalārūpaprakalpanam |
trisūtrīparidhānañca varmaṇābhyarcanaṃ hṛdeti |
kalārūpaprakalpanamiti candrasūryāgnikalākalpanamiti trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ iti sūtratrayeṇa veṣṭanam |
vajrīkaraṇamiti vajravaddṛḍhīkaraṇamiti |
kuśairiti prāgudagagraiḥ |
madhye catuṣpatharūpaṃ bhāgaṃ kṛtvā āvasathyādikaṃ bhāvayet |
taduktaṃ rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtena |
āvasathyaṃ madhyabhāge prācyāṃ satyantu paścime |
āhavanīyastato'nvāhāryaṃ dakṣiṇadeśataḥ |
gārhapatyañca mantrajño bhāvayeduttarakramāditi |
mantreṇa kavacamantreṇa humityanena akṣapāṭanamantreṇodghāṭanam |
ebhiḥ saṃskārairīritairmūlamantreṇa vīkṣaṇamityādikathitaiḥ kuṇḍāni saṃskuryādityanvayaḥ |
aśaktān pratyāha |
athavā tāni saṃskuryāccaturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ |
vīkṣaṇābhyukṣaṇāntaiśca caturbhirityarthaḥ |
tisrastisro likhedrekhā hṛdāprāgudagagragāḥ |
prāgagrāṇāṃ smṛtā devā mukundeśapurandarāḥ |
rekhānāmudagagrāṇāṃ brahmavaivasvatendavaḥ ||
tisrastisra iti vīpsayā prāgagrāstisra udagagrāstisra iti labhyate |
tataścādau prāgagrāṇāṃ likhanaṃ paścādudagrāṇāṃ likhanaṃ sarvāstu prādeśapramāṇā iti sāmpradāyikāḥ |
taduktaṃ rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtasautrāmaṇītantre ||
prācīsthamuttarasthañca paścimārambhamālikhet |
tisrastisro likhitvaivaṃ prokṣayedvāgbhavena ceti |
athavā ṣaṭkoṇavṛttaṃ trikoṇaṃ tatra saṃlikhet |
sarvāṇyabhyukṣya tāreṇa yogapīṭhamathārcayet |
atra tu ādhāraśaktītyādijñānātmāntaṃ sampūjya vāgīśvarayoryogapīṭhāya nama iti yogapīṭhaṃ pūjayet |
vāgīśvarīmṛtusnātāṃ nīlendīvarasannibhām |
vāgīśvareṇa saṃyuktāmupacāraiḥ prapūjayet |
śaktimantreṇa vāgīśīṃ sādhyamantreṇa vāgīśīṃ pūjayet |
taduktaṃ gaṇeśavimarṣaṇyām ||
śaktimantreṇa vāgīśīṃ vāgīśaṃ sādhyamantrata iti ||
śāradāyām ||
sūryakāntādisambhūtaṃ yadvā śrotriyagehajam |
ānīya cāgniṃ pātreṇa kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet |
sūryakāntādītyādiśabdādaraṇijanya iti labhyate |
taduktaṃ vaśiṣṭhasaṃhitāyām |
jātaṃ mārtaṇḍakāntāddhutavahamaraṇeḥ śrotriyāgārajaṃ vā āhitāgnergṛhādapīti |
pātreṇa kāṃsyapātreṇa pātrāntareṇāpihitena |
taduktaṃ rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtena yathā |
pātrāntareṇāpihite tāmrapātrādike śubhe |
agnipraṇayanaṃ kuryāt śarāve tādṛśe'pi ca |
yattu smṛtisāre ||
śarāve bhinnapātre ca kapāle conmukhe'pi vā |
nāgnipraṇayanaṃ kuryāt vyādhiṃ hāniṃ bhayāvahamiti |
tasya mukhamukhyapātrasambhave śarāvo na grāhya iti tātparyam |
kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet astramantreṇeti jñeyam |
taduktaṃ rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtena ||
astreṇāgniṃ samādhāya kavacena pidhāya tu |
kravyādāṃśantu cāstreṇa nair(-)ṛtyāṃ santyajet priye (!) |
anyatra tu vahnivījena kravyādāṃśatyāgaḥ |
taduktaṃ vahnibījena mantrī kravyādāṃśaṃ tyajettadanu ca manunā śodhayedastrakeṇa iti |
mantramuktāvalyāntu viśeṣaḥ |
ānīyāstreṇa nair(-)ṛtye kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet |
devāṃśaṃ mūlamantreṇa sthāpayet purataḥ sudhīriti |
saṃskuryāttaṃ yathā nyāyaṃ deśiko vīkṣaṇādibhiḥ |
audaryavaindavāgnibhyāṃ bhīmasyaikaṃ smaran vasoḥ |
yojayedvahnibījena caitanyaṃ pāvake tadā |
audaryeti binduḥ prasiddhaḥ paramātmasvarūpastasyāgnīṣomarūpatvāttayorvahnivaindava iti |
anye tu bindurbhrūmadhyaṃ tadbhavo vaindavaḥ |
vasoragnerbhaumasya pārthivasya ekamekaṃ smaran devāṃśaṃ niyojayet kuṇḍādiṣu nidadhyādityanvayaḥ |
nidhānaprakāramāha ||
tāreṇa mantrita mantrī dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtam |
astreṇa rakṣitaṃ paścāttanutreṇāvaguṇṭhanam |
arcitaṃ triḥ paribhrāmya kuṇḍasyopari deśikaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tadā tāramantroccāraṇapūrvakaḥ |
ātmano'bhimukhaṃ vahniḥ jānuspṛṣṭamahītalaḥ |
śivabījadhiyā devyā yonāvenaṃ vinikṣipet |
enamagnim |
paścāddevasya devyāśca dadyādācamanīyakam |
jvālayenmanunānena tamagnimatha deśikaḥ |
citpiṅgalahanadahapacayugmamudīrya ca |
sarvājñājñāpaya svāhāmantro'yaṃ prāgudīritaḥ |
jvālanena viśeṣo yathā rāghavabhaṭṭe |
juhuyuśca hutāgniśca pāṇisūrpasruvādibhiḥ |
na kuryādagnidhamanaṃ na kuryādvyajanādinā |
mukhe naiva dhamedagniṃ mukhadoṣo hi jāyate |
nāgniṃ mukhenetica yallaukike yojayanti tat ||
agnipraṇāmamantrastu |
agniṃ prajvalitaṃ vande jātavedaṃ hutāśanam |
suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ viśvatomukham |
upatiṣṭheta vidhivanmanunānena pāvakam |
vinyasedātmano dehe mantrairjihvāṃ havirbhujaḥ |
liṅgapāyuśirovaktraghrāṇanetreṣu sarvataḥ |
vahnīrārghīśasaṃyuktāḥ sādiyāntāḥ savindavaḥ |
varṇamantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā jihvānāṃ saptadeśikaiḥ ||
vahnīrephaḥ |
iro yakāraḥ |
arghīśa ukāraḥ |
etadyuktāḥ sādiyāntāḥ sakārādiyakārāntāḥ vaiparityenaite varṇāḥ savindavaḥ sapta jihvānāṃ sapta vindavo mantrāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ kathitā deśikairityarthaḥ |
sattvādiguṇabhedena saptajihvābhedamāha |
jihvāstāstrividhāḥ proktā guṇabhedena karmasu |
hiraṇyā gaganā raktā kṛṣṇānyā suprabhā matā |
bahurūpātiraktā ca sāttvikyo yogakarmasu |
parāgābhā suvarṇānyā tṛtīyā bhadralohitā |
lohitānantaraṃ śvetā dhūminī ca karālikā |
rājasyo rajasā vahneḥ vihitāḥ kāmyakarmasu |
viśvamūrtisphuliṅginyau dhūmravarṇā manojavā |
lohitānyā karālākhyā kālī tāmasya īritāḥ |
etāḥ sapta niyujyante krūrakarmasu mantribhiḥ ||
iti jihvābhedakathanam |
jihvānāṃ rūpatadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatāñcāha |
svasvanāma samābhāḥ syurjihvāḥ kalyāṇaretasaḥ |
amarttyapitṛgandharvayakṣanāgapiśācakāḥ |
rākṣasaḥ saptajihvānāmīritāścādhidevatāḥ |
amartyo devaḥ |
jihvāviśeṣe dravyaviśeṣahomo rāghavabhaṭṭādāvanusandheyaḥ |
vahneraṅgamanuṃ nyasyettamāvuktena vartmanā |
sahasrārciḥ svastipūrṇa uttiṣṭha puruṣaḥ punaḥ |
dhūmavyāpī saptajihvo dhanurddhara iti kramāt |
ṣaḍaṅgamanavaḥ proktā jātibhiḥ saha saṃyutāḥ |
sahasrārcirādīnāṃ caturthyantatvaṃ sampradānāt |
prayogastu |
oṃ sahasrārciṣe hṛdayāya nama ityādi jñeyam |
mūrtoraṣṭau tanau nyasyeddeśiko jātavedasaḥ |
mūrdhnāṃ pārśvakaṭyandhukaṭipārśvāṃsake punaḥ |
pradakṣiṇavaśānnyasyeducyante tā yathākramāt |
jātavedāḥ saptajihvo havyavāhanasaṃjñakaḥ |
aśvodarajasaṃjño'nyaḥ punarvaiśvānarādayaḥ |
kaumāratejāḥ syādviśvamukho devamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tārāgnaye padādyāḥ syūrnatyantā vahnimūrtayaḥ |
tāraḥ praṇavaḥ |
agnaye iti svarūpaṃ tenāgnyantena oṃ agnaye iti padamādau yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ |
prayoge tu mūrddhni oṃ agnaye jātavedase nama ityādyūhyam |
āsanaṃ kalpayitvāgnermūrtiṃ tasya vicintayet |
iṣṭaśaktiṃ svastikābhītimuccerdīrghairdorbhirdhārayantaṃ javābham |
hemakalpaṃ padmarāgaṃ trinetraṃ dhyāyedvahniṃ baddhamauliṃ jaṭābhiḥ |
pariṣiñcettatastoyairviśuddhairmaikhalopari |
darbhairagarbhairmadhyasthamekhalāyāṃ paristaret |
nikṣipeddikṣu paridhīn prācīvarjaṃ gurūttamaḥ |
prācīvarjaṃ dikṣu gurūttamaḥ paridhīnnikṣipedityanvayaḥ |
paridhayastu kātyāyanenoktā yathā |
paridhīn paridadhatyārdrān ekavṛkṣīyān bāhumātrān palāśavaikaṅkatavailvāniti |
prādakṣiṇyena sampūjyāsteṣu brahmādimūrtayaḥ |
dhyāyan vahniṃ yajenmadhye gandhādyairmanunāmunā |
vaiśvānarajātavedaḥ pade paścādihāvaha |
lohitākṣapadasyānte sarvakarmāṇi sādhaya |
vahnijāyāvadhiḥ prokto mantraḥ pāvakavallabhaḥ |
etat pūjanamaṣṭamūrtisaptajihvāpūjanāntaraṃ kāryam |
yadāha matsyasūkte daśamapaṭale |
athāgniyajanaṃ vakṣye sarvayajñeṣu bhūtidam |
ādau samīraṇaṃ kṛtvā paścāt pūjāṃ samācaret |
āsanaṃ pūjayitvā tu gṛhītvā raktapuṣpakam |
pātrāntarasthaṃ kusumaṃ dhyāyeddevaṃ hutāśanam ||
dhyānantu śāradoktasamānam |
yajet pūrvādipatreṣu |
haṃ jātavedase namaḥ, haṃ hutāśanāya namaḥ |
haṃ suvarṇavarṇāya namaḥ haṃ hiraṇyākhyāya namaḥ |
haṃ susiddhāya namaḥ |
haṃ hiraṇyāya namaḥ |
haṃ sarvatomukhāya namaḥ |
pūrvādipatreṣu |
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ prathamāṃ vahnerjihvāṃ mahādyutim |
varābhayakarāṃ vande hiraṇyākhyāṃ susiddhaye |
oṃ yyāṃ hiraṇyāyai namaḥ |
kanakāṃ dvibhujāṃ śuklāṃ hastābhyāṃ darbhasañcayān |
kamaṇḍaluñca bibhrāṇāṃ namaḥ sādhakasiddhidām oṃ yyāṃ kanakāyai namaḥ svāhā |
udyadindunibhāṃ varṇān caturbhirbhujapallavaiḥ |
śaṅkhacakrābhayavarān dadhatīṃ praṇamāmyaham |
oṃ raktāyai namaḥ svāhā |
suprabhā pāṇḍarā śvetakarābhyāñca kṛtāñjaliḥ |
padmāsanasthā nau śeṣarasanā māṃ prasīdatu |
suprabhāyai namaḥ svāhā |
oṃ bahurūpāyai namaḥ svāhā |
nīlotpalanibhe (!) devi (!) vahnivarṇe (!) surārcite |
(!) javārūpadhare (!) nityamitirūpe prasīda mām ||
oṃ yyaṃ yyaṃ abhirūpāyai namaḥ svāhā |
yadvā |
virephāvantimau vargau rephaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ svarasthitau |
indubinduśikhāyuktau jihvābījānyanukramāt || 7 ||
oṃ citpiṅgalahanahanadahadahapacapacasarvājñājñāpaya svāhā |
iti mantreṇa ca punaragniṃ sampūjayet sudhīḥ |
śāpacāre namaste'stu namaste havyavāhana (!) |
gavāntaka (!) suraśreṣṭha (!) śāntiṃ kuru namo'stu te ||
iti svāgatam || 1 ||
namaste bhagavan deva (!) āpo nārāyaṇātmaka (!) |
sarvalokahitārthāya pādyañca pratigṛhyatām |
iti pādyam || 2 ||
nārāyaṇaparaṃ nāma jyotīrūpa (!) sanātana (!) |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ viśvarūpa (!) namo'stu te ||
ityarghyam || 3 ||
jagadādityarūpeṇa prakāśayati yaḥ sadā |
tasmai prakāśarūpāya namaste jātavedase ||
ityācamanīyam || 4 ||
dhanañjaya (!) namaste'stu sarvapāpapraṇāśana (!) |
madhuparkaṃ prayacchāmi gṛhāṇa parameśvara (!) |
iti madhuparkaḥ || 5 ||
traiguṇyaviṣayādhāna tridhārūpa parātpara (!) |
trailokyasthitisaṃhatre vītihotrāya te namaḥ ||
iti punarācamanīyam || 6 ||
javāsindūrasaṅkāśaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
snānīyaṃ te mayā dattaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye ||
iti snānīyam || 7 ||
hutāśana (!) mahāvāho (!) devadeva sanātana (!) |
vasanante prayacchāmi dehi me paramaṃ padam ||
iti vastram || 8 ||
jyotiṣāṃ jyotīrūpastvamanādinidhanācyuta (!) |
mayā dattamalaṅkāramaṅkuru namo'stu te ||
ityalaṅkāraḥ || 9 ||
devīdevā mudaṃ yānti yasya samyak samāgamāt |
sarvadoṣopaśāntyarthaṃ gandho'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
iti gandhaḥ || 10 ||
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ hi brahmā ca jyotiṣāṃ patirīśvaraḥ |
gṛhāṇa puṣpaṃ deveśa (!) sānurūpaṃ jagadguro (!) ||
iti puṣpam || 11 ||
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāñca sukhamekaṃ sanātanam |
dhūpo'yaṃ devadeveśa (!) gṛhyatāṃ śrīdhanañjaya (!) ||
iti dhūpaḥ || 12 ||
tvāmekaṃ sarvabhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca |
paramāhuḥ parākāraḥ pradīpaḥ pratigṛhyatām || 13 ||
iti dīpaḥ ||
namo'stu yajñapataye prabhave jātavedase |
sarvalokahitārthāya naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
iti naivedyam || 14 ||
hutāśana (!) namastubhyaṃ namaste suravāhave (!) |
lokanātha (!) namaste'stu namaste jātavedase ||
iti vandanam || 15 ||
jihvāpūjāsthānamāha śāradāyām |
madhye īśvarakoṇeṣu jihvā jvālāruco yajet |
keśaroktena mārgeṇa pūjayedaṅgadevatāḥ |
paścādādāya pāṇibhyāṃ sruksruvau tāvadhomukhau |
triḥ sampratāpayedvahno darbhānādāya deśikaḥ |
tadagramūlamadhyāni śodhayettyeyākramāt |
gṛhītvā vāmahastena prokṣayeddakṣiṇe tanau |
punaḥ pratāpya tau mantrī darbhānagnau vinikṣipet |
ātmano dakṣiṇe bhāge sthāpayettau kuśāntare |
ājyasthālīmathādāya prokṣayedvastravāriṇā |
tasyāmājyaṃ vinikṣipya saṃskṛtaṃ vīkṣaṇādibhiḥ |
niruhya vāyavye'ṅgarān hṛdā teṣu niveśayet |
idaṃ tāpanamuddiṣṭaṃ deśikaistantravedibhiḥ |
sandīpya darbhayugalamājye kṣptvānale kṣipet |
gururhṛdayamantreṇa pavitrīkaraṇaṃ tvidam |
dīptena darbhayugmena nīrājyājyāt sa varmaṇā |
agnau visarjayeddarbhamabhidyotanamīritam |
ghṛteṣu jvalitān darbhān pradarśyāstrāṇunā guruḥ |
jātavedasi tānnyāsyedājyotpavanamīritam |
gṛhītvā ghṛtamaṅgārān pratyuhyāgnau jalaṃ spṛśet |
aṅguṣṭhopakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ darbhau prādeśasammitau |
kṛtvopanīyādastreṇa ghṛtamutpavanantvidam |
tadvad hṛdayamantreṇa kuśābhyāmātmasaṃmukham |
ghṛtesaṃplavanaṃ kuryāt saṃskārāḥ ṣaḍudīritāḥ |
prādeśamātraṃ sagranthidarbhayugmaṃ ghṛtāntare |
nikṣipya bhāgau dvau kṛtvā pakṣe śukletare smaret |
vāme nāḍīmiḍāṃ bhāge dakṣiṇe piṅgalāṃ punaḥ |
suṣumnāṃ madhyato dhyātvā kuryāddhomaṃ yathāvidhi |
atra sthānaviśeṣe homanindā matsyasūkte caturdaśapaṭale ||
yathā ||
karṇahome bhaved vyādhirnetre'ndhatvamudīritam |
nāsikāyāṃ manaḥpīḍā mastake ca dhanakṣayaḥ |
eteṣu pradhānāhutiparamanyathā śāradokto doṣaḥ syāt |
tadyathā |
sruveṇa dakṣiṇādbhāgādādāyājyaṃ sadā guruḥ |
juhuyādagnaye svāhetyagnerdakṣiṇalocane |
vāmatastadvadādāya vāme vahnivilocane |
juhuyādagnīṣomābhyāṃ svāheti hṛdayāṇunā |
hṛnmantreṇa sruveṇājyaṃ bhāgādādāya dakṣiṇāt |
juhuyādagnaye sviṣṭikṛte svāheti tanmukhe |
hetiṃ sampādayedbhāge svājyasyānnāhutikramāt |
ityagninetravaktrāṇāṃ kuryādudghāṭanaṃ guruḥ |
satārābhirvyāhṛtibhirājyena juhuyāt punaḥ |
juhuyādagnimantreṇa trivāraṃ deśikottamaḥ |
kuṇḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyāt paramaṃ prakṛtervapuḥ |
prācyāṃ śiraḥ samākhyātaṃ bāhuṃ dakṣiṇasaumyayoḥ |
jaṭharaṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniḥ pādau ca paścime |
garbhādhānādikā vahneḥ kriyā nirvartayet kramāt |
aṣṭābhirājyāhutibhiḥ praṇavena pṛthak pṛthak |
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ punaḥ |
anantaraṃ jātakarma syānnāmakaraṇaṃ tathā |
upaniṣkramaṇaṃ paścādannaprāśanameva ca |
cauḍopanayane bhūyo mahānāmnyaṃ mahāvratam |
mahānāmnyaṃ vedārambhaḥ ||
tathopaniṣadaṃ paścādgodānodvāhakau mṛtiḥ |
śubheṣu syurvivāhāntāḥ kriyāstāḥ krūrakarmasu |
maraṇāntāḥ samuddiṣṭā vahnerāgamavedibhiḥ |
tataśca pitarau tasya sampūjyātmani yojayet |
samidhaḥ pañca juhuyāt mūlāgraghṛtasaṃplutāḥ |
mantrairjihvāṅgamūrtīnāṃ kramādvahneryathāvidhi |
pratyekaṃ juhuyādekāmāhutiṃ mantravittamaḥ |
avadāya sruveṇājyaṃ catuḥsruci pidhāya tām |
sruveṇa tiṣṭhannevāgnau deśiko yatamānasaḥ |
juhuyādvahnimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena sampade |
vighneśvarasya mantreṇa juhuyādāhutīrdaśa |
sāmānyaṃ sarvatantrāṇāmetadagnimakhaṃ matam |
tataḥ pīṭhaṃ samabhyarcya devatāyai hutāśane |
arcayedvahnirūpāṃ tāṃ devatāmīṣṭadāyinīm |
tanmukhejuhuyānmantrī pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā |
ājyena mūlamantreṇa vaktraikīkaraṇantvidam |
vahnidevatayoraikyamātmanā saha bhāvayan |
mūlamantreṇa juhuyādājyenaikādaśāhutīḥ |
nāḍīsandhānamuddiṣṭametadāgamavedibhiḥ |
juhuyādaṅgamukhyānāmāvṛtīnāmanukramāt |
ekaikāmāhutiṃ samyak sarpiṣā deśikottamaḥ |
tato'nyeṣvapi kuṇḍeṣu saṃskṛteṣu yathāvidhi |
ācāryo viharedagniṃ pūrvādiṣa samāhitam |
ṛtvijo gandhapuṣpādyairaṅgādyāvaraṇānvitām |
tantroktāmetāmiṣṭvā ca pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā |
mūlenājyena juhuyuḥ sājyena caruṇā tathā |
āhutidānaprakāraśca matsyasūkte ||
uttānena tu hastena aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa pīḍitam |
saṃhatāṅgulipāṇistu juhuyāddeśikottamaḥ |
āhutistu ghṛtādīnāṃ sruveṇādhomukhena tu |
dadyāttilādyāhutiṃ tu daivenottānapāṇinā |
samiddhomaśca tilavanmodakādyāhutistathā |
aṅguṣṭhāditricaturairbilvapatra iti kramāt ||
dravyaviśeṣahome jihvāviśeṣo'pi tatraiva ||
ghṛtāhutau hiraṇyākhyā kanakā śasyahomataḥ |
raktā khyātā samiddhome kṛṣṇā sā āhutau tathā |
suprabhā modakavidhau bahurūpātirūpakā |
puṣpā patravidhau vahnerjihvāḥ sapta prakīrtitāḥ |
dravyālābhe pratinidhirapi tatraiva ||
uktaṃ na labhyate tatra pratikṛtyā ca homayet |
arkasyoḍumbaraṃ proktaṃ khadirasya śamīritā |
pippalasya palāśaḥ syāt palāśa syāpi pippalaḥ |
ubhayorevamevaṃ syādapāmārge palāśakam |
kuśābhāve bhaveddūrvā dūrvābhāve kuśo bhavet |
ikṣorabhāve tvamṛtā'mṛtāyāśca palāśakam |
padmābhāve hayāriḥ syājjalajānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
ghṛtaṃ na labhyate yatra śuddhakṣīreṇa homayet |
kṣīrasya tu dadhijñeyaṃ madhunaśca guḍaṃ bhavet |
śarkarāyāśca śrīkhaṇḍaṃ guḍakhaṇḍamathāpi vā |
rasānāñca rasenaiva sarvamikṣurasena vā |
modake piṣṭakaṃ jñeyaṃ phalānāñca phalena tu |
kāṣṭhasya caiva kāṣṭhena puṣpasya kusumena ca |
evamanyonyataḥ sarvaṃ sarvadravyeṣu sarvadā ||
adbhuteṣu tu sarveṣu uttarābhimukho bhavet |
samidhaḥ prāvaraṇaṃ kuryādanyatra pūrvadig bhavet |
yajamānaḥ svayaṃ naiva samidhaṃ pravayet kvacit |
putraśiṣyādibhiḥ kuryānna putraṃ viniyojayet ||
tathā ||
na kadācidasṛgdānaṃ gṛhayajñe vicakṣaṇaḥ |
bhūtikāmaḥ kvacit kuryādevaṃ tantravidāṃ matam |
ājyādikaṃ bhavedyatra samidhaḥ śrāvaṇe sthitam |
śeṣaṃ na yojayenmantrī anyatraivaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
ekāṅgaṃ lagnamekatra na pātre sthāpayet kvacit |
deśikaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā aiśānyādikrameṇa tu |
pradakṣiṇena kurvīta mantraiḥ parisamūhanam |
mantrapūrvaṃ sāgnikānāṃ dṛṣṭimeva niragnikam |
trikuśena mahāyāge vivāhādau tripatrakam |
vaiśvadeve tvekapatraṃ nityahome tathaiva ca |
digvidikṣu paristīrya mahāyāgeṣu sarvadā |
dikṣumātre nityahome vaiśvadeve tathaiva ca |
akṛtvā karma nityantu vṛthā naimittikaṃ caret |
tasmāt puṣpaphalādyena kṛtvā naimittikaṃ caret ||
tathā ||
prajāpatiṃ tathendrañca agniṃ somaṃ tathaiva ca |
etānnityāhutiṃ kṛtvā samiddhomamanantaram |
hutvā vyāhṛtibhiḥ paścāt sarvatraivaṃ maheśvari (!) |
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā tatra ityādimantrapañcakam |
ante sviṣṭikṛtiṃ dadyāddhomadravyeṇa śaṅkari (!) |
dānamadhye yajñabhede grahayajñe śatāntare |
saptabhede tvime pūrṇāḥ punaste ca tridhā kramāt |
ṛtvikskandhaṃ spṛśanmantrī dakṣiṇaṃ vā spṛśan bhujam |
yajamānaḥ sapatnīko juhuyāddeśikottamaḥ |
utthāya dadyāt pūrṇāñca nopaviśya kadācana |
kanakāyāntu jihvāyāṃ raktāyāṃ grahayajñake |
grahahomaśatānte ca pūrṇā ekā vidhīyate |
sahasrānte dvayaṃ kuryādayutānte caturthakam |
annahome yugaṃ dadyāt padmahome caturthakam |
ājyalājatilādīnāṃ home ca daśalakṣake |
panasāmraphalairhome dvitīyaṃ samudāhṛtam |
śatārddhe vā tadarddhe vā garbhādhānānnaprāśane |
sīmantonnayane caiva prāyaścittāhutiṣu ca |
dadhihome ca nitye ca eṣu pūrṇāṃ vivarjayet ||
atha homadravyapramāṇam matsyasūkte caturdaśapaṭale ||
karṣaikaṃ ghṛtahome tu dvitolañca payaḥ smṛtam |
vāṇatolaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tolakairmadhudugdhakam |
dadhi prasṛtimātrantu lājāḥ syurmuṣṭisammitāḥ |
pṛthukāṣṭapramāṇena athavā pūrvapūraṇam |
śaktavo muṣṭimātreṇa śarkarā tolakārddhakam |
tritolañca guḍaṃ vidyāddikṣupurvāvadhi smṛtam |
modakaṃ dhātrīmānañca mārgaṃ vadaramānataḥ |
piṇḍakasya yathā mānaṃ nārikelādiparvakam |
tālantu dvyaṅgulaṃ caiva panasaṃ bījasaṃkhyayā |
māraṇoccaṭane caiva panasaṃ daśadhā kṛtam |
aṣṭadhā nārikelantu mātuluṅgaṃ tridhā matam |
tridhā kṛtaṃ phalaṃ bailvamanyathā daśabhāgakam |
prādeśamātraṃ samidhaṃ dūrvāpatratrayaṃ smṛtam |
patrāvasānahome ca prādeśaṃ parikalpayet ||
samidviśeṣo yathā rāghavabhaṭṭe ||
viśīrṇā vidalā hrasvā vakrā sthūlā kṛśā dvidhā |
krimidaṣṭāśca dīrghāśca nistvacaḥ parivarjitāḥ |
viśīrṇāyuḥkṣayaṃ kuryādvidalā vyādhisambhavā |
hrasvāyāṃ vyādhimāpnoti vakrā vighnakarī sadā |
sthūlābhiharate lakṣmīṃ kṛśāyāṃ yājakakṣayaḥ |
dvidhāyāṃ netrarogāḥ syuḥ kīṭadaṣṭārthanāśinī |
doṣaṃ prakurvate dīrghāḥ prāṇaghnyo nistvacaḥ smṛtāḥ |
na kṣīṇā nādhikā nyūnāḥ samidhaḥ sarvakāmadāḥ |
ārdratvacāṃ samacchadāṃ tarjanyaṅgulivartulām |
īdṛśīṃ homayet prājñaḥ prāpnoti vipulāṃ śriyam |
śraute smārte catasroktāḥ samidhaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
matsyasūkte ||
caturaṅgulā ca guḍūcī vrīhayo muṣṭisammitāḥ |
sarṣapaṃ sūktimānena sūktiḥ syāt pañcatolakam |
marice viṃśakaṃ kṛtvā māraṇe daśakaṃ viduḥ |
daśadhā ca mṛṇālaṃ syānmūlakaṃ saptabhāgakam |
ekaikaśaḥ kaśeruśca śṛṅgaverāṅgulena tu |
mātuluṅgaṃ samaṃ kuryādannaṃ vyañjanasaṃyutam |
pūrvavadeva mānaṃ syāttaṇḍulaṃ caiva tatsamam |
candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṅkumādi ca |
nakule tu kulaṃ jñātvā kule dravyāntareṇa tu |
yathā yogo na gandhena rājyakāme viśeṣataḥ |
tintiḍībījamānena samuddiṣṭāni tāntrikaiḥ ||
yoginītantre'pi ||
karṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ sūktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam |
dadhi prasṛtimānantu tadarddhañca madhuspṛśam |
eṣāṃ vyāpārakaṃ vakṣye yathāvat śṛṇu pārvati (!) |
suvarṇāṣṭapramāṇena ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
payo bhavettadarddhena dadhi pañcasuvarṇakam |
dadhi caiva tadarddhena evaṃ mānavido viduḥ |
evaṃ śatasya mānantu prābalyaṃ vibhave sati |
pañcāśattatra jānīyāt sarvatraiva vicakṣaṇaḥ |
atha mānādhyāyaḥ ||
yoginītantre dvitīyabhāge ||
gavākṣamātre yadṛśyā arkaraśmestu lekhikā |
lekhikāṣṭau bhaveddhūlī dhūlayo'ṣṭau ca sarṣapaḥ |
sarṣapāṇāṃ catuṣkeṇa rattiketyabhidhīyate |
rattikānāṃ viṃśatiśca pādañca parikīrtitam |
tolikā tu catuṣpādaiścatustolaiḥ prasṛtikā |
prasṛtī dve karṣakañca dve karṣe tu palaṃ bhavet |
palārddhena bhavet sūktirdve sūktī guḍakaṃ matam |
vīramitrodayadhṛtahastihṛdayaprabandhe ||
jālāntarapraviṣṭāyāṃ sūryabhāsi yadīkṣyate |
rajastatparamāṇvākhyaṃ pramāṇaṃ prathamaṃ matam |
trasareṇurmatastaiśca paramāṇubhiraṣṭabhiḥ |
tairaṣṭabhirbhavellikhyo yūkā likhyaistathāṣṭabhiḥ |
yavo yūkābhiraṣṭābhiryavairaṣṭabhiraṅgulam |
muṣṭistāni ca catvāri dve ca muṣṭī dhanurgrahaḥ |
trimuṣṭiko vitastiḥ syādaratnau dve vitastike |
kiṣkurdvābhyāmaratnibhyāṃ dhanuḥ kiṣkudvayena ca |
sahasraṃ dhanuṣāṃ krośo gavyūtirdviguṇā tataḥ |
gavyūtayaśca catasro yojanaṃ kalpitaṃ kalā ||
matsyasūkte ṣoḍaśapaṭale tu ||
sarṣapāṇāṃ catuṣkeṇa māṣa ityabhidhīyate ||
atra māṣaḥ śasyavācakaḥ ||
māṣāṇāñcaiva tūryeṇa rattiketyabhidhīyate |
rattikānāṃ viṃśakañca pādañca parikīrtitam |
tolikā ca catuṣpādaiścatustolaiḥ prasṛtikā |
prasṛtī dve karṣakañca dve karṣe tu palaṃ bhavet |
paladvaye tu sūktiḥ syād dve sūktī dagdhakaṃ matam ||
[iti śrīprāṇatoṣiṇyāṃ caturthe kāmyakāṇḍe durgāmantrastutināma(-) māhātmyaśatanāmabalihomahomīyānukalpaparimāṇātmaka(-) durgotsavaprakaraṇarūpapuṣpakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paricchedaḥ] |
iṣṭadevīṃ namaskṛtya bhuktimuktipradāyinīm |
māsakṛtyamatho vakṣye viduṣāṃ parituṣṭaye ||
atha māsakṛtyam |
cāndra evātra māsastithikṛtyanimittatvādabhilāpādikantu saureṇaiva prāguktadharmakāṇḍadhṛtavacanāt |
matsyasūkte dvipañcāśatpaṭale ||
āśvine śuklapakṣe ca aṣṭamyāñca niśāgame |
siddhagaurīvrataṃ kuryād yā sādhvī dharmacāriṇī ||
iti siddhagaurīvratamasmin deśe apracaradrūpatvena na likhitam |
yasyātra prayojanaṃ vidyate tena tattu anveṣyam |
śuklapakṣe daśamyāntu āśvine parameśvari (!) |
vijayā nāma sā khyātā sarvatranigamālayam |
revantaṃ pūjayettatra īśvarīñca varānane (!) |
iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya yāsyanti śivamandiram |
tejo'sīti ca dvibhujaṃ turaṅgāsanasaṃsthitam |
khaḍgacarmadharañcaiva mantreṇānena pūjayet |
namaste sūryaputrāya turaṅgānāṃ hitāya ca |
śāntiṃ kuru turaṅgānāṃ revantāya namo namaḥ |
oṃ gandharvakulajātastvaṃ bhūpālāya ca keśava (!) |
brahmaṇastattvavāhyena somasya varuṇasya ca |
tejasā caiva sūryasya svalīlā te padā tathā |
rudrasya brahmacaryasya pavanasya balena ca |
dhānyakaṃ paśukaṃ vījaṃ dhyānaṃ siddhārthakāni ca |
padmapatraṃ niśānte ca sūtreṇa dviguṇena ca |
badhnīyādakṣamālāyāṃ gale cāpi viśeṣataḥ |
astraśastrādikañcaiva rājyāṅgāni ca bhāvini (!) |
prativījena puṣpādyaiḥ pūjayedavicārayan ||
atha khañjanadarśanaṃ tatraiva ||
daśamyāmaparāhṇe tu bhuktavatsu svayaṃ priye (!) |
śobhanaṃ khañjanaṃ paśyan namaskuryādvibhūtaye |
vāsudevasvarūpeṇa sarvakāmaphalaprada (!) |
pṛthivyāmavatīrṇo'si khañjarīṭa (!) namo'stu te |
khañjanāya namastubhyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāya ca |
nīlakaṇṭhāya bhadrāya bhadrarūpāya te namaḥ |
bhadra (!) tvaṃ dehi me bhadramāśāṃ pūraya pūraka (!) |
svastiko'si kuru svasti khañjarīṭa (!) namo'stu te |
nārāyaṇasvarūpātha saṃvatsarasukhaprada (!) |
nīlakaṇṭha (!) mahādeva (!) khañjarīṭa (!) namo'stu te |
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ puṣṭivardhanam |
darśanaṃ tava bhadrasya viṣṇurūpa (!) namo'stu te |
atha darśanaśubhāśubhaphalam ||
jalaprāsādaśikhare parvate ca jalāntike |
dṛṣṭe śubhaṃ bhavet kīrtirgoṣṭheṣu dhanavardhanam |
abjeṣu nṛpatirbhūyāttathā devālayeṣu ca |
taḍāgatīre dhanavān śmaśāne maraṇaṃ bhavet |
kṛṣṇagrīvo nīlakaṇṭhaḥ śvetakaṇṭho janārdanaḥ |
pīte tu pārvatī devī dhunvatpakṣe tu vīkṣaṇam |
vyādhirbhavati deveśi (!) sthire sampattikārakam |
bhaktaṃ bhuñjan bhavedrogī śriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca vāsavaḥ |
sumānaḥ kīrtanādeva āyuṣastu kṣayo bhavet |
tasmāttu khañjanaṃ nāma kīrtayedavicārayan ||
tatraiva ||
kaumudyāṃ rātriyoge tu gṛhiṇī yā pativratā |
indraṃ lakṣmīṃ samabhyarcya sugandhikusumādibhiḥ |
pāyasañca baliṃ dadyādannaṃ vyañjanasaṃyutam |
nārikelaphalairdevān pitṝnatha samarcayet |
bandhūṃśca pūjayedrātrau prakuryāt krayavikrayam |
na karoti mahālakṣmīḥ śāpaṃ dattvā vrajet puram |
niśīthe varadā lakṣmīḥ ko jāgarti vibhāṣiṇī |
nārikelodakaṃ pītvā akṣairjāgaraṇaṃ niśi |
tadvibhūtiṃ prayacchāmi ko jāgarti mahītale |
somañca pūjayet kumbhe paṭṭe vā pīṭhakeṣu ca ||
atha lakṣmīdhyānaṃ tatraiva ||
navayauvanasampannāṃ taptakāñcanasannibhām |
trinetrāṃ dvibhujāṃ ramyāṃ divyakuṇḍaladhāriṇīm |
śrīphalaṃ dakṣiṇe pāṇau vāme padmañca bibhratīm |
sarvālaṅkārasampūrṇāṃ sarvālaṅkāragarvitām |
kinnarāmaragandharvasiddhacāraṇasevitām |
vījena dīrghayuktena ṣaḍaṅgamatha kalpayet |
pūjayedupacārādyairnānānaivedyavandanaiḥ ||
pūjāmantrastu tatraiva ||
kṣīrodārṇavasambhūte (!) viṣṇorurasi saṃsthite (!) |
gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ deveśi (!) kaumudyāñca namo'stu te |
praṇāmamantrastu |
viśvarūpasya bhāryāsi padme (!) padmālaye (!) śubhe (!) |
mahālakṣmi (!) namastubhyaṃ kaumudīñca kurusva me |
namaste sarvajagatāṃ varadāsi haripriye (!) |
yā gatistvatprapannānāṃ sā me bhūyāt tvadarcanāt |
lakṣmi (!) devi (!) namastubhyamacalā bhava sarvadā |
kamale (!) varade (!) devi (!) kulodyotakarī mama |
hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā nārāyaṇe sthitā |
tathā tvaṃ pāhi māṃ devi (!) sarvalakṣaṇasambhave (!) |
kṛtā pūjā mayā bhaktyā kamale (!) varade (!) śubhe (!) |
pūjāṃ gṛhṇa sureśāni (!) namaste kamalālaye (!) |
pūrvādipatre sampūjya bhūtyādinavaśaktikāḥ |
vāsudevādikaṃ tatra vāmanādikamarcayet |
tatraiva kalase caiva indraṃ dhyātvā samarcayet |
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇamindramairāvatasthitam |
śacīsametaṃ varadaṃ dhyānena paricintayet |
pūjāmantro'pi ||
vajrahasta (!) mahāvāho (!) bahunetra (!) purandara (!) |
rakṣārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām |
dikpālāṃśca grahāṃścaiva brāhmaṇāṃścāgrato'rcayet |
viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇañcaiva bhāvabhūteśvaraṃ yajet |
pūjayitvā hyanenāpi vilvamudrāṃ pradarśayet |
padmamudrāṃ dhenumudrāṃ mantraṃ japtvā stutiṃ paṭhet ||
ityāśvinakṛtyam ||
tripañcāśatpaṭale ||
śrībhagavānuvāca ||
tulārāśiṃ gate bhānau śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ |
pratipadyeva gośṛṅge pūjayet kamalālayām |
upoṣya yāvakāhāraṃ baliṃ dadyācca pāyasam |
kundapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya sarvapāpaharo bhavet |
tatraiva pūjayeddevīṃ mahiṣeṇa mama priye (!) |
dūrvayāṅkarapuṣpābhyāṃ pūjayejjagatāṃ patim |
śālyodanaṃ tato bhuktvācamya gatvā jalāntike |
ghṛtañca dvividhaṃ kuryāt palaṃ kṛtvā maheśvari (!) |
jayaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tasya bhaṅge bhaṅgaṃ samādiśet |
vibhīṣaṇaṃ baliñcaiva sīmañca parameśvaram |
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyairnānānaivedyavandanaiḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tathā kuryāddampatīpūjanañcaret |
madhumāṃsāśanaṃ kuryādekabhaktena vartayet |
śuklapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ dharmarājaṃ samarcayet |
caruṃ kṛtvā vidhānena sodarānatha bhojayet |
aiśvaryaṃ labhate saukhyaṃ bahubhogānavāpnuyāt |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tathā lakṣmīṃ kundapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
kṛṣṇadravyabaliṃ tadyāttasmai vittaṃ prayacchati |
tṛtīyāyāṃ gaṇeśañca pūjayet piṣṭakādinā |
vartayedekabhaktena na śoko jāyate bhuvi |
caturthyāṃ modakairdevīṃ pūjayet kuśalārthakam |
dadhikhaṇḍabaliṃ dadyādvāñchitaṃ labhate dhruvam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe pratipadi devīṃ māheśvarīṃ yajet |
sitapārāvataiḥ pūjā bhūtidā jāyate dhruvam |
pañcamyāṃ vilvapatraiśca haraṃ gaurīṃ samarcayet |
baliñca modakaṃ dadyādvidyākāmaḥ sureśvari (!) |
kṣīrasya prāśanādeva pāpāt pūto na saṃśayaḥ |
pañcamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ haram |
mahāyonau samabhyarcya kulānāṃ tārayeddaśa ||
mahāyonau kāmākhyāyāṃ ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai śuklapakṣasya devaṃ dhanapatiṃ yajet |
yo janaḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ dadyānmodate nākamaṇḍale |
saptamyāṃ saṃyato bhūtvā ubhe pakṣe tu kārtike |
devaṃ matsyaṃ tathā kāmamindradevaṃ prapūjayet |
brāhmaṇān dampatīṃ caiva bhojayet prātareva ca |
phalamūlaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ pradadyāt dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām |
na ca vyādhiḥ kṣudhā vāpi kule tasya prajāyate |
aṣṭamyāñcaiva deveśi (!) śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ |
durgāṃ mattānilīñcaiva kṛṣṇakhaḍge samarcayet |
trikālaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā yaśasvī tejavān bhavet |
kṛṣṇapakṣe śivaṃ durgāṃ kamalāṃ kālikāṃ tathā |
mṛṇamayyāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ madhyarātre prayatnataḥ |
na ca vyādhibhayaṃ ghoraṃ yāvattu vatsarāvadhi ||
vṛhannīlatantre ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
kārtike śuklapakṣasya navamī yā śubhā bhavet |
tasyāṃ pūjyā maheśāni (!) sundarī paradevatā |
sundaryāḥ paṭale samyak pūjā ca kathitā śubhe (!) ||
matsyasūkte ||
śuklapakṣe navamyāntu tilairhomaṃ samācaret |
devamuddiśya phaladamuparyupari pañcame |
kṛṣṇe caiva yajeddevīṃ saptamyāṃ sūryamarcayeta |
dhanadhānyalakṣmīkaraṃ putrapautravivarddhanam |
kārtikasya tu śuklāyāṃ daśamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
tailena śuddhatailena arcayenmadhusūdanam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu kṣīreṇa madhunā ca viśiṣyate |
rātrau phalāśanaṃ kuryānmodate viṣṇumandire |
kṛṣṇapakṣe'rccayet kṛṣṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ śatakratum |
toṣayet paramānnādyairnarī na nirayaṃvrajet |
ekādaśyāṃ kārttikasya śuklapakṣe yaśasvini (!) |
snānaṃ śuklatilaiḥ kuryāttriśuklairharimarccayet |
prātareva tu dvādaśyāṃ nityakṛtyaṃ samāhitaṃ |
saṅkalpya ca gaṇeśānaṃ brahmāṇaṃ dikpatīnapi |
grahāṃśca pratikumbheṣu sthaṇḍile ca hariṃ yajet |
pañcāmṛtena gandhena tīrthatoyena snāpayet |
pūjayeccyutapatrādyaiḥ kumudaiḥ paṅkajairapi |
śāradīyena puṣpeṇa yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ |
trikālaṃ cārcayedbhaktyā agnikāryyaṃ tato niśi |
prabodhanaṃ tataḥ kuryānmadhyāhne parameśvari (!) |
divā snāne bhaveddhānistathā rātrau prabodhane |
ādye aṣṭākṣaraṃ dadyāt pratimantre maheśvari (!) |
kṛtāñjaliṃ tato baddhvā imaṃ mantramudāharet |
brahmendrarudrairabhinūyamāno bhavān suraughaiśca vivandanīyaḥ |
prāptā taveyaṃ dvādaśī kaumudyākhyā tvameva jāgṛṣva hi lokanātha (!) |
tataḥ spṛṣṭvā paṭhenmantrī śanairmantraṃ paṭhettataḥ |
