meghāgatairnirmmalacandratoyairāraṇyapuṣpairatha saurabheyaiḥ |
ahaṃ dadāmīti ca dharmahetoḥ jāgṛṣva jāgṛṣva ca lokanātha (!) |
jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā paṭhenmantraṃ satārakam |
prasīda nārāyana (!) kṛṣṇa (!) viṣṇo (!) mukunda (!) lakṣmīśa (!) bhavannamaste |
sampaśya lakṣmīṃ tava bhāvabhūtimāśritya cāśritya ca lokanātha (!) |
nṛtyagītairbahuvidhaiḥ purāṇaśravaṇena ca |
nayedrātriṃ maheśāni (!) pañcaghoṣapuraḥsaram |
prabhāte pūjayedbhaktyā dhenuṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇām |
brāhmaṇān pūjayedbhaktyādīnāndhakṛpaṇānapi |
pārśvaparivartane caiva mantramaṣṭākṣarāntare |
pārśvo bhava jagannātha (!) namo nārāyaṇācyuta (!) |
prasīda bhagavannātha (!) bhava saṃsāramākṣaṇa (!) |
parivarttaya pārśvo'pi govindācyuta (!) tadvayam |
divābhāgena karttavyaṃ pūrvavad vidhinā priye (!) |
kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇatarpaṇam |
śuklāyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pārvatyā saha śaṅkaram |
vilvapatraiḥ samabhyarcya na śoko jāyate bhuvi |
atha kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ kārttike māsi śaṅkari (!) |
prātaḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā srotasi vidhivannaraḥ |
umāṃ haraṃ raviṃ viṣṇuṃ candanena vilikhya ca |
padmapatrairmaheśāni (!) vilvapatraiḥ samarcayet |
śākena toṣayeddevān svayaṃ śākena varttayet || tathā |
madhyāhne snāpayet kumbhaṃ vasanaṃ tatra vinyaset |
abhiṣiñcettataḥ paścādātmānaṃ bāndhavaiḥ saha |
apāmārgasya puṣpeṇa trivāraṃ śirasopari |
vāmāvarttena deveśi (!) apāmārgasya patrakam |
vakṣyamāṇena vā kuryād gāyatryā vā samāhitaḥ |
yat kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ karma mayā janmaśatānyapi |
vyāpyādya tvatprasādena apāmārga (!) harasvame |
saṃhitākhyāñca puṇyākhyāṃ pretākhyānāntareṇa ca |
śrutvā saṃkhyāṃ dvijātibhyo dānaṃ dadyādvibhūtaye |
caturdaśī tathā pretā pūjyā pūrveṇa saṃyutā |
yadā paradine rātrau darśayuktā na sā bhavet |
evametat paraṃ grāhyaṃ nithyante dīpamutsṛjet |
devairapi nivṛtte cet pūrṇimā sacaturdaśī |
tadā pūrvā grahītavyā sadā rātrigatā api |
snāne pretakathāyāśca śravaṇe yamatarpaṇe |
sūryodayagatā grāhyā naraiḥ pretacaturdaśī |
ekādaśīṃ samārabhya yāvat pañcadarśīṃ prati |
nirāmiṣeṇa bhoktavyamekabhaktena varttayet |
bhīṣmavratamidaṃ proktaṃ sāvakāśena sevayet |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tulāditye śrīpatiṃ lolayā saha |
candanaiḥ pūjayedbhaktyā kulacchedo bhavenna hi |
tulāgataṃ samāvāpya lakṣmīrnidrāṃ vimuñcati |
tatra sampūjanādeva lakṣmīḥ syādanapāyinī |
śvetakumbhe'rcayellakṣmīṃ kuveraṃ raktakumbhake |
pītakumbhe'rcayedviṣṇuṃ nānānaivedyavandanai ||
nāradapañcarātre dvitīyarātre saptamādhyāye ||
kārtikīpārṇamāyāñca rādhārccā vuṣṇupūjanam |
yatra tatra tvaniyamaḥ para nirvāṇakāraṇam ||
matsyasūktaṃ ||
kadācit kārtike māsi yadi darśadvayaṃ bhavet |
tatrādyā sukharātriḥ syādaparastu malimlu caḥ |
malimluce vṛścike tu vuṣṇūtthānādanantaram |
lakṣmīprabodho bhavati sā jñeyā sukhasuptikā |
daṇḍaikarajanīyogo darśena syāt pare'hani |
tadā vihāya pūrvedyuḥ parataḥ sukharātrikā |
tatra śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ yena akṣayaṃ bhavati dhruvam |
śatagrahaṇajaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthe snānaṃ mahāphalam |
iṣṭadevaṃ samuddiśya pitṝnuddiśya yatnataḥ |
jīvitañcet samuddiśya dīpaṃ dadyāt śivālaye |
āyuṣkāmo hi deveśi (!) dīpaṃ dadyāccatuṣpathe |
dvātriṃśattu samutmṛjya pañcaviṃśatikaṃ priye (!) |
ākāśadīpaṃ dadyāttu navapañcayugena vā |
tridīpaṃ pañcadīpañca ekaṃ vā dāpayedbudhaḥ |
arghyañcaiva vahan jantūn jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
trihastaṃ sārddhahastaṃ vā hastamātramathāpi vā |
ūrddhe tu dāpayeddīpān labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam |
śire vakṣaḥsthale caiva aṅge vā maṇibandhake |
yo dīpaṃ darśayeddevi (!) svargaloke mahīyate |
kamalāṃ hlādinīñcaiva dharaṇīṃ vijayāṃ tathā |
jayāṃ lakṣmīṃ subhadrāñca mahāmāyāṃ dale'rcayet |
brahmādīn pūjayedagre vāsudevādikānapi |
śaṅkhaṃ padmanidhiṃ pūjet kuveraṃ varuṇaṃ tathā |
indrāṇīmaya sampūjya mantreṇānena saṃyajet |
namaste ityādi | viśvarūpasyetyādi |
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ varadāsi haripriye (!) |
sarvānandakare (!) devi (!) sarvaśākhe (!) namo'stute |
lole (!) devi (!) namaste'stu narakārṇavatāriṇi (!) |
kṣīrodamathanodbhūte (!) prasīda parameśvari (!) |
jaya padmālaye (!) devi (!) jaya lakṣmi (!) haripriye (!) |
sarvānandakare (!) devi (!) sarvaśākhe (!) namo'stu te |
jaya kṣīrodaduhitarmadgehe susthirā bhava |
iyaṃ sāṃvatsarī pūjā naivedyādikamuttamam |
lole (!) gṛhītvā tatsarvaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvari (!) |
dīpadānāntare caiva mantrametamudīrayet |
dāmodarāya nabhasi tulāyāṃ lolayā saha |
pradīpaṃ te prayacchāmi namo'nantāya vedhase |
ūrddhvataḥ sapta lokā ye ye cādhovarttinaḥ sadā |
dattākāśapradīpena prakāśaṃ vicarantute |
ye ca nārakiṇo lokāḥ pīḍayā bādhitāḥ sadā |
bhavasthāste prakāśantu dattākāśapradīpataḥ |
andhakāre sthitā ye ca ye ca lokavivarjitāḥ |
teṣāṃ prakāśanārthāya pradīpo dīyate mayā |
yamadvāre mahāghore santi ye puruṣā mama |
teṣāṃ prakalpitārthāya pradīpo dīyate mayā |
vātavarṣapataṅgādisnehavarttikṣayādinā |
nirvāṇasya pradīpasya na doṣo mama keśava (!) |
namaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pretebhyo namo dharmāya viṣṇave |
namo dharmāya rudrāya kāntārapataye namaḥ |
īśakoṇe pradadyāttu mālaye vijane'pi ca |
ulkā niśi tathā deyā dakṣiṇābhimukhena tu |
nikṣipettatra prathamaṃ mantreṇānena śaṅkari (!) |
ulkāmukhāśca ye keciccaranti iha bhūtale |
ujjvalajyotiṣā dagdhāsteṣāntu paramā gatiḥ |
āpado mama naśyantu mukharātriprasādataḥ |
ulkāsandīpanenaiva varddhantu mama pūruṣāḥ |
kārtikasya amāyāṃ vai samārabhya yaśasvini |
kālarātrivrataṃ kuryād yathākāryaṃ tathā śṛṇu |
vratavidhyādistu tripañcāśatpaṭale'nusandheyaḥ ||
iti kārttikakṛtyam ||
tatraiva catuḥpañcāśatpaṭale ||
vṛścike śuklapakṣasya pratipatsu maheśvaram |
dūrvāṅkuraiḥ samabhyarcya gaṇanāmīśvaro bhavet || 1 ||
dvitīyāyāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ jale sampūjyayatnataḥ |
ekāhāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tṛtīyāyāṃ janārdanam |
caturthyāñcaiva śrīkāntamekādaśyāṃ janārdanam |
dvādaśyāñcaiva brahmāṇaṃ trayodaśyāṃ śatakratum |
caturdaśyāñca gaurīśaṃ sitapadmaiḥ samarccayet |
śvetāmbaradharo bhūtvā trikālaṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
madhunā tarpayeddevān brahmaloke mahīyate |
vṛścike paurṇamāsyāntu kalyamutthāya vāgyataḥ |
pūjayet kṣetravighneśaṃ pañcamyāṃ kamalāṃ tathā |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vasuṃ samabhyarcya saptamyāñca divākaram |
aṣṭamyāṃ tripurāñcaiva navamyāṃ surasundarīm |
durgāṃ bālāṃ samuddiśya ekabhaktena varttayet |
daśamyāñcaiva tāṃ devīṃ dikpatīṃścāpi pūjayet |
savitāraṃ snāpayitvā devān rātrau baliṃ caret |
vṛhannīlatantre ṣaṣṭhapaṭale ||
mārge māsi site pakṣe saptamī ravivallabhā |
annadāṃ pūjayedbhaktyā putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
lakṣmīḥ sthirāyate'vaśyaṃ yāvacca sacarācaram |
tāvattasya gṛhe lakṣmīścauddhatyaṃ parivarjayet |
niścalā ca bheddevi (!) satyaṃ satyaṃ gaṇeśvari (!) |
pūjā cāsyā maheśāni (!) kathitā tava sannidhau |
annadākalpake samyag jānīhi naganandini (!) |
matsyasūkte ||
vṛścike paurṇamāsī tu vijñeyā kṣetrapūrṇimā |
dvāpare pūrṇimā pauṣe tretāyāṃ māghamāsake |
balibhirguḍakhaṇḍaiśca pūjayitvā dvijottamam |
alakṣmīṃ nāśayeddātā lakṣmīñca labhate parām |
yāvakaiḥ śarkarādyaiśca modakairvividhairapi |
kṣetrapūrṇimāmārabhya trirātraṃ parameśvari (!) |
kṛtvā naktaṃ maheśāni (!) viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
surayajñamidaṃ proktaṃ mahāvibhavadāyakam |
dhanadhānyalakṣmīkaraṃ śrīsaubhāgyapradāyakam |
kṛṣṇapratipadi viṣṇuṃ pūjayet pārvatīpatim |
agnikāryaṃ trikālañca lakṣmīvān jāyate kule |
dvitīyāyāṃ guḍaṃ prāśya pūjayet sundarīmapi |
tṛtīyāyāñca govindaṃ tilaṃ prāśya tato niśi |
caturthyāṃ yāvakāhāro madanañca niśāpatim |
dadhi prāśya tato rātrau śivaloke mahīyate |
pañcamyāṃ dinanāthañca viṣṇuñca lolayā saha |
pūjayet pīvare kumbhe kṣīraṃ prāśya labhet śriyam |
pūjayeccaiva govindaṃ gavāmapyadhipo bhavet |
saptamyāñca tathāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ vijitendriyaḥ |
dhanādhyakṣaṃ śvetakumbhe trikālaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
mahāvibhavamāpnoti lakṣmīḥ syādanapāyinī |
nādeyatoye deveśi (!) kṛṣṇapakṣe jagadgurum |
citrapaṭṭe samabhyarcya kṣīraṃ prāśya tato niśi |
aṇimādiguṇaiḥ siddhirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
daśamyāñca maheśāni (!) ekādaśyāṃ śatakratum |
dvādaśyāṃ keśavaṃ mūle trayodaśyāñca pārvati (!) |
caturdaśyāmaśokena kāmaṃ viṣṇuṃ samarccayet |
trikālaṃ snānamāsādya ekabhaktena varttayet |
evaṃ kṛtvā sakṛddevi (!) brahmaloke mahīyate |
amāvasyāyāṃ gomukhye gale vipramukhe gale |
gokṣīreṇa caruṃ kṛtvā pitṝnuddiśya śaṅkari (!) |
madhunā guḍakhaṇḍena lavaṇenodakena ca |
trikālaṃ tarpayitvā tu kāmamāpnotyabhīpsitam |
aiśvaryamatulaṃ prāpya pitṛloke mahīyate ||
ityāgrahāyaṇakṛtyam ||
tatraiva ||
dhanuḥsthe ca tataḥ sūrye śuklapakṣe varānane (!) |
pratipadi maheśāni (!) prātaḥsnāyī jitendriyaḥ |
trikālaṃ pūjayet sūryyaṃ rogānmucyeta nānyathā |
kṛṣṇapakṣe jagannāthaṃ pūjayet pārvatīpatim |
agnikāryyaṃ tataṃ kṛtvā tato mucyeta bandhanāt |
dvitīyāyāṃ samārabhya śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ |
ādityamatha rudrāṃśca pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ |
yāvat pañcadaśīñcaiva tāvadeva maheśvari (!) |
saṃsārānmucyate devi (!) nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
caturthyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu dhanūrāśiṃ gate ravau |
ekabhaktena deveśi (!) rameśaṃ prati pūjayet |
kṛṣṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ viṣṇuṃ pañcamyāṃ madhusūdanam |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ skandaṃ viśākhāñca rātrau tu kṣīrabhojanam |
saptamyāñca tathāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ pakṣayordvayoḥ |
kātyāyanīṃ samabhyarcya ekabhaktena śaṅkari (!) |
daśamyāṃ pārvatīnāthamekādaśyāṃ śriyaḥ patim |
piṣṭakaiḥ pūjayeddviṣṇuṃ svayaṃ naktaṃ samācaret |
yāvaccaturdaśīṃ prāpya amāvāsyāñca pretyaṣe |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tataḥ kalpe pitṝnuddiśya tarpayet |
puroḍāśena vidhinā kadācinnāvasīdati ||
iti pauṣakṛtyam ||
tatraivaṃ pañcāśatpaṭale ||
śrībhagavānuvāca ||
makarasthe sahasrāṃśau śuklapakṣe yaśasvini (!) |
pratipadi sarittoye snātvābhyacya janārdanam |
vattayedekabhaktena agnikāryyapuraḥsaram |
kṣīreṇāghyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ mucyate śokasāgarāt |
dvitīyāyāṃ tathā śakraṃ candanena vilipya ca |
pīṭhe vā'gurupatre ca pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ |
haviṣyāśī bhavedrātrau rūpavānabhijāyate |
tṛtīyāyāmumākāntaṃ śrīpatiṃ kamalālayām |
samabhyarcya niśānāthaṃ kundapuṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ |
mudgañca prāśanaṃ kuryānmahāpātakanāśanam |
caturthyāṃ śuklapakṣasya pūjayedgaṇanāyakam |
tāmrakumbhe viśeṣeṇa pañcaratnena śaṅkari (!) |
tilān samprāśayedrātrau tilairhomaṃ samācaret |
lakṣmīvān mutarāṃ cāpi dhanavān sa prajāyate |
pañcamyāñca jagaddhātrīṃ prātareva nadījalaiḥ |
snāpayitvā sulakṣmīṃ tāṃ kumbhairmārakatairapi |
vasantapañcamī nāma sarvapāpapramocanī |
vasantañca samabhyarcya kandarpaṃ saratiṃ priye (!) |
vasantarāgaśravaṇāt śriyamāpnotyabhīpsitām |
śrīpañcamīṃ tu kecittāṃ manayaḥ pravadanti vai |
varttayedekabhaktena śriyo na vicyutirbhavet |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaḥ kṛtasnānaḥ pūjayecca divākaram |
kṣīreṇārghyaṃ tato dadyānmucyate vyādhibandhanāt |
sūryagrahaṇatulyā hi śuklā māghasya saptamī |
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ tasyāṃ snānaṃ mahāphalam |
vadaryāścārkapatrasya sapta patrāṇi śālijān |
raktāṃśca taṇḍulān dūrvāḥ kṛtvā śirasi majjayet |
oṃ yadyajjanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mayā saptasu janmasu |
tanme rogañca śokañca mākarī hantu saptamī |
saptārkapatrairaktaiśca taṇḍulairgandhacandanaiḥ |
phalairdūrvājavāpuṣpairarghyaṃ dadyāt kṛtakriyaḥ |
saptasaptiprītivahe (!) saptalokapradīpani (!) |
saptavyāhṛtike (!) devi (!) namaste ravimaṇḍale |
jananī sarvabhūtānāṃ saptamī saptasaptike (!) |
saptavyāhṛtike (!) devi (!) namaste ravimaṇḍale |
dānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ homaṃ jāpaṃ surārcanam |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca haviṣyānnaṃ svayaṃ tataḥ |
tīrthe snānaṃ daśaguṇaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ koṭireva ca |
ravivāre ca samprāpte koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet |
dadyādarghyaṃ sahasrañca śataṃ vāpi tadarddhakam |
ayutena labheddāsyaṃ lakṣaiḥ sāyujyameva ca |
aśakto dvādaśaṃ dadyāt pañcaviṃśamathāpi vā |
dviguṇatvānmaheśāni (!) vratāṅge'rghya mudāhṛtam |
bhajedravidine prāpte pravṛtte cottarāyaṇe |
punnāmadheyanakṣatre gṛhṇīyāddaśamīvratam |
hasto mitrastathā puṣyo jyeṣṭhā bhṛgupunarvasū |
punnāmadheyanakṣatrāṇyetānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ |
saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu kṛtakṛtyaḥ samāhitaḥ |
pārvatīśaṃ gaṇeśañca pūjayeddayitayā saha |
trikālaṃ pūjayitvā tu tilapāyasamodakaiḥ |
tato naktaṃ carenmantrī haviṣyānnena śaṅkari (!) |
yat kṛtaṃ dvādaśāṣṭamyāmekenaiva tu tat phalam |
bhavettasmāt prayatnena sarvasvenāpi bhāvini (!) |
pitṝnuddiśya yat śrāddhaṃ yaḥ karoti svabhaktitaḥ |
sarvaśrāddhe yat phalañca kāṅkṣantisma na saṃśayaḥ |
pitṛtarpaṇataḥ śeṣe sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ |
tilodakantu bhīṣmāya pradadyādañjalitrayam |
vāmopavītinā devi (!) dakṣiṇāśāmukhena tu |
dadyādanena mantreṇa śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
ehi bhīṣma (!) mahābāho (!) śāntanoḥ kulanandana (!) |
gṛhāṇa dattamasmābhiḥ pānīyaṃ varado bhava |
vaiyāghrapadyagotrāya sāṅkatiḥ pravarāya ca |
aputrāya dadāmyetat salilaṃ bhīṣmavarmaṇe |
madhyāhnavyāpinī grāhyā śrāddhe bhīṣmāṣṭamī sadā |
snāne ca tarpaṇe dāne grāhyā sūryodayāt parā |
yadyekasmiṃstu vai māsi yadi svānmākarīdvayam |
bhīṣmāṣṭamī bhavedvāpi tadā grāhyā parā tithiḥ |
navamyāntu jagaddhātrīṃ gaurīṃ kamalayā saha |
śrīvṛkṣe pūjanādeva mahatīṃ śrīyamāpnuyāt |
daśamyāmatha naktāśo saptamīṃ saptakumbhake |
pūjayenmarupatraiśca nānāvibhavavistaraiḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayedbhaktyā ṛṣiṃ sampūjya vaiṣṇavam |
toṣayedbhāvabuddhyā ca tattulyo jāyate priye (!) |
ekādaśyāṃ prātareva tataḥ saṅkalpayedvratī |
trikālaṃ pūjayedviṣṇumagnikāryasamanvitam |
ekenaivopavāsena kṛtena parameśvari (!) |
sarvapāpairviśuddhātmā harisāyujyamāpnuyāt |
jāgaraṃ kārayedrātrau saṃhitāśravaṇādibhiḥ |
na cātra vāradoṣo'sti māghe caiva ghaṭeṣu ca |
utthāne śayane viṣṇorvāsarantu na laṅghayet |
dinakṣaye daśāviddhe sadaiva parivarjayet |
gṛhasthastu viśeṣeṇa putravāṃścedviśeṣataḥ |
naktaṃ puṇyakṣayaścaiva pūrvasaṅkalpitaṃ vinā |
dvādaśyāmapyuṣaḥkāle snānaṃ kuryānnadījale |
dhātrīsnānaṃ prakuryāttu mahāpātakanāśanam |
govindaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā dhenuṃ dadyāttato vratī |
dānañcaivāgnikāryañca brāhmaṇānatha yojayet |
śṛṇu devi (!) mahāguhyaṃ śrīviṣṇorvratapañcakam |
vibhūtidvādaśī nāma pañcaiva parikīrtitāḥ |
kārtikasya ca mārgasya māghasya phālgunasya ca |
āṣāḍhasya varārohe (!) dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣake |
śrāvaṇasya tu siṃhasya aśūnyā nāma dvādaśī |
janārdanaṃ samuddiśya upavāsaṃ karoti yaḥ |
aśūnyā ca bhavet śayyā janmajanmani śaṅkari (!) |
trayodaśyāntu śuklāyāṃ vibhūtyākhyā trayodaśī |
mādhavaṃ kalase kṛtvā bhūtimāpnoti śāśvatīm |
māghe māsi site pakṣe khyātā rāmacaturdaśī |
kāmaviddhāpi sā kāryā śivarātrividhānataḥ |
paurṇamāsyāmuṣaḥkāle snānaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ |
sampūjya ca jagannāthaṃ dānaṃ dadyādvibhūtaye |
dhenuṃ dadyādvijātibhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
indhanañcaiva pakvānnaṃ haviṣyānnena varttayet |
kṛṣṇapakṣe pratipadi skandamuddiśya yatnataḥ |
dānaṃ dadyāddvijāgrebhyaḥ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ |
dvitīyāyāṃ jagannāthaṃ samuddiśya prapūjayet |
pradadyāccarunaivedyaṃ haviṣyānnena varttayet |
tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā dharmaṃ citraguptaṃ samarcayet |
piṣṭakāśī bhavedrātrī dharmalokādbhaveccyutiḥ |
caturthyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu lakṣmīṃ kumbhe samarccayet |
pāyasāśī bhavennityaṃ ramāyā na cyutirbhavet |
pañcabhyāṃ madanaṃ devaṃ gopālaṃ rukmiṇīmapi |
citre vākṣatapuñjeṣu naro na nirayaṃ vrajet |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ dhanvantariṃ śambhuṃ kumāraṃ pūjayenniśi |
kṣīrakumbhe maheśāni (!) na śoko jāyate bhuvi |
saptamyāṃ kamalānāthaṃ ghṛtakumbhe samarcayet |
vāridhārāṃ tao dadyādbhāryayā ca vratasya vai |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāñca vilvapatreṇa śaṅkaram |
trikālaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā pārvatyā saha gomaye |
piṇḍebhyo'rcya hṛṣīkeśamekabhaktena varttayet |
daśamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya gaṅgāṃ sampūjayedvratī |
ekādaśyāṃ haviṣyāśī mādhavañca samarccayet |
trayodaśyāṃ tathā kāmaṃ caturdaśyāñca pratyuṣe |
anarkābhyudite kāle snānaṃ kuryāt sarijjale |
śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati |
raṭantī nāma vikhyātā sarvapāpaharā śivā ||
vṛhannīlatantre saptamapaṭale ||
mādhe māsyasite pakṣe raṭantyākhyā caturdaśī |
tasyāṃ sampūjayettārāṃ mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ |
cakravarttī mahārājo bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||
matsyasūkte ||
amāvasyāṃ kṛtasnānastilānnena maheśvari (!) |
śrāddhaṃ kuryāddhaviṣyāśī pitṛloke mahīyate ||
iti māghakṛtyam ||
matsyasūkte |
śrībhagavānuvāca ||
kumbhasaṃsthe sahasrāṃśau pūjāmārabhya deśikaḥ |
tathā kṛṣṇe maheśāni (!) pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
brahmāṇañcaiva gāyatrīṃ satīṃ gaurīṃ jayantikām |
kamalāṃ pārvatīñcaiva mahāmahiṣamardinīm |
sarasvatīṃ mahāmāyāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ ratiṃ tathā |
kālarātrimumāñcaiva yajettairupacārakaiḥ |
karṇenākarṇanī tūrṇī pūrṇā madanaprītidā |
krīḍayeyuśca pūrvāhṇe narāḥ sindūramaṇḍitāḥ |
pūjayecca maheśāni (!) gopālaṃ gopivallabham |
mandāraiḥ kiṃśukaiścaiva tathā cūtāṅkurairapi |
pūjayedvidhivaddevaṃ śivikāyāṃ tatonyasyet |
muhūrte'bhijite pañcavādyairyātrāṃ samācaret ||
nāradapañcarātre dvitīyarātre saptamādhyāye ||
paraṃ śivacaturdaśyāṃ śivaṃ samprāpya pūjanam |
taddine'naśanaṃ vipra (!) paraṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam |
matsyasūkte ||
śivavratamatho vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
candrābje karaṇe devi (!) rudrasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
caturdaśyāmamāvāsyādivasaṃ yadi saṃspṛśet |
yadā taryodaśī candrā trayodaśyāṃ śivavratam |
prāpnonyatulabhogantu yasya rātrau caturdaśī |
śivarātrivrataṃ tatra kartavyaṃ tithipūjanam |
māghaphālgunayormadhye yā ca kṛṣṇā caturdaśī |
śivayogena saṃyuktā śivarātrirudāhṛtā |
divāsparśe vrataṃ vidyādrātrau vā pūrṇameva tu |
hīnenaiva vrataṃ kuryāt śivayogasya śaṅkari (!) |
māghītaṃ parato yā syāt kṛṣṇā māghī caturdaśī |
tasyāṃ sampūjanādeva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
yogatithyantare caiva praveśañca samācaret |
na rātrau pāraṇaṃ kuryānna sandhyāyāṃ kathañcana |
snānamāvāhanaṃ kuryāccaturdaśyāḥ samāgame |
āture mārjanaṃ jñeyaṃ snānāt koṭiguṇaṃ phalam |
ekādaśaguṇaṃ kuryānnaivedyaṃ parameśvari (!) |
baliñca trividaṃ kuryāt śṛṇuṣva varavarṇini (!) |
aṣṭamyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmathāpi vā |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī skandaṣaṣṭhī śivarātricaturdaśī |
ghaniṣṭhā śivayoge ca yā ca kṛṣṇā caturdaśī |
rātriyoge tu samprāptā sā tu puṇyatamāmatā |
yogasparśe puṇyamātraṃ rātriyoge'dhikaṃ phalam |
sarvarātrau daśaguṇaṃ divāsparśe sahasrakam |
snātvā saṃsthāpayelliṅgaṃ sthaṇḍile yatra pūjayet |
tatra vai darpaṇe kuryāt śālagrāme manau tathā |
vāriṇā prathame snānaṃ pañcanadyeti vā punaḥ |
āpyāyasyeti kṣīreṇa dadhikrāvneti vai dadhi |
madhuvāteti madhunā gāyatryā ca guḍenaṃ ca |
āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa tathā ratnodakairapi |
toyenānena mantreṇa tathā pañcāmṛtena tu |
mārjayedvilvapatreṇa ghaṭasthāpanamārabhet |
saṅkalpānte paṭhenmantraṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭena tu |
adya śaiva caturdaśyāṃ jāgarayāmyahaṃ niśām |
pūjāṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ kārayāmyagra śaktitaḥ |
śiva (!) śaṅkara (!) sarvajña (!) vratānāṃ phaladāyaka (!) |
śivarātrivrataṃ deva (!) karomi tvatprasādataḥ |
caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāro bhūtvā caivāpare'hani |
bhokṣye'haṃ bhuktimuktyarthaṃ śaraṇaṃ me bhaveśvara (!) |
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret |
gaṇeśaṃ dikpatīṃścaiva grahāścaiva marudgaṇān |
brahmāṇaṃ pratikumbhe ca tato devāsanaṃ yajet |
nandinañca mahākālaṃ pūrvadvāri yajedbudhaḥ |
bhūteśaṃ caṇḍapāṇiñca dakṣiṇadvāri saṃyajet |
uttare caiva vetālaṃ vṛṣabhañca tato yajet |
madhye ādhāraśaktyādīn sāṅgopāṅgaṃ samarccayet |
dhyāyeddevaṃ maheśānaṃ dhyānaṃ śṛṇu varānane (!) |
vṛṣāsanagataṃ padmaṃ tatra padmāsane sthitam |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśamaṇimādiguṇairyutam |
daśabhirbāhubhirdhatte śūlaśaktivarābhayam |
khaṭvāṅgaṃ bhujagañcaiva ghaṇṭāṅkuśaṃ tathaiva ca |
ḍamaruṃ bījapūrañca nīlotpalavaraṃ tathā |
dvātriṃśallakṣaṇopetaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam |
icchādiśaktisahitaṃ bījenāropayettataḥ |
aṅgapūjāṃ vidhāyātha dadyāt pādyādikaṃ śubham |
tataḥ svaśaktisaṃyuktān pūrvādidigdale yajet |
śrīkaṇṭhādīṃśca tadvāhye mūrtīraṣṭau ca saṃ yajet |
upacāraiḥ samabhyarcya aṅgapūjāvasānake |
anana vidhimantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ vibhūtaye |
dadhidūrvākṣatañcaiva gandhapuṣpasamanvitam |
jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā mantreṇānena sādhakaḥ |
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sarvapāpaharāya ca |
śivarātrau dadāmyarghyaṃ prasīda umayā saha |
trimadhvaktena deveśi (!) prathamaprahareṇa tu |
modakaṃ pāyasānnaṃ vā saṃyuktaṃ vā viśiṣyate |
dvitīyaprahare caiva svayaṃ syādvāruṇena tu |
snānaṃ kuryāttu mantreṇa śṛṇu mantraṃ varānane (!) |
ajñānatimirāndhānāṃ praṇītakalmaṣātmanām |
snānaṃ karomi deveśa (!) sarvapāpaviśuddhaye |
devañca pūrvavat snātvā pūrvavaccārcanañcaret |
rudrasūktena kāmena rudrasūktena cārcayet |
haraṃ maheśaṃ vijayaṃ yakṣeśaṃ varadaṃ śivam |
nārāyaṇañca brahmāṇaṃ pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ |
homānte pradadedarghyaṃ madhukṣīrājyasaṃyutam |
kuśapuṣpasamāyuktaṃ guḍaśarkarayānvitam |
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya bhuktimuktipradāya ca |
śivarātrau dadāmyarghyaṃ sarvābhimatasādhanam |
tṛtīyaprahare caiva snānaṃ kuryādviśuddhaye |
vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa kuśenābhyukṣya vāriṇā |
virūpākṣa (!) mahādeva (!) sucintyo me bhavādhipa (!) |
śivarātrau kṛtasnānādbhuktimuktiprado bhava |
śiva (!) śaṅkara (!) deveśa (!) prabho (!) paśupate (!) hara (!) |
hṛhāṇārghyamidaṃ deva (!) umākānta (!) prasīda me |
dattvārghyaṃ vidhivaddevi (!) pūjayenmanmathaṃ haram |
yogeśaṃ mādhavaṃ dharmaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ tathaiva ca |
caturthaprahare caiva snānaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ |
mārjanañca tataḥ kuryānmantreṇānena sundari (!) |
yathāṣṭakoṭiliṅgānāṃ yat phalaṃ pūjanādvibho (!) |
tadetat prāpyate nātha (!) śivarātrau snānakarmaṇā |
pāvakaṃ bhuvanaṃ viṣṇu narasiṃhaṃ śatakratum |
janārdanaṃ mādhavañca madhyapīṭhe samarcayet |
gaurīñca vīrabhadrañca candrārddhakṛtaśekharam |
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthamarghyo me pratigṛhyatām |
saṃsārakleśadagdhasya vratenānena śaṅkara (!) |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ śivarātrau prasīda me |
prabhāte ca tataḥ kṛtvā nityaṃkṛtyaṃ samāhitaḥ |
devaṃ tryambakamantreṇa snāpayet pūjayettataḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivaddadyāt pāraṇañca samācaret |
namaḥ śivāyeti mantreṇa brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ |
vṛhannīlatantre saptamapaṭale |
prāṅgaṇe madhyarātrau ca phālgune māsi sundari (!) |
caturdikṣu maheśāni (!) kadalīkhaṇḍamuttamam |
apāpayāge deveśi (!) maṇḍapaṃ kāraya priyam |
cūtāśvatthavaṭairdevi (!) channaṃ kuryācca maṇḍapam |
kumārīveṣṭitaṃ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ sarvamohanam |
tārāmūrtistathā kālīmūrttirvā devarājaka (!) |
sarvakāryapradāṃ deva (!) tāṃ kuruṣva maheśvara (!) |
annadā mūrtimetāṃ hi kuru vā suravandita (!) |
paṭṭavastrairmahādevyai baliṃ yatnena dāpayet |
āsanaṃ kambalaṃ dadyāt svāgataṃ madhunirmitam |
pādyantu payamā dadyādarghyaṃ dadyāt kuśena ca |
madhuparkaṃ ghṛtenaiva jalenācamanīyakam |
krameṇa snānamācarya vasanaṃ lohitaṃ smṛtam |
rajatābharaṇaṃ dadyāt sarvadevamanoramam |
taṇḍulena vinā deva (!) naivedyaṃ dāpayet priya (!) |
carvyaṃ coṣyaṃ tathā lehyaṃ peyaṃ dadyānmanoramam |
raktacandanabījena japedaṣṭasahasrakam |
śuklapratipadārabhya navamyāñca samāpayet |
baliṃ dadyānmahādevyaichāgena mahiṣeṇa vā |
annaṃ matsyaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ ghṛtaṃ paramaśobhanam |
piṣṭakaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ dadyāddevyai manoramam |
homayed devadeveśa (!) yathāśakti vidhānataḥ |
kumārīṃ pūjayedyatnairdravyairbahuvidhairapi |
homādikantu sakalaṃ kumārīpūjanaṃ vinā |
paripūrṇaphalaṃ naiva saphalaṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet |
tataḥ sakalasiddhyarthaṃ kumārīṃ vā prapūjayet ||
tathā |
tāriṇīṃ kālikāñcaivānnapūrṇāṃ bhairavīṃ parām |
sampūjya vidhivadbhaktyā sarvasiddhirbhaviṣyati |
pūjāvidhānaṃ deveśa (!) śrītumarhasyasaṃśayaḥ ||
matsyasūkte saptapañcāśatpaṭale |
śrībhagavānuvāca |
atha māsāśritaṃ karma vakṣye devi (!) samāsataḥ |
yathākrama yathākālaṃ yathāśakti vidhānataḥ |
vratastho dāpayeddānaṃ yajñaṃ kuryādvratāgame |
pratigrahaṃ vinodañca strīṇāṃ samprekṣaṇādikam |
bhojanaṃ kāṃsyalauhe ca tāmbūlasya ca bhakṣaṇam |
kṣārañca kaṭukañcaiva varjayenmūlakaṃ tathā |
vilvayāvakamāṣāṃśca tiktānnaṃ mākṣikaṃ tyajet |
śākaṃ sarvavrate śastaṃ sakṛtpakvaṃ viśiṣyate |
mūlapatrakaraurādiphalakāntādiyojanam ||
iti phālgunakṛtyam ||
rāmārcanacandrikāyāṃ pañcamapaṭale |
madhau śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ jānakīramaṇaṃ prabhum |
rājopacāraiḥ sampūjya rāmamāmantrayet kalau |
dolārūḍhaṃ prapaśyanti ye kṛṣṇaṃ madhumādhave |
aparādhasahasraistu muktāste nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dolārūḍhasya devasya ye'gre kurvanti jāgaram |
samyak puṇyaphalāvāptirnimiṣe nimiṣe bhavet |
caitraśuklanavamyāntu karttavyaṃ vratamuttamam |
rāma eva paraṃ brahma taddinaṃ rāmatoṣakam |
vratasya vistārastatrānusandheyo'tra tu granthagauravabhiyā na likhitaḥ |
taddine upavāsasyāvaśyakatvamapi tatraiva |
yastu rāmanavamyāntu bhuṅkte mohādvimūḍhadhīḥ |
kumbhīpākeṣu ghoreṣu pacyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
upavāsāsamarthasya ekabhaktamapyuktaṃ tatraiva |
navamyāmekabhaktena aṅgabhūtena rāghavaḥ |
ikṣvākuvaṃśatilakaḥ prīto bhavati nānyathā |
tathā |
ekabhaktavratī tatra sahācāryo jitendriyaḥ |
śṛṇvan rāmakathāṃ divyāmahaḥ śeṣaṃ nayenmune (!) |
anyat sarvaṃ tithitattvādāvanusandheyam |
tathā |
dvādaśyāṃ caitramāsasya śuklāyāṃ damanotsava |
baudhāyanādibhiḥ proktaḥ karttavyaḥ prativatsaram |
tatra syāt svīyatithiṣu vahnyādau damanārpaṇam |
vahnirviriñcirgirijā gaṇeśaḥ phaṇī viśākho dinakṛnmaheśaḥ |
durgāntako vighnaharismarāśca sarve'pi pīṭhe'tra tithau tu pūjyāḥ |
damanotsavayātrā tatraivānusandheyā atra tu granthagauravabhiyā na likhitā |
tatphalantu tatraiva |
svayaṃ dhṛtvābhyarcya bandhūn viprān sambhojya pārayet |
syādaśvamedhajaṃ puṇyamityāha bhagavān śivaḥ |
pāraṇāhena labhyeta dvādaśī ghaṭikā na cet |
tadā trayodaśī grāhyāpavitrā damanārpaṇe |
mādhave damanāropaḥ syānmadhau vismṛto yadi |
vaiśākhyāṃ śrāvaṇe bhādre karttavyaṃ vā tadarpaṇam ||
iti caitrakṛtyam |
vaiśākhe paurṇamāsyāntu jalasthaṃ jagadīśvaram |
śuklāmekādaśīṃ yāvat pūjayettaṃ praharṣitaḥ |
nikṣipya jalapātre tu māse mādhavasaṃjñite |
mādhavaṃ ye'rcayiṣyanti devāste na narā bhuvi |
svarṇapātre tathā raupye tāmre vā mṛṇmaye'pi vā |
toyasthaṃ yo'rcayeddevaṃ śālagrāmasamudbhavam |
pratimāṃ vā mahābhāga (!) tasya puṇyamanantakam |
tasmāt jyaiṣṭhe sadā bhūpa (!) toyasthaṃ pūjayeddharim |
vītapāpo narastiṣṭhed yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam |
jñeyaḥ kālavikalpā'yaṃ muktasya dvayameva vā |
gandhodakaṃ vā tatpātre nityapūjāṃ samāpya ca |
abhivādya divā rātrau devaṃ nītvā nijāsanam |
pañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya tīrthaṃ prāpyā visarjayet |
ātmānaṃ gṛhadārādīn tena tīrthena pāvayet |
dvādaśyānta jale rātrāvarcayedgāruḍoktitaḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayedrātrau jalasthaḥ jalaśāyitam ||
iti vaiśākhajyaiṣṭhayoḥ kṛtyam ||
tatraiva ||
āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyām kṣīrābdhiśanotsavaḥ |
kāryo'nyathā tvanāvṛṣṭirbhavet paurāṇavākyataḥ |
mithunasthe sahasrāṃśau svāpayenmadhusūdanam |
tulāñcāpi gate tasmin punarutthāpayet prabhum |
mithunasthe sahasrāṃśau na svāpayati yo harim |
vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha sambhūya hyanāvṛṣṭistadānyathā |
asmiṃstithau vaiṣṇavānāṃ mudrāṅkadhāraṇamuktaṃ tatraiva |
śaunakoktaprakāreṇa taptamudrāṅkadhāraṇam |
karttavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaiḥ sarvaiḥ sampradāyānurodhataḥ |
sāmavede'pi |
pratadviṣṇo abjacakre sutapte janmāmbhodhā uttare karṣaṇīndrāḥ |
mūle bāhvordadhati praṇavāni liṅgānyaṅge taptāyudhāni paryanta iti |
tatphalamuktamatharvaṇā |
yathā |
urukramasya cinhairaṅkitā loke urubhāgā bhavantīti |
brāhmaṇasyāpi vaiṣṇavasyāṅkadhāraṇamuktaṃ rāmārcanacandrikāyām |
yathā |
agnihotraṃ tathā nityaṃ vedasyādhyayanaṃ tathā |
brāhmaṇasya tathaivedaṃ taptacakrāṅkadhāraṇam |
yadyapi vaiṣṇavasyeti noktaṃ kevalaṃ brāhmaṇasyeti tathāpyatra prāguktavacanaikavākyatayā vaiṣṇavasyeti labhyate |
dhāraṇa kramastu tatraiva |
ṣoḍaśopacārairbhagavantamabhyarcya cākṣare parame vyoma śanno mitrasaṃbaruṇa ityetābhyāṃ cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ cābhyarcya dvādaśākṣaram |
nahi tajjarāyāgnermathe prathamasya pracetasamityābhyām agnāvādadhyāt |
vaiśvadevasya syāmityagniṣvarthayet |
puruṣasūktena śatamāhutīrhutvā bhagavantaṃ puruṣasūktenopastutya yo brāhmaṇamiti daṇḍavat purato nipatet |
tataḥ |
sudarśana (!) mahājvāla (!) sūryakoṭisamaprabham |
ajñātārthasya me nityaṃ viṣṇormārgaṃ pradarśaya ||
iti gṛhītvā oṃ sudarśanāya vidmahe mahājvālāya dhīmahi tannaścakraṃ pracodayāditi cakrādhānam |
tataḥ |
pāñcajanya (!) mahādhvāna (!)(!) dhvastapātakasañcaya (!) |
pāhi māṃ pāpinaṃ ghorasaṃsārārṇavapātitam ||
ityādāya pāñcajanyāya vidmahe pavamānāya dhīmahi tannaḥ śaṅkhaḥ pracodayāditi śaṅkhādhānam ||
mudrādhāraṇaphalamapi tatraiva ||
ya evaṃ kurute vidvān brāhmaṇaḥ śrotriyaḥ śuciḥ |
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta viṣṇulokañca gacchati |
athavā utthānadvādaśyāmapi mudrāṅkadhāraṇam kāryyam |
śayanyāñcaiva bodhinyāṃ cakratīrthe tathaiva ca |
śaṅkhacakravidhānena vahnipūto bhavennaraḥ ||
iti taddhṛtavacanāditi mudrādhāraṇavidhiḥ ||
prāṇyaṅgacūrṇaṃ carmmāmbujambīre bījapūrakam |
ayajñamiṣṭamannādyaṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam |
dagdhamannaṃ masūrañca māṣañcetyaṣṭadhāmiṣam |
rucyaṃ tattaddeśalabhyaṃ phalamūlādi varjayet |
niṣpāvān rājamāṣāṃśca masūrasanmitāni ca |
vṛntākuñca kaliṅga supte deve na bhakṣayet |
matsyasūkte aṣṭapañcāśatapaṭale ||
dharaṇyāmṛtumatyāntu tathā sapta dināni ca |
vaṭe somavaṭe caiva na datte'pi madhūjake |
pūjayet kṣetrapālañca jayapālaṃ mahābalam |
nagaragrāmapīṭhādye hyagastye cottare'pi vā |
na kuryādgrāmamadhye tu na koṇe'pi varānane (!) |
uttarāśāṃ gate sūryaṃ puṇyarkṣe tu śubhe'hani |
sthāpayet prathamaṃ vṛkṣaṃ sthiro bhava itīrayan |
snāpayet pañcagavyena triḥsūtreṇa ca veṣṭayet |
kṛtākṛtajñavipreṇa sthitabhāryeṇa sundari (!) |
vṛṣānte tridinañcaiva mithanānte dinatrayam |
ravisaṃkramaṇe madhye bhūmidāhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
kalau dinatrayaṃ varjyaṃ vṛṣānte mithunāditaḥ |
ravisaṃkramaṇe caiva bhūmīdāho dinatrayam |
bhūmidāhe tyajet sarvaṃ dāhe dāhaphalaṃ labhet |
vyavahāre koṣahāniḥ putrasyotpādanāt kṣām |
pragrahe darśane strīṇāmasaubhāgyaṃ vijānīhi |
tasya śāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi kṛtsnāṃ cāmīkaraṃ phalam |
dadyāddoṣopaśāntyarthaṃ dadyādvā tilakāñcanam |
kāmyaṃ naimittikañcaiva yātrā mantraṃ kriyāṃ tathā |
ṛtumatyāṃ na kurvīta pūrvasaṅkalpitāṭṭate |
na kuryāt khananaṃ bhūmeḥ sūcyagreṇāpi śaṅkari (!) |
bījānāṃ vapanañcaiva caturviṃśatiyāmakam |
pramādādvapanaṃ kṛtvā gāśca tatra pracārayet |
kṛcchraṃ kuryādbhakṣaṇācca khananāttilakāñcanam |
durgādyā mātaraḥ sarvā ṛtumatyo bhavanti ṣaṭ |
jaiminiśca sumantuśca vaiśampāyana eva ca |
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva pañcaiva pañcaite vavvavādṛṇāḥ |
paṭhedvā dhārayedgehe na vavvāgnibhayaṃ tathā |
meṣe vṛṣe ca mithune dadyādvāri suśītalam |
pratimāyāṃ mahāliṅge śālagrāme tathaiva ca |
yajñavṛkṣasya mūle vā pañca tridhārayānvitam |
muhūrttamapi yo dadyānmama viṣṇoḥ śiropari |
vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya modate brahmaṇā saha |
śālagrāmaśilāyāntu aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet |
viprāya modakaṃ dattvā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet |
tṛṣārtebhyo'pi jantubhyaḥ svargaloke mahīyate |
kuśāgraniḥsṛtaṃ vāri yo dadāti dine dine |
deheṣu tarumūleṣu viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati |
gandhodakasya yo dhārāṃ guḍakṣīramathāpi vā |
ekaikaṃ vāriṇā siktaṃ candanokṣitameva vā |
dinaikaṃ madhudhārāpi paraṃ brahmādhigacchati |
karpūrāgurusammiśraṃ yo dadyāt śarkarānvitam |
sa svarge vipulān bhogān bhuṅkte ca pitṛbhiḥ saha ||
ityāṣāḍhakṛtyam ||
rāmārccanacandrikāyām ||
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ śaunakādibhiḥ |
uktastadā prakartavyaḥ pavitrāropaṇotsavaḥ |
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ |
hariśca prītimāpnoti yaḥ pavitraṃ samācaret |
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena yo na kuryāt pavitrakam |
haranti rākṣasāstasya sarvaṃ pūjādikaṃ phalam ||
iti śrāvaṇakṛtyam ||
tatraiva ||
atha bhādrapade śukladvādaśyāṃ karṇikotsavaḥ |
karttavyo vaiṣṇavaiḥ sārddhaṃ śayanotsavavaddhareḥ |
prāpte bhādrapade māsi ekādaśyāṃ site'hani |
kaṭadānaṃ bhavedviṣṇormahāpātakanāśanam |
śayanotsavarītyā tu devaṃ nītvā jalāśayam |
kaṭadānotsavaṃ kurve iti saṅkalpya pūjayet |
devadeva (!) jagannātha (!) yogagamya (!) janārdana (!) |
kaṭadānaṃ karomyadya prāpte bhādrapade śubhe |
anena dakṣiṇāvṛttaṃ dakṣiṇāṅge prakalpayet |
mahāpūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūrvavat svagṛhaṃ vrajet ||
iti bhādrakṛtyam ||
atha varṣakṛtyam ||
varadātantre dvitīyapaṭale ||
ādyāyākhyakṣarīmadhikṛtya ||
karma kuryāt phalāvāptyai candrādiśobhane budhaḥ |
binā naimittikaṃ devi (!) anyathā viphalaṃ bhavet [ vārṣikī kālikā pūjā rājyadā'nyakriyāṃ vinā |
sā cāpi tatra karttavyā śṛṇuṣva parameśvari (!) |
sā pūjā iti |
rājyadā dhanadā pūjā jayadā'śubhasaṅkule |
śatrukāryakṣatikarī nijakāryaprasādhinī |
rājavaśyapradā sarvaṃ grahadoṣanivārikā |
prakāśe doṣadā śīghraphaladā kathyate mayā |
mahāviṣuvasaṃkrāntyā savastraṃ ghaṭamutsṛjet |
upānahau] ca chatrañca kālīprīṇanahetave |
akṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tathaivamutsṛjedghaṭam |
svarṇaṃ vā rājataṃ vāpi tejasaṃ mārttikaṃ tathā |
vaiśākhe jaladānantu svarṇadānasamaṃ priye (!) |
jyaiṣṭhe pakvānnadānena āṣāḍhe panasena ca |
śrāvaṇe paramānnena pūjayet parameśvarīm |
bhādre tu piṭakaiḥ pūjā āśvine śāradotsavaḥ |
bhagavatyai ratnavastraṃ dattvānyaddravyameva ca |
paścāt svayañca tadgrāhyaṃ kārttike śītavāsasā |
navānnena mārgaśīrṣe navamudgena pauṣake |
māghe ca phālgune caiva dugdhena ca ghṛtena ca |
caitre dadhnā mahāpūjā sarvaduḥkhavināśinī |
iyaṃ te vārṣikī pūjā sarvasāmrājyadāyinī |
ātmapriyaṃ tathā vastu yathāvaddhi nivedayet |
vārṣikīṣu maheśāni (!) sarvābhīṣṭāni sādhayet |
etattu dakṣiṇāvidyāviṣaye sādhakottamaḥ |
kuryādyaḥ prativarṣantu sa bhavedbhūmipāgraṇīḥ |
pañcavarṣe bhavedrāṣṭraṃ sāmrājyaṃ daśavarṣake |
viṃśavarṣe maheśāni (!) mahāsāmrājyadāyinī |
lakṣādhipatyaṃ rājyaṃ syāt sāmrājyaṃ daśalakṣake |
śatalakṣe maheśāni (!) mahāsāmrājyamāpnuyāt |
dāso'pi bhṛtyatāṃ tyaktvā akasmājjāyate mahān |
manasā na smṛtaṃ yattu vacasā kathitaṃ na yat |
dakṣiṇāsevakaḥ satyaṃ tathā rājyamavāpnuyāt ||
pañcamamaṭale |
atirājyasya rājyāptisādhanaṃ kathayāmi te |
śubhe kāle samārabhya varṣamekaṃ samācaret |
candratārānukūlaṃ hi dinaṃ grāhyaṃ maheśvari (!) |
prātaḥ snātvā śuddhavāsaḥ paridhāya prasannadhīḥ |
saṅkalpaṃ hṛtarājyasya lābhāya samupācaret |
kālikā tryakṣarīvidyāmadhigamya gurormukhāt |
sādhanaṃ vidhivat kṛtvāvaśyaṃ rājyamavāpnuyāt |
ādye'hni pūjayeddevīṃ javākuṅkumavarbaraiḥ |
pūjānte parameśāni (!) sahasraṃ prajapenmanum |
janaśūnyagṛhe sthitvā samāpya japamuttamam |
tatastu juhuyāt sāṣṭaśataṃ dūrvāghṛtendukaiḥ |
mantreṇānena deveśi (!) kālāgurughṛtena vā |
kāli (!) kāli (!) tato rājeśvari (!) rājyaprade (!) padam |
rājyaṃ dehi padañcoktvā dayāmayi (!) padaṃ ṭhaṭhaḥ |
idaṃ hi paramaṃ mūlamantraṃ rājyāptaye śive (!) |
japahomau tu karttavyau mantreṇānena deśikaḥ |
svecchāccāro'tra deveśi (!) sthānādiśodhanaṃ na ca |
tataḥ pratidinaṃ yāvadvarṣamekaṃ japenmanum |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ mantraṃ kadācinna parityajet |
na pūraścaraṇāpekṣā mantre'smin parameśvari (!) |
bhūmilagnaikapādastu paurṇamāsyāṃ japenmanum |
kālāgurudraveṇaiva tatsakhye tarpayecchivām |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vilvavṛkṣaṃ caturdaśyāṃ javātarum |
amāvasyāsu sarvāsu śephālītarumuttamam |
spṛṣṭvā japeddaśa daśa vārān sūryodaye vratī |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pūjyedatiyatnataḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā ratrau cāpi japecchatam |
evaṃ dvādaśamāseṣu kṛtvā rājyamavāpnuyāt |
kṛtenaitena deveśi (!) prayogo nāti yatnataḥ |
indratulyena ripuṇā hṛtaṃ rājyamavāpnuyāt |
varṣamadhye yadi ripurbalavān sādhako bhavet |
tacchaktināśakāmo'tra cared yat kathayāmi te |
amukaṃ stambhaya svāhā kālikā tryakṣarīpuṭam |
brāhmaṇe guruvāre tu kṣatriye śukravāsare |
vaiśye maṅgalavāre ca śūdreravisutāhani |
pūrvāhṇe prajapenmantrasahasraṃ nirjanasthale |
evaṃ pañcadine kṛtvā pūjayedghoradakṣiṇām |
śatrornāmākṣararkṣe tu unmattamūlamuttamam |
utpāṭya parameśāni (!) kuṅkumena vigharṣayet |
candracandanakarpūrajātīlavaṅgasaṃyutam |
kucandanaṃ javāṃ dūrvāmekīkṛtya baliṃ diśet |
mantreṇānena deveśi (!) rāmatattvākhyamudrayā |
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya kālike (!) kālarātrike (!) |
maddattaṃ padamuccārya gṛhṇa gṛhṇa padadvayam |
amukasya ripoḥ kāryyaṃ vināśaya padadvayam |
chindhi chindhi matha matha mama rājyaṃ pradāpaya |
ṭhadvayenaiva manunā aṣṭamyāṃ balimādiśet |
balidānena deveśi (!) kṣīṇaśaktirbhavedripuḥ |
ātmīyarājyarakṣārthamakṣamastatkṣaṇādbhavet |
evaṃ kṛte varṣamadhye'vaśyaṃ rājyamavāpnuyāt |
prāpte rājye varārohe (!) kālikāṃ ghoranisvanām |
pūjayedbahujātīyairdravyaiśca balibhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
toṣayedbrāhmaṇāvārīrdīnān dhanagaṇairapi |
tadeva sthirarājyaḥ syānnānyathā viphalaṃ bhavet |
na nārīṃ nindayedvācā karmmaṇā manasāpi vā |
brāhmaṇānapi deveśi (!) sthirarājyāya sarvadā ||
atha devīṣoḍaśayātrāḥ ||
vāmakeśvaratantre catuḥpañcāśatpaṭale ||
bhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi (!) pravakṣyāmi yātrāvidhimanuttamam |
tava yātrā maheśāni (!) ṣoḍaśī parikīrtitā |
dvādaśeṣveva māseṣu amāvasyā praśasyate |
tasyāṃ pūjādikarmāṇi kurvāṇo mokṣamāpnuyāt |
kulavāre kulatithau pūjayet prajapenniśi |
kulavārau tu vijñeyau kujamandau maheśvari (!) |
caturdaśyaṣṭamī caiva amāvasyātha pūrṇimā |
navamī ca mahādevi (!) tithayaḥ kulasaṃjñakāḥ |
tatra saṃkrāntiyogena mahāyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
asmin dine maheśāni (!) devīpūjā sukhapradā |
vaiśākhe mañcayātrā ca candanāgurukalpanā |
jyaiṣṭhe mahāsnānayātrā ambuvācīdinatrayam |
aṣāḍhe rathayātrā ca digdinavyāpinī parā |
śrāvaṇe jalayātrā ca vastrabhūṣaṇacāmaraiḥ |
bhādre yātrā dhūnanākhyā caṇḍikāyā dinatrayam |
āśvine ca mahāpūjā yātrā yajñabalipriyā |
kārtike dīpayātrā ca navānnamagrahāyaṇe |
pauṣe cāṅgarāgayātrā vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
māghe māsi mahādevi (!) raṭantī ca caturdaśī |
dolākeliḥ phālgune ca caitre catuṣṭayau |
dūtīyātrā rāsayātrā vāsantī nīlayātrikā |
evaṃ yātrā proktā ṣoḍaśī bhavamocanī ||
devyuvāca ||
saṃkṣepāt kathitā deve (!) yātrā ca ṣoḍaśī prabho (!) |
kena vā kriyate yātrā vidhānaṃ brūhi me prabho (!) |
bhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi (!) pravakṣyāmi sārātsārataraṃ vacaḥ |
yat kṛtvā sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ kriyātīto bhavet priye (!) |
gurvājñayā kriyātītaścābhiṣikto jitendriyaḥ |
kāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryavarjitaḥ |
gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa devīmālambya yatnataḥ |
pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmabhiḥ |
atmavat pūjayeddevīṃ divārātrikrameṇa ca |
prātaḥkāle dantakāṣṭhairmukhaprakṣālanaṃ caret |
dhautavastraṃ paridhāpya tailābhyaṅgañca kārayet |
sugandhinā jalenaiva devyāḥ snānaṃ prakalpayet |
pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā yathāvittānusārataḥ |
pūjāvasāne deveśi (!) bhāvayedvākyasambhavaiḥ |
vākyasambhavaiḥ stavairityarthaḥ |
śāyayitvā vicitrāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ sukhahetave |
tata utthāpya mandhyāyāṃ dīpairnnīrājanañcaret |
rātrau tithiviśeṣe ca pūjyā tvamasi sādhakaiḥ |
annaṃ vyañjanasaṃyuktaṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ saśarkaram |
panasāmraphalañcaiva dāḍimaṃ nāgaraṅgakam |
yadutatkṛṭatamaṃ loke dadyāt sādhakasattamaḥ |
madhu māṃsaṃ piṣṭakañca pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam |
matsyaṃ pravīṇaṃ mudrāñca candravimbanibhāṃ parām |
nārikelaṃ tarambūñca kharjūraṃ tālapiṣṭakam |
panasāmraphalañcaiva dāḍimaṃ nāgaraṅgakam |
dhyānaniṣṭho japāviṣṭastato dhīro jitendriyaḥ |
vārṣikīṃ prārabhed yātrāṃ śṛṇu tat sāvadhānataḥ ||
pañcapañcāśat ||
vaiśākhe pūrṇimāyāñca mañcaṃ hastacauṣṭayam |
dīrghamāyatamevaṃ taduccamānaṃ prakīrttitam |
tatra saṃsthāpya deveśīṃ gītavādyādimaṅgalaiḥ |
candanāgurukarpūrakuṅkumālaktasindūraiḥ |
mṛganābhimākṣikaiśca gātramārjanamācaret |
snānañca kārayeddevyāḥ karpūravāsitairjalaiḥ |
mandire ca tato pūjayitvā yathāvidhi |
homaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ dattvā santoṣya bhojanādibhiḥ |
kumārīṃ pūjayitvā ca brāhmaṇaḥnapi bhojayet |
evaṃ vidhividhānajño yātrāṃ kṛtvā virājate |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi mahāsnānaṃ karpūrādisuvāsibhiḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataiḥ pūrṇaiḥ kalasaiḥ snāpayettataḥ |
vastrairgātraṃ mārjayitvā dhūpayed ghṛtaguggulaiḥ |
mañcācca mandire nītvā baliṃ pūjāñca homayet |
gandhāṣṭakairaṅgarāgaṃ kārayitvā yathāvidhi |
vidhinā kārayeddevi (!) svīkumārīdvijārcanam |
prasādaṃ bhakṣayet paścāt putradārasvabandhubhiḥ |
itthaṃ yātrāvidhiṃ kṛtvā vihared bhairavo yathā |
āṣāḍheprathame deve (!) ambu vācīdinatrayam |
saṅgopana gṛhe devīṃ sthāpayedvastraveṣṭanaiḥ |
rātrau mahāniśāyoge pañcācāreṇa deśikaḥ |
pūjayitvā baliṃ dattvā homayitvā vihārayet |
śuklapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ rathe saṃsthāpya caṇḍikām |
cālayennṛtyagītaiśca svecchācāreṇa sādhakaḥ |
tasmāt pūjāgṛhe nītvā balihomādinārcayet |
strīkumārīdvijān sarvān bhojayedannasambhavaiḥ |
vittaśāṣṭhyaṃ na kurvīta sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ |
śrāvaṇe jalayātrā ca vastracāmarabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
sajjīkṛtya śubhāṃ naukāṃ sādhako vāhayet svayam |
devīṃ saṃsthāpya vidhinā bhagaliṅgānukīrttanaiḥ |
tataḥ pūjāgṛhe nītvā pūjayedvidhipūrvakam |
bhādre māsi trayodaśyāmārabhya tridinaṃ śubham |
kuhau vā paurṇamāsyāṃ vā dhūnañca samācaret |
pratyahaṃ pūjayedrātrau balihomādikīrttanaḥ |
nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi mano'bhilaṣitāni ca |
dattvā striyaḥ kumārīśca viprān sarvān pratoṣayet |
āśvine ca mahāpūjāṃ navamyāmārabhet sudhīḥ |
pratyahaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ balihomamastavādibhiḥ |
pratyahaṃ bhojayedviprān kumārīśca suvāsikāḥ |
divārcyā paśuvīreṇa rātrau kaulānusārataḥ |
evañca sādhakaśreṣṭho nirvāṇaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt |
tatrāpyaśakto deveśi (!) tridinaṃ pūjayecchivām |
kārtike'mātithau devi (!) dīpayātrāṃ samācaret |
rātrau mahāniśāyoge dīpādibhiraṅkṛtam |
kṛtvā devīgṛhaṃ pūjābalihomādinārcayet |
ghṛtapradīpābhāve tu tailadīpaṃ samācaret |
mārgaśīrṣe mahādevi (!) navānnaṃ vidhipūrvakam |
matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ pāyasañca dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu |
sūpaṃ śākaṃ piṣṭakañca miṣṭānnaṃ vrīhisaṃyutam |
tilalaḍḍuṃ nārikelaṃ śarkarāguḍamiśritam |
sarvaṃ navaṃ navaṃ dadyāt pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ |
prasādaṃ bhakṣayeddevyāḥ putradārānvitaḥ sudhīḥ |
pauṣe navāni vastrāṇi nānālaṅkāraṇāni ca |
aṅgarāgavidhiṃ kṛtvā dattvā pūjāvidhiṃ caret |
vinā homena balinā brāhmaṇārādhanena ca |
pūjā naiva mahādevyāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
māghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe sureśvari (!) |
raṭantī pāpanāśārthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pāpinaṃ janam |
tasmin dine maheśāni (!) pūjayedvibhavāvadhi |
dānaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇebhyaścaṇḍikāprītaye dadet |
śrītārttāya kṣudhārttāya daridrāya yatātmane |
annaṃ vastraṃ suvarṇañca devīprītikaraṃ param |
phālgune pūrṇimāyāñca mañcaṃ kṛtvā trikhaṇḍakam |
tatra devyā āsanañca bhūṣayedvastraveṣṭanaiḥ |
caturdikṣu patākāñca rambhāñca kṣudraghaṇṭikām |
dolayet phālgune devīṃ divārātriprabhedataḥ |
pūjayedbhojayedviptrān bandhūn jñātīn sutādikān |
nṛtyagītavādyabhāṇḍaistoṣayet kālikāṃ sadā |
catre kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ dūtīyāgavidhiṃ caret |
rātrau devīṃ pūjayitvā nava kanyāḥ prapūjayet |
tadabhāvai viprakanyāṃ suveśāṃ yauvanānvitām |
nānālaṅkāravastrādyairgandhamākhyānulepanaiḥ |
bhūṣayitvā bhojayitvā svayaṃ bhojanamācaret |
kaulācāreṇa deveśi (!) rātrau pūjāvidhiṃ caret |
dūtīyāgoktamantreṇa sarvaṃ pūjādikaṃ nayet |
vāsantī tridinaṃ yāvat balihomādinā yajet |
paurṇamāsyāṃ rāsayātrāṃ devyāḥ kuryānniśārddhake |
pūrvavanmañcamāsthāpya devīṃ devyāsanaṃ yajet |
sammukhe vāsasaṃsthānaṃ bhairavībhairavānvitam |
kṛtvā tān pūjayitvā ca bhrāmayet kumbhacakravat |
kolāhalaṃ mṛdaṅgādivādyairnṛtyaiḥ sugītakaiḥ |
kuryādānandahṛdayaḥ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ |
vittāśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta devīyātrā sukhapradā |
saṃkrāntyāmārabhenmantrī nīlayātrāṃ maheśituḥ |
dhūpena dhūpayeddevi (!) mahākālasya tuṣṭaye |
mahākālena ca samaṃ rātrau devīṃ prapūjayet |
savitpradhānaivedyaṃ nānāvastusamanvitam |
dattvā stutvā nato bhūtvā gānaṃ kuryāt sabāndhavaḥ |
ānandodriktahṛdayo mantrī narttanamācaret |
śivābaliḥ prakarttavyo niśārddhe śivatuṣṭaye |
vaiśākhe pūrṇimāñcetyādyetatparyyantaṃ kaulatantreṇa samānam |
evaṃ sāṃvatsarīṃ yātrāṃ kṛtvā sādhakasattamaḥ |
guroḥ prāsādāddeveśi (!) śivatulyo na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti devīṣoḍaśayātrāḥ ||
pṛthvīvikhyātakīrtirguṇigaṇa hṛdayāmbhojasūryaprakāśaḥ snigdhaḥ sampūrṇacandrapratikṛtiramarācāryaśuddhopalabdhiḥ |
jīyāt śrīprāṇakṛṣṇāhvaya iha vibudhadruḥ sadīpāsakānāṃ bhūyāṃso mātṛkākhye vapuṣi samagaman brāhmaṇā yatprasādāt ||
śrīrāmatoṣaṇakṛtī jagatāṃ hitāya śrīprāṇakṛṣṇaparitoṣanideśavartī |
natvā sucārucaraṇāmbujāmiṣṭadevyāścakre caturthamidamuttamakāmyakāṇḍam ||
granthiḥ śākhā praśākhā stavakakiśalaye satphalañca prasūnaṃ sarvaṃ tatkāmyakāṇḍe ruciramatiphalaṃ dhīmatāṃ darśanīyam |
vidvāṃsaḥ (!) paśyatedaṃ nayanamalaharaṃ divyadṛṣṭiprasādaṃ nānāsandehanāśi pramudditahṛdayāḥ sarvalokopakarttṛ ||
[iti prāṇakṛṣṇaviśvāsānumatāyāṃ śrīrāmatoṣaṇavidyālaṅkārabhaṭṭācāryyaviracitāyāṃ śrīprāṇatoṣiṇyāṃ kāmyābhidhānaṃ caturthakāṇḍaṃ samāptam] ||
